COMMUNAL WAYS.4: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring; limited to once per night. The caster must sleep for a normal sleep cycle (minimum of four hours) for this spell to work.
COMMUNAL WAYS.5: As Intuitions I, except the caster gets to gaze 3 minutes into the future.
COMMUNAL WAYS.6: Caster gets a vision of the events surrounding the death of any 1 dead being through the eyes of the deceased, including a view of the killer, if any. Caster must be within 10' of the corpse. Corpse must have died within a number of years equal to the caster’s level.
COMMUNAL WAYS.7: Caster can open a channel with any 1 known being the caster is acquainted with. This spell will enable the caster to learn the specific location (direction and distance only) of the other being, making it possible for the caster to use a Channels spell (see Channels list). Note that this spell does not allow any sort of communication, although the target will know that a Channel has been opened to him.
COMMUNAL WAYS.8: As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 5 minutes into the future.
COMMUNAL WAYS.9: Caster gains a +50 to his Attunement skill as applied to magic items tied to his religion (i.e., those based in Channeling magic and usable by the caster).
COMMUNAL WAYS.10: As Dream I, except the limit is 3 dreams/night on different topics.
COMMUNAL WAYS.11: As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 10 minutes into the future.
COMMUNAL WAYS.12: Caster receives a “yes” or “no” to a question on a single topic; usable but once a day. This answer normally comes from the caster’s deity or some supernatural subordinate of that deity.
COMMUNAL WAYS.13: The target of this spell is a small pool of clear, clean water. The water must be calm (and remain so for the duration of the spell). The caster may designate a topic and a vision will appear in the pool that relates to the topic. This vision normally takes 5-50 rounds. This vision may be seen by anyone looking into the pool.
COMMUNAL WAYS.14: Caster can mentally communicate with one other person, who must be a member of the same religion.
COMMUNAL WAYS.15: As Channel Opening I, except range is 10 miles per level.
COMMUNAL WAYS.16: As Commune I, except caster may ask two questions.
COMMUNAL WAYS.17: As Dream I, except the limit is five dreams/night on different topics.
COMMUNAL WAYS.18: As Magic Basin I, except up to two topics may be designated (5-50 rounds are required for each vision).
COMMUNAL WAYS.19: Caster gets a vision of the events surrounding the death of any 1 dead being within 10 feet. Caster gets an understanding of the reason(s) the deceased died, exactly who the killer was (if any), and who was ultimately responsible (if anyone). The vision of who is ultimately responsible will be a quick montage of the connections between the killer and the person ultimately responsible. Corpse may be of any age.
COMMUNAL WAYS.20: As Commune I, except caster can receive a more detailed answer (e.g., a name or short phrase) to a question involving only one concept.
COMMUNAL WAYS.25: As Intuitions I, except caster may gaze into the future for a number of minutes equal to the caster’s level.
COMMUNAL WAYS.30: As Channel Opening I, except caster can open a channel to anyone the caster chooses, regardless of whether or not the caster is acquainted with the being. Caster must specify the type of being sought (e.g., a priest of a specific deity, a warrior with blue eyes, etc.), range is 1 mile per level. Channel will open to the nearest being matching the description, if any.
COMMUNAL WAYS.35: As Channel Opening I, except range is 100 miles per level.
COMMUNAL WAYS.40: As Magic Basin I, except up to one topic for every 10 levels (or fraction thereof) of the caster may be designated, and the visions take less objective time (although they will seem as subjectively long to the viewer), requiring only 1 round per vision.
COMMUNAL WAYS.50: Caster receives detailed information on a single topic question. This information comes directly from the caster’s deity.

LIFE MASTERY.1: Caster can detect presence and number of living entities (Tiny animals or larger) within the area of effect and can concentrate on a different 5'R area each round. Caster will be aware of mundane life, such as insects, very small animals and plants, but not of their exact number, only general types.
LIFE MASTERY.2: Caster can preserve a dead body, preventing decomposition. Preservation can only be used on bodies of living beings that are or were capable of life, it cannot be used to preserve other organic matter.
LIFE MASTERY.3: The cast can reduce a stat penalty due to Life Drain by 1. A target can only receive one Heal Life Essence spell per day, and can only have a specific stat affected once per week.
LIFE MASTERY.4: Caster prevents the soul of a target from leaving its body (thus preventing actual death), although the body will continue to take damage (from bleeding or other effects) for the duration. If the body is not capable of sustaining life at the end of the duration, then the soul will depart. This will prevent Absolution of any kind, unless the Absolution makes a successful RR against this spell.
LIFE MASTERY.5: Target is infused with a part of the caster’s life force. Caster takes a -2 to a stat bonus of his choice, and the target gets a +2 to any stat bonus (which does not have to be the same stat bonus as the caster reduces). The target receives the benefits for the duration of the spell, but the caster’s penalty can only be removed via Heal Life Essence. Each stat can only be under the benefit of a single Infuse Life at a time, although the caster could have several penalties due to multiple Infuse Life spells being cast.
LIFE MASTERY.6: Target is temporarily revived by returning the soul to the body for a brief time, regardless of the condition of the body (if body is terribly damaged the target may not be able to take advantage of his brief return to the living).
LIFE MASTERY.7: As Preservation I, except for duration.
LIFE MASTERY.8: Caster can analyze a life form he can see or has previously detected with Life Awareness. He understands the nature of the life form (race), its approximate level, and if its life is currently in danger. Caster can analyze one being each round for the duration of the spell (requires Concentration).
LIFE MASTERY.9: Caster can restore life to a recently dead body (within 1 rnd/lvl) by giving up his own life. The target’s soul is returned to his body with no ill effects (although he is still subject to any wounds he had). The caster’s soul departs, however this spell also acts as a Preservation II spell on the caster’s body. Duration is for the Preservation effect; the other effects are permanent.
LIFE MASTERY.10: As Heal Life Essence I except that a stat penalty can be reduced by 2.
LIFE MASTERY.11: As Lifekeeping I, except for duration.
LIFE MASTERY.12: As Infuse Life I, except the caster’s stat bonus is reduced by 4 and the target’s stat bonus is increased by 4.
LIFE MASTERY.13: As Preservation I, except for duration.
LIFE MASTERY.14: Caster can return the soul of a being (that has not been dead for more than 1 min/lvl) to its body. If the body is not capable of sustaining life, then the soul will depart again. The target gets a -15 to all stats (which can be restored via Heal Life Essence).
LIFE MASTERY.15: As Heal Life Essence I, except penalty can be reduced by 3.
LIFE MASTERY.16: As Lifekeeping I, except for duration.
LIFE MASTERY.17: As Infuse Life I, except caster’s stat bonus is reduced by 6 and the target’s stat bonus increased by 6.
LIFE MASTERY.18: As Preservation I, except for duration.
LIFE MASTERY.19: As Lifegiving I, except body can have been dead for up to 1 day/level.
LIFE MASTERY.20: As Heal Life Essence I except penalty can be reduced by 5.
LIFE MASTERY.25: As Lifekeeping I, except for duration.
LIFE MASTERY.30: As Infuse Life I, except caster’s stat bonus is reduced by 10 and the target’s stat bonus increased by 10.
LIFE MASTERY.35: As Lifegiving I, except body can have been dead for up to 1 month/level.
LIFE MASTERY.40: As Heal Life Essence I, except the entire stat penalty is removed.
LIFE MASTERY.50: As Lifegiving I, except there is no time limit.

PROTECTIONS.1: Target gets a +5 bonus to RRs and maneuver rolls. The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a non-mobile target. If cast on a mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast on a non-mobile target that is moved, the spell is dispelled. If the caster is the target, the duration is one minute per level and concentration is not required.
PROTECTIONS.2: As Prayer I, except bonus applies to DB (Defensive Bonus) and maneuver rolls.
PROTECTIONS.3: As Prayer I, except the bonus applies to RRs and DB.
PROTECTIONS.4: Target is protected from natural heat up to 80°C (treat as if target were in 20°C temperature). For temperatures above 80°C, subtract 60°C to determine the effective temperature for the target. Target also receives +20 to all RRs vs. heat spells/attacks and a +20 to DB vs. elemental fire/heat attacks. If the caster is not the target, concentration is required. Duration is as for Prayer I.
PROTECTIONS.5: Target is protected from natural cold down to -10°C (treat as if target were in 20°C temperature). For temperatures below 20°C, add 30°C to determine the effective temperature for the target. Target also receives +20 to all RRs vs. cold spells/attacks and a +20 to DB vs. elemental cold/ice attacks. If the caster is not the target, concentration is required. Duration is as for Prayer I.
PROTECTIONS.6: Target is protected from physical attacks as if armored. Target is granted the benefits of AT 4, but is not encumbered in any way, as he is not actually armored.
PROTECTIONS.7: Target gains a +30 bonus to his RRs against a specific spell (spells whose name differs only by Roman numeral are considered the same spell for this purpose, but a “Lord” or “True” version is not).
PROTECTIONS.8: All who are within the sphere are allowed the benefits of either a Heat Resistance or a Cold Resistance spell (must be the same for all targets). The sphere is not mobile.
PROTECTIONS.9: As Sacred Protection I, except AT is 6.
PROTECTIONS.10: All within the radius are allowed the benefits of Prayer I or Bless I or Resistance I (must be the same for all targets). The sphere is not mobile.
PROTECTIONS.11: As Prayer I, except total bonus is +15 and the spell may be divided among 1-3 targets (1 target would get a +15 bonus, 3 targets could each get +5 bonuses, etc.).
PROTECTIONS.12: As Bless I, except total bonus is +15 and spell may be divided among 1-3 targets as in Prayer III.
PROTECTIONS.13: As Resistance I, except total bonus is +15 and the spell may be divided among 1-3 targets as in Prayer III.
PROTECTIONS.14: As Sacred Protection I, except AT is 8.
PROTECTIONS.15: As Temperature Sphere I, except radius is 20'.
PROTECTIONS.16: As Protective Sphere I, except radius is 30'.
PROTECTIONS.17: As Protective Sphere I, except all within the radius are allowed the benefits of Prayer III or Bless III or Resistance III (i.e., each protected individual gains a +15 bonus).
PROTECTIONS.18: As Prayer I, except total bonus is +25 and the spell may be divided among 1-5 targets (1 target would get a +25 bonus, two targets could get a +13 bonus for one and a +12 bonus for the other, etc.)
PROTECTIONS.19: As Sacred Protection I, except AT is 10.
PROTECTIONS.20: As Bless I, except total bonus is +25 and the spell may be divided among 1-5 targets as in Prayer V.
PROTECTIONS.25: As Resistance I, except total bonus is +25 and the spell may be divided among 1-5 targets as in Prayer V.
PROTECTIONS.30: As Protective Sphere I, except all within the radius are allowed the benefits of Prayer V or Bless V or Resistance V (i.e., each protected individual gains a +25 bonus).
PROTECTIONS.35: As Temperature Sphere I, except radius is 10' per level and the effect is as both Heat Resistance and Cold Resistance, depending on what temperatures occur to protect against.
PROTECTIONS.40: As Sacred Protection I, except multiple targets may be given the equivalent of any armor from AT 2 to AT 10, with the restriction that the total ATs provided must be no greater than the level of the caster (e.g., a 40th level caster could provide AT 10 to four targets or AT 5 to eight targets or AT 8 to three targets and AT 4 to four targets).
PROTECTIONS.50: Target gets a +30 bonus to RRs, maneuver rolls, and DB.

REPULSIONS.1: Causes up to 5 Undead to flee or disintegrate. Up to five “points” of Undead may be affected: a “Class I” Undead counts as 1 point, a “Class II” Undead counts as 2 points, etc. “Animated Dead” are treated as “Class I” Undead but are not entitled to an RR (they automatically disintegrate if the spell does not fail). Otherwise, each target is entitled to an RR: if it fails by 1-50, it will flee (targets that cannot flee remain motionless) for 1 round per 1 failure. If it fails by more than 50, it disintegrates. The RR of any undead creature can be modified by concentrating the effects of the spell on that target: for each additional point of the spell allocated to a target (beyond those normally needed to affect it), that target’s RR is modified by -5. Thus Repel Undead V could affect 5 Class I Undead with no RR modifier or 1 Class 1 Undead with an RR modifier of -20 or 1 Class II Undead with an RR modifier of -5 and 2 Class I Undead with no RR modifier or any other combination of targets providing no more than 5 points were allocated. Once an undead has made an RR against a given caster’s Repel Undead spell, it cannot be affected by a Repel Undead spell from that caster again until one of the following happens: the caster gains a level, the undead is “killed” and has to reconstitute itself, or the caster converts to a new power source (i.e., changes religion).
REPULSIONS.2: When the caster is a target of a spell from the Realm of Channeling, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR before the caster makes an RR, using the level of this spell as the attacking level and the level of the incoming spell as the defending level. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster of this spell normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target. Being a “willing target” does not eliminate this effect, but the caster’s own spells do not need to make an RR. Note that the caster is considered to be a target of any spell which includes him in its area of effect or would “detect” him.
REPULSIONS.3: Cancels a Channels I spell being transmitted or received within range. Note that the Channels I spell gets no RR.
REPULSIONS.4: [RR Mod: -20] Nullifies a curse for the duration of this spell. The curse is not dispelled and takes effect again once the duration of this spell expires.
REPULSIONS.5: As Anti-Channels I, except affects up to a Channels III.
REPULSIONS.6: As Repel Undead V, except 9 points of undead may be affected.
REPULSIONS.7: Dispels a curse if the curse fails an RR. The curse’s level is the level of the caster of the curse. If the curse is not dispelled, the caster cannot try again until he has gone up another level of experience.
REPULSIONS.8: Any active spell from the realm of Channeling that is on the target must make an RR. If the spell fails its RR, it is dispelled.
REPULSIONS.9: [RR Mod: -20] As Neutralize Curse I, except curse is nullified for one hour per level.
REPULSIONS.10: As Anti-Channels I, except affects up to a Channels V.
REPULSIONS.11: As Repel Undead V, except 12 points of Undead may be affected.
REPULSIONS.12: As Anti-Channels I, except affects up to a Channels VIII.
REPULSIONS.13: An entity from another plane (typically a demon) is sent back to whence it came. This spell will affect entities of up to Type (or Grade for elementals) II or up to 10th level if they do not have a “Type”.
REPULSIONS.14: As Dispel Channeling I, except affects up to five targets.
REPULSIONS.15: As Anti-Channels I, except affects up to a Channels X.
REPULSIONS.16: As Repel Undead V, except 15 points of Undead may be affected.
REPULSIONS.17: As Lesser Banishment, except affects entities up to Type (or Grade) IV or 20th level if they do not have a “Type”.
REPULSIONS.18: [RR Mod: -20] As Neutralize Curse I, except curse is nullified for 1 day/level.
REPULSIONS.19: As Dispel Channeling I, except affects up to ten targets.
REPULSIONS.20: As Repel Undead V, except this spell disintegrates any one Undead of Class V or lower automatically or automatically sends a Class VI fleeing for 1 round per caster level.
REPULSIONS.25: [RR Mod: -50] As Uncurse, except for the RR modification.
REPULSIONS.30: As Anti-Channels I except any Channeled spell can be canceled. Spells channeled with the aid of a Holy Bridge (Cleric Base list, Channels) are not affected.
REPULSIONS.35: As Repel Undead V, except a number of points of Undead equal to the caster’s level may be affected and if 20 points are applied to any one Undead, the effect is that of Lord Repel Undead on that target.
REPULSIONS.40: As Lesser Banishment, except affects any entity short of a god.
REPULSIONS.50: Once per round, the caster can intercept one channeled spell that is being transmitted or received within this spell’s range and cast that spell himself. The person sending the channeled spell gets an RR (the defending level is that of the caster sending the channeled spell). Alternatively, the caster can intercept channeled PP for his own use. Interception takes no activity. Casting an intercepted spell takes the normal time.

SUMMONS.1: Caster can instantly summon a first level non-intelligent (i.e., possessing the Animalistic or Mindless flaw) living creature, which appears somewhere within the spell’s range. The caster can specify the general type of creature, but exactly what the creature is should be determined randomly (e.g., the caster could specify “four-legged, hoofed” and could get a zebra, horse, camel, etc.). If the creature can understand the caster’s communication, the creature can be controlled by normal communication. Otherwise, control is maintained through concentration of the caster. If the creature summoned is used for a task that is not dangerous (in its own perception), the duration for this spell is 10 minutes per level. However, if the creature is ever put into a dangerous situation, the duration immediately drops to 1 round per level. At the end of the spell’s duration, the summoned creature will disappear back whence it came.
SUMMONS.2: As Summons I, except the caster chooses one of the following options: a) the level of the summoned creature is increased by one, b) an extra 1st level creature can be summoned, or c) the duration can be doubled. When applying options to the higher level Summons spells, option “a” can only be applied to one creature at a time (i.e., two 2nd level creatures takes three options: one for the second creature and one each to raise the creatures to 2nd level).
SUMMONS.3: As Summons II, except two options are chosen.
SUMMONS.4: As Summons II, except three options are chosen.
SUMMONS.5: As Summons II, except four options are chosen.
SUMMONS.6: As Summons II, except five options are chosen.
SUMMONS.7: As Summons II, except six options are chosen.
SUMMONS.8: As Summons II, except seven options are chosen.
SUMMONS.9: As Summons II, except nine options are chosen.
SUMMONS.10: Caster summons a Type I Demon that appears over the course of 2 rounds; the caster can control it by concentrating. After the caster stops concentrating, the demon will fade out over the course of 2 rounds, attacking the closest being until gone.
SUMMONS.11: As Summons II, except fourteen options are chosen.
SUMMONS.12: Caster can summon (teleport to his location) a single “guard”, who must be a member of an intelligent race, a follower of the caster’s own religion, and currently doing service to the summoner or the summoner’s religious institution. Guard must also be within range of the spell when it is cast or it will fail.
SUMMONS.13: As Summons II, except nineteen options are chosen.
SUMMONS.14: As Demonic Gate I, except summons a Type I extraplanar being of a non-hostile nature. Control is not possible, though the summoned being will be helpful and will usually do as the caster requests if communication is possible.
SUMMONS.15: As Demonic Gate I, except a Type II Demon is summoned.
SUMMONS.16: As Summon Guard, except one guard can be summoned for every five full levels of the caster (e.g., a 16th level caster could summon three guards).
SUMMONS.17: As Summons X, except it can be delayed up to 1 day/level or until triggered by one of the following (decided by the caster at the time of casting): specified movements, sounds, touch, or actions. Trigger must be such as the caster would be able to sense it if still at the location of the spell effect. At the time of casting, the caster may specify a single task for the creature(s) to perform when it/they arrive(s).
SUMMONS.18: Caster sends out a telepathic summons heard by all the faithful within range to gather for a holy war. Response is voluntary, except for the Paladins of the faith, who must make an RR if they wish to resist. Use of this spell tends to be strictly monitored by the Cleric’s superiors, both mortal and divine, so it is best used only when there is a real need.
SUMMONS.19: As Divine Gate I, except a Type II entity is summoned.
SUMMONS.20: As Demonic Gate I, except a Type III Demon can be summoned.
SUMMONS.25: As Summons II, except one option per caster level is chosen.
SUMMONS.30: As Summons I, except caster can summon a specific type of creature of a level up to half the caster’s level for more lengthy service.
SUMMONS.35: As Divine Gate I, except a Type III entity is summoned.
SUMMONS.40: As Demonic Gate I, except a Type IV Demon can be summoned.
SUMMONS.50: Caster can pull any being through a “gate” to the caster’s location; if the being is intelligent, it must be willing to come. An intelligent being will know the religious affiliation of the gating person and a vague idea of the reason and the significance for the “gate”.

ANIMAL MASTERY.1: Puts any animal into a magical sleep.
ANIMAL MASTERY.2: Caster may heal any non-fatal damage in any animal of Small size or smaller.
ANIMAL MASTERY.3: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any one animal species.
ANIMAL MASTERY.4: As Animal Sleep I, except up to 3 animals may be made to sleep.
ANIMAL MASTERY.5: Allows caster to control the actions of any one animal.
ANIMAL MASTERY.6: Caster can locate members of any one species of animal within the area of effect or he can find out what species are in the area.
ANIMAL MASTERY.7: All animals within 10' will act friendly toward caster. This does not control the animals.
ANIMAL MASTERY.8: Caster may heal any non-fatal damage in any animal of Medium size or smaller or heal fatal damage in an animal of Small size or smaller.
ANIMAL MASTERY.9: Caster can understand and/or visualize the thoughts and emotions of any one animal.
ANIMAL MASTERY.10: Caster magically summons a 1st level animal from the surrounding area. The caster can specify the species of creature or simply a general type, but not a particular individual. If the animal can understand the caster (e.g., through use of Animal Tongues), the creature can be controlled through normal communications. Otherwise, control is maintained only through concentration by the caster. If the animal summoned is used for a task that is not dangerous (in the animal’s perception), the duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level. However, if the animal is ever put into a dangerous situation, the duration immediately drops to 1 round per level.
ANIMAL MASTERY.11: As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control up to three animals.
ANIMAL MASTERY.12: As Animal Summons I, except the caster chooses two of the following options: a) the level of the summoned creature is increased by one, b) an extra 1st level creature can be summoned, or c) the duration can be doubled. When applying options, option “a” can only be applied to one creature at a time (i.e., two 2nd level creatures takes three options: one for the second creature and one each to raise the creatures to 2nd level).
ANIMAL MASTERY.13: Caster can “call” any one known, individual animal; if it is physically possible, the animal will come to the caster.
ANIMAL MASTERY.14: This spell will return any animal of no more than Small size from the dead. The animal cannot have been dead for more days than its own level plus the caster’s level. If this spell is ever cast unsuccessfully on an animal (i.e., if an attempt to cast this spell ends in spell failure), then that animal can never be revived. The animal will be at -100 to all actions for a number of days equal to 20 days per day dead.
ANIMAL MASTERY.15: When cast upon any domesticated animal, that animal will return to its “wild” state. The animal will have no difficulty in adapting to the harsh requirements of the wilderness (and have no desire to return to domestication). Most animals will be willing targets of this spell, but those with a strong tie to a particular human may prefer domestication.
ANIMAL MASTERY.16: As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control up to five animals.
ANIMAL MASTERY.17: Caster may heal any non-fatal damage in any animal of any size or heal fatal damage in an Animal of Medium size or smaller.
ANIMAL MASTERY.18: As Animal Summons III, except four options can be chosen.
ANIMAL MASTERY.19: As Animal Reviving I, except animal may be of up to Medium size and recovery period is only one day per day spent dead.
ANIMAL MASTERY.20: As Animal Summons III, except nine options can be chosen.
ANIMAL MASTERY.25: As Animal Mastery I, except caster can control all animals of a given species within 10'R per level.
ANIMAL MASTERY.30: As Animal Reviving I, except animal may be of up to Big size and recovery period is only one day per day spent dead for a Big animal, with no recovery period for smaller animals.
ANIMAL MASTERY.35: Caster may heal any damage in any animal of any size.
ANIMAL MASTERY.40: As Animal Reviving I, except animal may be of any size and recovery period is only one day per day spent dead for a Large or larger animal, with no recovery period for smaller animals.
ANIMAL MASTERY.50: As Animal Summons III, except caster can select one option for every level of experience.

HERB MASTERY.1: Caster can understand the nature, origin, value, and uses of any magical herb. If a plant is not a magical herb, no information can be gained other than that fact.
HERB MASTERY.2: Allows caster to enhance the efficacy of any one herb (growing or dead) with healing or durational effects. For healing herbs, recovery rolls receive an extra +25 bonus. For herbs with a durational effect, the duration is doubled (i.e., x2). This spell may be employed only once per herb.
HERB MASTERY.3: Allows caster to locate any one specific variety of herb that is sought, regardless of physical obstacles. This spell gives exact direction, distance, and quantity. If multiple patches of the herb are within range, the caster is aware of all of them.
HERB MASTERY.4: Allows caster to prepare one dose of any herb so that it will be instantly effective. When the herb is subsequently used, its benefits/dangers will be immediately felt. The herb will keep for 1 day per level of the caster.
HERB MASTERY.5: Caster can double the potency of any one herb (growing or dead). This has the effect of halving the quantity of herb needed for a full dose, i.e. if a normal dose requires one full leaf to be effective, following this spell, only half a leaf would be required. This spell may be employed only once per herb. May not be combined with Herb Enhancement.
HERB MASTERY.6: As Herb Finding I, except that the range is 300'.
HERB MASTERY.7: Caster can grow an herb to sudden maturity by planting the proper seed; the herb is sterile and the growth takes 1-10 rnds.
HERB MASTERY.8: As Herb Enhancement II, except healing herbs receive a +50 bonus and herbs with a durational effect have the duration trebled (x3). This spell may be employed only once per herb and may not be combined with Herb Enhancement II.
HERB MASTERY.9: As Herb Finding I, except range is 500'.
HERB MASTERY.10: Allows caster to remove any harmful poisons, by-products, or side effects from all herbs within range. This includes eliminating any addictive properties.
HERB MASTERY.11: As Herb Mastery II, except potency is 3x.
HERB MASTERY.12: As Herb Finding I, except locates all herbs in area of effect.
HERB MASTERY.13: As Herb Finding I, except range is 1 mile. Location is known within 10'R.
HERB MASTERY.14: Preserves an herb indefinitely. If another spell is then cast on the herb, this spell will be cancelled and normal deterioration of the herb will begin.
HERB MASTERY.15: As Herb Mastery II, except potency is 4x
HERB MASTERY.16: As Herb Finding III, except locates all herbs in area of effect.
HERB MASTERY.17: As Instant Herbal Cures, except herb will keep for 1 week per level of the caster.
HERB MASTERY.18: As Herb Finding I, except range is 5 miles. Location is known within 25'R.
HERB MASTERY.19: As Herb Finding V, except locates all herbs in area of effect.
HERB MASTERY.20: As Herb Finding I, except range is 20 miles; location is known within 100'R.
HERB MASTERY.25: As Herb Enhancement III, except that 1 herb per caster level can be affected. All herbs must be of the same type.
HERB MASTERY.30: As Herb Mastery II, except that the potency of 1 herb, growing or dead, can be increased by 100% x lvl/5 of caster (e.g., a 30th Ivl caster could increase potency of any herb by 600%, i.e., 6x, so one normal “dose” of a herb could be split into six effective portions).
HERB MASTERY.35: As Instant Herbal Cures, except herb will keep until used.
HERB MASTERY.40: As Preserved Instant Herbal Cures, except affects up to 1 herb/level.
HERB MASTERY.50: As Herb Finding I, except that caster can locate any 1 herb variety within a range of 1 mile/lvl of caster (e.g., 50 miles for a 50th level caster); location is known within 100'R.

NATURE'S LORE.1: Caster has a 75% chance of detecting each individual trap in a 5'R. Caster can concentrate on a 5'R area each round. There must be plants or animals in the area of effect or no information will be gained. Spiders and insects are animals, so many indoor environments will still allow the use of this spell. If a trap is missed, the spell will not find it no matter how many times the caster scans the same area.
NATURE'S LORE.2: Allows caster to monitor animate activity in the area (e.g., the caster will be aware of movements, subtle and overt). Caster cannot move while concentrating. Caster does not receive a picture of what is moving, just an awareness of the movement. This will allow distinguishing general size and shape of a moving object. Someone staying still, but breathing, will be detected, but only a very general idea of size would be determinable.
NATURE'S LORE.3: Caster learns the location(s) of any “path(s)” within 200'. The spell gives the nearest point on the path, but not the path’s course. (See Section 10.16 for information on interpretation of “path”.)
NATURE'S LORE.4: Detects any active spell or active magical item. Caster can concentrate on a different 5'R area each round. (See Section 10.4 for more about detection spells.)
NATURE'S LORE.5: Caster has a 95% chance of correctly predicting time, type, and severity of weather over the next 24 hr period.
NATURE'S LORE.6: As Nature’s Awareness I, except that the radius is 200'.
NATURE'S LORE.7: As Weather Prediction I, except period is 3 days.
NATURE'S LORE.8: For the duration of this spell, the caster will know the direction and distance to any unique natural feature that the caster is familiar with. The feature must be within range or no information is gained.
NATURE'S LORE.9: Allows caster to set up a natural “alarm system” in the area of effect; any disturbing activity will cause caster to be alerted. This alert will wake the caster, if he is in a natural sleep.
NATURE'S LORE.10: As Nature’s Awareness I, except that radius is 300'.
NATURE'S LORE.11: As Weather Prediction I, except period is 5 days.
NATURE'S LORE.12: Caster can remember an exact route that the caster has previously traveled regardless of whether or not the original journey was made with the caster’s normal sensory abilities active (e.g., a 12th level caster could remember the course of 12 hours of a trip even if blindfolded during that time). To be effective, this spell must be cast within one month of the journey.
NATURE'S LORE.13: As Waiting Awareness I, except radius is 100'.
NATURE'S LORE.14: As Locate Landmark I, except for range.
NATURE'S LORE.15: Allows caster to visualize and sense activity in a known fixed area (100'R).
NATURE'S LORE.16: As Nature Awareness I, except radius is 500'.
NATURE'S LORE.17: Caster can communicate with any elemental force within range. The elemental force must be able to communicate (i.e., this spell does not confer communication abilities upon the force, just translation of those it does have). Elemental forces include all elementals, water spirits, forest spirits, etc.
NATURE'S LORE.18: The target of this spell is a small pool of water. The water must be calm (and remain calm for the duration of the spell). The caster may designate a topic and a vision will appear in the pool that relates to the topic. The vision will take 1-50 rounds.
NATURE'S LORE.19: As Locate Landmark I, except for range.
NATURE'S LORE.20: As Nature’s Eye I, except the range is 10 miles and caster can monitor an area of 500'R.
NATURE'S LORE.25: As Weather Prediction I, except period is 1 day/level.
NATURE'S LORE.30: As Nature’s Eye I, except range is 100 miles and caster can monitor an area of 500'R.
NATURE'S LORE.35: As Nature’s Awareness I, except radius is 100'/level.
NATURE'S LORE.40: Caster is made aware of the ecological health of the area and anything that is causing significant ecological impact on the area (e.g., the water from the magic spring makes everything here grow fast, poison is leaching out from the pile of mine tailings, or the unicorns prevent disease from spreading through the wildlife).
NATURE'S LORE.50: Allows caster to monitor an area of 100'R that the caster has both been to and become acquainted with (i.e., spent at least 1 day meditating in or 30 days living in).

NATURE'S PROTECTION.1: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of animal or plant for use with spells later on this list. The caster can only have as many forms of each kingdom studied as he has ranks in this list. Thus, a Druid with 8 ranks in Nature’s Protection may have studied 8 types of animal and 8 types of plant. Caster may choose to forget a studied form at any time to make room for replacements.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.2: Protects caster from natural heat up to 176°F (80°C) and natural cold down to 14°F (-10°C), experiencing either as a 68°F (20°C) environment. For temperatures beyond the protected ranges, treat the caster as being in an environment of 20°C modified by one degree per degree beyond the protection limit (e.g., if the temperature were 180°F, the caster would experience it as 72°F). Against cold/ice or heat/fire attacks, the caster gains +20 to DB and RRs. Duration is 1 hour per level if the caster does not move, but if the caster moves, then duration becomes Concentration.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.3: Allows caster to take on the physical coloration of any 1 organic object. The caster must be in contact with the object when the spell is cast. In many situations, this will give a +10 to +50 bonus (GM’s discretion) to Stalking attempts.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.4: Allows caster to appear as any one type of plant that he has studied. This is purely a visual illusion: caster will still sound, smell, and feel the same, and the caster undergoes no physical change.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.5: Caster can move silently, so long as he does not create a sound originating more than 1' from his body. This typically provides a +10 to +50 bonus (GM’s discretion) to Stalking maneuvers when moving.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.6: Caster can breathe normally under water. Water may be salt or fresh, but no other liquid is breathable by means of this spell.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.7: Allows caster to appear as any one type of animal that he has studied. This is purely a visual illusion: caster will still sound, smell, and feel the same, and the caster undergoes no physical change.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.8: Caster and objects on his person appear to be a shadow and are almost invisible in dark areas (in many situations this could be handled with a Stalking bonus between +25 and +75).
NATURE'S PROTECTION.9: Any single attack made against the caster this round suffers a -50 modifier. The weapon or object defended against must be from an organic source (e.g., an animal) or at least a partially organic weapon (e.g., an arrow) and the caster must be able to see the attack.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.10: Allows caster to take the form of any one plant he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the plant. The caster’s size can change by up to one size increment. Caster does not gain the physical abilities of the plant other than Size category.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.11: As Resist Elements, except it protects caster from any natural heat or natural cold (treat as if caster were in 68°F [20°C] environment), and DB/RR bonus is +40.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.12: For the duration of this spell, the caster’s mental patterns will appear to be those of any animal he has studied. The caster cannot move while this spell is active.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.13: As Organic Defense I, except the penalty is -100.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.14: Allows caster to take the form of any one animal he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the animal. The caster’s size can be varied up to one size increment. Caster does not gain the physical abilities of the animal, other than Size category.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.15: As Animal Thoughts I, except caster can move (though he must still maintain concentration).
NATURE'S PROTECTION.16: As Plant Form I, except caster may also assume the scent and physical abilities of the plant.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.17: As Animal Form I, except caster may also assume the movement abilities of the animal.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.18: As Organic Defense I, except attack automatically misses.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.19: As Animal Form II, except caster also gains the physical attacks of the animal. Caster can vary his size up to two Size increments. Caster gains normal OB of the animal with its natural attacks, gaining the instincts to use them properly.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.20: As Plant Form II, except caster can change his form to any other plant he has studied at any time during the duration of the spell and he can vary his size by up to 2 size increments.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.25: As Animal Form III, except caster can change his form to any other animal he has studied at any time during the duration of the spell and caster has all physical abilities of the animal.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.30: As Plant Form True and Animal Form True operating at the same time.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.35: As Animal Thoughts II, except caster does not need to concentrate, and duration is 1 minute per level.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.40: As Nature’s Form True, except for duration.
NATURE'S PROTECTION.50: As Organic Defense III, except one attack may be defended against each round the spell is in effect.

NATURE'S WRATH.1: The caster’s next attack gains a +5 to its OB. If the caster is attacking in animal form, this bonus is doubled.
NATURE'S WRATH.2: Target will find that animals, both wild and domestic have become wary of him. All maneuvers dealing with handling, influencing, or working with animals suffer a penalty of -25.
NATURE'S WRATH.3: Plants around the target become highly animated and attempt to take hold of the target. Treat as a size Small Grapple attack with an OB equal to the caster’s skill in this list. This spell requires the presence of suitable plants (grasses, flowers, or larger plants). If a Grapple % result occurs, the plants will continue to hold the target until it is freed. For attempts to break free, treat the plants’ Grappling skill as equal to the original OB and their Strength bonus as +0.
NATURE'S WRATH.4: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Lightning Bolt attack table, as a Miniscule attack.
NATURE'S WRATH.5: As Nature’s Ire I, except bonus is +10.
NATURE'S WRATH.6: Creates an opaque wall of fire (up to 10'x10'x6"). Anyone passing through it takes an A Heat critical (no RR). See Section 10.20 for additional details on Wall spells.
NATURE'S WRATH.7: As Nature’s Ire I, except bonus is +15.
NATURE'S WRATH.8: Plants around the target become highly animated and attempt to take hold of the target. Treat as a size Medium Grapple attack with an OB equal to the caster’s skill in this list. This spell requires the presence of suitable plants (vines, tall stalks such as corn/maize, small bushes such as roses, or larger plants). If a Grapple % result occurs, the plants will continue to hold the target until it is freed. For attempts to break free, treat the plants’ Grappling skill as equal to the original OB and their Strength bonus as +5.
NATURE'S WRATH.9: The caster’s next attack (including spells) does double concussion hit damage.
NATURE'S WRATH.10: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Lightning Bolt attack table, as a Miniscule attack.
NATURE'S WRATH.11: Winds gust about the target, always blowing from the direction in which he tries to move and anyone else in the radius will share this effect (no RR). This will prevent a sailed vessel from moving, reduce normal movement by two Paces (e.g., target may no longer Walk, but must at least use a Jog pace, which will produce a Creep). In addition, the target (but not others in the radius) will have a special -20 penalty to Endurance rolls due to moving. Any loose items will be blown away. Any missile fire into or out of the area affected will suffer a -80 modification to OB.
NATURE'S WRATH.12: As Wall of Fire, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (it is non-mobile).
NATURE'S WRATH.13: As Nature’s Ire I, except bonus is +25.
NATURE'S WRATH.14: Plants around the target become highly animated and attempt to take hold of the target. Treat as a size Big Grapple attack with an OB equal to the caster’s skill in this list. This spell requires the presence of suitable plants (large bushes, mature ivy, or larger plants). If a Grapple % result occurs, the plants will continue to hold the target until it is freed. For attempts to break free, treat the plants’ Grappling skill as equal to the original OB and their Strength bonus as +10.
NATURE'S WRATH.15: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Lightning Bolt attack table, as a Miniscule attack.
NATURE'S WRATH.16: As Nature’s Ire I, except bonus is +30.
NATURE'S WRATH.17: The area of effect is pelted with heavy hail. Treat as an Ice Bolt attack on everyone in the area of effect with an OB equal to half the caster’s skill in this list and with no range modification. Fumble results on the Ice Bolt attack are ignored.
NATURE'S WRATH.18: Plants around the target become highly animated and attempt to take hold of the target. Treat as a size Large Grapple attack with an OB equal to the caster’s skill in this list. This spell requires the presence of suitable plants (generally trees or plentiful vines). If a Grapple % result occurs, the plants will continue to hold the target until it is freed. For attempts to break free, treat the plants’ Grappling skill as equal to the original OB and their Strength bonus as +15.
NATURE'S WRATH.19: As Nature’s Ire I, except bonus is +35.
NATURE'S WRATH.20: A bolt of lightning is shot from the caster’s palm; the results are determined on the Lighting Bolt Table as a Medium sized attack.
NATURE'S WRATH.25: Plants around the target become highly animated and attempt to take hold of the target. Treat as a size Huge Grapple attack with an OB equal to the caster’s skill in this list. This spell requires the presence of suitable plants (thick growth including large plants). If a Grapple % result occurs, the plants will continue to hold the target until it is freed. For attempts to break free, treat the plants’ Grappling skill as equal to the original OB and their Strength bonus as +25.
NATURE'S WRATH.30: As Lightning Bolt I, except range increment is 125'.
NATURE'S WRATH.35: As Nature’s Ire I, except bonus is +50 and attack does double concussion hit damage.
NATURE'S WRATH.40: As Hailstorm, except for range, radius, and the OB is equal to the caster’s skill in this list.
NATURE'S WRATH.50: Caster can cause an earthquake; with the caster’s location at the time of casting as the epicenter. The quake can be delayed up to 1 round/level. The severity of the quake on the Richter scale is determined by a roll: (01-20) = 5.5, (21-45) = 6, (46-65) = 6.5, (66-80) = 7.0, (81-90) = 7.5, (91-95) = 8.0, (96-98) = 8.5, (99-100) = 9.0.

PLANT MASTERY.1: Caster learns nature, value, and history of one plant (that is not a magical herb).
PLANT MASTERY.2: Allows caster to increase speed of growth for any 1 species of plant within the area of effect to ten times the normal rate.
PLANT MASTERY.3: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 plant species.
PLANT MASTERY.4: Instantly heals damage to one plant that is not a tree.
PLANT MASTERY.5: Allows caster to increase speed of growth for any 1 species of plant within the area of effect to a hundred times the normal rate.
PLANT MASTERY.6: Caster can locate members of any 1 species of plant or find out what species are in the area.
PLANT MASTERY.7: Allows caster to double the size of any 1 plant. This requires 1 day’s growth. When fully mature the plant will achieve twice its normal size.
PLANT MASTERY.8: Caster can control the automatic and/or mental processes of any one plant. Caster can also control the plant’s movements, although this does not allow movement beyond normal allowances. If cast daily, this can be used to direct a plant’s growth into specific unusual shapes, so long as these would be naturally possible.
PLANT MASTERY.9: As Speed Growth I, except the range is 100' and the radius is 100'.
PLANT MASTERY.10: As Plant Growth II, except size increase is 3 times.
PLANT MASTERY.11: As Plant Control I, except caster can control any three plants.
PLANT MASTERY.12: As Plant Restore, except it can affect any plant (including trees).
PLANT MASTERY.13: As Plant Growth II, except size increase is 5 times.
PLANT MASTERY.14: As Rapid Growth I, except the range is 100' and the radius is 100'R.
PLANT MASTERY.15: As Plant Control I, except caster can control any 5 plants.
PLANT MASTERY.16: Summons a wall of very tough (but pliable) thorny growth. The wall is up to 10'x10'x5'. Anyone moving through the wall receives d10 dagger attacks (each with a +50 OB) per foot of wall moved through. See Section 10.20 for additional details on Wall spells.
PLANT MASTERY.17: This spell will put out any fires upon living materials that are in the area of effect. Fumble results on the Ice Bolt attack are ignored.
PLANT MASTERY.18: As Plant Growth II, except size increase is 10 times.
PLANT MASTERY.19: This spell requires a tree at least 80 years old as its target. If this spell is cast on a tree every day for a year (not necessarily by the same person each time), then the tree will awaken, becoming a Slowroot (See Creature Law). The newly awakened tree will not automatically be under any control of the caster(s) who wakened it.
PLANT MASTERY.20: As Plant Growth II, except caster can increase size of all plants of 1 species within a 100'R by 5x.
PLANT MASTERY.25: As Rapid Growth I, except for range and area of effect.
PLANT MASTERY.30: As Plant Control I, except caster can control all plants within range (100'R).
PLANT MASTERY.35: As Wall of Thorns, but dimensions are up to 20'x10'x5' and the duration is permanent (the wall is rooted and living).
PLANT MASTERY.40: Caster can animate any 1 plant; the plant can then move slowly (10'/rnd for plants under 10' tall, 20'/rnd if taller), carrying any root system it may possess along.
PLANT MASTERY.50: As Plant Animation, except caster can animate up to 1 plant/level.

CURSEBREAKING.1: When the caster is a target of a spell from an Evil spell list, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR before the caster makes an RR. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster of this spell normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target. Being a “willing target” does not eliminate this effect, but the caster’s own spells do not need to make an RR. Note that the caster is considered to be a target of any spell which includes him in its area of effect or would “detect” him.
CURSEBREAKING.2: As Holy Cancellation Evil, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
CURSEBREAKING.3: As Holy Cancellation Evil, except affects spells from the realm of Essence.
CURSEBREAKING.4: As Holy Cancellation Evil, except affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.
CURSEBREAKING.5: Any active spell from an Evil spell list that is on the target must make an RR. If the spell fails its RR, it is dispelled.
CURSEBREAKING.6: [RR Mod.: -20] Nullifies a curse for the duration of this spell. The curse is not dispelled and takes effect after the duration of this spell.
CURSEBREAKING.7: As Dispel Evil I, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
CURSEBREAKING.8: As Dispel Evil I, except affects spells from the realm of Essence.
CURSEBREAKING.9: As Dispel Evil I, except affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.
CURSEBREAKING.10: Caster can determine nature and origin of any one curse, including the name of the one who bequeathed it.
CURSEBREAKING.11: Any active Evil spell that is (at least partly) within the radius of effect must make an RR (use the spell’s level for the RR). If the spell fails its RR, it is dispelled.
CURSEBREAKING.12: Caster learns the current location of the caster of a given curse, so long as the caster is within range. Location is direction plus distance. The curse must have been previously analyzed with Curse Tales.
CURSEBREAKING.13: [RR Mod.: -20] As Neutralize Curse I, except curse is nullified for one hour per level.
CURSEBREAKING.14: As Dispel Evil Sphere I, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
CURSEBREAKING.15: As Dispel Evil Sphere I, except affects spells from the realm of Essence.
CURSEBREAKING.16: As Dispel Evil Sphere I, except affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.
CURSEBREAKING.17: As Find Curser I, except range is 10 miles per level.
CURSEBREAKING.18: [RR Mod: -20] As Holy Cancellation Evil, except affects all spells, “incoming” spells make their RR at -20, and duration is 10 minutes per level.
CURSEBREAKING.19: As Dispel Evil Sphere I, except radius is 50'.
CURSEBREAKING.20: Dispels a curse if the curse fails an RR. The curse’s level is the level of the caster of the curse. If the curse is not dispelled, the caster cannot try again until he has gone up another level of experience.
CURSEBREAKING.25: As Dispel Channeling Sphere I, except radius is 50'.
CURSEBREAKING.30: [RR Mod.: -50] As Uncurse, except curse makes its RR with a -50 penalty.
CURSEBREAKING.35: As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except radius is 50'.
CURSEBREAKING.40: As Dispel Mentalism Sphere I, except radius is 50'.
CURSEBREAKING.50: As Dispel Evil Sphere V, except affects all spells and duration is one minute per level. Any given spell need only resist this spell once, but any spell coming into the area of effect while this spell is active must make its RR or be dispelled. Sphere moves with the caster.

HOLY ARMS.1: Adds +5 to the caster’s melee or missile OB for the current round.
HOLY ARMS.2: After casting this spell, the caster’s next melee or missile attack will, if made against a foe who receives a critical reduction due to size or other factors, have the critical reduction reduced by one. For example, a Medium combatant attacking a Large foe would normally have a C critical done against that foe reduced to an A critical. If that Medium combatant benefited from this spell, that critical would only be reduced to a B.
HOLY ARMS.3: Caster gains a +5 to his Strength stat bonus.
HOLY ARMS.4: Adds +10 to the caster’s melee or missile OB for the current round.
HOLY ARMS.5: As Righteous Blow I, except two steps of critical reduction are negated.
HOLY ARMS.6: Weapon becomes indestructable for spell duration. This includes not only normal breakage, but also magical effects that would break or otherwise damage the weapon. It is still possible to disarm the wielder of the weapon. Once the weapon has spent three consecutive rounds outside the caster’s possession, it can be broken normally.
HOLY ARMS.7: Adds +15 to the caster’s melee or missile OB for the current round.
HOLY ARMS.8: As Righteous Blow I, except three steps of critical reduction are negated.
HOLY ARMS.9: A bright, shimmering aura surrounds the caster. All creatures “of darkness” who are in the area of effect must make an RR each round or receive an A severity Holy critical.
HOLY ARMS.10: Adds +20 to the caster’s melee or missile OB for the current round.
HOLY ARMS.11: As Righteous Blow I, except four steps of critical reduction are negated.
HOLY ARMS.12: Caster gains a +10 to his Strength stat bonus.
HOLY ARMS.13: Adds +25 to the caster’s melee or missile OB for the current round.
HOLY ARMS.14: Caster will not fumble. Caster cannot be disarmed nor his weapon(s) broken while the spell lasts.
HOLY ARMS.15: A bright, shimmering aura surrounds the caster. All creatures “of darkness” who are in the area of effect must make an RR each round or receive a B severity Holy critical.
HOLY ARMS.16: Adds +30 to the caster’s melee or missile OB for the current round.
HOLY ARMS.17: Caster gains a +15 to his Strength stat bonus.
HOLY ARMS.18: Caster immediately hurls a (melee) weapon, which attacks using his normal throwing OB with the weapon or his melee OB with the weapon, whichever is higher. This spell allows this attack to use the ranges for a short bow.
HOLY ARMS.19: Adds +35 to the caster’s melee or missile OB for the current round.
HOLY ARMS.20: A bright, shimmering aura surrounds the caster. All creatures “of darkness” who are in the area of effect must make an RR each round or receive a C severity Holy critical.
HOLY ARMS.25: Adds +40 to the caster’s melee or missile OB for the current round.
HOLY ARMS.30: A bright, shimmering aura surrounds the caster. All creatures “of darkness” who are in the area of effect must make an RR each round or receive a D severity Holy critical.
HOLY ARMS.35: Adds +50 to the caster’s melee or missile OB for the current round.
HOLY ARMS.40: A bright, shimmering aura surrounds the caster. All creatures “of darkness” who are in the area of effect must make an RR each round or receive an E severity Holy critical.
HOLY ARMS.50: Caster exposes all within the area of effect to the raw power of his deity. This has an effect equal to a Fire Ball attack with an OB equal to twice the caster’s level (i.e., a 50th level caster results in a +100 OB), with concussion damage doubled, Fire criticals replaced with Holy criticals, and all criticals being treated as Slaying III. The caster acts as the center-point for the blast and is not immune to any of the damage. For the caster, no objects, spells, etc. will protect him from the blast.

HOLY HEALING.1: Reduces target’s blood loss by up to 1 hit per round. Until the injury is actually treated by some means (e.g., Medicine maneuver or appropriate Relief spell), the target cannot move or be moved without the bleeding resuming. Multiple Flowstop spells may not be cast upon the same wound.
HOLY HEALING.3: Removes up to -30 in penalties from fatigue.
HOLY HEALING.4: An injury of any type other than nerve or brain injury incurring a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, and the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll.
HOLY HEALING.6: Target is relieved of 1 round worth of accumulated stun effects.
HOLY HEALING.7: As Flowstop I, except up to 5 hits per round.
HOLY HEALING.8: Instantly stops bleeding from one wound that bleeds at a rate of 1 hit/round.
HOLY HEALING.9: As Light Wound Relief, except an injury incurring a penalty up to -40.
HOLY HEALING.12: As Light Wound Relief, except an injury incurring a penalty of any amount.
HOLY HEALING.13: Instantly stops bleeding from one wound that bleeds at a rate of up to 3 hits/round.
HOLY HEALING.14: Target is relieved of 3 rounds worth of accumulated stun effects.
HOLY HEALING.15: Caster can cure any paralysis problem. The recovery time is 1-10 days. Treat as -100 injury for progress of recovery.
HOLY HEALING.17: Target regains function in one sensory organ, so long as that sensory organ has not been completely destroyed (in which case Organ Regeneration is required). The recovery time is 1-10 hours.
HOLY HEALING.18: Target comes out of a coma or unconsciousness caused by injury, disease, poison, spell, or spell failure. Process takes 1-10 hours and target is at -50 to Endurance rolls for 1-10 days.
HOLY HEALING.19: Stops bleeding on a wound that is bleeding at any rate. For one hour, the target can engage in no activity more vigorous than walking or bleeding will resume at the prior rate.
HOLY HEALING.20: Target is relieved of all accumulated stun effects.
HOLY HEALING.25: Target is healed of all concussion hit damage.
HOLY HEALING.30: As Light Wound Relief, except the recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
HOLY HEALING.35: As Medium Wound Relief, except the recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
HOLY HEALING.40: As Severe Wound Relief, except the recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
HOLY HEALING.50: Caster can use one of the lower level spells on this list of 25th level or below once per round.

HOLY SHIELDS.1: Everyone in the area of effect who is aligned with the caster (see above) subtracts 5 from all elemental attacks against them. They may also add 5 to all RRs versus spells. These bonuses are not conferred to the caster.
HOLY SHIELDS.2: Causes a bright aura about the caster, providing a more powerful appearance and subtracting 10 from all attacks on the caster.
HOLY SHIELDS.3: Creates a golden full shield emblazoned with the holy symbol of the caster’s faith. If the caster has a free arm, it functions in all ways as a physical shield, but it does not count for encumbrance, and lasts for 1 minute per level. If the caster does not have a free arm, it moves of its own accord to defend the caster, providing +25 DB against up to 3 frontal attacks per round, but cannot benefit from Shield skill and cannot be combined with any other shield, and the duration is only 1 round per level. In either case, it is unbreakable.
HOLY SHIELDS.4: Caster may employ the Protecting Others rules (see RMCL Section 9.7) to defend two other individuals at the same time with only the normal penalty for protecting one individual.
HOLY SHIELDS.5: Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits (round off fractional hits) before passing out. Hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.
HOLY SHIELDS.6: As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 10.
HOLY SHIELDS.7: Caster can deflect any one missile that the caster can see and which passes within the 100' range of this spell; this causes 50 to be subtracted from the missile’s attack.
HOLY SHIELDS.8: As Aura, except it produces an extremely powerful appearance and subtracts 15 from all attacks.
HOLY SHIELDS.9: As Deflections I, except its effect is against 1 melee attack.
HOLY SHIELDS.10: As Unpain I, except an additional 50% of hits can be sustained.
HOLY SHIELDS.11: As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 15.
HOLY SHIELDS.12: As Deflections I, except 2 missiles may be affected.
HOLY SHIELDS.13: As Deflections I, except missile automatically misses.
HOLY SHIELDS.14: As Bladeturn I, except 2 melee attacks may be affected.
HOLY SHIELDS.15: As Unpain I, except an additional 75% of hits can be sustained.
HOLY SHIELDS.16: As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 20.
HOLY SHIELDS.17: As Deflections I, except 3 missiles may be affected.
HOLY SHIELDS.18: As Aim Untrue I, except 2 missiles may be affected.
HOLY SHIELDS.19: As Bladeturn I, except 3 melee attacks may be affected.
HOLY SHIELDS.20: As Unpain I, except an additional 100% of hits can be sustained.
HOLY SHIELDS.25: As Protection Prayer I, except bonuses are 25.
HOLY SHIELDS.30: As Deflections I, except as many missiles as the caster’s level may be affected.
HOLY SHIELDS.35: As Bladeturn I, except as many melee attacks as the caster’s level may be affected.
HOLY SHIELDS.40: Creates a golden suit of plate armor around the caster. This armor does not interfere with spell-casting, but otherwise acts as a normal suit of armor with Armor Type 10 including arm and leg armor and helmet.
HOLY SHIELDS.50: As Protection Prayer V, except radius of effect is 100' and duration is 10 minutes per level.

HOLY WAR.1: Detects the presence of Undead in the area of effect. Caster can concentrate on a different area each round. (See Section 10.4 for more about detection spells.)
HOLY WAR.2: Detects the total number of “enemies” (giving approximate direction and distance). This spell also reveals the most heavily represented type of enemy (by total levels). Caster can concentrate on a different 50'R each round.
HOLY WAR.3: Caster’s next melee attack (within one minute of casting this spell) which scores a critical on an undead will do an additional A Holy critical.
HOLY WAR.4: Caster’s next melee attack (within one minute of casting this spell) which scores a critical on a demon will do an additional A Holy critical.
HOLY WAR.5: The caster gains a +10 bonus to his RRs against Life Drain by the undead.
HOLY WAR.6: For the duration of this spell, the caster can read and speak one “enemy” language with skill rank 8.
HOLY WAR.7: As Smite Undead I, except the additional Holy critical is severity B.
HOLY WAR.8: As Smite Demon I, except the additional Holy critical is severity B.
HOLY WAR.9: Caster’s next melee attack (within one minute of casting this spell) which scores a critical on an ‘enemy’ will do an additional A Holy critical.
HOLY WAR.10: As Resist Undead I, except bonus is +30.
HOLY WAR.11: As Smite Undead I, except the additional Holy critical is severity C.
HOLY WAR.12: As Smite Demon I, except the additional Holy critical is severity C.
HOLY WAR.13: As Resist Undead I, except protects everyone within 20' of the caster.
HOLY WAR.14: As Smite Enemy I, except the additional Holy critical is severity B.
HOLY WAR.15: Detects the presence of Undead in the area of affect. Caster can examine a different 50'R each round. The caster gains a general notion of the most prominent undead type in the radius (by total levels). “General” means that the caster could learn that the undead were mainly skeletons, but not which type(s) of skeletons.
HOLY WAR.16: As Smite Undead I, except the additional Holy critical is severity D.
HOLY WAR.17: As Smite Demon I, except the additional Holy critical is severity D.
HOLY WAR.18: As Smite Undead I, except effect applies to every melee attack while duration lasts.
HOLY WAR.19: As Smite Enemy I, except the additional Holy critical is severity C.
HOLY WAR.20: As Reveal Enemies, except for range and area of effect.
HOLY WAR.25: Caster’s next melee attack (within one minute of casting this spell) which scores a critical on an undead or a demon will do an additional E Holy critical.
HOLY WAR.30: As Smite Demon II, except effect applies to every melee attack while duration lasts.
HOLY WAR.35: Caster’s next melee attack (within one minute of casting this spell) which scores a critical on an ‘enemy’ will do an additional E Holy critical.
HOLY WAR.40: As Smite Undead III, except effect applies to every melee attack while duration lasts.
HOLY WAR.50: As Smite Abomination, except effect applies to every melee attack while duration lasts.

INSPIRING WAYS.1: For the duration of this spell, all within the area of effect (including the caster) may make a second RR versus any fear or panic effect. This second RR is made with an additional +10 modifier.
INSPIRING WAYS.2: Caster inspires all allies who are within the area of effect (they must be aware of the caster). All allies gain +5 to melee attacks and Endurance rolls for the duration of the spell. This spell will only work during combat or highly religious moments (e.g., an oratory presentation prior to a large battle). These bonuses do not apply to the caster.
INSPIRING WAYS.3: For as long as they speak together, the target of this spell will believe that the caster is a good friend and is acting in the target’s best interests.
INSPIRING WAYS.4: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +10.
INSPIRING WAYS.5: For as long as the caster speaks, the target will believe that the reasoning and ideas that the caster expresses are correct and valid.
INSPIRING WAYS.6: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +15.
INSPIRING WAYS.7: For as long as the caster speaks, the target will become more cautious (less rash) and will tend to obey the caster’s warnings without hesitation or doubt.
INSPIRING WAYS.8: Target must obey the caster. However, he will not perform any act that is completely alien to him or is self-destructive.
INSPIRING WAYS.9: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +20.
INSPIRING WAYS.10: As Voice of Friendship, except spell will affect all who can hear the caster.
INSPIRING WAYS.11: The caster gains a +25 bonus to his Leadership skill and +5 to any Influence maneuvers.
INSPIRING WAYS.12: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +25.
INSPIRING WAYS.13: As Command I, except spell affects two targets.
INSPIRING WAYS.14: As Voice of Reason, except spell will affect all who can hear the caster.
INSPIRING WAYS.15: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +30.
INSPIRING WAYS.16: As Courage, except the second RR automatically succeeds.
INSPIRING WAYS.17: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +35.
INSPIRING WAYS.18: As Voice of Caution, except spell will affect all who can hear the caster.
INSPIRING WAYS.19: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +40.
INSPIRING WAYS.20: [RR Mod.: -50] After casting this spell, the caster must tell the truth (as he knows it). The target will believe that the caster is speaking the absolute truth.
INSPIRING WAYS.25: As Inspirations I, except bonuses are +50.
INSPIRING WAYS.30: As Voice of Conviction, except spell will affect all who can hear the caster.
INSPIRING WAYS.35: The caster gains a +50 bonus to his Leadership skill and +15 to any Influence maneuvers.
INSPIRING WAYS.40: As Inspirations True, except radius of effect is 100'.
INSPIRING WAYS.50: Caster can use any lower level spell from this list once per round.

BEASTLY WAYS.1: Caster’s vision in low light is as a cat. In near darkness (e.g., a dark night but not in situations with no light), caster sees with normal clarity and over normal distance, but cannot see color.
BEASTLY WAYS.2: Caster gains a +40 bonus to any maneuvers primarily involving jumping.
BEASTLY WAYS.3: Caster gains an increased sense of smell and hearing (subtle smells and higher sonic ranges included). Adds +50 to Perception maneuvers using only these senses or +20 to Perception maneuvers using these senses combined with others.
BEASTLY WAYS.4: Caster gains a +5 bonus to initiative rolls.
BEASTLY WAYS.5: Caster gains improved ability to maneuver without his sight. When blinded or otherwise without sight, this spell adds +50 to maneuver rolls in the dark. Note that this spell does not negate penalties for blindness; it simply decreases them.
BEASTLY WAYS.6: Caster can safely hold his breath for the duration of this spell.
BEASTLY WAYS.7: Caster can “glide” through the air. The product of caster’s altitude and horizontal speed cannot exceed 100 (with altitude in feet and speed in feet per round). For example, a caster can glide along at a rate of 5' per round if he were 20' off the ground, or he could glide at the rate of 50' per round if he were 2' off the ground. Note that the product must equal 100 (i.e., the caster cannot choose to have a result less than or more than 100). Elevation may be increased up to 5' or decreased up to 10' each round, with the highest elevation being used to calculate the horizontal speed. There is a minimum elevation of 2'.
BEASTLY WAYS.8: Caster gains the visual acuity of a hawk. Adds +50 to all Perceptions involving only sight; +20 to all Perceptions involving this sense combined with others.
BEASTLY WAYS.9: Caster’s skin has the resilience of a large cat (effective AT of 3).
BEASTLY WAYS.10: Caster gains the ferocity of a wild boar. He gains +20 to his melee OB and does double concussion hit damage in melee, but cannot parry or use missiles for the duration of the spell.
BEASTLY WAYS.11: Caster gains the ability to make claw attacks as a lion. He may attack using the Claw Attack Table (size of attack is caster’s own size). The caster must develop skill with these claws as an Unarmed combat skill, but does gain a special bonus equal to his ranks in this list.
BEASTLY WAYS.12: Caster’s skin has the resilience of a bear (effective AT of 4).
BEASTLY WAYS.13: Caster gains an extra 1 AP each round and a +10 bonus to initiative rolls.
BEASTLY WAYS.14: Caster gains the ability to make a grappling attack with the strength of a bear. When the caster makes a Grappling/ Wrestling attack, it does double normal concussion hit damage and any attempt to break free from a hold the caster has established is done with a -30 penalty. His Grapple attack also gains a special bonus to OB equal to the caster’s ranks in this list.
BEASTLY WAYS.15: Caster’s skin has the resilience of a rhinoceros (effective AT of 6).
BEASTLY WAYS.16: As Glide I, except product is 300.
BEASTLY WAYS.17: Caster gains the ability to make bite attacks like a shark. He may attack using the Bite Attack Table (size of attack is caster’s own size). The caster must develop skill with this bite as an Unarmed combat skill, but does gain a special bonus equal to his ranks in this list.
BEASTLY WAYS.18: Caster’s skin takes on the resilience of a minor drake (providing the protection of Armor Type 8).
BEASTLY WAYS.19: Caster gains an extra 2 AP each round and a +15 bonus to initiative rolls.
BEASTLY WAYS.20: Caster gains the strength of an ox. He gains +40 to his melee OB and does triple concussion hit damage in melee, but cannot parry or use missiles for the duration of the spell.
BEASTLY WAYS.25: As Glide I, except product is 500.
BEASTLY WAYS.30: Caster gains an extra 3 AP each round and a +20 bonus to initiative rolls.
BEASTLY WAYS.35: For the duration of this spell, all of the caster’s physical attacks (whether ranged or melee) deliver a poison upon achieving a critical. An RR is made against poison based on the caster’s level and the effects are felt in 1-5 rounds. The poison may be of any type of the caster’s choosing (the same poison for the duration of any given casting of this spell). While fast-acting, the poison is not powerful and can achieve no more than Moderate effect.
BEASTLY WAYS.40: Caster gains a +40 bonus to all Ambush rolls and gains an extra five effective ranks in Ambush in order to determine how much he can modify the roll for any critical done.
BEASTLY WAYS.50: Caster’s skin takes on the resilience of a lesser drake (providing the protection of Armor Type 10).

INNER WALLS.1: Target is protected from natural heat up to 80°C (treat as if target were in 20°C temperature). For temperatures above 80°C, subtract 60°C to determine the effective temperature for the target. Target also receives +20 to all RRs vs. heat spells/attacks and a +20 to DB vs. elemental fire/heat attacks. The duration of this spell is 10 minutes per level if cast on a non-mobile target. If cast on a mobile target, the spell will last as long as the caster concentrates. If cast on a non-mobile target that is moved, the spell is dispelled. If the caster is the target, duration is one minute/level and concentration is not required.
INNER WALLS.2: Target is protected from natural cold down to -10°C (treat as if target were in 20°C temperature). For temperatures below 20°C, add 30°C to determine the effective temperature for the target. Target also receives +20 to all RRs vs. cold spells/attacks and a +20 to DB vs. elemental cold/ice attacks. Duration is as for Heat Resistance.
INNER WALLS.3: Target is protected from natural light and light changes (instantly adjusting vision to changing light intensity to never be blinded by glare, sudden light, or sudden darkness. Target also receives +20 to all RRs vs. light or electricity spells/attacks and a +20 to DB vs. elemental light/ electricity attacks. Duration is as for Heat Resistance.
INNER WALLS.4: Caster can ignore a penalty due to injury of up to -10 or subtract that amount from a more severe penalty (e.g., if the caster was suffering wounds causing a -45 penalty, he would only experience a -35 penalty). Movement while this spell is active will not aggravate the injury.
INNER WALLS.5: Caster gains a +10 bonus to all RRs.
INNER WALLS.6: Caster can sterilize 1 cubic foot per level of any solid or liquid. This will not affect inert poisons or harm creatures larger than 1/4" in length.
INNER WALLS.7: As Ignore Wounds I, except caster ignores up to -30 in penalties.
INNER WALLS.8: Caster gains a +10 bonus to his DB.
INNER WALLS.9: As Resistance Wall I, except bonus is +20.
INNER WALLS.10: As Ignore Wounds I, except caster ignores up to -50 in penalties.
INNER WALLS.11: Caster is protected from any natural cold, heat, light, or electricity (treat as if target were in 20°C temperature). Caster also receives a +40 to all RRs vs. heat, fire, cold, ice, light, and electricity; +40 DB vs. elemental cold/ice, fire/heat, and electricity attacks.
INNER WALLS.12: If the caster receives any form of Stun result, the caster may make a Body Development maneuver at Hard Difficulty (which does not require any AP). If this maneuver is successful, the caster does not suffer the Stun result.
INNER WALLS.13: As Martial Wall I, except bonus is +20.
INNER WALLS.14: As Ignore Wounds I, except caster ignores up to -80 in penalties.
INNER WALLS.15: As Resistance Wall I, except bonus is +30.
INNER WALLS.16: Allows caster to attempt to throw off the effects of any poison or disease by making an RR with a special +25 modification. This spell may only be cast once per incident of poisoning or disease until the caster gains another level.
INNER WALLS.17: As Ignore Wounds I, except caster ignores up to -100 in penalties.
INNER WALLS.18: As Martial Wall I, except bonus is +30.
INNER WALLS.19: As Resistance Wall I, except bonus is +40.
INNER WALLS.20: Allows target to attempt to throw off any 1 disease by making an RR with a special +50 modification. This spell may only be cast once per target per disease until the caster gains another level.
INNER WALLS.25: An RR is made for the curse (using the curse’s level as the defending level). If the RR fails, the curse is removed. This spell may only be cast once per target per curse until the caster gains another level.
INNER WALLS.30: Allows target to attempt to throw off the effects of any poison by making an RR with a special +50 modification. This spell may only be cast once per target per poison until the caster gains another level.
INNER WALLS.35: As Heat Resistance, Cold Resistance, and Light Resistance, plus caster is immune to natural heat, cold, and light/electricity, and is treated as one Size larger when taking damage from spells using these elements.
INNER WALLS.40: As Ignore Wounds I, except caster ignores all penalties from wounds and duration is 10 minutes per level.
INNER WALLS.50: Caster gets +25 to his DB, RRs, and maneuver rolls.

MOVING WAYS.1: Caster can walk or run on any nearly horizontal rocky or earthen surfaces as if on level ground. Running using this spell is no more fatiguing than walking.
MOVING WAYS.2: Caster can walk along tree limbs as if on level ground.
MOVING WAYS.3: Target may swim at a “walking” pace without any chance of fatigue, using the normal swimming rules (RMCL Sections 5.3 & 3.17). This will allow someone without Swimming skill to tread water in place and avoid drowning without the need for a maneuver.
MOVING WAYS.4: Caster can walk on water as if on level dry ground. Water need not be perfectly still, but must be fairly calm.
MOVING WAYS.5: Caster can walk or run on any sandy surfaces as if on level solid ground. Running using this spell is no more fatiguing than walking.
MOVING WAYS.6: Caster can merge into any organic material (alive or dead). While merged caster cannot move, perceive, or cast spells. When the caster emerges from the material, it is possible to emerge from any side or face of the material, although this is limited to moving “through” no more than the caster’s own body size plus two feet worth of material. The caster can exit at any time up to the end of spell duration (at which time the caster automatically emerges at the entrance point).
MOVING WAYS.7: Caster can walk without leaving tracks or other visible signs of his passing.
MOVING WAYS.8: As Limbwalking, except caster can move at a running pace (three times walking speed), without it being any more fatiguing than walking.
MOVING WAYS.9: As Waterwalking, except caster can move at a running pace (three times walking speed), without it being any more fatiguing than walking.
MOVING WAYS.10: As Traceless Passing, except caster can hide the tracks of any 2 beings (not necessarily including the caster).
MOVING WAYS.11: As Swimming, except caster may swim at up to a “Dash” pace with no chance of fatigue.
MOVING WAYS.12: As Merging Organic, except caster can turn within the material and can perceive the outside world if within 6" of the surface.
MOVING WAYS.13: As Hide Tracks I, except it hides 5 beings’ tracks.
MOVING WAYS.14: As the Running spells above, except any one of the spell effects can be used as needed (e.g., the caster could run on sand, then on water, then on limbs, etc.).
MOVING WAYS.15: As Traceless Passing, except the duration is 10 minutes per level.
MOVING WAYS.16: As Hide Tracks I, except it hides 10 beings’ tracks.
MOVING WAYS.17: As Traceless Passing, except caster can move at three times normal pace (i.e., at a Run pace) with no more fatigue than walking.
MOVING WAYS.18: As Great Merging Organic, except caster may use self-targeted spells while merged.
MOVING WAYS.19: As Traceless Passing True, except caster can move at three times normal pace (i.e., at a Run pace) with no more fatigue than walking.
MOVING WAYS.20: As Hide Tracks I, except it hides 20 beings’ tracks.
MOVING WAYS.25: As Running True, except caster can move at Sprint speed (four times walking pace) with it being no more fatiguing than walking.
MOVING WAYS.30: As Running True, except caster can affect one target per level (one target must be the caster).
MOVING WAYS.35: As Running True, except caster can run with no chance of fatigue.
