MOVING WAYS.40: As Hide Tracks I, except caster can either absolutely hide his own tracks (preventing discovery via any spell, etc.) or he can hide the tracks of a number of beings equal to his level as long as they remain within 100'.
MOVING WAYS.50: Caster can swim a mile per minute without fatigue and has a +100 bonus to any Swimming maneuvers.

NATURE'S GUISES.1: Allows caster to take on the physical coloration of any 1 organic object. The caster must be in contact with the object when the spell is cast. In many situations, this will give a +10 to +50 bonus (GM’s discretion) to Stalking attempts.
NATURE'S GUISES.2: All shadows and darkness within the area of effect deepen, giving all Perception maneuvers involving seeing anything hidden/hiding in the area a penalty of -20. Area is not mobile.
NATURE'S GUISES.3: Caster’s odor becomes greatly reduced, providing a -50 penalty for the caster to be detected or tracked using the sense of smell.
NATURE'S GUISES.4: Caster can move silently, so long as he does not create a sound originating more than 1' from his body. This typically provides a +10 to +50 bonus (GM’s discretion) to Stalking maneuvers.
NATURE'S GUISES.5: Caster blends into surrounding terrain, providing a +75 bonus to Stalking attempts. Caster may not move (appreciably) without destroying this effect. This bonus is not cumulative with Hues or Shadow.
NATURE'S GUISES.6: Caster and objects on his person appear to be a shadow and are almost invisible in dark areas (e.g., in many situations this could be handled with a Stalking bonus between +25 and +75).
NATURE'S GUISES.7: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of animal or plant for use with spells later on this list. The caster can only have as many forms of each kingdom studied as he has ranks in this list. Thus, a Ranger with 8 ranks in Nature’s Guises may have studied 8 types of animal and 8 types of plant. Caster may choose to forget a studied form at any time to make room for replacements.
NATURE'S GUISES.8: Allows caster to appear as any one type of plant that he has studied. This is purely a visual illusion: caster will still sound, smell, and feel the same, and the caster undergoes no physical change.
NATURE'S GUISES.9: For the duration of this spell, the caster’s mental patterns will appear to be those of any animal he has studied. The caster cannot move while this spell is active.
NATURE'S GUISES.10: As Study Form, except a particular animal or plant form may be studied. For example, the woodsman’s dog (as opposed to just a dog) may be studied. The caster may only have as many of these particular forms studied as he has ranks in this list. These are in addition to the general forms learned by Study Form.
NATURE'S GUISES.11: Allows caster to appear as any one type of animal that he has studied. This is purely a visual illusion: caster will still sound, smell, and feel the same, and the caster undergoes no physical change.
NATURE'S GUISES.12: Caster momentarily takes on a fearsome appearance that requires all within a 20' radius to resist versus Fear (attack level is that of the caster) or flee for 1 round per 5 fail. Targets must be able to see the caster in order to be affected.
NATURE'S GUISES.13: As Animal Thoughts I, except caster can move (though he must still maintain concentration).
NATURE'S GUISES.14: Caster appears to be friendly and pleasant so long as he does not make any overtly hostile action. This adds +20 to his social interactions with all living things.
NATURE'S GUISES.15: Allows caster to take the form of any one plant he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the plant. The caster’s size can change by up to one size increment. Caster does not gain the physical abilities of the plant other than Size category.
NATURE'S GUISES.17: Allows caster to take the form of any one animal he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the animal. The caster’s size can be varied up to one size increment. Caster does not gain the physical abilities of the animal, other than Size category.
NATURE'S GUISES.18: As Terrible Form, except dreadful appearance lasts for 1 round per level, during which any person in the radius of effect must make an RR against Fear each round (with a +10 bonus for each RR after the first) or flee for 1 round per 5 fail. Targets must be able to see the caster in order to be affected. Those who flee in terror will afterwards not be able to recollect clearly what the caster looked like.
NATURE'S GUISES.19: As Plant Form I, except caster may also assume the scent and physical abilities of the plant.
NATURE'S GUISES.20: As Animal Form I, except caster may also assume the movement abilities of the animal.
NATURE'S GUISES.25: As Animal Form II, except caster also gains the physical attacks of the animal. Caster can vary his size up to two Size increments. Caster gains normal OB of the animal with its natural attacks, gaining the instincts to use them properly.
NATURE'S GUISES.30: As Plant Form II, except caster can change his form to any other plant he has studied at any time during the duration of the spell and he can vary his size by up to 2 size increments.
NATURE'S GUISES.35: As Animal Thoughts II, except caster does not need to concentrate, and duration is 1 minute per level.
NATURE'S GUISES.40: As Animal Form III, except caster can change his form to any other animal he has studied at any time during the duration of the spell and caster has all physical abilities of the animal.
NATURE'S GUISES.50: As Plant Form True and Animal Form True operating at the same time.

PATHMASTERY.1: Caster learns the origin and nearest “destination” of any path within the area of effect.
PATHMASTERY.2: Caster knows which way is north, which way is up, and his distance above or below the ground’s surface.
PATHMASTERY.3: Caster gets a +50 bonus to all Tracking maneuvers.
PATHMASTERY.4: Caster acquires a visual image of any user(s) of a given path, up to 1 hour in the past per level of the caster.
PATHMASTERY.5: Caster learns the location(s) of any path(s) within 1 mile. This spell reveals the nearest point of each path, but not the path’s course.
PATHMASTERY.6: Caster learns the origin of one set of tracks, and acquires a visual image of the one who left them. Caster will gain a +25 bonus when tracking this particular being or animal.
PATHMASTERY.7: Caster is aware of any being within the area of effect that has hostile intentions towards him (i.e., he knows their number and locations). The hostility must be directed specifically at the caster (or the group he is in) or the spell reveals nothing. The being’s hostility must be active (i.e., driving the being to perform aggressive actions), not passive (i.e., hate exists, but no action is planned).
PATHMASTERY.8: Caster acquires visual and aural (sound) images of any being or animal that has passed within a 50'R of a specific object. The being or animal can have passed up to 1 hour per level earlier. If more than one being or animal has passed, the caster will see them one image at a time, one image per round (starting with the oldest image).
PATHMASTERY.9: As Far Pathfinding I, except range is 5 miles.
PATHMASTERY.10: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any one animal or plant species.
PATHMASTERY.11: Caster acquires a visual image of all beings or animals who left tracks in the area. This provides a +50 bonus when later tracking any of these beings or animals. If more than one being or animal has left tracks, the caster will see them one image at a time, one image per round (starting with the oldest image).
PATHMASTERY.12: Caster can communicate with any one stone if it possesses any mental qualities (e.g., caster could speak to a holy stone which possesses some sort of intelligence).
PATHMASTERY.13: As Far Pathfinding I, except range is 20 miles.
PATHMASTERY.14: As Sense Ambush I, except area of effect is 100'R.
PATHMASTERY.15: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any one species of “natural” monster. This excludes the undead, artificial creations (e.g., constructs), and entities from another plane (e.g., demons).
PATHMASTERY.16: Caster gets a +75 bonus to all Tracking maneuvers.
PATHMASTERY.17: As Sense Ambush I, except area of effect is 150'R.
PATHMASTERY.18: Caster can track individuals through an underwater environment without penalty.
PATHMASTERY.19: As Far Pathfinding I, except range is 1 mile per level and exact routes within the range are ascertained.
PATHMASTERY.20: As Sense Ambush I, except area of effect is 10'R/lvl.
PATHMASTERY.25: Allows caster to ascertain the proper path to what he seeks (includes the course along that path). For example, he could know the quickest way to the city or the safest way to the city, depending on his goals.
PATHMASTERY.30: Negates any Hide Tracks spell (except for Hide Tracks True) and provides a +100 Tracking bonus.
PATHMASTERY.35: Caster can track individuals through the air (i.e., track a flying being, object) without penalty.
PATHMASTERY.40: Caster learns of one being: where it originated (was born/created), where it began its current journey, and where it is currently bound, both its next destination and ultimate destination, if these are not the same. This will detect the largest, most important journey that the target is on. For example, if cast on two individuals going out to fetch water from the local well, that is what the spell would reveal if cast on the innkeeper’s daughter who is not planning on going anywhere in particular other than back to the inn with the water, but if the other person was a pilgrim traveling to a holy city, just getting some water at a stopover point, then that pilgrimage would be the journey revealed.
PATHMASTERY.50: Allows caster to know entire course of the tracks in the area of effect (i.e., exactly where and how they go). This will not negate Hide Tracks True.

SURVIVAL'S WAY.1: Caster receives a +25 bonus to all Survival maneuvers.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.2: Allows caster to set a fire of 1'R; fire will then last as long as there is fuel. A target in the 1'R will take an A Heat critical. Caster may only target a specific location, not an individual, with this spell.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.3: Caster gains a +20 bonus to all Medicine or Herbalism maneuvers.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.4: Caster gains a +50 bonus to any roll to notice a trap.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.5: As Survival I, except the bonus is +50.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.6: Allows caster to purify a number of gallons of water equal to the caster’s level.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.7: Any skill similarity penalty for using Survival in a different biome or any animal skill for a different animal is reduced by -25. This spell may be combined with Survival I or II.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.8: This spell creates a minor, normal trap (constructed magically). The trap can deliver up to a B critical strike (must be either a Slash, Krush or a Puncture; specified by the caster at time of casting) to any one target. The size of the trap may vary from 1'R to 10'R. The time to construct this trap is 1 round per 1'R.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.9: All traces of an encampment vanish. No trace is left of the fire pit, tracks in the area of the encampment are erased, etc. One casting covers the traces of 10 people or animals; additional castings can be used to cover larger camps. This spell does not prevent new traces from being created if the group is still present, it only erases traces that have already accumulated.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.10: Allows caster to monitor animate activity in the area (e.g., the caster will be aware of movements, subtle and overt). Caster cannot move while concentrating. Caster does not receive a picture of what is moving, just an awareness of the movement. This will allow distinguishing general size and shape of a moving object. Someone staying still, but breathing, will be detected, but only a very general idea of size would be determinable.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.11: Caster may locate the nearest natural object of a specified type, e.g. a specified type of animal or plant, a natural spring, a cave, etc. The object can be a specific item if the caster is personally familiar with that item (e.g. the ranger can find his own horse, or the nearest horse, but not a specific horse that has only been described to him). Caster continues to sense the direction and distance for the duration.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.12: Allows caster to set up a natural “alarm system” in the area of effect; any disturbing activity will cause caster to be alerted. This alert will wake the caster, if he is in a natural sleep.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.13: As Common Nature I, except penalties are reduced by -50.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.14: As Lesser Trap, except trap can deliver an E critical hit.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.15: As Traceless Encampment, except that it will actively hide an encampment still in use. Sleeping areas are shrouded by plants or become recessed into the ground, any fire casts light only visible in a 10'R area and produces no smoke, no tracks are left by those staying in the encampment, etc. Hides 1 person/animal per caster level. Any Awareness maneuver to locate the camp suffers a -100 penalty.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.16: Caster has a 95% chance of predicting weather over a 30-day period.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.17: Creates a natural spring producing enough water to supply 1 person/animal per caster level. The spring is created in the most appropriate location within 500' (must be in a natural setting at ground level), and the caster immediately knows its location. If in a location which would not normally support a spring (e.g. in the desert), the spring will last 10 min/lvl. In a suitable location, it may last days or become permanent.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.18: As Common Nature I, except penalties are reduced to zero.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.19: As Locate Natural Object, except the range is 10 miles.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.20: As Nature’s Awareness I, except detecting activity up to 500' away.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.25: As Waiting Awareness I, except over a 100' radius.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.30: Caster becomes aware of the presence, general location, general type, and number of any actively hostile beings in the area of effect. These beings do not have to be specifically hostile to the caster, but may simply be generally hostile.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.35: Caster’s body adapts to survive in any natural environment. This can involve submersion in freezing water at depths with crushing pressure, traversing molten lava, or enduring exposure to a raging sandstorm. This does not cover any form of deliberate attack (even while comfortable naked in a blizzard, the caster will still suffer normal damage from a Cold Ball). The GM must determine what conditions qualify as “natural.”
SURVIVAL'S WAY.40: As Nature’s Awareness I, except detecting activity up to 100' per level away from the caster.
SURVIVAL'S WAY.50: Caster can use one lower level spell on this list each round.

CURSES.1: Detects a curse on an item or person.
CURSES.2: Target can see at night as if it were day, but he can only see in the day as if it were the darkest night.
CURSES.3: Target will never voluntarily fly by any means, nor climb any greater height than 100'.
CURSES.4: Target can only eat bread or dairy products. Anything else will aggravate his ulcer (unless he makes a physical RR vs 4th level) and he will be incapacitated for 1-10 hours.
CURSES.5: Target cannot move faster than a walking pace on his own (he may be carried or ride at a faster pace).
CURSES.6: Target can only eat green leaves. Eating other food incapacitates him (if he fails a physical RR vs 6 th level) for 1-10 hours.
CURSES.7: Target will never voluntarily swim, enter any water (even a bath), or get into a boat.
CURSES.8: All of target’s fumble numbers (before any reduction due to skill) when attacking are doubled (e.g., a fumble number of 4 becomes 8). When rolling absolute maneuvers, any result of 50 or less is absolute failure. When rolling percentage maneuvers, an “F” result always results in some additional problem arising.
CURSES.9: Target loses all Power Points if target is a Channeling spell user. He cannot cast any spells from the Channeling realm, even by use of magic items, including Runes. A hybrid user of Channeling will only lose half of his Power Points, but cannot cast his Base lists as well as those which are pure Channeling. These PP cannot be regained until the duration of the spell ends or the curse is removed.
CURSES.10: Target can only speak and write in his native language.
CURSES.12: Target loses 1 Power Point every 10 minutes. Power Points are recovered in a normal fashion, but begin to leak away as soon as they are regained.
CURSES.13: Target’s appearance becomes extremely attractive. If anyone sees the uncovered face of the target or gets within 3' (and is of an appropriate sexual orientation and fails an RR), that person will attempt to possess and carry off the target (fighting if necessary). Certain persons will get modifications to their RRs (positive or negative) based on outlook (a hedonist from a tribe that routinely kidnaps brides would be at a large penalty, an ascetic who had taken an oath of celibacy would have a bonus).
CURSES.14: Target’s blood will coagulate and create a blood clot around the area of any cut wound (bleeding at least one hit per round). The clot will cut off circulation to the area fed by the given vessel and target will lose the affected body section after 2-20 minutes due to system damage (e.g., a thigh wound might ultimately mean loss of leg; a neck wound would be fatal). An Extremely Hard (-30) Medicine maneuver, taking 1d10 rounds, will prevent loss of the body part, as will a Joining spell from Blood Law, Blood Mastery, or Blood Ways.
CURSES.15: Target’s appearance becomes hideous and horrifying. If a person sees the uncovered face of the target or gets within 3' of the target, he must make an RR. If he fails by more than 50, he attacks the target. If he fails by 50 or less, he will make every effort short of endangering his own safety to get away from the target. Even if he makes his RR, the viewer will experience extreme distaste for the target. Friends and family will gain bonuses to their RRs, but even they will regard the target with pity and disgust.
CURSES.16: Target will lie 50% of the time, regardless of the topic.
CURSES.17: Any time that the target rolls doubles (e.g., a natural roll of 44), the equipment he is using must check for breakage.
CURSES.18: Target may only speak the truth.
CURSES.19: Once per day (at a random time), the target will experience the pain from an old wound. For new characters, treat this as an A Krush critical strike (rerolling a lethal result) 50% of the time and d10 concussion hits the other 50% of the time. Alternatively, the GM can re-open a specific old wound.
CURSES.20: Target will move at fastest possible pace until he collapses of exhaustion (-100 total penalties). He may be restrained, but whenever freed, or he rests enough to recover from penalties to below -50 he will begin to run again.
CURSES.25: Every time the target is in a combat situation near friends who are within 10', there is a 10% chance each round (non-cumulative) that he will attack one of his friends (randomly determine which one if there are multiple possible targets) and attempt to kill that friend. For these purposes, a “friend” includes any companion, ally, or associate.
CURSES.30: As Excommunication, except effect is permanent until removed.
CURSES.35: Target becomes unable to tolerate magical herbs or oral medicines, vomiting them up without benefit. Healing times for all injuries are doubled.
CURSES.40: Target can never be a willing target of any spell cast by another.
CURSES.50: Target may not attack any “evil” creature. The target will obey the commands of any evil being who is 10 or more levels higher than himself, but can command (+30 to Influence and +60 Leadership) any “Evil” creature whose level is at least 10 below the target’s level. See Section 10.8 for definition of “Evil”.

DARK CHANNELS.1: Detects any active spell or active magical item from an Evil source, or any entity capable of casting Evil spells; caster can concentrate on a different 5'R area each round. (See Section 10.4 for more about detection spells.)
DARK CHANNELS.2: [RR Mod.: -10] Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power. The target is stunned (-50).
DARK CHANNELS.3: When this spell is cast, the 1st level spell that the caster begins to cast (or prepare) the next round will be “channeled” to another spell user of the Channeling realm. The “channeled” spell is transmitted to the other spell user when it would normally take effect, and must be used by the receiving spell user immediately or delayed as described in Section 4.8 (treating the receiving spell user as the caster of the spell). All normal restrictions on the transmitted spell apply. The caster of the Channels spell must be able to see the receiver or know exactly where the receiver is (direction and distance or specific place). The receiver must know exactly when the spell is coming (but need not know what the spell sent is). For example, if a Cleric was at a certain altar at a certain time (midnight of full moon) ready to receive a spell; then another spell user (or deity) who knew this could use Channels I to send a spell to that Cleric. Because the spell is passed through the aura of the receiving character, the spell is cast at the level of the receiving character (including any level-based parameters).
DARK CHANNELS.4: Causes a “holy” being or a Channeler of a “good” power to be unable to approach closer than 100' to the caster and to retreat, if possible, to maintain that distance. If the target fails its RR by more than 30, it must flee (if of this plane) or be banished back to its home plane of existance (in which case duration is “permanent”). This spell will affect entities of “Type I” or of up to 5th level for beings without a “Type”.
DARK CHANNELS.5: [RR Mod.: -10] Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power. The target falls into a deep, magical sleep.
DARK CHANNELS.6: As Channels I, except a 1st-3rd level spell may be transmitted.
DARK CHANNELS.7: Caster can open a channel with any 1 known being the caster is acquainted with. This spell will enable the caster to learn the specific location (direction and distance only) of the other being, making it possible for the caster to use a Channels spell. Note that this spell does not allow any sort of communication, although the target will know that a Channel has been opened to him.
DARK CHANNELS.8: [RR Mod.: -10] Caster points his arm (elbow locked and fist clenched) at the target and channels raw power. The target is blinded.
DARK CHANNELS.9: As Repel Holy I, except affects up to Type III or 15th level targets.
DARK CHANNELS.10: Caster may cast one of the Black Channel I spells (see Section 10.7).
DARK CHANNELS.11: As Channels I, except a 1st-5th level spell may be transmitted.
DARK CHANNELS.12: As Repel Holy I, except affects up to Type IV or 20th level targets.
DARK CHANNELS.13: [RR Mod: -20] Target’s “soul” is torn from the target’s body (or other physical location if the soul is otherwise housed); it remains in whatever place “souls” go for 1 week/10 failure. The soul can be returned early only through Lifegiving or Reuniting. Target is unconscious until soul is restored; even subconscious activity (i.e., healing, etc.) suffers a -75 penalty.
DARK CHANNELS.14: The next Channels spell cast by the caster of this spell may be sent to anyone, regardless of the realm of the other individual. However, the spell channeled must be from an Evil spell list.
DARK CHANNELS.15: Caster may cast one of the Black Channel II spells (see Section 10.7).
DARK CHANNELS.16: As Channel Opening I, except range is 10 miles per level.
DARK CHANNELS.17: As Channels I, except a 1st-7th level spell may be transmitted.
DARK CHANNELS.18: As Repel Holy I, except affects up to Type VI or 30th level targets.
DARK CHANNELS.19: As Channels I, except a 1st-10th level spell may be transmitted.
DARK CHANNELS.20: [RR Mod: -20] As Absolution, except the “soul” can only be brought back through Lifegiving.
DARK CHANNELS.25: Caster may cast one of the Black Channel III spells (see Section 10.7).
DARK CHANNELS.30: [RR Mod: -20] As Absolution, except the “soul” is utterly destroyed.
DARK CHANNELS.35: As Channels I, except a 1st-20th level spell may be transmitted.
DARK CHANNELS.40: As Channel Opening I, except range is 100 miles per level.
DARK CHANNELS.50: Opens a direct channel to the caster’s deity (or other power source); results depend on the deity’s personality, motives, and powers. Any spell the deity can cast may be transmitted through the gate.

DEMONIC PACTS.1: Caster’s mind is filled with dark secrets tugging at his subconscious mind. Any Lore or Science maneuvers on a demon-related topic are made by the caster with a +25 bonus.
DEMONIC PACTS.2: Caster and one demon seal an agreement whereby this spell binds both of them to keep the bargain they have made. The spell will last until the bargain expires due to a time limit agreed upon or simply no longer applies. It is extremely hard to break this spell; it receives a +100 to its RR to resist any form of Dispel or other magic to remove or nullify it. The two parties to the agreement cannot attempt to circumvent the Oath without triggering the punishment for violation of the bargain. Upon any violation of the bargain, the offending party takes an E Holy critical, then on the following round takes a D Holy critical and so on until taking an A Holy critical on the fifth round. These criticals are not modified by size.
DEMONIC PACTS.3: Allows a demon to stay on this plane while it performs a mission for the caster. Caster and demon must have already made the Oath of Binding. Duration is until the demon fulfills its mission (and returns to the caster if it has not yet received its reward and the mission has left it away from the caster), its mission ends in failure (e.g., the item it was sent to fetch is destroyed), or the maximum duration of 1 hour per caster level has elapsed. While this spell is active, the demon can only pursue its mission (or return to the caster once the mission is completed). When this spell ends, unless some other spell allows the demon to stay, it will return to its home plane after a grace period of 1 minute per level of the demon.
DEMONIC PACTS.4: For a period of one week, the caster must cast this spell and spill some of his own blood (taking 1-10 hits of damage in the process) each day. At the end of that week, the caster will have attracted a Stage I familiar spirit into this world and established a bond to it. See Section 10.3 for details on the familiar spirit and its relationship to the caster.
DEMONIC PACTS.5: Caster gains a +25 bonus to his choice of any one Composition, Crafting, Lore, Medical, Performance Art, or Vocation skill. This bonus lasts until the caster casts another Diabolical Skill spell (only one Diabolical Skill spell may be active at one time), the caster touches or is touched by a Holy object (includes Unholy object if the Unholiness is associated with a dark god rather than a demon), is on sacred ground, or is affected by any non-Informational spells from a non-Evil user of Channeling.
DEMONIC PACTS.6: Allows caster to observe any location on the same plane in a pool of blood (blood must not have congealed; spell will prevent congealing during spell duration). This spell has no limits on distance and can focus in on any known place, being, or object that the caster is personally familiar with or can describe well enough to uniquely identify. It is subject to magical protections against information spells and such protections are automatically successful. This spell is also unable to reveal anything on holy ground, though it can spy upon holy objects.
DEMONIC PACTS.7: As Demonic Mission I, except maximum duration is 1 day per caster level.
DEMONIC PACTS.8: This spell must be cast on the caster’s Stage I familiar spirit every day for two weeks. At the end of that time, more of the spirit’s strength will have been drawn from its own plane, allowing it to manifest as a Stage II familiar spirit. See Section 10.3 for the various Stages of the familiar spirit.
DEMONIC PACTS.9: As Diabolical Skill I, except bonus is +50.
DEMONIC PACTS.10: Frees a demon from any constraining Conjuring Circle and allows it to remain for 10 minutes per caster level until it returns to its home plane.
DEMONIC PACTS.11: As Demonic Vision I, except allows the caster to hear what is going on at the site looked upon.
DEMONIC PACTS.12: As Familiar Spirit II, except the caster’s Stage II familiar becomes Stage III in a three week process.
DEMONIC PACTS.13: As Demonic Mission I, except maximum duration is 1 week per caster level.
DEMONIC PACTS.14: As Diabolical Skill I, except bonus is +75.
DEMONIC PACTS.15: As Demonic Vision II, except caster sees the scene as if it were well lit, even if it is in total darkness.
DEMONIC PACTS.16: As Familiar Spirit II, except the caster’s Stage III familiar becomes Stage IV in a four week process.
DEMONIC PACTS.17: As Unleash Demon I, except duration is 1 hour per caster level.
DEMONIC PACTS.18: As Demonic Mission I, except maximum duration is 1 year per caster level.
DEMONIC PACTS.19: As Diabolical Skill I, except bonus is +100.
DEMONIC PACTS.20: As Familiar Spirit II, except the caster’s Stage IV familiar becomes Stage V in a five week process.
DEMONIC PACTS.25: As Unleash Demon I, except duration is 1 day per caster level.
DEMONIC PACTS.30: As Familiar Spirit II, except the caster’s Stage V familiar becomes Stage VI in a six week process.
DEMONIC PACTS.35: This spell is used only once, if ever. Using it, the caster transforms himself into a Lich, one of the most feared of the undead. If the caster fails when attempting this spell, he will simply die. With success, the caster becomes one of the undead without ever actually dying. At this point, the caster is sustained by magic and dwells in a place between life and death.
DEMONIC PACTS.40: As Unleash Demon I, except duration is 1 week per caster level.
DEMONIC PACTS.50: As Cheat Death, except caster’s organs are transferred into a ready container (jar, box, chest, etc.). The caster then becomes a somewhat more powerful Classic Lich and can only be truly destroyed if the container with his organs is destroyed.

DEMONIC SUMMONS.1: Caster empowers a circular diagram (a simple pentacle will suffice, but many prefer something more elaborate) of between five and ten feet in radius to confine a demon within its borders. This conjuring circle will prevent any Type I demon from leaving or attacking (including casting any spells or using other magical abilities) across this circle. If a demon is left in the circle until the duration expires, the demon is freed and may spend 1 minute per demon level on this plane before returning to its home plane.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.2: One Type I demon is instantly banished back to the plane whence it came. If the demon is currently confined to a Conjuring Circle, it makes its RR with a penalty of -25.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.3: Summons a Type I demon which appears at a point within range designated by the caster (within a Conjuring Circle is usually a good idea). It takes the demon two rounds to materialize, during which it is possible to identify the kind of demon appearing (using Creature Lore: Demon). If the demon is not within a Conjuring Circle, it may do as it wishes and can remain for 1 minute per demon level before vanishing back to its home plane. If it is within a Conjuring Circle it remains there until something causes it to be released or banished. When casting this spell, the caster must roll a Spell Mastery maneuver (difficulty Easy). If the Spell Mastery is a Success, the kind of demon that appears is up to the caster; in the case of Absolute Success, the caster may select what level the demon is from the possible range of levels for that kind of demon (or specify a particular demon, if one is known). Partial Success means that the caster knows what kind of demon he is getting (does not need to attempt Creature Lore: Demon). Failure means a random demon of the correct Type is summoned. Absolute Failure means that the caster has summoned a random demon of the next higher Type (in the case of Demon Summoning I, this would be a Type II demon).
DEMONIC SUMMONS.4: Demon obeys the caster for the duration of this spell. The demon vanishes back to its home plane at the end of this spell. If the demon is trapped within a Conjuring Circle, it makes its RR with a -25 penalty. However, if the demon succeeds in its RR, it is freed from any confinement and may stay in this world for 1 minute per level of the demon. A failed control attempt will usually anger a demon. This spell affects demons of Type I only.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.5: As Conjuring Circle I, except will confine a demon of Type II or lower.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.6: As Banish Demon I, except a demon of Type II or lower may be banished.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.7: As Summon Demon I, except summons a demon of Type II and the required Spell Mastery roll is of Light difficulty.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.8: As Control Demon I, except a demon of Type II or lower may be controlled.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.9: As Conjuring Circle I, except will confine a demon of Type III or lower.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.10: As Banish Demon I, except a demon of Type III or lower may be banished.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.11: As Summon Demon I, except summons a demon of Type III and the required Spell Mastery roll is of Medium difficulty.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.12: As Control Demon I, except a demon of Type III or lower may be controlled.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.13: As Conjuring Circle I, except will confine a demon of Type IV or lower.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.14: As Banish Demon I, except a demon of Type IV or lower may be banished.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.15: As Summon Demon I, except summons a demon of Type IV and the required Spell Mastery roll is of Hard difficulty.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.16: As Control Demon I, except a demon of Type IV or lower may be controlled.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.17: As Conjuring Circle I, except will confine a demon of Type V or lower.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.18: As Banish Demon I, except a demon of Type V or lower may be banished.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.19: As Summon Demon I, except summons a demon of Type V and the required Spell Mastery roll is of Very Hard difficulty.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.20: As Control Demon I, except a demon of Type V or lower may be controlled.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.25: As Conjuring Circle I, except will confine a demon of Type VI or lower.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.30: As Banish Demon I, except a demon of Type VI or lower may be banished.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.35: As Summon Demon I, except summons a demon of Type VI and the required Spell Mastery roll is of Extremely Hard difficulty.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.40: As Control Demon I, except a demon of Type VI or lower may be controlled.
DEMONIC SUMMONS.50: As Summon Demon I, except summons a demon of greater than Type VI and the required Spell Mastery roll is of Sheer Folly difficulty, but since this is the most powerful class of demons, an Absolute Failure is the same as a normal failure. Note that demons this powerful cannot be controlled like those of lesser power, so this is a spell to consider carefully before using.

DISEASE.1: Target gets a cold. Treat as a mild Pneumonic disease that does not go away. (See RMCL, Section 15.6.)
DISEASE.3: Target has no sense of smell. Target never perceives by smell alone and suffers a -25 modifier to all Awareness maneuvers involving smell and other senses.
DISEASE.4: Target has no sense of hearing. Target never perceives by hearing alone and suffers a -25 modifier to all Awareness maneuvers involving hearing and other senses.
DISEASE.5: Over the course of one week, the target’s tongue will rot away. When the tongue is fully gone, the target will be unable to speak.
DISEASE.6: Target gets severe asthma. For every round of physical exersion (e.g., running or melee combat), the target must make an Endurance roll.
DISEASE.7: Target gets leprosy. This causes a gradual loss of feeling (and blood flow) in the extremities. Every day, the target suffers a cumulative -1 penalty to all perceptions involving touch to a maximum of -25. There is similarly a cumulative -1 penalty added each day to any roll depending on the target’s appearance (e.g., Charm maneuvers), but the maximum for this penalty is -50. After one week of leprosy, all concussion hit damage against the target is halved due to loss of feeling.
DISEASE.8: Target becomes slightly allergic to a substance of the caster’s choosing. When in the presence of this substance, the target loses 1 AP each round due to the distraction of runny nose, sneezing, etc.
DISEASE.9: The roots of any one plant wither and die and no new roots can be grown. The plant will eventually die.
DISEASE.10: The target becomes a hemophiliac. All concussion hits taken by the target are doubled and hits heal at half the normal rate. All attempts to stop bleeding by the target are made with a -30 penalty and even magical healing stops one less hit/round of bleeding than would normally be the case.
DISEASE.11: The target contracts malaria; after the initial bout of high fever, delerium, coma, and incapacitation (lasting 1 + 2d10 days), the target will be subject to random “relapses” similar to the initial bout (5% chance each month of a relapse). If the target receives no care during the initial bout, there is a 99% chance of death during this time (only 1% chance if given competent medical attention).
DISEASE.12: Caster may instantly kill any one plant he touches.
DISEASE.13: Target becomes an epileptic; in a tense situation, there is a 5% chance that he will go into an epileptic fit for 2d10 rounds. If someone is able to provide care (anyone with a rank in Medicine may do so), there is a 1% chance that the target will do an A Krush critical to himself by hitting some object; if there is nobody to do so, there is a 20% chance of taking a critical. In any case, he is treated as stunned (-75).
DISEASE.14: Target gets pneumonia; if the target is kept warm and completely immobile for 2 weeks, he will have only a 25% chance of dying (50% chance if not treated). The chance of dying is modified by the target’s Constitution stat bonus (e.g., if the target has a +7 Constitution stat bonus, his chance of dying if untreated is 43%). If the target survives this two week period, the lingering symptoms are as a mild Pneumonic disease (RMCL, Section 15.6).
DISEASE.15: As Minor Allergy, except 2 AP are lost each round.
DISEASE.16: The target suffers any one of the diseases from this list of up to 5th level (caster’s choice). In addition, the target is contagious. All who come into contact (5'R) of the target must make an RR (with a +25 modifier if only close to target, +0 if touching target, and at -25 if the individual has intimate contact with the target). If the original target makes his RR, he does not suffer the effects, but must make a second RR or will still be a carrier of the disease. All people who catch the disease from the target are not themselves contagious.
DISEASE.17: Target gets elephantiasis; one of his extremities (not his head) swells and grows up to five times normal size. Exact effect should be determined by the GM (but the extremity should be completely useless).
DISEASE.18: At the rise of the next full moon, the target becomes a Lesser Werewolf (see Creature Law).
DISEASE.19: As Carrier I, except disease may be chosen from spells up to 10th level.
DISEASE.20: Target gets leukemia; he will weaken at a rate of 2% per day (-2/day, cumulative, to all activities). When the total reachs 100% (-100 penalty), the target dies.
DISEASE.25: As Carrier I, except disease may be chosen from spells up to 15th level.
DISEASE.30: Target gets rabies; after 21 days of no visible effect, the disease sets in. The target’s organs contract; he foams at the mouth, becomes very thirsty and violent; and any one he bites or scratches must resist or contract the disease. The target dies 5-7 days after the disease’s onset.
DISEASE.35: As Minor Allergy, except 3 AP are lost each round.
DISEASE.40: At the rise of the next full moon, the target becomes a Greater Werewolf (see Creature Law).
DISEASE.50: Target gets a “plague”. If he fails his RR, he will die 95% of the time (after 10 minutes). The other 5% of the time, he believes that he resisted (and suffers no effects), but becomes a carrier instead. Anyone coming within 5' of the carrier must resist (+25 RR; +0 RR if touching the target; -25 RR if in intimate contact with the target) or face the same chances as the original target. Only the original target is contagious.

WOUNDING.1: Target suffers 1d10 concussion hits of damage.
WOUNDING.2: Target suffers the result of a failed Fatigue check (resulting in a -10 fatigue penalty, becoming an injury penalty if the target exceeds -50 fatigue total).
WOUNDING.3: Target will bleed at the rate of 1 hit per round.
WOUNDING.4: Target suffers 3d10 concussion hits of damage.
WOUNDING.5: One of the target’s external sensory organs (eye, ear, nose, etc.) is damaged. Target will operate without that organ until healed. In addition, the target will have a -10 modification per 10 failure for all actions that partially use that organ (-100 for all actions involving that organ specifically).
WOUNDING.6: Target suffers a hairline fracture in a limb, penalty is -20.
WOUNDING.7: Target will bleed at the rate of 3 hits per round.
WOUNDING.8: Target suffers 5d10 concussion hits of damage.
WOUNDING.9: As Sensory Damage I, except affects two sensory organs.
WOUNDING.11: Target suffers 7d10 concussion hits of damage.
WOUNDING.12: Target suffers a -1 penalty to his Constitution bonus.
WOUNDING.13: Target suffers a simple fracture in a limb, penalty is -40.
WOUNDING.14: Target will bleed at the rate of 5 hits per round.
WOUNDING.15: Target suffers 10d10 concussion hits of damage.
WOUNDING.16: Target suffers a -2 penalty to his Constitution bonus.
WOUNDING.17: Target suffers a compound fracture in a limb, penalty is -60.
WOUNDING.18: Target suffers a spasm in his arms, causing him to drop anything he is holding.
WOUNDING.19: Target suffers a -3 penalty to his Constitution bonus.
WOUNDING.20: Target suffers 15d10 concussion hits of damage.
WOUNDING.25: Target suffers a penalty to his Constitution bonus equal to -1 for every 5 levels of the caster (e.g., if the caster were 25th level, the penalty would be -5).
WOUNDING.30: Target will bleed at the rate of 1 hit per round per every 5 levels of the caster (e.g., if the caster is 30th level, then the target bleeds at a rate of six hits per round).
WOUNDING.35: Target suffers multiple fractures in a limb, total penalty is -100.
WOUNDING.40: Target suffers spinal injury, resulting in paralysis below the waist (if RR failed by 25 or less) or from the neck down (if RR is failed by 26 or more). Target immediately drops to ground and is at -50 for any activity that is still possible.
WOUNDING.50: Target loses all his hits, then takes an additional 1 hit per level of the caster.

DELVING WAYS.1: Caster can measure a distance or length so long as both ends are within sight or caster can measure either the weight or the volume of one item by touching it or the caster can know both the temperature and barometric pressure.
DELVING WAYS.2: Caster can read text written in an unknown language, but only understands basic concepts of it.
DELVING WAYS.3: Gives nature and origin of natural stone, and when and how worked stone was obtained and worked.
DELVING WAYS.4: As Stone Analysis, except metal may be examined.
DELVING WAYS.5: As Stone Analysis, except a gas may be examined.
DELVING WAYS.6: As Stone Analysis, except wood or other plant materials may be examined.
DELVING WAYS.7: As Text Analysis I, except gives a complete technical analysis (vocabulary and syntax) but not an understanding of idioms, jargon, implications, or cultural references.
DELVING WAYS.8: As Stone Analysis, except a liquid may be examined.
DELVING WAYS.9: As Stone Analysis, except items composed of organic materials of animal origins (e.g., bone, leather, ivory) may be examined. This will identify rune paper.
DELVING WAYS.10: Gives significant details about an item’s construction and purpose (not specific powers).
DELVING WAYS.11: Provides analysis of an active spell, giving its duration and the profession of its caster and its type (not its level or exactly what spell it is).
DELVING WAYS.12: Caster gains a knowledge of any non-magical bonus possessed by the target object.
DELVING WAYS.13: Caster gains a +30 bonus to any maneuvers involving mathematical calculations.
DELVING WAYS.14: Gives information concerning a being’s death (weapon, spell, time since, etc.); must be cast in place of death (within 24 hr) or in the presence of body (no time limit).
DELVING WAYS.15: As Text Analysis II, except everything but implications is known (e.g., answers to riddles are not known automatically).
DELVING WAYS.16: One item, person, or place may be examined to see if it has magical power, which realm the power is from, a general idea of its origin, and its basic configuration.
DELVING WAYS.17: Caster’s awareness leaves the caster’s body (which is inactive) and may travel at 1 mile/min; however it can only travel 10'/rnd when in solid material or when observing the world. If the caster overstays the duration, he must make an RR (against Essence) modified by -50 or die (attack level is equal to the number of rounds overstayed). Caster’s awareness can see and hear normally.
DELVING WAYS.18: As Death Analysis, except gives a visual image of the killer (if any) and a vague reason for death (e.g., revenge, robbery, accident, etc.).
DELVING WAYS.19: Gives nature and origin of a work of art, including who the (primary) artist was, what materials and tools were used, when and where the work was done, and the intended purpose and message of the work.
DELVING WAYS.20: Any of the lower level spells may be used together on one item, person, or place (Conveyance is not included).
DELVING WAYS.25: As Analysis, except one item per round may be examined.
DELVING WAYS.30: As Power Analysis, except exact origin, creator, and detailed purpose are given.
DELVING WAYS.35: As Death’s Delving, except caster can sense direction and distance to the killer, the body, and to the killing weapon (if any) so long as the distance does not exceed 1 mile per level of the caster.
DELVING WAYS.40: The caster gains complete information on the item’s construction, purpose, magical abilities, and any non-magical bonuses.
DELVING WAYS.50: As Conveyance, except rate is 10 mile/min (50'/rnd through solids or while observing).

DETECTING WAYS.1: Detects any active spell or active magical item from the Essence realm; caster can concentrate on a different 5'R area each round.
DETECTING WAYS.2: As Detect Essence, except realm is Mentalism.
DETECTING WAYS.3: As Detect Essence, except realm is Channeling.
DETECTING WAYS.4: As Detect Essence, except detects magic of any realm (does not reveal which realm is detected).
DETECTING WAYS.5: As Detect Essence, except detects invisible things; all attacks against something so detected are modified by -50.
DETECTING WAYS.6: As Detect Essence, except it gives a 75% chance of detecting a trap (modified by half the bonus or penalty difficulty of finding the trap through a Perception maneuver). If a trap is missed, the spell will not find it no matter how many times the caster scans the same area.
DETECTING WAYS.7: As Detect Essence, except detects any evil being or any item created by evil or long used by a very evil person.
DETECTING WAYS.8: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail. The caster must have the dimensions of the object exact within 10% of actual size and know at least two other attributes that make the item unique (e.g., color, texture, weight, etc.) within range of the spell. Note that sometimes the caster must know more than two other attributes to make the item unique.
DETECTING WAYS.9: As Detect Essence, except detects poisonous substances.
DETECTING WAYS.10: Gives the power (level) of the person or item or spell examined; caster can concentrate on a different target each round.
DETECTING WAYS.11: As Detect Essence, except detects dead bodies and whether anything has died in the radius in the last 24 hours.
DETECTING WAYS.12: As Location I, except range is 300'.
DETECTING WAYS.13: As Detect Essence, except detects one herb of the caster’s choice.
DETECTING WAYS.14: As Detect Essence, except detects one species of life chosen by the caster.
DETECTING WAYS.15: As Detect Essence, except detects any active or latent (awaiting a trigger event) spell that has been cast in the area examined. Realm(s) of spell(s) are revealed, as well as general type (Force, Elemental, etc.); also revealed is whether spell is active or awaiting a triggering event.
DETECTING WAYS.16: As Location I, except range is 500'.
DETECTING WAYS.17: As Detect Essence, except detects any area where magic does not act normally or where there is an abnormal structure to the local space and/or time (as with the presence of an interdimensional Gate).
DETECTING WAYS.18: As Perceive Power, except range is 300'.
DETECTING WAYS.19: As Detect Essence, except detects one metal of the caster’s choice.
DETECTING WAYS.20: As Location I, except range is 1 mile.
DETECTING WAYS.25: As Detect Essence, except detects any type of detection spell that is operating in the area examined and gives exact spell detected as well as the location of that spell’s caster if he is within 100'.
DETECTING WAYS.30: Detects as any one of the lower level Detect spells. Thing detected and area of effect can both be changed each round.
DETECTING WAYS.35: As Perceive Power I, except range is 100'/level and everything within a 5' radius can be “perceived” at once.
DETECTING WAYS.40: As any of the lower level Detect or Discover spells, except entire 100' radius around the caster is scanned instantly and the locations of any detected things are learned to within 1'.
DETECTING WAYS.50: As Location I, except range is 1 mile/ level.

ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.1: Target is totally protected from all natural light (not lightning); +10 to all RRs or DBs vs. elemental light (electricity) attacks.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.2: Target is totally protected from all natural heat to 200° F; +10 to all RRs or DBs vs. elemental heat/ fire attacks.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.3: Target is totally protected from all natural cold to -20° F; +10 to all RRs or DBs vs. elemental cold/ ice attacks.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.4: As Resist Light, except all beings within 10'R of target are protected.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.5: As Resist Heat, except all beings within 10'R of target are protected.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.6: As Resist Cold, except all beings within 10'R of target are protected.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.7: As Resist Heat and Resist Cold, except for duration, and only natural temperature extremes are protected against.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.8: As Resist Light, except protects against all natural light and lightning; +20 to all RRs vs light (electricity); -20 to elemental electricity attacks.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.9: As Lightarmor, except protects against heat.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.10: As Lightarmor, except protects against cold.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.11: As Lightarmor, except protects all beings within 10'R centered on target.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.12: As Heatarmor, except protects all beings within 10'R centered on target.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.13: As Coldarmor, except protects all beings within 10'R centered on target.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.14: As Resist Light, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.15: As Lightarmor, except it also reduces the effective Size of any electrical attack on the target by 1 (e.g., a Medium Lightning Bolt becomes a Small Lightning Bolt).
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.16: As Resist Heat, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.17: As Lightning Armor, except fire and heat spells are affected (e.g., fire bolts and fire balls).
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.18: As Resist Cold, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.19: As Lightning Armor, except cold and ice spells are affected (e.g., ice bolts and cold balls).
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.20: As Lightarmor, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.25: As Heatarmor, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.30: As Coldarmor, except as many targets as the caster’s level can be affected.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.35: As Fire Armor, except protects all beings within 10'R centered on target.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.40: As Ice Armor, except protects all beings within 10'R centered on target.
ELEMENTAL SHIELDS.50: Acts as Lightning Armor, Fire Armor, and Ice Armor all at the same time.

ESSENCE HAND.1: Causes an object of up to 1 lb. weight to vibrate rapidly; if the item is fragile, make a breakage check. If it is an object held by a being, the being must make an RR or fumble it (each round).
ESSENCE HAND.2: Exerts 5 pound of counterforce on a person or object. Object cannot be moved by Staying alone, which can only be used to counter another force, such as gravity, and it can only exert force in one direction. A person (or other animate target) must win a feat of strength based on their weight vs. the weight capacity of the spell in order to move against the force.
ESSENCE HAND.3: Caster can move one object at a distance, weighing up to 1 pound, up to 1'/second with no acceleration. If the caster stops concentration before the duration is up, the object remains stationary as if it had Staying I thrown on it. If the object is held, resolve any attempt to grab it as a feat of strength based on the weight capacity of the spell vs. the weight of the target holding the object.
ESSENCE HAND.4: As Vibrations I, except weight limit is 5 lbs.
ESSENCE HAND.5: As Staying I, except force limit is 25 lbs.
ESSENCE HAND.6: As Telekinesis I, except weight limit is 5 lbs.
ESSENCE HAND.7: As Vibrations I, except weight limit is 25 lbs.
ESSENCE HAND.8: As Staying I, except force limit is 125 lbs.
ESSENCE HAND.9: As Vibrations I, except weight limit is 50 lbs.
ESSENCE HAND.10: Causes +50 to be added to the attack roll of the missile. The caster must touch the firer and see the missile for the entire round that the missile is fired.
ESSENCE HAND.11: As Telekinesis I, except the weight limit is 25 lbs.
ESSENCE HAND.12: As Staying I, except the force limit is 250 lbs.
ESSENCE HAND.13: As Vibrations I, except as many 5 lb. objects as the caster’s level can be vibrated (they must all be within the field of vision of the caster).
ESSENCE HAND.14: As Telekinesis I, except weight limit is 50 lbs.
ESSENCE HAND.15: As Staying I, except force limit is 500 lbs.
ESSENCE HAND.16: Caster may “hurl” one object (that starts within 10' of the caster) of 1 lb. or less with sufficient force to deliver an attack on the Sling Attack Table with the ranges of a Short Bow. Base the caster’s OB on his directed spell skill with this spell. If a weapon is “hurled”, a medium Spell Mastery maneuver will allow use of the weapon’s normal attack table, retaining the Short Bow range penalties. If this is done, the weapon gets any normal OB bonuses (e.g., from superior materials).
ESSENCE HAND.17: As Telekinesis I, except weight limit is 100 lbs.
ESSENCE HAND.18: As Vibrations I, except weight limit is 10 lbs./level.
ESSENCE HAND.19: As Vibrations I, except as many 25 lb. objects as the caster’s level can be vibrated (they must all be within the field of vision of the caster).
ESSENCE HAND.20: As Aiming, except missile attack bonus is +100.
ESSENCE HAND.25: As Staying I, except force limit is 50 lbs./level.
ESSENCE HAND.30: As Telekinesis I, except weight limit is 10 lbs./level.
ESSENCE HAND.35: As Mass Vibrations I, except objects may be up to 10 lbs./level in weight.
ESSENCE HAND.40: As True Telekinesis, except within the weight limit, the caster may simultaneously manipulate up to one object for every five caster levels (i.e., a 40th level caster could control eight objects at once).
ESSENCE HAND.50: As Aiming, except missile attack automatically does maximum damage (roll the critical normally, except that it is treated as Slaying II).

ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.1: Caster can pick a point up to 10' away and experience tactile sensations as if their hand was in that place, able to move as their hand might. The point may be on the other side of a barrier (e.g., in a chest, behind a door), but cannot move through solid objects from that starting point. Sensations of intense heat or cold will not cause pain, nor will touching something painful to the touch produce more than a dull ache (i.e., painful sensation is muted). Target cannot be moved and cannot feel the “touch”.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.2: Caster is aware of the presence of all sentient/ thinking beings within 20'.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.3: Caster can pick a point up to 10' away and will hear as if physically at that point (there can be intervening objects such as walls). Note that this means that the caster does not have hearing at his own location.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.4: As Listen I, except the caster’s sense of smell functions from the fixed point.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.5: Caster’s point of hearing may be moved independently up to 100' away (moves at 10'/md); the caster must be physically able to go there (e.g., the caster could not send this point of hearing through walls or closed doors). Note that this means that the caster does not have hearing at his own location.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.6: As Listen I, except the caster sees from the fixed point (it can rotate).
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.7: As Long Ear I, except the caster sees from the moving point (it can rotate).
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.8: As Listen I, except the range is 100'.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.9: As Long Ear I, except the caster’s sense of smell functions from the moving point.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.10: Caster can read the surface thoughts of one target.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.11: As Watch I, except the range is 100'.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.12: As Long Ear I, except the range is 300'.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.13: As Smell I, except the range is 100'.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.14: As Listen I, except the range is 500'.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.15: As Long Eye I, except the range is 300'.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.16: One of the caster’s senses has an extended spectrum of sensitivity. Vision may be extended into infrared or ultraviolet light or hearing extended into infrasonic or ultrasonic frequencies. Applicability to any other sense is up the Gamemaster.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.17: As Long Nose I, except the range is 300'.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.18: As Watch I, except range is 500'.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.19: As Smell I, except range is 500'.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.20: As Listen I, except the range is 1 mile/ level.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.25: As Watch I, except the range is 1 mile/ level.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.30: As Listen I, except the range is unlimited (the caster must be able to locate the desired point in terms of direction and distance).
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.35: As Smell I, except the range is 1 mile/ level.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.40: When making a ranged attack, including any form of spell, all range penalties are reduced to one-tenth rounded down (e.g., a -25 penalty would be reduced to -2). Any Perception maneuver penalties based on sight should be made as if the caster were at one-tenth the actual distance from what is being observed.
ESSENCE'S PERCEPTIONS.50: As Listen True, except the caster sees instead of hears.

LESSER ILLUSIONS.1: Caster can speak and the caster’s voice will appear to come from any point desired within 100' (point must be in the caster’s field of vision).
LESSER ILLUSIONS.2: Creates any simple, immobile image/ scene in an area of up to 10'R, or creates a set of immobile sounds in an area of up to 10'R.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.3: As Sound/Light Mirage, except it creates a set of immobile smells/scents in the area of effect, or a set of immobile tastes in the area of effect.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.4: Creates a simple, immobile image or scene up to an area of 10'R. One of the following options may also be chosen: a) an extra sense can be added (not the tactile or Presence senses), b) the duration can be doubled, c) the range can be doubled, d) the radius of the area of effect can be doubled, or e) the illusion can cast light. All parts of the area of effect must be in the caster’s field of vision at the time of casting.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.5: Creates the image of one object or being that will move however the caster wants (as long as the caster concentrates). When the caster stops concentrating, the image remains but stops moving. The caster may resume concentration again later, and make the image move again (presuming that the duration has not expired). The image can be of any size that would fit in a 10'R.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.6: One object (up to 10 pounds per level) has its visual appearance altered for the duration of the spell. Note that no other aspect of the object changes. This spell cannot make an object cast light (although it may alter the appearance of light given off, whether naturally or from another spell).
LESSER ILLUSIONS.7: As Illusion II, except it can be delayed by up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can chose one of the following: a) time period, b) specified movements, c) specified sounds, d) specified smells, or e) specified tastes. If a sense is used to trigger the spell, that sense must be included in the illusion.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.8: As Illusion II, except two options can be chosen. See notes above for guidelines on how to combine the options.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.9: As Phantasms I, except one of the following options may also be chosen: a) an extra sense can be added (not the tactile or Presence senses), b) the duration can be doubled, c) the range can be doubled, d) the radius of the area of effect can be doubled, e) another image can be created and moved independently of the first (all separate images must be within the caster’s field of vision and within range of the spell), f) the phantasm can cast light, or g) limited repetitious sounds, movements, etc., can be added that do not require concentration of the caster (the proper senses involved must also be included within the illusion).
LESSER ILLUSIONS.10: As Phantasms II, except it can be delayed as in Waiting Illusion II. The phantasm will move and act if given a simple command (at the time of casting) or it can deliver a short speech (if sound was one of the included senses).
LESSER ILLUSIONS.11: As Waiting Illusion II, except two options can be chosen. See notes above for guidelines on how to combine the options.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.12: As Phantasms II, except two options can be chosen.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.13: As Illusion III, except four options.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.14: As Waiting Illusion III, except three options can be chosen.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.15: As Phantasms III, except it can be delayed as in Waiting Phantasms II.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.16: As Waiting Illusion III, except four options can be chosen.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.17: As Phantasms II, except three options can be chosen.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.18: As Phantasms IV, except it can be delayed as in Waiting Phantasms II.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.19: As Illusion III, except six options.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.20: As Waiting Illusion III, except five options can be chosen.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.25: As Phantasms II, except four options.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.30: As Illusion III, except nine options.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.35: As Waiting Illusion III, except nine options can be chosen.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.40: As Illusion III, except fourteen options.
LESSER ILLUSIONS.50: As Phantasms II, except nine options.

PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.1: Caster can tell the exact mass and/or weight of one object per caster level.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.2: Target gains an extremely acute sense of hearing. This results in +50 to Perception rolls involving only hearing, +25 to Perception involving hearing and other senses.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.3: Adds +50 to any rolls for any moving maneuvers performed at a walking pace or less (e.g., walking a 3" beam).
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.4: Target can see up to 100' as if it were daylight, so long as there is some light.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.5: Target has a 300° field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the target is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus is lowered to +15.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.6: Target’s voice carries three times as far as normal.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.7: Target can see 100' in any water (including murky water) as if through air in daylight.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.8: Target can breathe water but not air.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.9: Target can see varying degrees of heat on the surfaces of objects. This spell does not allow the caster to see “through” things. While this vision is sufficient for moving around, it is not sufficient at all for reading or mapping.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.10: Target can breathe any gas as normal air.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.11: Delays the effect of a poison on a target. If the poison is not eliminated before the spell expires, the poison will affect the target at that time.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.12: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. No light at all is needed for this spell to work.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.13: Target can hear normally underwater or in any other medium that distorts sound.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.14: Target can dig through earth at a rate of 10'/round. Target cannot dig through solid stone or metal.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.15: Target can breathe water, air, and any gas at will.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.16: As Balance, except can affect one target/level of caster.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.17: Target has a 360° field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the target is lowered to zero and the rear bonus is lowered to +5.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.18: As Nightvision, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster’s level.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.19: As Watervision, except can affect one target/level of caster.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.20: As Nightvision, Sidevision, Watervision, Heatvision, and Darkvision all functioning at the same time.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.25: As Waterlungs, except can affect 1 target/level of caster.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.30: As Gaslungs, except can affect 1 target/ level of caster.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.35: As Darkvision, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster’s level.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.40: As Changing Lungs, except can affect 1 target/level of caster.
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT.50: As Vision, except can affect 1 target/level of caster.

RUNE MASTERY.1: Caster may cast this spell with another spell in order to store that second spell. The spell to be stored must be cast within one minute after the Spell Store spell is cast. The stored spell may then be cast later as an instantaneous spell. The Spell Store spell costs the same number of PP as the spell that is stored. No other spell may be cast while a spell is stored.
RUNE MASTERY.2: This spell attempts to remove an existing rune. The rune will resist at its own level, but if the caster knows what the rune is, the rune suffers a -20 penalty to its RR.
RUNE MASTERY.3: This spell inscribes another spell on a specially prepared piece of paper. The rune can then be used to cast the inscribed spell once (although the paper can be reused). The spell to be inscribed must be cast within one minute after the Rune spell is cast. Rune I can only inscribe 1st level spells. The rune can be set to affect the reader. The spell to be inscribed in the rune must be cast with that intent, but the caster of the Rune spell need not be the caster of the spell to be inscribed. The caster of the Rune spell and the caster of the inscribed spell must both touch the Rune Paper, that is to hold the rune.
RUNE MASTERY.4: Any Runes maneuver made by the caster has a +10 bonus.
RUNE MASTERY.5: Any attempt to read the affected rune by someone other than the caster will suffer a penalty of -50 to the Runes maneuver.
RUNE MASTERY.6: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-2nd level spells.
RUNE MASTERY.7: [RR Mod.: -30] Attempts to remove a Runic Lock from a rune. If this spell fails, the caster must gain a level before he can attempt to unlock this rune again.
RUNE MASTERY.8: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-3rd level spells.
RUNE MASTERY.9: Any Runes maneuver made by the caster has a +25 bonus.
RUNE MASTERY.10: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-5th level spells.
RUNE MASTERY.11: [RR Mod: -20] A Sign can be inscribed on any “non-mobile” surface and targets the triggering being. A Sign can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster): a) certain movements within 20’, b) certain sounds within 20’, c) touch, or d) reading. The Sign is erased when a being fails an RR against it. Sign of Shock puts the target in a state of shock for 1 min/1 failure – treat as if the target is stunned (-50).
RUNE MASTERY.12: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-6th level spells.
RUNE MASTERY.13: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Shock, except target will flee the sign’s location for 1 min/5 failure. Note that the target’s RR is made against Essence, not against Fear.
RUNE MASTERY.14: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-7th level spells.
RUNE MASTERY.15: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Shock, except target falls into a sleep from which he cannot be awakened for 10 min/10 failure.
RUNE MASTERY.16: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-8th level spells.
RUNE MASTERY.17: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Shock, except target is blind for 1 hour/10 failure.
RUNE MASTERY.18: As Rune I, except caster may inscribe 1st-9th level spells.
RUNE MASTERY.19: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Shock, except target is paralyzed and can take no action for 1 hour/10 failure.
RUNE MASTERY.20: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-10th level spells.
RUNE MASTERY.25: This spell allows for the random creation of magic items. See Treasure Law Section 5.3.
RUNE MASTERY.30: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-20th level spells.
RUNE MASTERY.35: [RR Mod: -20] As Sign of Shock, except target takes one C critical of any type specified by the caster per 10 failure.
RUNE MASTERY.40: As Rune I, except it may be used to inscribe a spell up to the caster’s level.
RUNE MASTERY.50: [RR Mod: -20] As any Sign spell from this list, except that it can affect a number of targets up to the level of the caster before disappearing.

SPELL WALL.1: Target gains a bonus of +5 to RRs against spells and a bonus of +5 to DB against elemental attacks.
SPELL WALL.2: When the caster of this spell is the target of a spell from the realm of Essence, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR before the caster makes an RR. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster of this spell normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target. Being a “willing target” does not eliminate this effect, but the caster’s own spells do not need to make an RR. Note that the caster is considered to be a target of any spell which includes him in its area of effect or would “detect” him.
SPELL WALL.3: As Protection I, except all beings within 10'R of target (sphere moves with target) get the benefits.
SPELL WALL.4: As Cancel Essence, except it affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.
SPELL WALL.5: As Protection I, except bonuses are +10.
SPELL WALL.6: As Cancel Essence, except it affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
SPELL WALL.7: As Protection Sphere I, except bonuses are +10.
SPELL WALL.8: As Cancel Essence, except for the area of effect (centered on and moving with the caster). Any spell targeting inside the area of effect may be canceled. If the radius encounters an already existing spell, that spell must make an RR (with a +30 modifier) or be neutralized within the sphere (so long as it is within the sphere).
SPELL WALL.9: Creates a shimmering shield in front of the caster: it provides a bonus to the caster’s RR or DB of 10 against all frontal Essence spell attacks on the caster (force and elemental). If the caster takes an instantaneous action to do so, he can “deflect” one spell attack. This results in adding the caster’s ranks in this list to his RR or, for spells that use an attack table, to his DB (in addition to the basic bonus of 10 for having the Shield). Multiple deflections can be done in a single round, but each is a separate instantaneous action (costing 1 AP for every instantaneous action after the first).
SPELL WALL.10: As Essence Shield, except it is effective only against Mentalism spells.
SPELL WALL.11: As Protection I except bonuses are +15.
SPELL WALL.12: As Cancel Essence Sphere I, except it affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.
SPELL WALL.13: As Essence Shield, except it is effective only against Channeling spells.
SPELL WALL.14: As Essence Shield, except it is effective against any two of the three realms.
SPELL WALL.15: As Protection I, except bonuses are +20.
SPELL WALL.16: As Cancel Essence Sphere I, except it affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
SPELL WALL.17: As Cancel Essence Sphere I, except for radius.
SPELL WALL.18: As Essence Shield, except it is effective against all three realms.
SPELL WALL.19: As Protection I, except bonuses are +25.
SPELL WALL.20: Target gets a +50 bonus for all RRs vs. Essence spells.
SPELL WALL.25: Target gets a +50 bonus for all RRs vs. Mentalism spells.
SPELL WALL.30: Target gets a +50 bonus for all RRs vs. Channeling spells.
SPELL WALL.35: As Cancel Essence Sphere I, except that it affects spells from any realm of magic, and has an enhanced radius.
SPELL WALL.40: As Cancel Magic Sphere II, except for radius.
SPELL WALL.50: As Essence Resistance, except all three realms are affected.

UNBARRING WAYS.1: Caster can cause any lock visible within 100' to be locked (the lock is just normally locked and can be opened normally).
UNBARRING WAYS.2: A door (or container) can be magically “locked”. The door can be broken normally or the spell can be dispelled; otherwise, the door cannot be opened.
UNBARRING WAYS.3: Gives the caster a +20 bonus for picking the lock analyzed. If the caster takes a round to explain the lock to someone else, that person gets a +10 bonus to pick the lock.
UNBARRING WAYS.4: When cast on a lock there is a 20% chance a normal lock will open, and a 45% chance that a Magic Lock will open (failure means there is a 10% chance of setting off attached traps). Rolls are open-ended, and the quality of the lock may modify the roll (given percentage assumes a “Medium” quality lock).
UNBARRING WAYS.5: As Locklore, except applies to disarming traps.
UNBARRING WAYS.6: As Opening I, except its chances concern disarming traps.
UNBARRING WAYS.7: Causes a door to expand and jam into its frame (roll 1-100: severity ranges from slightly stuck to unopenable).
UNBARRING WAYS.8: Reduces the inherent strength of a door. All attempts to force or break through the door get a +50 bonus; Breakage Rolls for the door are made at -50.
UNBARRING WAYS.9: As Opening I, except that every lock within the radius of effect has a chance of opening. Roll separately for each lock.
UNBARRING WAYS.10: As Opening I, except chances are 40% for normal locks and 90% for a Magic Lock.
UNBARRING WAYS.11: Will vaporize a non-magical door up to 6" thick, 10' high and 10' wide (if the door is thicker than 6" it will vaporize the closest 6 inches).
UNBARRING WAYS.12: As Opening II, except its chances concern disarming traps.
UNBARRING WAYS.13: As Magic Lock, except duration is 1 hr/lvl and the chance that an Opening spell (or Open Prison) will work is reduced by 20%.
UNBARRING WAYS.14: As Magic Lock, except door is unbreakable by normal means (lasts 1 hour/level).
UNBARRING WAYS.15: As Undoor I, except door can be up to 20'x20'x2'.
UNBARRING WAYS.16: As Open Prison I, except chances are 40% for normal locks and 90% for Magic Locks.
UNBARRING WAYS.17: As Undoor I, except door can be up to 50'x50'x3'.
UNBARRING WAYS.18: As Magic Lock, except duration is 1 day/level and the chance that an Opening spell (or Open Prison) will work is reduced by 40%.
UNBARRING WAYS.19: As Undoor I, except any single door is vaporized.
UNBARRING WAYS.20: A doorway (8'x5') is created in any wall up to 6"/level deep.
UNBARRING WAYS.25: Gives the caster a 90% chance of opening a lock. The roll is open-ended and the quality of the lock may modify the roll.
UNBARRING WAYS.30: As Lock Mastery, except its chances concern disarming traps.
UNBARRING WAYS.35: All traps in the radius of effect have a 95% chance of failing to operate. Once the spell duration is over or the trap is outside the effect radius, the trap will function normally. This does require that the trap have some mechanism involved. A pit trap with a trap door opening will fail, but a pit simply covered over with some branches will still not support any more weight than normal.
UNBARRING WAYS.40: As Lock Mastery and Trap Mastery, except applies to every lock and trap within the radius of effect.
UNBARRING WAYS.50: Caster can utilize any one of the lower level spells on this list each round.

DISPELLING WAYS.1: When the caster (of Cancel Essence) is the target of a spell from the Essence realm, the “incoming” spell must first make a successful RR before the caster needs to make an RR. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster normally; otherwise, the incoming spell has no effect on this target. Being a “willing target” does not eliminate this effect, but the caster’s own spells do not need to make an RR. Note that the caster is considered to be a target of any spell which includes him in its area of effect or would “detect” him.
DISPELLING WAYS.2: As Cancel Essence, except it affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.
DISPELLING WAYS.3: As Cancel Essence, except it affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
DISPELLING WAYS.4: Any active spell from the realm of Essence that is on the target must make an RR. If the spell fails its RR, it is dispelled.
DISPELLING WAYS.5: As Dispel Essence, except affects spells of the realm of Mentalism.
DISPELLING WAYS.6: As Dispel Essence, except affects spells of the realm of Channeling.
DISPELLING WAYS.7: Any active spell from the realm of Essence that is (at least partly) within the radius of effect must make an RR. If the spell fails its RR, it is dispelled.
DISPELLING WAYS.8: As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except affects spells of the realm of Mentalism.
DISPELLING WAYS.9: As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except affects spells of the realm of Channeling.
DISPELLING WAYS.10: As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except radius is 50'.
DISPELLING WAYS.11: As Dispel Mentalism Sphere I, except radius is 50'.
DISPELLING WAYS.12: As Dispel Channeling Sphere I, except radius is 50'.
DISPELLING WAYS.13: As Cancel Essence, except affects spells from any realm.
DISPELLING WAYS.14: As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except radius is 100'.
DISPELLING WAYS.15: As Dispel Mentalism Sphere I, except radius is 100'.
DISPELLING WAYS.16: As Dispel Channeling Sphere I, except radius is 100'.
DISPELLING WAYS.17: Target has no Essence Power Points and can cast no Essence spells for 24 hours (includes spells cast using power enhancers). This can also be cast against items that could normally cast spells.
DISPELLING WAYS.18: As Unessence, except Mentalism is affected.
DISPELLING WAYS.19: As Unessence, except Channeling is affected.
