DISPELLING WAYS.20: As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except radius is 300'.
DISPELLING WAYS.25: As Dispel Mentalism Sphere I, except radius is 300'.
DISPELLING WAYS.30: As Dispel Channeling Sphere I, except radius is 300'.
DISPELLING WAYS.35: As Dispel Essence Sphere V, except all 3 realms are affected.
DISPELLING WAYS.40: As Dispel Sphere True V, except radius is 100'.
DISPELLING WAYS.50: As Dispel Sphere True V, except radius is 200'.

FLUID ELEMENTS.1: Caster can whisper and the air will carry his words to one person within range.
FLUID ELEMENTS.2: A missile within 10' of the caster is given calm air around it throughout its flight, allowing it to ignore all penalties due to wind, including magical air movement (e.g., an Airwall).
FLUID ELEMENTS.3: Creates a dense fog within the area of effect. Treat as a heavy fog as described in RMCL Section 15.7.
FLUID ELEMENTS.4: Creates a wall of dense churning air up to 10'x10'x3'. This wall requires 1 AP to cross, the pace of anyone moving through it at more than a Walk comes out with his pace reduced by one (e.g, a Run going in would be a Jog coming out), and attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty.
FLUID ELEMENTS.5: Creates a wall of water up to 10'x10'x1'. This wall requires 2 AP to cross, the pace of anyone moving through it at more than a Walk comes out with his pace reduced by two (e.g, a Run going in would be a Walk pace coming out) to a minimum of a Walk, and attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty.
FLUID ELEMENTS.6: A missile launched from within 10' of the caster is aided by a wind that leads it towards its intended target. This provides a +10 bonus to the missile attack. This cannot be combined with Path of Calm.
FLUID ELEMENTS.7: Disperses fog within the area of effect. If not all of a fog is dispersed (i.e., the fog covers a greater area than the area of effect for this spell), the fog will refill the area of effect, reducing the cleared radius by 10' every 1-5 minutes (varying depending on the heaviness of the fog and ambient humidity).
FLUID ELEMENTS.8: A bolt of water is shot from the caster’s palm; results are determined on the Water Bolt Table.
FLUID ELEMENTS.9: Target’s fluids are immediately replenished, eliminating any dehydration that the target may have been suffering. This spell also meets the target’s water needs for the next 24 hours, not including losses directly due to magic (i.e., it will not defend against a Dessication spell, but will cure its effects if cast after).
FLUID ELEMENTS.10: Creates a 5' radius of near vacuum; all within the radius take a B Impact critical as the air leaves and rushes back in (if they fail an RR).
FLUID ELEMENTS.11: As Guiding Wind I, except bonus is +20.
FLUID ELEMENTS.12: As Waterwall, except caster need not concentrate and the duration is 1 minute per level.
FLUID ELEMENTS.13: All water within a 100'R is calmed; waves are cut by 20' in the center and less towards the perimeter. This will negate the effects of currents in the area of effect.
FLUID ELEMENTS.14: By concentrating, the caster can convert a liquid that is mostly water into pure water or a gas that is mainly breathable air into fresh air. If purifying a liquid, the caster can purity a cubic foot per round of concentration. If purifying a gas, the caster can purify 10' cubed (i.e., 1000 cubic feet) each round. The purification has a permanent effect; the duration of Concentration is purely a matter of continuing purification.
FLUID ELEMENTS.15: A bolt of water is shot from the caster’s palm; results are determined on the Water Bolt Table.
FLUID ELEMENTS.16: As Vacuum I, except radius is 10'.
FLUID ELEMENTS.17: As Guiding Wind I, except bonus is +30.
FLUID ELEMENTS.18: Caster can control the speed and direction of the wind. Caster can increase or decrease wind speed by 1 mph per caster level (e.g., if the wind speed is normally 20 mph, a 15th level caster could alter the wind speed to between 5 and 35 mph). By directing the wind against missile attacks the caster can cause a -1 modification for each mph of wind speed. Note that caster can also control the direction of the flow of gases and/or clouds.
FLUID ELEMENTS.19: A bolt of water is shot from the caster’s palm; results are determined on the Water Bolt Table.
FLUID ELEMENTS.20: As Vacuum I, except radius is 15'.
FLUID ELEMENTS.25: As Guiding Wind I, except bonus is +50 and any range penalties are halved.
FLUID ELEMENTS.30: The area of effect for this spell is the water immediately surrounding the boat that the caster is on (where “boat” should be interpreted loosely; a log is a “boat” for purposes of this spell if the caster is riding it on water). For as long as the caster concentrates, the speed of the boat will be increased by 25' per round (approximately 3 miles per hour).
FLUID ELEMENTS.35: Creates a whirlpool with a 50 foot radius in any liquid body that will draw in any objects in the liquid up to 500' away. Objects capable of moving under their own power may make a Very Hard Swimming maneuver to resist the pull of the whirlpool.
FLUID ELEMENTS.40: As Vacuum I, except radius is 30'.
FLUID ELEMENTS.50: Summons forces of nature in a fierce thunderstorm which includes heavy rain, 25-60 mph winds, lightning (random) and a blizzard (if correct climate). Can be delayed up to 1 hour/level after casting.

GATE MASTERY.1: The caster can attune himself to a small creature of animal intelligence (i.e., with the Animalistic flaw) to serve as his familiar. The caster must obtain the creature (which can be no more than 10% of caster’s own mass) through normal means and cast the spell on the animal daily for 1 week (associating with the animal for 2 hours each day). The caster can then control the familiar and view the world through its senses by concentrating on it (must be within 50' per caster level). If the animal is killed, the caster will have a -25 modification to all actions for 2 weeks.
GATE MASTERY.2: Caster can instantly summon a first level non-intelligent (i.e., possessing the Animalistic or Mindless flaw) living creature, which appears somewhere within the spell’s range. The caster can specify the general type of creature, but exactly what the creature is should be determined randomly (e.g., the caster could specify “four-legged, hoofed” and could get a zebra, horse, camel, etc.). If the creature can understand the caster’s communication, the creature can be controlled by normal communication. Otherwise, control is maintained through concentration of the caster. If the creature summoned is used for a task that is not dangerous (in its own perception), the duration for this spell is 10 minutes per level. However, if the creature is ever put into a dangerous situation, the duration immediately drops to 1 round per level. At the end of the spell’s duration, the summoned creature will disappear back whence it came.
GATE MASTERY.3: While this spell is active, any spell targeting the caster (including “self” spells) for which the caster is a willing target will also affect the familiar. Note that a familiar may not benefit from every possible spell (e.g., even though familiars tend to be smarter than normal for their kind, a familiar would not know what to do with the benefits of Fire Mastery).
GATE MASTERY.4: [RR Mod.: Special, see text] By concentrating, the caster can control one Grade I elemental. If this spell fails, the elemental will act normally unless it is a spell-caster, in which case it will become hostile (i.e., only a spell-casting elemental will recognize a control attempt as a hostile act). If the caster of this spell knows the Magician Base list corresponding to the elemental’s element, then the caster’s ranks in that list are subtracted from the RR. If the caster knows the Closed Essence elemental list corresponding to the elemental’s element (e.g. Fluid Elements for Water or Air elements), then the subtraction is half the number of the caster’s ranks in that list. Once free of control, the elemental will be hostile to the caster if the elemental was placed in danger. A controlled elemental may be commanded to return to its origin; this will take the elemental two rounds. Thus, this spell doubles as a means of banishing elementals.
GATE MASTERY.5: As Summons I, except the caster chooses one of the following options: a) the level of the summoned creature is increased by one, b) an extra 1st level creature can be summoned, or c) the duration can be doubled. When applying options to the higher level Summons spells, option “a” can only be applied to one creature at a time (i.e., two 2nd level creatures takes three options: one for the second creature and one each to raise the creatures to 2nd level).
GATE MASTERY.6: Allows the caster to summon a Grade I elemental. This elemental will appear over the course of two rounds. If uncontrolled after those two rounds are complete, it will act normally according to its nature. Uncontrolled elementals can return to their place of origin at any time, taking two rounds to do so. If the elemental is in a region that is particularly suitable for it (e.g., an Ice elemental summoned to a glacier), it will not return for 1d10 days. If the region is not particularly suitable for it (e.g., an Ice elemental summoned to a temperate forest), it will stay for 1d10 hours. If the region is unsuitable for the elemental (e.g., an Ice elemental summoned to a desert), it will stay for 1d10 minutes. This is normal behavior and if a method of communication exists, or if there is an obvious motive to act otherwise, behavior may vary.
GATE MASTERY.7: As Summons II, except two options can be chosen.
GATE MASTERY.8: As Elemental Control I, except that a Grade I or II elemental can be controlled.
GATE MASTERY.9: As Summons III, except four options can be chosen.
GATE MASTERY.10: As Elemental Summons I, except a Grade I or II elemental can be summoned.
GATE MASTERY.11: As Summons III, except 9 options can be chosen.
GATE MASTERY.12: As Elemental Control I, except that a Grade I-III elemental can be controlled.
GATE MASTERY.13: As Familiar, except that there is no limit on the mass of the familiar, and the caster suffers a -50 penalty for two weeks if the familiar is killed.
GATE MASTERY.14: As Elemental Summons I, except an elemental of Grade III or lower can be summoned.
GATE MASTERY.15: As Summons X, except it can be delayed up to 1 day/level or until triggered by one of the following (decided by the caster at the time of casting): specified movements, sounds, touch, or actions. Trigger must be such as the caster would be able to sense it if still at the location of the spell effect. At the time of casting, the caster may specify a single task for the creature(s) to perform when it/they arrive(s).
GATE MASTERY.16: As Summons III, except 19 options can be chosen.
GATE MASTERY.17: As Elemental Control I, except that a Grade I-IV elemental can be controlled.
GATE MASTERY.18: Cast on a Grade I, II, or III elemental that the caster currently controls (through an Elemental Control spell), this spell places the elemental under the caster’s permanent control. By concentrating, the caster can issue orders to mastered elementals, which will continue to follow an order without the caster’s concentration. A mastered elemental receives a +40 to all RRs against attempts to control it by a different caster. However, any elemental will become hostile if this spell is cast on it and the spell does not succeed (and the elemental is no longer under the caster’s control and has a +40 bonus to resist new controls). A mastered elemental can be sent away by its master in the same way as a controlled elemental; this banishment terminates the Mastery spell. A caster can never have more levels of elementals mastered than his number of ranks in this list (e.g., a caster with 20 ranks in Gate Mastery may be Master of 10 level 2 elementals or 5 level 4 elementals or 2 level 6 elementals and 4 level 2 elementals or some other combination whose total levels do not exceed 20). The range given is only for initial mastery; once mastery is achieved, the caster and the mastered elemental may part without breaking the bond.
GATE MASTERY.19: As Elemental Summons I, except an elemental of Grade IV or lower can be summoned.
GATE MASTERY.20: As Summons III, except one option per caster level is chosen.
GATE MASTERY.25: As Elemental Control I, except that a Grade I-V elemental can be controlled.
GATE MASTERY.30: As Elemental Summons I, except an elemental of Grade V or lower can be summoned.
GATE MASTERY.35: As Elemental Control I, except that a Grade I-VI elemental can be controlled.
GATE MASTERY.40: As Elemental Summons I, except an elemental of Grade VI or lower can be summoned.
GATE MASTERY.50: As Lesser Elemental Mastery, except Grade I through VI elementals can be mastered.

INVISIBLE WAYS.1: A single inanimate object is made nearly invisible, allowing it to be seen through. Object cannot be larger than 10'x10'x3'.
INVISIBLE WAYS.2: A single object is made invisible (1 garment, 1 naked body, etc.); until 24 hrs pass or the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc.) or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack) or casts a spell of type E or F.
INVISIBLE WAYS.3: As Transparency, except duration is one minute/level.
INVISIBLE WAYS.4: As Unseen I, except everything within 1' of the target is invisible as long as it is within the 1'R and none of the Unseen I termination conditions occur.
INVISIBLE WAYS.5: As Unseen I, except range is 100'.
INVISIBLE WAYS.6: As Invisibility I, except the caster can vary the radius up to 1'. This makes the invisible target harder to see by reducing the “fringe effect”.
INVISIBLE WAYS.7: One melee attack (armed or unarmed) is covered by a moment of invisibility. Unless the target of that attack has the power to see the invisible, the target’s parry is subject to a -100 penalty (down to a minimum of 0 parry DB).
INVISIBLE WAYS.8: As Invisibility I, except the constant radius is 10'. Note that anything that exits the radius will become visible again.
INVISIBLE WAYS.9: Caster can see all invisible things anywhere that he can normally see. In addition, he suffers no penalties against invisible targets (as they are not invisible to him).
INVISIBLE WAYS.10: As Unseen I, except 3 objects can be affected.
INVISIBLE WAYS.11: As Invisibility Sphere I, except caster can vary the radius up to 10', determined at time of casting.
INVISIBLE WAYS.12: As Invisibility I, except range is 100'.
INVISIBLE WAYS.13: As Unseen I, except 5 objects can be affected.
INVISIBLE WAYS.14: As Unseen III, except range is 100'.
INVISIBLE WAYS.15: As Invisibility I except two targets can be the center of two separate radii of invisibility.
INVISIBLE WAYS.16: As See Invisible I, except it allows a target to see invisible things.
INVISIBLE WAYS.17: As Unseen I, except 10 objects can be affected.
INVISIBLE WAYS.18: As Split Invisibility, except the caster can vary the two radii by up to 10'.
INVISIBLE WAYS.19: As Unseen Blow, except affects all melee attacks by the target during the spell’s duration.
INVISIBLE WAYS.20: As Invisibility Sphere II, except caster can vary the radius by up to 20'.
INVISIBLE WAYS.25: As Unseen I, except as many objects as the caster’s level may be affected.
INVISIBLE WAYS.30: As Invisibility I, except as many targets as the caster’s level may be the centers of constant 1' radii of invisibility.
INVISIBLE WAYS.35: As Invisibility II, except as many targets as the caster’s level may be the centers of variable radii of invisibility.
INVISIBLE WAYS.40: As See Invisible II, except as many targets as the caster’s level may be given the power to see invisible objects.
INVISIBLE WAYS.50: As Invisibility I, except the caster can vary the radius of invisibility up to 1' and if the caster attacks he is only visible for the 5 seconds immediately following the attack (two instances). Likewise, he may cast a type E or F spell and become visible for the following 5 seconds. Violent blows do not affect this spell.

LIVING CHANGE.1: Allows caster to analyze the form of another being for future use with Exact Change or Change Self Exact. The caster can only have as many forms analyzed as he has ranks in this list. Caster may choose to forget a form at any time to make room for replacements.
LIVING CHANGE.2: Caster enhances the target’s appearance. The target still looks like himself or herself, but in an idealized way, such as seen in a flattering portrait.
LIVING CHANGE.3: Allows caster to grow or shrink within the limits of his Size category.
LIVING CHANGE.4: Alters the caster’s entire body to the form of another humanoid race. The form cannot be that of a particular individual form. For example, a human caster could take the form of a Dwarf, but not the Dwarven High Chancellor. Only the physical form is gained (e.g., a target who becomes a Dwarf would not receive the Dwarves’ ability to see in the dark). This spell does not allow the caster to change his Size category, but size may be changed as desired within that limit.
LIVING CHANGE.5: As Resize Self, except that non-magical organic objects held or carried by the caster will change size in the same proportion as does the caster.
LIVING CHANGE.6: As Changing to Kind, except target to be changed need not be the caster.
LIVING CHANGE.7: As Changing to Kind, except alteration can be to any organic form within the caster’s Size category. No special abilities of the form are gained.
LIVING CHANGE.8: Allows caster to grow or shrink the target within the limits of the target’s Size category.
LIVING CHANGE.9: As Change Self, except that non-magical organic objects held or carried by the caster will refit to the caster’s new form or merge into his body for the duration, depend on whether the item can readily be adapted to the new form.
LIVING CHANGE.10: As Change Self, except altered form can be that of a specific being analyzed by Change Lore.
LIVING CHANGE.11: As Change to Kind, except alteration can be to any organic form within the target’s Size category. No special abilities of the form are gained.
LIVING CHANGE.12: Caster can shrink down to within the limits of one Size category smaller than his own.
LIVING CHANGE.13: As Change, except altered form can be that of a specific being analyzed by Change Lore.
LIVING CHANGE.14: Caster can grow to within the limits of one Size category larger than his own.
LIVING CHANGE.15: As Change Self Exact, except caster may assume a different form anytime during the spell, by concentrating for one round/change.
LIVING CHANGE.16: Target can shrink down to within the limits of one Size category smaller than his own.
LIVING CHANGE.17: Target can merge into any solid, inanimate material. While merged, target cannot move, perceive, or cast spells. When the target emerges from the material, it is possible to emerge from any side or face of the material, although this is limited to moving “through” no more than the target’s own body size plus two feet worth of material. The target can exit at any time up to the end of spell duration (at which time the target automatically emerges at the entrance point).
LIVING CHANGE.18: As Exact Change, except target may assume a different form anytime during the spell, by concentrating for one round/change.
LIVING CHANGE.19: Target can grow to within the limits of one Size category larger than his own.
LIVING CHANGE.20: Target may pass through any inanimate material up to 1 foot/level. It takes 1 round to pass through 2 feet of material.
LIVING CHANGE.25: As Resize, except it simultaneously enlarges or shrinks as many targets (can be beings or objects) as the caster’s level. All targets must change size by the same percentage amount.
LIVING CHANGE.30: As Change, except affects up to the caster’s level in targets (all targets must take the same type of form).
LIVING CHANGE.35: Target can shrink or grow within the limits of two Size categories above or below his own.
LIVING CHANGE.40: As Merging, except affects up to the caster’s level in targets; all targets exit after a set time or with caster.
LIVING CHANGE.50: As Passing, except affects up to the caster’s level in targets.

LOFTY BRIDGE.1: Allows the target to make one leap up to 50' laterally or 20' vertically (as a separate 1 AP action, with no Pace penalty for the leaping movement) in the round that the spell was cast.
LOFTY BRIDGE.2: This spell is cast on a target who is falling and takes effect immediately, allowing the target to land safely in a fall up to 20' per level of the caster and to take that distance off the severity of any longer fall.
LOFTY BRIDGE.3: Caster teleports target to a point up to 100' away, but there can be no intervening “barriers” in a direct line between the target and the point. A “barrier” is anything the target could not physically go through; a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not.
LOFTY BRIDGE.4: Allows target to move up and down vertically 10' per round. This spell does not confer any ability to control horizontal movement, which must be accomplished by other means.
LOFTY BRIDGE.5: Allows target to fly at a rate of up to 35'/round (approximately 5 mph). This spell allows free movement in all three dimensions and allows hovering.
LOFTY BRIDGE.6: Opens a portal 3'x6'x3' in any solid surface, through which anyone can pass. At the end of the duration, the surface is returned to its previous state. Anyone in the area of effect when the spell ends will be forced back out to the point of entry.
LOFTY BRIDGE.7: As Fly I, except maximum rate is 75'/round (approximately 10 mph).
LOFTY BRIDGE.8: As Leaving I, except target can pass through barriers by specifying exact distances. If the arrival point coincides with solid material, the target does not move, instead being stunned (-50) 1-10 rounds, and the PP for this spell are expended.
LOFTY BRIDGE.9: As Leaving I, except target can be moved 300'.
LOFTY BRIDGE.10: As Long Door I, except movement range is 10 miles per level. Making a precise appearance is difficult, especially if unfamiliar with the destination. The following chances for error exist: Never seen place (only described) = 50%; been briefly (1 hr) = 25%; Studied (24 hr) = 10%; Studied carefully (1 week) = 1%; Lived in (1 yr) = .01 %. In case of failure: first determine direction of error (randomly), then determine amount of error (make an open-ended d100 roll for the number of feet).
LOFTY BRIDGE.11: As Fly I, except rate is 150'/round (approximately 20 mph).
LOFTY BRIDGE.12: As Long Door I, except movement range is 300'.
LOFTY BRIDGE.13: As Teleport I, except up to 3 targets may be moved to same place.
LOFTY BRIDGE.14: As Portal, except portal is 3'x6' and up to 5'/ level deep.
LOFTY BRIDGE.15: As Long Door I, except movement range is 500'.
LOFTY BRIDGE.16: As Teleport III, except 5 targets may be moved.
LOFTY BRIDGE.17: As Fly I, except rate is 225'/round (approximately 30 mph).
LOFTY BRIDGE.18: As Teleport III, except 10 targets may be moved.
LOFTY BRIDGE.19: As Leaving I, except as many targets as the caster’s level may be moved.
LOFTY BRIDGE.20: As Teleport III, except 20 targets can be moved.
LOFTY BRIDGE.25: As Long Door III, except as many targets as the caster’s level may be moved up to 300'.
LOFTY BRIDGE.30: As Teleport III, except as many targets as the caster’s level may be moved.
LOFTY BRIDGE.35: As Fly III, except as many targets as the caster’s level may fly at 150' per round.
LOFTY BRIDGE.40: As Fly True, except as many targets as the caster’s level may fly at 225' per round.
LOFTY BRIDGE.50: As Teleport I, except with no movement range limit.

LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.1: Gives nature and origin of natural light, and when and how magical light (including visual illusions, if the caster knows it is an illusion) was created (list and specific spell).
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.2: Beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster’s palm; it has a 50' effective range. If the caster’s hand is closed into a fist, the light will “turn off”. If the caster’s fist is reopened before the end of the duration, the light will turn on again.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.3: Causes any wood to ignite and burn. All wood ignited must be within 1' of caster’s palm.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.4: Lights a 10'R area about the point touched. This spell may be cast onto a target as explained in Section 10.17.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.5: Causes all non-magical flames in a 5'R to die down and cools the area to where it will not reignite on its own.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.6: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Lightning Bolt attack table, as a Miniscule attack.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.7: Target weapon, which must remain in the caster’s possession or the spell is cancelled, bursts into magical flame. Neither weapon nor wielder is harmed, but any time the weapon delivers a critical an additional Heat critical with a severity one less than the regular critical (e.g., a ‘C’ crit produces an additional ‘B’ Heat crit) is also inflicted.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.8: Creates an opaque wall of fire (up to 10'x10'x6"). Anyone passing through it takes an A Heat critical (no RR).
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.9: As Light I, except radius can be up to 50' (can be changed by concentrating 1 round).
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.10: Target weapon, which must remain in the caster’s possession or the spell is cancelled, crackles with electical arcs. Neither weapon nor wielder is harmed, but any time the weapon delivers a critical an additional Electricity critical of equal severity is also inflicted.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.11: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Lightning Bolt attack table, as a Miniscule attack.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.12: A bolt of fire is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Fire Bolt Table.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.13: As Light I, except radius can be up to 100' (can be changed by concentrating 1 round).
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.14: As Wall of Fire, except it is up to 30' long and does a B Heat critical.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.15: A 1' diameter ball of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching the selected target/location, it expands to affect a 10'R area. Resolve attack on the Fire Ball Table.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.16: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Lightning Bolt attack table, as a Miniscule attack.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.17: As Light I, except radius can be up to 150' (can be changed by concentrating 1 round).
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.18: Ray of light of any color springs from caster’s palm; can be up to 3 miles long.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.19: Nullifies all magically created darkness in a 100'R, and lights that area as full daylight. This spell may be cast onto a target, as explained in Section 10.17.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.20: A bolt of fire is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Fire Bolt Table.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.25: A bolt of lightning is shot from the caster’s palm; the results are determined on the Lighting Bolt Table as a Medium-sized attack.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.30: As Flaming Blade, except can affect 1 target/level of caster and each weapon functions while held by the person holding it when the spell is cast.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.35: As Shocking Blade, except can affect 1 target/level of caster and each weapon functions while held by the person holding it when the spell is cast.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.40: A bolt of lightning is shot from the caster’s palm; the results are determined on the Lighting Bolt Table as a Medium-sized attack.
LUMINOUS ELEMENTS.50: As Utterlight, except that duration is 10 minutes per level and the radius illuminated is 10' per level.

RAPID WAYS.1: Caster draws or changes weapon “instantly” (i.e., without expending AP; the action is included as part of this spell). This includes readying ammunition, but not long actions like readying a crossbow.
RAPID WAYS.2: Target gains a +20 bonus to any Movement maneuver done at a Jog (x2) pace or faster. If no Movement maneuver is required, the pace penalty can be reduced by 20 for any simultaneous action.
RAPID WAYS.3: Target gains an additional 1 AP to use each round this spell is in effect (i.e., target normally gets 5 AP to use during the round).
RAPID WAYS.4: Target gains a +5 bonus to initiative rolls.
RAPID WAYS.5: The round in which this spell is cast counts as a round of spell preparation for the caster.
RAPID WAYS.6: Target gains an additional 1 AP to use each round this spell is in effect (i.e., target normally gets 5 AP to use during the round).
RAPID WAYS.7: Target gains a +10 bonus to initiative rolls.
RAPID WAYS.8: Caster requires 2-3 AP to cast a spell (i.e., he may cast a spell taking 3 AP at no penalty or taking 2 AP at a -25 penalty).
RAPID WAYS.9: As Speed I, except affects a number of targets up to the caster’s level.
RAPID WAYS.10: Target gains a +15 bonus to initiative rolls.
RAPID WAYS.11: As Speed I, except target gains an additional 2 AP.
RAPID WAYS.12: As Swiftness I, except affects a number of targets up to the caster’s level.
RAPID WAYS.13: Target gains a +20 bonus to initiative rolls.
RAPID WAYS.14: Caster requires 2 AP to cast a spell (i.e., he casts taking 2 AP at no penalty).
RAPID WAYS.15: As Haste I, except target gains an additional 2 AP.
RAPID WAYS.16: As Speed II, except affects a number of targets up to the caster’s level.
RAPID WAYS.17: As Speed I, except target gains an additional 3 AP.
RAPID WAYS.18: As Haste I, except affects a number of targets up to the caster’s level.
RAPID WAYS.19: As Swiftness II, except affects a number of targets up to the caster’s level.
RAPID WAYS.20: As Haste I, except target gains an additional 3 AP.
RAPID WAYS.25: As Swiftness III, except affects a number of targets up to the caster’s level.
RAPID WAYS.30: As Speed I, except target gains an additional 4 AP.
RAPID WAYS.35: As Haste II, except affects a number of targets up to the caster’s level.
RAPID WAYS.40: As Speed IV, except affects a number of targets up to the caster’s level.
RAPID WAYS.50: As Haste I, except target gains an additional 4 AP.

SHIELD MASTERY.1: Gives a +10 magical bonus to a non-magical shield, enhancing the wielder’s Shield skill.
SHIELD MASTERY.2: Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster; it subtracts 25 from up to 3 attacks per round from the caster’s front. This does not occupy a hand, but is not usable with a physical shield (nor does it benefit from the Shield skill).
SHIELD MASTERY.3: Causes target to appear blurred to attackers, granting a +10 to the target’s DB.
SHIELD MASTERY.4: Caster temporarily enchants one non-magical set of clothes (not armor) to confer a +10 DB. Wearer must be at his natural AT to gain the bonus.
SHIELD MASTERY.5: Caster can deflect any one missile that the caster can see and which passes within the 100' range of this spell; this causes 50 to be subtracted from the missile’s attack.
SHIELD MASTERY.6: Caster temporarily enchants one non-magical organic armor to confer a +10 DB. Wearer’s AT must come from this armor to gain the bonus.
SHIELD MASTERY.7: Caster can deflect any one melee attack that the caster can see within the 100' range of this spell; this causes 50 to be subtracted from the melee’s attack.
SHIELD MASTERY.8: As Enchanted Shield, accept range is 50' and one shield per caster’s level can be enchanted.
SHIELD MASTERY.9: As Deflections I, except 2 missiles may be affected.
SHIELD MASTERY.10: As Deflections I, except missile automatically misses.
SHIELD MASTERY.11: As Bladeturn I, except 2 melee attacks may be affected.
SHIELD MASTERY.12: Caster temporarily enchants one non-magical inorganic (usually metal) armor to confer a +10 DB. Wearer’s AT must come from this armor to gain the bonus.
SHIELD MASTERY.13: As Deflections I, except 3 missiles may be affected.
SHIELD MASTERY.14: As Shield, except bonus is 40 against up to 4 attacks per round and duration is 10 minutes per level.
SHIELD MASTERY.15: As Aim Untrue I, except 2 missiles may be affected.
SHIELD MASTERY.16: As Blur, except as many targets as the caster’s level may be affected.
SHIELD MASTERY.17: As Bladeturn I, except 3 melee attacks may be affected.
SHIELD MASTERY.18: One missile passing within 100' of caster is reversed and makes an attack on its source (use caster’s ranks in this list as OB, no DB except from magic or armor material bonus).
SHIELD MASTERY.19: As Aim Untrue I, except 3 missiles may be affected.
SHIELD MASTERY.20: As Deflections I, except as many missiles as the caster’s level may be affected.
SHIELD MASTERY.25: As Bladeturn I, except as many melee attacks as the caster’s level may be affected.
SHIELD MASTERY.30: As Mass Deflections, except missiles automatically miss.
SHIELD MASTERY.35: As Mass Deflections or Mass Bladeturn, except caster may mix defending against melee or missile attacks, to a combined total up to the caster’s level.
SHIELD MASTERY.40: As Enchanted Shield, Enchanted Clothes, Enchanted Organic, and/or Enchanted Inorganic except as many targets as the caster’s level may be affected. An individual may have both clothing/armor and shield enchanted for double protection, although this counts as two targets.
SHIELD MASTERY.50: As Re-aiming, except the caster may reverse any number of missiles passing within 100'.

SOLID ELEMENTS.1: Caster transforms up to one cubic foot per level of clay into baked pottery. Firing clay in this manner will always be successful. This can also cook glazes onto earthenware. Quality of product depends on the skill of whomever shapes the clay.
SOLID ELEMENTS.2: Creates a cube of ice, 1' along each edge. It can be formed around an inanimate object, so long as that object cannot resist or fails its RR.
SOLID ELEMENTS.3: Caster may add +15 to all maneuvers to work ice or stone.
SOLID ELEMENTS.4: The caster may decrease the temperature of any inanimate body of liquid of up to 1 cubic foot per level by 50°F [28°C] per round of concentration. Once the liquid freezes, it will not continue to grow colder, but will begin to warm naturally if the caster stops concentrating. Caster is immune to the cold thus generated.
SOLID ELEMENTS.5: A single inanimate solid object of no more than 1 pound/level weight is made stronger. It will take only half as many hits if damaged and if checked for breakage, it receives a +50 bonus to its roll.
SOLID ELEMENTS.6: Creates a wall of packed earth up to 10'x10'x (3' at base, 1' at top); it can be dug through only (20 manrounds at top).
SOLID ELEMENTS.7: Any previous cracks or flaws in material up to 10'x10'x10' section will extend to their limit.
SOLID ELEMENTS.8: Caster may add +30 to all maneuvers to work ice or stone.
SOLID ELEMENTS.9: Creates a wall of non-precious stone up to 10'x10'x1'; it can be chipped through or toppled if not against a wall.
SOLID ELEMENTS.10: A bolt of ice is shot from the palm of the caster. Results are resolved on the Ice Bolt Table.
SOLID ELEMENTS.11: Target weapon, which must remain in the caster’s possession or the spell is cancelled, glitters with frost. Neither weapon nor wielder is harmed, but any time the weapon delivers a critical an additional Cold critical of equal severity is also inflicted.
SOLID ELEMENTS.12: Creates a wall of ice up to 10'x10'x (2' at base, 1' at top); it can be melted through or chipped through or toppled if not against a wall.
SOLID ELEMENTS.13: As Earthwall, except duration is permanent.
SOLID ELEMENTS.14: Caster may add +45 to all maneuvers to work ice or stone.
SOLID ELEMENTS.15: As Icewall I, except size is up to 20'x20'x (4' at base, 2' at top).
SOLID ELEMENTS.16: A bolt of ice is shot from the palm of the caster. Results are resolved on the Ice Bolt Table.
SOLID ELEMENTS.17: As Stonewall, except duration is permanent and dimensions may be up to 20'x20'x1'.
SOLID ELEMENTS.18: Chills metal to the point that it becomes extremely brittle (1 object only), giving it a -50 penalty to its strength and the object will be subject to a breakage check if it strikes another object or is struck. Anyone in direct skin-to-metal contact with the chilled metal will take a B Cold Critical each round contact is maintained.
SOLID ELEMENTS.19: Caster may add +60 to all maneuvers to work ice or stone.
SOLID ELEMENTS.20: A bolt of ice is shot from the palm of the caster. Results are resolved on the Ice Bolt Table.
SOLID ELEMENTS.25: Caster may add +75 to all maneuvers to work ice or stone.
SOLID ELEMENTS.40: Creates a wall of bronze up to 20'x10'x (4' at base, 2' at top).
SOLID ELEMENTS.50: Caster can hurl an Ice Bolt (as Ice Bolt V) each round (as an instantaneous action) for up to one round for every five levels of the caster.

SPELL ENHANCEMENT.1: Caster adds +25 to his next Spell Mastery maneuver within 1 minute of casting this spell.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.2: Causes the caster’s next spell cast within 1 minute to have double the normal duration. This is not cumulative with any other Extension spell. Only spells with a defined duration can have their duration changed with an Extension spell. This does not include spells with a duration of concentration (C) or -.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.3: The caster’s next spell (cast within 1 minute of this spell) gains a +25 bonus to the spell-casting roll and to any associated Spell Mastery maneuver.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.4: Causes the caster’s next spell cast within 1 minute to have its range increased by 50'. This is not cumulative with any other Ranging spell. Only spells with a range greater than touch/self can have their range extended with a Ranging spell. For spells with a range increment (directed spells), divide the increase by 5 to get the change to the increment (e.g., for Lesser Ranging, the increase to a range increment would be 10').
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.5: As Extension II, except duration is three times normal.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.6: As Lesser Ranging, except casting time is instantaneous.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.7: Causes the caster’s next spell cast within 1 minute to have its area of effect increase by 5'R. Obviously, this applies only to spells with a radius effect. This is not cumulative with any other Increased Radius spell.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.8: As Lesser Ranging, except range is increased by 100' (or +20' range increment).
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.9: As Extension II, except duration is four times normal.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.10: As Instant Lesser Ranging, except range is increased by 100' (or +20' range increment).
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.11: As Increased Radius I, except radius is increased by 10'.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.12: As Ranging I, except range is increased by 200' (or +40' range increment).
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.13: As Extension II, except duration is five times normal.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.14: As Instant Ranging I, except range is increased by 200' (or +40' range increment).
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.15: As Increased Radius I, except radius is increased by 15'.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.16: Causes the caster’s next applicable spell (directed spells and those that do a critical) cast within 1 minute of casting this spell to have its Size increased by one size category (typically Medium to Big).
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.17: As Ranging I, except range is increased by 300' (or +60' range increment).
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.18: As Extension II, except duration is ten times normal.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.19: As Instant Ranging I, except range is increased by 300' (or +60' range increment).
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.20: As Increased Radius I, except radius is increased by 20'.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.25: As Ranging I, except range is increased by 500' (or +100' range increment).
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.30: As Extension II, except duration is increased by 12 hrs.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.35: As Extension II, except duration is increased by 24 hrs.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.40: As Extension X, Ranging III, and Increased Radius II combined.
SPELL ENHANCEMENT.50: As Extension II, except duration is permanent. This spell may only be cast once per month. The caster has a random temporary stat decreased by one. This loss may only be recovered by normal stat gain upon gaining a level.

SPELL REINS.1: Caster may cast this spell with another spell in order to store that second spell. The spell to be stored must be cast within one minute after the Spell Store spell is cast. The stored spell may then be cast later as an instantaneous spell. The Spell Store spell costs the same number of PP as the spell that is stored. No other spell may be cast while a spell is stored.
SPELL REINS.2: If the target of this spell is casting a spell, the caster will know what realm the spell is from and what Type of spell the target is casting.
SPELL REINS.3: The attack spell that is targeted with this spell must make an RR. If the RR succeeds, it will attack its original target as intended; otherwise the effects of the spell are delayed for the duration of this spell. At the end of the duration, if the target of the held spell has moved more than 20', the held spell may randomly affect another target within 10' of the original target point. If a spell is not cast on the original target, the new target gets a +15 RR bonus. Elemental attack spells suffer a -30 modification if not cast upon the original target. An attack spell for purposes of this spell is any spell having a target.
SPELL REINS.4: As Spell Store, except the spell to be stored may be cast by someone (or something if the spell is cast by an item) other than the caster storing the spell. The PP cost of this spell is three more than that of the spell to be stored (with a minimum cost of 4 PP).
SPELL REINS.5: Caster can deflect one Bolt, Ball, or Cone of magical origin. The incoming spell must make an RR. If the RR succeeds, it will attack its target normally; otherwise, the attack roll is modified by a penalty equal to the amount by which the RR was failed.
SPELL REINS.6: As Spell Hold I, except attack spells can be held up to 2 rounds.
SPELL REINS.7: As Spell Store, except other spells may be cast while the stored spell remains in storage. However, such casting requires an additional PP and the spell-casting roll suffers a -10 penalty. The PP cost of this spell is five more than that of the spell to be stored (with a minimum cost of 7 PP).
SPELL REINS.8: As Spell Bending I, except attack roll is modified by twice the amount of RR failure.
SPELL REINS.9: As Spell Hold I, except attack spells can be held 3 rounds.
SPELL REINS.10: The target elemental attack spell must make an RR with a modification of +20 (in favor of the elemental attack spell). If the RR succeeds, the attack is made as normal; otherwise, the elemental attack spell is reversed back on its caster with a +0 OB.
SPELL REINS.11: As Spell Bending I, except attack roll is modified by three times the amount of RR failure.
SPELL REINS.12: As Spell Hold I, except attack spells can be held 4 rounds.
SPELL REINS.13: The caster may “borrow” Power Points from the days to come. When this spell is cast, the caster regains all Power Points to the caster’s normal maximum. Every time the caster casts this spell, he loses all PP for the next two days (the normal duration of the spell). The caster also suffers concussion hit damage equal to 10% of the caster’s normal maximum hits. In addition, for the duration of this spell, he will cast spells as if he were one level lower than he actually is. This spell may be cast multiple times (borrowing PP from many days to come), but all effects are cumulative. For example, if cast twice, the caster will lose all PP for the next four days, take 20% of maximum hits in damage, and cast spells at two levels lower than normal. All penalties will remain in effect until the duration of the spell lapses. The next time the caster sleeps, that rest period will be extended by six hours for each casting of this spell and if this sleep is interrupted, the days of no PP will not begin to count down until after the caster has slept for the full required period of normal sleep requirement plus six hours per casting of Power Loan.
SPELL REINS.14: As Spell Bending I, except attack roll is modified by four times the amount of RR failure.
SPELL REINS.15: As Spell Hold I, except attack spells can be held 5 rounds.
SPELL REINS.16: As Reverse Spell I, except a successfully reversed spell rebounds with an OB equal to half of the original OB.
SPELL REINS.17: As Spell Bending I, except attack roll is modified by five times the amount of RR failure.
SPELL REINS.18: As Spell Hold I, except attack spell is held 10 rounds.
SPELL REINS.19: By using this spell, the caster can transfer the maintenance and control of one spell with a duration of Concentration (C) to a target. The target must then concentrate to maintain the spell (while the original caster is now free of this requirement) and controls any aspects of the spell effects subject to change. Target must have better than animal intelligence (i.e., no Mindless or Animalistic flaw).
SPELL REINS.20: As Spell Hold I, except attack spell is held for 20 rounds.
SPELL REINS.25: As Spell Bending I, except spell can be totally deflected up to 90° in any direction. Caster of this spell may chose to designate another target for the “bent” spell – use half of the original OB.
SPELL REINS.30: As Spell Hold I, except attack spell is held up to 1 round/level.
SPELL REINS.35: As Spell Store, except any number of spells may be stored up to a total number of spell levels equal to the caster’s level. When the stored spell complex is released, all the spells are cast as one instantaneous spell. Each of the component spells may be individually targeted, although only one may have a Directed Spell bonus added to the attack. Spell failure is rolled on the Force spell column, with triple the number of spells added to the spell failure roll (i.e., spell failure when casting five spells in a complex would result in a +15 to the spell failure roll). The PP cost of this spell is equal to the total PP cost of the spells stored plus ten (with a minimum cost of 35).
SPELL REINS.40: As Complex Spell Store, except any or all of the stored spells may be cast by someone (or something) other than the caster storing the spell complex. The PP cost of this spell is equal to the total PP cost of the spells stored plus ten plus the number of stored spells cast by someone else (with a minimum cost of 40).
SPELL REINS.50: As Reverse Spell I, except all spells within a 100'R of the caster are reversed.

SPIRIT MASTERY.1: Causes target(s) to fall into a natural sleep; the total number of levels that can be affected is 3 (e.g., 3 of level 1; 1 of level 2 and 1 of level 1; 1 of level 3.). All targets must be in caster’s field of vision. Caster should assign target priority, i.e., which is the 1st potential target, the 2nd, etc. The first round of sleep is magical (the target cannot be awakened through normal means). Falling asleep is rapid, but not so instantaneous that the victim cannot slump gently to the ground (no injuries under normal circumstances from falling to the ground).
SPIRIT MASTERY.2: Humanoid target believes the caster is a good friend.
SPIRIT MASTERY.3: As Sleep III, except a total of five levels can be affected.
SPIRIT MASTERY.4: Target is incapable of making decisions or initiating action, but may continue to fight current foes or in self-defense. The target may also follow orders from the target’s leader (if any), but will only be able to follow them so long as no ambiguities arise.
SPIRIT MASTERY.5: Target will perform a single suggested act that is not self-destructive or diametrically opposed to the target’s personality (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, no suggestions that a priest pray to an enemy god, etc.).
SPIRIT MASTERY.6: As Sleep III, except a total of 10 levels may be affected.
SPIRIT MASTERY.7: Humanoid target has its Action Points per round reduced by 3 (i.e., normally, the target will have 1 AP each round).
SPIRIT MASTERY.8: Humanoid target must obey the caster as specified in Suggestion.
SPIRIT MASTERY.9: As Sleep III, except a total of 20 levels may be affected.
SPIRIT MASTERY.10: As Charm Kind, except any sentient creature may be affected.
SPIRIT MASTERY.11: Target is given one task; failure results in a penalty determined by the Gamemaster (task must be within capabilities of target). If the target ignores the quest, this incurs the same effects as for failure.
SPIRIT MASTERY.12: [RR Mod.: -10] Target is stunned (-50) for 1 round/10 failure.
SPIRIT MASTERY.13: [RR Mod.: -10] Target takes 50% of remaining concussion hits upon failure.
SPIRIT MASTERY.14: As Hold Kind, except any sentient being can be affected.
SPIRIT MASTERY.15: [RR Mod.: -10] Target falls into a natural sleep as Sleep III, but there is no level limit.
SPIRIT MASTERY.16: [RR Mod.: -10] Target will not cooperate or agree with anyone for 1 day/10 failure.
SPIRIT MASTERY.17: [RR Mod.: -10] Target is forced to come and face the caster (fighting if necessary) and then remain immobile for 1 rnd/10 failure. Caster must remain immobile, or control lapses.
SPIRIT MASTERY.18: [RR Mod.: -10] Any of the “Words” above can be set to go off at a specified time or if there is movement within a designated 10' radius. Listed duration is maximum wait time. Duration of effect on eventual target is normal for the selected “Word”. The target of the Word is the individual whose movement triggered it, or the closest target in the case of a specified time.
SPIRIT MASTERY.19: [RR Mod.: -10] Target suffers the results of an E critical strike on the table of the caster’s choice.
SPIRIT MASTERY.20: As Quest, except the target is punished for failure (or refusal) by suffering 5 randomly selected E criticals.
SPIRIT MASTERY.25: [RR Mod.: -10] Any three different “Words” are cast on one target in the same round (a separate RR roll must be made for each one).
SPIRIT MASTERY.30: [RR Mod.: -10] Any “Word” may be used and it will affect a number of levels equal to the level of the caster (assign target priority as described in Sleep III).
SPIRIT MASTERY.35: As Master of Kind, except any sentient being can be affected.
SPIRIT MASTERY.40: [RR Mod.: -10] As Waiting Word, except instead of a “Word” spell, the effect is as the Phrase spell.
SPIRIT MASTERY.50: Caster can use one spell/round on this list (10th level or lower) with range improved to 100' where the original range is less.

CONTROLLING SONGS.1: Targets will not take aggressive (offensive) action towards the caster.
CONTROLLING SONGS.2: Targets are calmed and cannot take aggressive (offensive) action during the performance. This spell also soothes pain and can offset up to -10 in penalties due to injury (until the spell ends).
CONTROLLING SONGS.3: Targets must dance (to the best of their ability). This requires Concentration and the dancers cannot choose to leave the area of effect unless a second RR is made. All dance-related maneuvers by the targets have a +25 bonus.
CONTROLLING SONGS.4: Targets are stunned (-50) while song lasts.
CONTROLLING SONGS.5: As Calming Song, except targets are only non-aggressive with respect to the caster and targets will be drawn to the caster. They will approach the caster as close as possible without touching the caster or having to fight for position, and they will follow the caster if he is moving.
CONTROLLING SONGS.6: Targets fall into a light sleep. Targets get another RR if someone attempts to wake them while this spell is still active. When the duration is up, the target can be awakened normally.
CONTROLLING SONGS.7: Targets regard the caster as a good friend.
CONTROLLING SONGS.8: Targets must make an RR versus Essence magic, but the results are treated as an RR versus Fear (see RMCL Section 14.3). Normal modifications against Fear do not apply.
CONTROLLING SONGS.9: Targets become emotionally open and regard the caster favorably. This adds +10 to any maneuver made to seduce a target of this spell by someone other than the caster and adds +10 to any Influence skill maneuver or +30 to any seduction attempt made by the caster to affect a target of this spell.
CONTROLLING SONGS.10: As Calming Song, except for area of effect, and it can offset up to -20 in injury-related penalties.
CONTROLLING SONGS.11: As Dancing Song, except for area of effect.
CONTROLLING SONGS.12: As Lullaby, except targets experience a sleep troubled by nightmares. For 24 hours after awakening, they will have a -40 penalty to any RR against fear or fear-inducing magic.
CONTROLLING SONGS.13: [RR Mod.: -25] As Fear’s Song, except targets suffer a -25 modification to their RRs.
CONTROLLING SONGS.14: As Stunning Song, except for area of effect.
CONTROLLING SONGS.15: As Luring Song, except for area of effect.
CONTROLLING SONGS.16: Targets will attack nearest individual other than the caster. If two or more individuals are equidistant, the target will attack the one he would normally be most inclined to fight. If a target injures (inflicts a critical on) a loved one, a close friend, or a longtime comrade in arms, he may make a new RR.
CONTROLLING SONGS.17: As Lullaby, except for area of effect.
CONTROLLING SONGS.18: As Charming Song, except for area of effect.
CONTROLLING SONGS.19: [RR Mod.: -25] As Panic’s Song, except for area of effect.
CONTROLLING SONGS.20: Targets will obey the caster’s commands, unless the action commanded is totally alien to the target’s nature (e.g., no suicidal or self-mutilating commands unless the target is already self-destructive). If a target cannot understand the command, it will simply take no action.
CONTROLLING SONGS.25: [RR Mod: -50] As Panic’s Song, except for area of effect and RR modifier.
CONTROLLING SONGS.30: [RR Mod: -10] As Calming Song, except for area of effect, RR modifier, and a maximum of -30 in offset penalties.
CONTROLLING SONGS.35: [RR Mod: -10] As Seduction’s Song, except for area of effect, RR modifier, and the caster’s bonuses are +50 to seduction attempts and +25 to other Influence maneuvers, while those other than the caster gain a +25 to seduction attempts where the object of the seduction is under the influence of this spell.
CONTROLLING SONGS.40: [RR Mod: -10] As Song of Command, except for area of effect and RR modifier.
CONTROLLING SONGS.50: [RR Mod: -10] As Fight Song, except for area of effect and RR modifier.

ENTERTAINING WAYS.1: Caster is lit by a bright circle of light (between 5' and 10' diameter as desired). At the time of casting, the caster designates his “front” and the light will shine from that direction. The caster can change his “front” by concentrating (the light will blink off and another will blink on). The diameter and color of the light can also be changed and the light dimmed down to a soft mood light. All adjustable features can be changed at once.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.2: All non-magical light sources in the area of effect are dimmed to the luminosity of soft candle light.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.3: Caster can create colored lights that will shine in the area of effect. The caster can change the colors and forms of the light by concentrating. The light can take any form the caster desires, but the light will not illuminate more than the area of effect. For example, several small spheres of various colors can float around the caster’s feet, or five red beams can flash back and forth across the caster’s body.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.4: Caster receives a +5 bonus to all Performance Art maneuvers for the duration of this spell.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.5: Caster can make any one target (up to 1 pound per level of the caster) vanish. The caster must designate a location for the target to “reappear” in (the location must be within the caster’s line of sight and within 100' per level of the caster). The object is teleported to the designated location at the time of casting, where it may remain invisibly until the duration expires or the caster chooses for it to appear. When the item is teleported, it makes a sound only where it disappears.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.6: The target of this spell is enthralled with the caster (for as long as the caster is performing or for the duration of this spell, whichever is shorter). While enthralled, the target is considered to be Concentrating on the performance and has a -75 to Perception regarding anything else. Enthrallment is broken if the target is attacked.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.7: The caster can place any one inanimate object (up to 1 pound per level of the caster) into any available container. The container opening must be large enough to fit at least one dimension of the object. When the container is examined, it will appear empty to all normal perception (including feeling). The caster may pluck the item from the container at any time (up to the duration of the spell). If the object is not taken from the container before duration is up, the object appears in the container as if it were there all along.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.8: When the caster has experienced a fumble/failure result with an attack or physical maneuver, this spell allows the caster to turn tragedy into comedy. The caster suffers no negative effects beyond losing the opportunity to act as desired; the caster’s antics also bolster allied morale and the next friendly morale/fear RR made in the current situation receives a +20 bonus.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.9: As Showman I, except bonus is +10.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.10: Caster can read at three times the normal rate; this material is retained unusually well, granting a +10 bonus to any attempt to recall the information later.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.11: As Enthrall I, except affects up to five targets.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.12: Target will perform any actions that the caster dictates for the duration of this spell. If the target of this spell has previously been a “volunteer” for the caster, he suffers an RR modification of -1 for each previous time he was a successful target. If an action is commanded which is completely alien to the target, the target receives a new RR with a +50 bonus.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.13: Target of this spell (which may be the caster) gains an enhanced appearance. This spell enhances facial appearance, body appearance, and clothing appearance (roughly equivalent to a modern make-over, including fashion). Target gains a +10 to all rolls where personal appearance is a factor or +20 if appearance is a major factor.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.14: As Showman I, except bonus is +15.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.15: As Enthrall I, except affects up to ten targets.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.16: As Legerdemain, except affects any target up to the caster’s own mass.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.17: As Showman I, except bonus applies to a number of target up the caster’s level.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.18: As Showman I, except bonus is +20.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.19: As Quick Study, except caster can read a page at a glance (i.e., caster can read as fast as he can turn through the pages).
ENTERTAINING WAYS.20: As Enthrall I, except affects a number of targets up to the caster’s level.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.25: As Showman I, except bonus is +25.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.30: As Disappear, except may affect any one living creature or inanimate object up to 100 pounds per level of the caster.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.35: As Master of Ceremonies I, except bonus is +10.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.40: As Showman I, except bonus is +40.
ENTERTAINING WAYS.50: As Master of Ceremonies I, except bonus is +20.

INSPIRING SONGS.1: Target becomes an “Ally” for purposes of this list. The caster is always considered an Ally for purposes of this list. The caster is limited to a number of Allies (other than the caster) equal to his ranks in this list, but may remove any one individual from the status of Ally with a round of concentration at any time.
INSPIRING SONGS.2: All Allies make Endurance rolls with a +50 bonus.
INSPIRING SONGS.3: When Allies are working together on some shared task, this spell provides a bonus to that task equal to +3 per number of Allies involved (includes the caster, although the caster obviously cannot be providing “hands on” help).
INSPIRING SONGS.4: Allies gain a +10 bonus to all RRs against fear or magic that produces fear or calm. They also gain +4 OB.
INSPIRING SONGS.5: This spell casts another spell known to the caster, but changes the nature of that spell. The spell to be shared must have “1 target” or a larger number of targets as its normal area of effect. The Song of Sharing I will cause the shared spell to affect all Allies within a 5'R as if the shared spell had been directly cast on each of them. The PP cost of casting is the cost of this spell (5 PP) plus the cost of the spell to be shared. For example, if a Bard knew the spell Leaping from the Lofty Bridge list, every Ally within 5' could be given the ability to Leap by casting Song of Sharing I and expending 6 PP (5 for the base cost of Song of Sharing I and 1 PP for the Leaping spell effect). If the spell to be shared is of higher level than the Song of Sharing, the shared spell’s level is used for determining the difficulty of spell-casting. Spell effects end when either the duration of the Song of Sharing ends or when the normal duration of the spell shared ends (i.e., the Leaping effect would only last one round).
INSPIRING SONGS.6: Caster creates a defensive song that will protect anyone (not just Allies) from sound-based attacks (including the spells on Controlling Songs). Any such attack must make a successful RR against the caster’s level or fail within the bounds of the Countersong.
INSPIRING SONGS.7: All Allies gain a +20 bonus to all Lore skill maneuvers and any other memory-based tasks.
INSPIRING SONGS.8: All Allies within area of effect are telepathically linked. They may communicate mentally with each other freely. Essentially this is silent, largely secure communication.
INSPIRING SONGS.9: As Battle Hymn I, except the RR bonus is +20 and the OB bonus is +8.
INSPIRING SONGS.10: As Song of Sharing I, except for radius of effect.
INSPIRING SONGS.11: Allies may add the caster’s level to their spell-casting maneuver rolls.
INSPIRING SONGS.12: As Countersong I, except radius is 20'.
INSPIRING SONGS.13: As Battle Hymn I, except the RR bonus is +30 and the OB bonus is +12.
INSPIRING SONGS.14: Allies reduce all stun rounds taken by 1 and gain a +30 bonus to RRs against spells which cause confusion.
INSPIRING SONGS.15: As Song of Sharing I, except for radius of effect.
INSPIRING SONGS.16: Allies recover 2 concussion hits per round.
INSPIRING SONGS.17: As Countersong I, except radius is 30'.
INSPIRING SONGS.18: As Battle Hymn I, except the RR bonus is +40 and the OB bonus is +16.
INSPIRING SONGS.19: Allies gain +10 OB and do double hits and an additional Impact critical (one severity level less than the primary critical) in melee combat.
INSPIRING SONGS.20: As Song of Sharing I, except for radius of effect.
INSPIRING SONGS.25: As Battle Hymn I, except the RR bonus is twice the caster’s level and the OB bonus is +20.
INSPIRING SONGS.30: As Song of Sharing I, except for radius of effect.
INSPIRING SONGS.35: As Countersong I, except radius is 50'.
INSPIRING SONGS.40: As Song of Sharing I, except that radius is equal to the caster’s level in feet.
INSPIRING SONGS.50: As Countersong I, except radius is 100'.

ITEM LORE.1: Caster can assess the value of a musical instrument to within 10% of its actual value. This spell allows the caster to calculate different values for the different cultures he is familiar with based on the general value of the instrument, the raw materials used to make it, and the quality of craftsmanship and sound. Additional value (e.g., from being made by a famous maker) is not revealed. The caster also gains a general knowledge of the instrument’s origins (the culture of origin and the instrument’s age within 10% of its actual age). Finally, he understands how the instrument is to be played, although actually playing competently requires the development of skill with the instrument through practice.
ITEM LORE.2: The caster has a +50 bonus to any attempt to appraise the market value of the target item. Item may be appraised for any culture/location of which the caster has knowledge.
ITEM LORE.3: Detects magical power in an item, but not the realm or how much. A different item can be examined each round by concentrating.
ITEM LORE.4: The caster can examine any visual symbol of an individual or group, be it a company logo, shield design, tattoo, flag, or other device. The caster learns the name of the individual or group so represented, a rough idea of the nature and (usual) location of that which is represented (e.g., “a knight of Glakony” or “a criminal gang in the southern islands”), and the purpose of the emblem (e.g., “to mark his works”, “to identify church grounds, property, or servants”, or “battlefield identification”).
ITEM LORE.5: Any Runes maneuver made by the caster has a +15 bonus.
ITEM LORE.6: The caster learns the area of origin of the item, the race of the being who made it, and when it was made (within 100 years). If the creator gave the item a name, that is also revealed.
ITEM LORE.7: Any Attunement maneuver made by the caster has a +15 bonus.
ITEM LORE.8: The caster learns the primary power of a magical item. This knowledge comes in the form a short narrative illustrating this power or an explanatory bit of verse.
ITEM LORE.9: The caster learns a narrative account of the most significant event in the item’s recent past. The event cannot have occurred more than one hour per level of the caster in the past.
ITEM LORE.10: The caster learns who made the item and when. He also learns of any craftsmanship bonus the item possesses. He learns whom the item was made for, if it was crafted for a specific person or group, and he learns for what purpose the item was made.
ITEM LORE.11: The caster learns if there is a curse on the item.
ITEM LORE.12: As Rune Literacy III, but bonus is +35.
ITEM LORE.13: The caster learns the cultural and historical significance of one item. He also learns its personal significance, if any, to its current owner. This knowledge comes in the form of an illustrative narrative.
ITEM LORE.14: As Attuning III, but bonus is +35.
ITEM LORE.15: The caster gains complete information on the item’s construction, purpose, magical abilities, and any non-magical bonuses.
ITEM LORE.16: The caster receives a narrative account of how someone died. Since this is not a vision, the caster has only a description of the killer (and perhaps the name, if it is revealed in dialog), but vision-centric defenses against retrosurveillance will not stymie this spell. When this spell is cast, the caster must be touching an object that had significance in the death (i.e., the murder weapon, the body, etc.) The narrative will be “from the point of view” of the object in question, so casting on multiple objects may provide a more complete account of events.
ITEM LORE.17: As Item’s Tale, except without a time limit.
ITEM LORE.18: As Rune Literacy II, but bonus is +50.
ITEM LORE.19: The next touch-ranged spell on this list cast by the caster of this spell will have its range improved to 20'.
ITEM LORE.20: As Attuning III, but bonus is +50.
ITEM LORE.25: As Item’s Tale, except caster learns the whole history of the item. This does not include every detail, but does include all significant events.
ITEM LORE.30: As Item Analysis and Item Origins combined, except that the Bard may study one item each round during the duration of the spell.
ITEM LORE.35: As Rune Literacy III, but bonus is +75.
ITEM LORE.40: Caster immediately knows the location of the most valuable (financially) object within the area of effect.
ITEM LORE.50: As Attuning III, but bonus is +75.

SOUND CONTROL.1: Creates a 1'R area into and out of which sound cannot travel. As discussed in Section 10.17, this spell can be cast on an individual target, which the spell will then follow; this target gains +25 to Stalking attempts, but likewise automatically fails any Perception attempts based on hearing alone and suffers a -50 to Perception rolls where hearing is a factor (e.g., to detect someone Stalking the target). Note that this does not interfere with spell-casting (the target can still speak, even yell, the sound is simply unable to leave the radius of the Quiet - certain spells like Ultrasonics may have their range limited to the interior of the Quiet radius, however).
SOUND CONTROL.2: Caster may manipulate sound within the area of effect, creating any single sound desired. This sound may be heard outside the area of effect, if the caster wishes. Sound cannot be damaging.
SOUND CONTROL.3: For the duration of this spell, all sounds in the area of effect are no louder than a whisper. The caster is immune to the effects of this spell. In addition, the caster can designate up to one extra target per level to be immune to the effects of the spell. By concentrating for one round, the caster may make one target immune to the effect or remove one target’s immunity.
SOUND CONTROL.4: A fanfare of music plays. The caster may designate one instrument (that will make the sounds of the fanfare) for every five levels of experience (or portion thereof). The volume of the fanfare cannot exceed that which would be normally made by the designated instrument(s).
SOUND CONTROL.5: As Quiet I, except radius is 10'.
SOUND CONTROL.6: As Sonic Law I, except radius is 10'.
SOUND CONTROL.7: Causes a very loud, sudden sound next to the target’s ears; target is stunned (-50) for 1 round per 10 failure.
SOUND CONTROL.8: Target cannot hear sounds occurring more than 6" from the target’s ears.
SOUND CONTROL.9: Certain sound waves cause any cracks or flaws in solid, inanimate material (up to 1,000 cu') to expand to their limit.
SOUND CONTROL.10: Caster may designate any music to be played as if the caster were playing it (and the caster must actually have played the music at least once). The music will play continuously for the duration of the spell. If the musical score finishes before the duration is over, the music will repeat as many times as needed. The caster can designate singing instead of an instrument.
SOUND CONTROL.11: As Sphere of Silence I, except radius is 50'.
SOUND CONTROL.12: As Sonic Law I, except radius is 100'.
SOUND CONTROL.13: Causes a nonmetal, rigid, inanimate object to shatter (up to 1 cubic foot in size). All within a 5'R take an A Impact critical, anyone holding the object takes a C critical.
SOUND CONTROL.14: A set series of sounds can be concentrated upon and then delayed up to 24 hours or until triggered by a specified sound. The sounds to be delayed may last up to 1 minute per level.
SOUND CONTROL.15: As Music, except caster may designate one instrument per five levels of experience (or portion thereof) that will play simultaneously. All instruments (including vocals) will play as if the caster were playing them.
SOUND CONTROL.16: As Sonic Law I, except radius is 10' per level of the caster.
SOUND CONTROL.17: As Sudden Sound, except for range.
SOUND CONTROL.18: All beings (except the caster) within range capable of hearing ultrasonic sounds are stunned (-50) 1 rnd/10 failure; an RR must be made once per round while in the radius. Even if they are not stunned, animals capable of hearing ultrasonics will have to make a second, non-magical RR against Fear (level of Fear is half the caster’s level).
SOUND CONTROL.19: First, this spell will clean and tune an instrument instantly; this effect is “permanent”. This spell cannot repair actually broken or missing parts; if new strings are supplied, it can use them to replace broken ones, for example. Second, the sound quality of the instrument is improved to the equivalent of a +10 quality instrument if it was below that value. Third, if the caster spends a round in concentration, the instrument can be made to sound like any other instrument with which the caster is familiar.
SOUND CONTROL.20: As Cracks, except material with cracks will crumble to dust.
SOUND CONTROL.25: As Sphere of Silence I, except radius is 100'.
SOUND CONTROL.30: As Minor Ultrasonics, except for radius.
SOUND CONTROL.35: Caster launches a concentrated burst of sound at the target, doing a D Impact critical.
SOUND CONTROL.40: As Sudden Sound, except affects up to one target per caster level.
SOUND CONTROL.50: As Sonic Law I, except parameters are as listed and sounds can be programmed, the sounds may be delayed (up to 24 hr), there can be more than one sound at a time, and sounds are instantly changeable.

SOUND PROJECTION.1: Caster can whisper and the whisper can be heard at any point he chooses within the range.
SOUND PROJECTION.2: Both the caster’s voice and the sound of any musical instrument(s) he is playing carry twice as far as normal. This allows for speaking to or performing for larger crowds.
SOUND PROJECTION.3: The caster has a +15 bonus to Performance Art maneuver rolls made when casting a spell on the Controlling Songs or Inspiring Songs spell lists. The “Song” must be cast within 1 minute after completing this spell. This bonus applies both to the initial roll and to any continuation rolls.
SOUND PROJECTION.4: The center of the radius of a spell on the Controlling Songs or Inspiring Songs spell lists may be placed at a distance of up to 50' from the caster. The “Song” must be cast within one minute after completing this spell. Silent performance techniques (e.g. juggling) cannot be used with Distant Drums.
SOUND PROJECTION.5: As Long Whisper I, except range is 300'.
SOUND PROJECTION.6: As Sounding II, except increase is five times.
SOUND PROJECTION.7: As Distant Drums V, but maximum distance is 100'.
SOUND PROJECTION.8: A spell on the Controlling Songs or Inspiring Songs spell lists will continue to stay in effect after the caster is done performing. The “Song” must be cast within one minute after completing this spell. This extended effect is as long as the initial performance (including any extension by making continuation rolls). For example, if the caster plays a Stunning Song for four rounds, then runs away, the victims will suffer a total of eight rounds of stun (-50).
SOUND PROJECTION.9: As Long Whisper I, except range is 500'.
SOUND PROJECTION.10: A spell on the Controlling Songs spell list can affect only those individuals the caster chooses. He may either select them individually or by choosing one or more categories of being to affect (e.g., “rats”, “children”). The “Song” must be cast within one minute after completing this spell. This spell allows the caster to make himself one of the targets of his own Controlling Song.
SOUND PROJECTION.11: As Sweet Music III, but bonus is +30.
SOUND PROJECTION.12: As Distant Drums V, but maximum distance is 200'.
SOUND PROJECTION.13: As Long Whisper I, except range is 1000'.
SOUND PROJECTION.14: As Sounding II, except sound carries out to a chosen distance up to one mile radius without diminution of sound.
SOUND PROJECTION.15: As Distant Drums V, but maximum distance is 300'.
SOUND PROJECTION.16: As Echoes, but the extended effect lasts twice as long as the performance.
SOUND PROJECTION.17: As Long Whisper I, except range is 100' per level of the caster.
SOUND PROJECTION.18: As Sweet Music III, but bonus is +50.
SOUND PROJECTION.19: As Distant Drums V, but maximum distance is 500'.
SOUND PROJECTION.20: A spell on the Controlling Songs or Inspiring Songs spell list will not interfere with the caster’s normal movement. The “Song” must be cast within one minute after completing this spell. The caster may continue his performance while doing full movement at up to a jogging pace with no pace penalties.
SOUND PROJECTION.25: As Distant Drums V, but maximum distance is one mile, and the caster must be able to see the place where he wants to center his Controlling Song.
SOUND PROJECTION.30: As Echoes, but the extended effect lasts three times as long as the performance.
SOUND PROJECTION.35: A spell on the Controlling Songs spell list will influence even beings normally immune to mental spells, be they mindless undead, strange demons, or animated stone. The “Song” must be cast within one minute after completing this spell.
SOUND PROJECTION.40: As Sweet Music III, but bonus is +75.
SOUND PROJECTION.50: A spell on the Controlling Songs spell list can be made to repeat itself at a later time in the same place. The “Song” must be cast within one minute after completing this spell. The repetition can be triggered any time in the next 48 hours after completion of the initial performance. The caster can choose one of the following triggers: a) a set time, b) specified movement/action, c) specified sound, d) specified species, or e) specified realm of magic actively cast. For options b through e, they trigger the Repeat Performance if they occur/exist in the area affected by the Controlling Song. For those options, the response to the trigger may occur instantly or there may be a set delay in order, e.g., to let more orcs enter the area of effect before the spell goes off.

CONCEALMENT MASTERY.1: Caster and objects on the caster’s person appear to be in shadow and thus are almost invisible in dark areas (in many situations this could be handled with a Stalking bonus of between +25 and +75).
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.2: Up to three objects are made invisible (1 garment, 1 naked body, etc.); until 24 hrs pass or the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc.) or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack) or casts a spell of type E or F.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.3: Target inanimate object takes on the visual appearance of a similar object. For example, a small red key may appear as a small blue spoon. The object cannot vary in dimensions by more than 100% of actual size in any given dimension. This is strictly a visual illusion (and can be detected as such).
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.4: As Unseen III, except it covers one target and everything within 1' of the target.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.5: As Conceal I, except the caster may choose two options - affect one additional object, double the duration, increase the range to 50' for one object, or add a tactile sense to one concealed object.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.6: As Invisibility I, except the caster can vary the radius up to 1'. This makes the invisible target harder to see by reducing the “fringe effect.”
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.7: One melee attack (armed or unarmed) is covered by a moment of invisibility. Unless the target of that attack has the power to see the invisible, the target’s parry is subject to a -100 penalty (down to a minimum of 0 parry DB).
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.8: Caster’s apparent location is offset from the actual location; all attacks have no effect 10% of the time. Each time a foe misses due to this effect, the chance of that foe missing again goes down 5%.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.9: As Conceal III, except choose four options.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.10: As Unseen III, except up to 10 objects.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.11: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 20%.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.12: As Invisibility II, except caster can vary the radius up to 10', determined at the time of casting.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.13: Caster becomes almost impossible to read as to honesty or emotions (-100 to all attempts to use Social Awareness skill on the caster) and spells to read the caster’s mind or emotional state must make an RR roll against this spell or simply fail.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.14: Caster can see invisible things anywhere the caster can normally see; the caster’s attacks on invisible targets get no penalty (as they are not invisible to him).
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.15: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 30%.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.16: As Invisibility Sphere II, except caster can vary the radius by up to 20'.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.17: As Unseen Blow, except affects all melee attacks by the target during the spell’s duration.
CONCEALMENT MASTERY.18: As Hide Thoughts, except for duration.
