The caster can give a simple, straight-forward task for the creature to attempt to complete. The creature will do its best to complete the task (within the duration of the spell). When the duration of this spell expires, the creature returns to its normal “unbound” state. Once this spell is cast, the creature can leave the range of the spell without ending its duration.
DARK SUMMONS.8: As Summons II, except four options are chosen.
DARK SUMMONS.9: As Binding II, except binds up to a 5th level creature.
DARK SUMMONS.10: As Summons II, except six options may be chosen.
DARK SUMMONS.11: The target of this spell is a familiar that has had Investiture I successfully cast on it. This spell puts more of the caster into his familiar. The caster must cast this spell once per day for six months (spending two hours each day). The caster can use the familiar’s senses up to 1,000 feet per level away and can cast spells through the familiar up to 200' per level away. The creature’s AT improves to 5, the DB bonus improves to +20 and the OB bonus improves to +30, and it makes RRs at the higher of its own level or three fourths of the caster’s level. It also gains a venomous attack that is used in conjunction with its normal attack (poison type of the caster’s choice, equal level to the familiar). The appearance of the familiar becomes even more grotesque, beginning to assume aspects of the caster’s appearance. The change may be extreme enough to make it unrecognizable as the animal it was. If the familiar dies, the caster loses half his Power Points and Concussion Hits for 1-5 weeks.
DARK SUMMONS.12: As Summons II, except nine options are chosen.
DARK SUMMONS.13: As Binding II, except binds up to a 10th level creature.
DARK SUMMONS.14: As Summons II, except eleven options are chosen.
DARK SUMMONS.15: As Order Bound II, except maximum duration is 10 hours.
DARK SUMMONS.16: As Summons II, except fourteen options are chosen.
DARK SUMMONS.17: As Binding II, except binds up to a 15th level creature.
DARK SUMMONS.18: As Summons II, except sixteen options are chosen.
DARK SUMMONS.19: The target of this spell is a familiar that has had Investiture II successfully cast on it. This spell puts even more of the caster into his familiar. The caster must cast this spell once per day for one year (spending two hours each day). The caster can use the familiar’s senses up to 1 mile per level away and can cast spells through the familiar up to 1000' per level away. The creature’s AT improves to 7, the DB bonus improves to +30 and the OB bonus improves to +50, and it makes RRs at the higher of its own level or the caster’s level. It retains its venom from Investiture II. Its form becomes completely grotesque and could not be associated with the animal it once was. If the familiar dies, the caster loses three quarters of his Power Points and Concussion Hits for 1-5 weeks.
DARK SUMMONS.20: As Summons II, except nineteen options are chosen.
DARK SUMMONS.25: As Binding II, except binds a creature of any level.
DARK SUMMONS.30: As Order Bound II, except maximum duration is 1 hour per caster’s level.
DARK SUMMONS.35: As Summons II, except a number of options equal to the caster’s level are chosen.
DARK SUMMONS.40: The target of this spell is a familiar that has had Investiture III successfully cast on it. This spell puts even more of the caster into his familiar. The caster must cast this spell once per day for two years (spending two hours each day). The caster can use the familiar’s senses up to 10 miles per level away and can cast spells through the familiar up to 1 mile per level away. The creature’s AT improves to 9, the DB bonus improves to +50 and the OB bonus improves to +75, and it continues to make RRs at the higher of its own level or the caster’s level. It retains its venom from Investiture II, but potency is the higher of the familiar’s level or the caster’s level. It cannot really become more grotesque. If the familiar dies, the caster loses all of his Power Points and Concussion Hits for 1-5 weeks, spending that period in a coma.
DARK SUMMONS.50: Caster can use any lower level spell on this list, once per round.

ESSENCE TWISTING.1: The local Essence field is distorted, causing all RRs against spells from the Realm of Essence to be made at -10.
ESSENCE TWISTING.2: As Baneful Essence, except affects spells from the Realm of Mentalism.
ESSENCE TWISTING.3: As Baneful Essence, except affects spells from the Realm of Channeling.
ESSENCE TWISTING.4: The local Essence field is distorted, causing all RRs against spells from the Realm of Essence to be made at +10.
ESSENCE TWISTING.5: As Baneful Essence, except affects all spells.
ESSENCE TWISTING.6: As Weaken Essence, except affects spells from the Realm of Mentalism.
ESSENCE TWISTING.7: As Weaken Essence, except affects spells from the Realm of Channeling.
ESSENCE TWISTING.8: As Baneful Essence, except penalty is -20.
ESSENCE TWISTING.9: As Woeful Essence, except affects spells from the Realm of Mentalism.
ESSENCE TWISTING.10: As Weaken Essence, except affects all spells.
ESSENCE TWISTING.11: As Woeful Essence, except affects spells from the Realm of Channeling.
ESSENCE TWISTING.12: Any time an attempt to cast a spell from the Realm of Essence within the area of effect results in spell failure, +30 is added to the spell failure roll.
ESSENCE TWISTING.13: As Treacherous Essence, except affects spells from the Realm of Mentalism.
ESSENCE TWISTING.14: As Woeful Essence, except affects all spells.
ESSENCE TWISTING.15: As Treacherous Essence, except affects spells from the Realm of Channeling.
ESSENCE TWISTING.16: Any attempt to cast a spell of the Realm of Essence will be made with a -20 penalty to the Spellcasting roll.
ESSENCE TWISTING.17: Any attempt to cast a spell of the Realm of Mentalism will be made with a -20 penalty to the Spellcasting roll.
ESSENCE TWISTING.18: Any attempt to cast a spell of the Realm of Channeling will be made with a -20 penalty to the Spellcasting roll.
ESSENCE TWISTING.19: As Treacherous Essence, except affects all spells.
ESSENCE TWISTING.20: Any attempt to cast any spell will be made with a -20 penalty to the Spellcasting roll.
ESSENCE TWISTING.25: As any of the above spells relating to the Realm of Essence, except for area of effect and duration.
ESSENCE TWISTING.30: As any of the above spells relating to the Realm of Mentalism, except for area of effect and duration.
ESSENCE TWISTING.35: As any of the above spells relating to the Realm of Channeling, except for area of effect and duration.
ESSENCE TWISTING.40: All spells cast that are from an Evil spell list are resisted at -10, while those from other lists suffer a -25 to their Spellcasting rolls and are resisted with a +10 bonus.
ESSENCE TWISTING.50: As any of the above spells of less than 40th level, except for area of effect and duration.

FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.1: Caster’s eyes enlarge. Caster gains a +20 to Perception rolls involving vision exclusively and a +10 to Perception rolls involving vision along with other senses. Any vision enhancement spells cast on the caster while this spell is active will last until this spell expires or their normal duration, whichever is longer.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.2: Caster’s skin and subcutaneous fat are changed into a more protective form, granting the caster a natural AT of 2. This covers the entire body and constitutes a full set of armor.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.3: Caster grows a prehensile tail strong enough to support his own weight.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.4: Caster grows several tentacles, which can be used to make an attack on the Grapple Attack Table without occupying the caster’s hands. The size of the attack is the same as the size of the caster. The OB of the attack is the caster’s skill in this list.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.5: Caster’s skin and subcutaneous fat are changed into a more protective form, granting the caster a natural AT of 3. This covers the entire body and constitutes a full set of armor.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.6: Caster grows wings. Caster can now fly at a rate equal to his normal walking speed. He can fly at faster paces, but must make Endurance rolls as if moving one pace faster than actual, with movement at Dash pace requiring an Endurance roll every round at a -20 penalty.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.7: Caster grows horns, which can be used to make an attack on the Horn Attack Table. The size of the attack is the same as the size of the caster. The OB of the attack is the caster’s skill in this list.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.8: Caster’s skin and subcutaneous fat are changed into a more protective form, granting the caster a natural AT of 4.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.9: Caster grows clawed hands, which can be used to make an attack on the Claw Attack Table. The size of the attack is the same as the size of the caster. The OB of the attack is the caster’s skill in this list.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.10: As Wings I , except Fatigue checks are as normal for the pace of movement and any maneuver rolls related to flight are made with a +20 bonus.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.11: Caster’s skin and subcutaneous fat are changed into a more protective form, granting the caster a natural AT of 5. This covers the entire body and constitutes a full set of armor.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.12: Caster grows fangs or teeth suitable for attacks, which can be used to make an attack on the Bite Attack Table. The size of the attack is the same as the size of the caster. The OB of the attack is the caster’s skill in this list.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.13: Caster grows spiny projections. Any time the caster is attacked unarmed or with a weapon less than onehalf the caster’s height in length, the attacker will suffer an attack resolved on the Stinger Attack Table. The size of the attack is the same as the size of the caster. The OB of the attack is half the caster’s skill in this list. This attack is automatic and does not require an action by the caster.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.14: As Wings II, except base speed is twice the caster’s normal walking pace.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.15: Caster’s skin and subcutaneous fat are changed into a more protective form, granting the caster a natural AT of 6. This covers the entire body and constitutes a full set of armor.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.16: When using the attacks provided by spells on this list, the caster can substitute his skill in this list for any one of the following Combat Expertise skills: Disarm, Multiple Attacks, Restricted Quarters, or Reverse Strike. The skill to which this applies may be different each round.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.17: The attack provided by Horns, Claws, Bite, or Spines will deliver a poison upon doing a critical. The level of the poison is the caster’s level. Only one attack becomes poisonous, but this spell can be cast multiple times if the caster has cast more than one of the listed spells active. Caster determines the type of poison. This spell lasts as long as the spell whose attack it is enhancing.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.18: Caster’s skin and subcutaneous fat are changed into a more protective form, granting the caster a natural AT of 7. This covers the entire body and constitutes a full set of armor.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.19: Caster grows a group of spinnerets somewhere on his body, which can be used to make webs. This can be used to create up to 100' of silk rope per round, capable of withstanding a thousand pounds of weight. Webs can be sticky in some parts and not in others, allowing the creation of anchored bridges made of webbing. The webs can also be launched with the ranges of a javelin, with the attack resolved on the Grapple Attack Table. The size of the attack is the same as the size of the caster. The OB of the attack is the caster’s skill in this list.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.20: Caster’s skin and subcutaneous fat are changed into a more protective form, granting the caster a natural AT of 8. This covers the entire body and constitutes a full set of armor.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.25: Caster begins to exhale a toxic gas (caster is immune to the effects). Any living thing coming within 10' of the caster must make an RR versus poison each round or suffer a cumulative -5 penalty and take 1d10 damage from the effects of the gas. Treat the penalty as organ damage (lungs) for treatment/healing purposes and the final penalty as a single injury. Level of the poison is the level of the caster. Caster can also exhale a 50' long cone, reaching a width of 25' at its furthest extent, but this requires such effort that an Endurance roll is called for.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.30: Caster’s skin and subcutaneous fat are changed into a more protective form, granting the caster a natural AT of 9.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.35: Caster’s body adapts to survive in environmental conditions. This can involve submersion in freezing water at depths with crushing pressure, traversing molten lava, enduring exposure to a raging sandstorm, or withstanding the bizarre conditions of an alien dimension. This does not cover any form of deliberate attack (even while comfortable naked in a blizzard, the caster will still suffer normal damage from a Cold Ball).
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.40: Caster’s skin and subcutaneous fat are changed into a more protective form, granting the caster a natural AT of 10.
FOUL TRANSFORMATIONS.50: Caster may use any lower level spell for this list once per round.

NECROMANCY MASTERY.1: Allows the caster to understand and speak the language(s) of any undead beings.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.2: Caster is not subject to automatic harmful effects caused by the proximity of the undead. This provides no protection against deliberate attack.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.3: Caster becomes aware of all undead within the area of effect. He knows their general locations (within 10'), number, and general nature (whether corporeal or incorporeal, mindless or intelligent, controlled or uncontrolled, and what Class of undead).
NECROMANCY MASTERY.4: Caster can control one Class I undead. If this spell is resisted, the target will immediately attack the caster, preferring him over any other available targets.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.5: Caster has a +10 bonus to RRs and DB against attacks by the undead.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.6: Using a suitable corpse or spirit, the caster creates a Class I undead. Corpses must be a condition suitable for the type of undead to be created and in any case, the being to be converted into one of the undead may not have been dead any longer than one day per level of the caster. If the caster succeeds in a Hard Spell Mastery maneuver with an additional -10 penalty times the Class number of the undead created, then the caster may select what type of undead is created by this spell. If this maneuver fails, the GM selects an appropriate undead creature. Upon creation, the undead must make an RR against its creator. If it fails, it will be non-hostile to its creator until some circumstance (such as a failed attempt to Control it) should change things. If it succeeds, it is free to attack its maker if uncontrolled.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.7: Target undead will obey a command by the caster for a period of one day. At the end of that time, the undead returns to its normal behavior. If this spell is resisted, the target will immediately attack the caster, preferring him over any other available targets.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.8: As Control Undead I, except caster can control a Class II undead or control a Class I undead with a -10 to its RR.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.9: This spell must be cast within 100' of the place of death of the being whose spirit is to be turned into an incorporeal form of undead. This spell will fail if the body is protected against being turned into one of the undead (e.g., under the protection of a Restful Spirit spell). The spirit summoned by this spell is suitable for creating an undead being of up to Class III. A Create Undead spell must be successful before the end of this spell’s duration, or the spirit will depart once more. Spirit may not have been dead for more than 1 day/level of caster.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.10: As Create Undead I, except creates a Class II or lesser undead.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.11: Caster has a +20 bonus to RRs and DB against attacks by the undead.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.12: As Control Undead I, except caster can control a Class III undead or control a Class II undead with a -10 to its RR or control a Class I undead with a -20 to its RR.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.13: As Command Undead I, except duration is 1 month.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.14: As Create Undead I, except creates a Class III or lesser undead.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.15: As Summon Lesser Spirit, except the spirit summoned is suitable for the creation of undead of up to Class VI and may have been dead up to 1 week/level of caster.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.16: As Control Undead I, except caster can control a Class IV undead or control a Class III undead with a -10 to its RR or control a Class II undead with a -20 to its RR or control a Class I undead with a -30 to its RR.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.17: Caster has a +30 bonus to RRs and DB against attacks by the undead.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.18: As Command Undead I, except duration is 1 year.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.19: As Create Undead I, except creates a Class IV or lesser undead.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.20: As Control Undead I, except caster can control a Class V undead or control a Class IV undead with a -10 to its RR or control a Class III undead with a -20 to its RR or control a Class II undead with a -30 to its RR or control a Class I undead with a -40 to its RR.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.25: As Control Undead I, except caster can control a Class VI undead or control a Class V undead with a -10 to its RR or control a Class IV undead with a -20 to its RR or control a Class III undead with a -30 to its RR or control a Class II undead with a -40 to its RR or control a Class I undead with a -50 to its RR.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.30: As Create Undead I, except creates a Class V or lesser undead.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.35: Caster can control undead up to his level in total of the undeads’ Class numbers. The RR of an undead may be reduced by -10 by assigning extra levels to its control up to a maximum penalty of -50. For example, a 38th level caster really wants to get control of the Class VI Greater Vampire leading the undead marauders, so he assigns an extra five levels on top of the six minimally required in order to create a -50 RR penalty. This leaves the caster with 27 levels left to assign to the control of other undead.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.40: As Create Undead I, except creates a Class VI or lesser undead.
NECROMANCY MASTERY.50: Places target undead under the caster’s lasting control. The caster need but command the mastered undead, and it will obey to the best of its ability. Undead created by the caster get a -25 to their RRs. The caster can never have more levels of undead mastered than he has levels, although the undead mastered by means of the Necromantic Ways list do not count against the limit mastered by this list and vice versa (i.e., a 60th level caster could have 60 levels of mindless undead mastered by means of Master Mindless Undead and another 60 levels of undead mastered by means of Undead Mastery).

NECROMANTIC WAYS.1: Caster can cause any dead body (within 50% of his own mass), to rise up and move. The caster must concentrate for the body to perform an action; if he stops concentrating, the body will stand motionless. The body can be maneuvered with a -25 modifier and can melee with a -20 OB. The body cannot have been dead more than 1 day. Use the stats from Creature Law for Class I Standard Created Undead except that the OB is -20 and it cannot move faster than a walk.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.2: Caster can control one Class I mindless undead. When the caster does not concentrate, the undead will stay in place and attack only if a living target is within 10'.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.3: [RR Mod.: -25] Caster may master 1 “Class” worth of mindless undead per level of the caster. This spell must be cast separately on each undead. The target undead must already be controlled by the caster and if the target resists this spell, it will attack the caster immediately and may not be subject to the caster’s control again until the caster gains another level. A mastered undead allows the caster to control this specific undead without concentration (it will continue to follow the last order it was given).
NECROMANTIC WAYS.4: As Animate Dead I, except caster can control 2 bodies at once or one body with a -15 modifier to maneuvers and an OB of -10. Additionally, bodies may have been dead for up to 2 days.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.5: Given a body that has been dead less than 1 week, the caster can turn the body into a Class I undead. The newly-created undead will attempt to attack the closest living being (if uncontrolled), but can take no other activity than moving to that being and attacking. If controlled, the undead will do as commanded by the controller.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.6: As Control Mindless Undead I, except 1 Class II mindless undead or 2 Class I undead can be controlled.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.7: As Animate Dead I, except caster can control 3 bodies at once or one body with a -5 modifier to maneuvers and an OB of +0. Additionally, bodies may have been dead for up to 3 days.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.8: As Create Mindless Undead I, except 1 Class II undead or 2 Class I undead can be created.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.9: As Control Mindless Undead I, except 1 Class III mindless undead or 1 Class II and 1 Class I undead or 3 Class I undead can be controlled.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.10: As Animate Dead I, except caster can control 4 bodies at once or one body with a +5 modifier to maneuvers and an OB of +10. Additionally, bodies may have been dead for up to 4 days.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.11: As Create Mindless Undead I, except 1 Class III undead or 1 Class II and 1 Class I or 3 Class I undead can be created.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.12: As Animate Dead I, except caster can control 5 bodies at once or one body with a +10 modifier to maneuvers and an OB of +20. Additionally, bodies may have been dead for up to 5 days.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.13: As Control Mindless Undead I, except 1 Class IV mindless undead or 1 Class III and 1 Class I undead or 2 Class II undead or 1 Class II and 2 Class I undead or 4 Class I undead can be controlled.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.14: As Animate Dead I, except caster can control 6 bodies at once or one body with a +15 modifier to maneuvers and an OB of +30. Additionally, bodies may have been dead for up to 6 days.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.15: As Create Mindless Undead I, except 1 Class IV undead or 1 Class III and 1 Class I or 2 Class II or 1 Class II and 2 Class I or 4 Class I undead can be created.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.16: As Control Mindless Undead I, except 1 Class V mindless undead or 5 Class I undead or any other combination where the total Class numbers of the undead is five can be controlled.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.17: Caster fills a corpse with extra Essence. If the corpse becomes an undead creature within the duration of the spell, its level is determined using the Level Spread Table (Table 3-2) in Creature Law normally, but with a bonus to the roll equal to the caster’s ranks in this list. A caster may also cast this spell on himself prior to using Cheat Death - normally the conversion into a Lich results in a reduction in level, so every bit helps.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.18: As Create Mindless Undead I, except 1 Class V mindless undead or 5 Class I undead or any other combination where the total Class numbers of the undead is five can be created.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.19: As Control Mindless Undead I, except 1 Class VI mindless undead or 6 Class I undead or any other combination where the total Class numbers of the undead is six can be controlled.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.20: As Create Mindless Undead I, except 1 Class VI mindless undead or 6 Class I undead or any other combination where the total Class numbers of the undead is six can be created.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.25: As Control Mindless Undead I, except caster can control any group of undead whose Class numbers total no more than the caster’s level.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.30: This spell is used only once, if ever. Using it, the caster transforms himself into a Lich, one of the most feared of the undead. If the caster fails when attempting this spell, he will simply die. With success, the caster becomes one of the undead without ever actually dying. At this point, the caster is sustained by magic and dwells in a place between life and death.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.35: As Animate Dead VI, except the caster can raise as many bodies as he has levels or improve individual corpses as in the Animate Dead spells by assigning one level per number of the spell above one (e.g. a 37th level caster decides that the first corpse in his army will have +5 to maneuvers and an OB of +10 as in Animate Dead IV; to do this he must assign one level for the corpse, plus three more for the improvement to Animate Dead IV quality, and has 33 levels left to assign to animating further dead). These corpses will remain animated for a full day, during which the caster can control the entire army whenever he concentrates. Additionally, corpses may be as old as one day dead per level of caster.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.40: As Create Mindless Undead VI, except any combination where the total Class numbers of the undead is no more than the caster’s level can be created. At the time the army is raised, the caster can give it an order that it will relentlessly follow for 1 day. At the end of that time, the undead will become uncontrolled and begin attacking the nearest living targets. Additionally, corpses may be as old as one day dead per level of caster.
NECROMANTIC WAYS.50: As Cheat Death, except caster’s organs are transferred into a ready container (jar, box, chest, etc.). The caster then becomes a somewhat more powerful Classic Lich and can only be truly destroyed if the container with his organs is destroyed.

ANTICIPATIONS.1: Caster becomes aware of his primary foe’s likely attack. If the caster parries, the DB gained from the parry is doubled.
ANTICIPATIONS.2: Caster becomes aware of his primary foe’s likely defense. If the foe parries, the DB gained from the parry is halved.
ANTICIPATIONS.3: When faced with a choice about which the caster has little or no information (e.g., which corridor leads to the wine cellar), the caster may cast this spell and the Gamemaster will determine which choice the caster actually makes, biasing the choice favorably by 25% (e.g., if there are two choices, roll 1-100: correct on 26-100, incorrect on 01-25).
ANTICIPATIONS.4: Once this spell is cast, the next time that the caster needs to cast a spell, he will have already subconsciously readied himself to do so. Treat the caster as having prepared that next spell for two rounds.
ANTICIPATIONS.5: Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen in the next minute if the caster takes a specified action.
ANTICIPATIONS.6: Caster is aware of any being within the range of the spell that has hostile intentions towards him. The hostility must be directed specifically at the caster or the spell reveals nothing. The being’s hostility must be active (i.e., driving the being to perform aggressive actions), not passive (i.e., hate exists, but no action is planned).
ANTICIPATIONS.7: Caster has a second sense for the coming actions of his competitor(s) in any game involving skill (possibly with some significant element of chance, but the game must allow meaningful tactical choices, so games such as chess, go, poker, qualify; simply dicing for the highest number would not), providing a +30 bonus to all maneuvers related to that game. Duration is one game or playing session. Does not apply to essentially solitaire games or gambling, regardless of degree of skill involved.
ANTICIPATIONS.8: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring; limited to once per night. The caster must sleep for a normal sleep cycle (minimum of four hours) for this spell to work.
ANTICIPATIONS.9: Caster has a vision of what has occurred in a room or place; limited to up to 1 min/level into the past. The room must fit within a cube with edges equal to twice the caster’s level in feet (i.e., if the caster is 9th level, then the room must fit inside an 18' x 18' x 18' cube).
ANTICIPATIONS.10: Predicts most probable action of a being in the next round; specifics are not learned (e.g., attack in melee, cast a spell; but no detail on attack target or what spell).
ANTICIPATIONS.11: As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 2 minutes into the future.
ANTICIPATIONS.12: As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 hour/ level.
ANTICIPATIONS.13: As Anticipate Hostility, except for area of effect, duration, and range.
ANTICIPATIONS.14: As Dream I, except limit is 2 dreams/night on different topics.
ANTICIPATIONS.15: As Anticipations, except if action is to cast a spell, the spell to be cast and target(s) are learned.
ANTICIPATIONS.16: As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 day/ level.
ANTICIPATIONS.17: As Dream I, except limit is 3 dreams/night on different topics.
ANTICIPATIONS.18: Caster can predict with 95% accuracy the time, type, and severity of the weather to come over the next seven days assuming no spells or magical phenomena interfere.
ANTICIPATIONS.19: As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 week/ level.
ANTICIPATIONS.20: As Intuitions I, except caster may gaze into the future for a number of minutes equal to the caster’s level.
ANTICIPATIONS.25: As Anticipations, except caster can predict actions of all beings within 100' of himself.
ANTICIPATIONS.30: As Dream I, except limit is 5 dreams/night on any combination of topics the caster chooses.
ANTICIPATIONS.35: As Dream V, except limit is one dream/ night per every five levels of the caster (i.e., a 35th level caster may have seven dreams).
ANTICIPATIONS.40: As Room Feel I, except there is no time limit.
ANTICIPATIONS.50: As Anticipations True, except spell types and targets are learned.

BRILLIANCE.1: Beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster’s palm; it has a 50' effective range. If the caster’s hand is closed into a fist, the light will “turn off”. If the caster’s fist is reopened before the end of the duration, the light will turn on again.
BRILLIANCE.2: Causes a small, 1" diameter point of light that will glow softly. This spell provides enough light for Nightvision to work properly, but not enough light to allow much mobility in the dark.
BRILLIANCE.3: Lights a 10'R area about the point touched.
BRILLIANCE.4: Causes a bright aura about the caster, providing a more powerful appearance and subtracting 10 from all attacks on the caster.
BRILLIANCE.5: [RR Mod: -10] Causes a 10'R sphere of intense light, all within are stunned (-50) for 1 round/10 failure.
BRILLIANCE.6: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Lightning Bolt attack table, as a Miniscule attack.
BRILLIANCE.7: Reduces illumination to a dark night in a 10'R area about the point touched.
BRILLIANCE.8: As Aura, except it produces an extremely powerful appearance and subtracts 15 from all attacks.
BRILLIANCE.10: As Light I, except radius is 50'.
BRILLIANCE.11: As Darkness I, except radius is 50'.
BRILLIANCE.12: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Lightning Bolt attack table, as a Miniscule attack.
BRILLIANCE.13: Causes any object up to 1,000 cubic feet to glow with any desired color.
BRILLIANCE.14: As Glow, except produces one light per caster level and these can be directed by concentration anywhere within 5' of the caster. Illumination will still be quite soft, but ten of them provide enough light to read by even without Nightvision.
BRILLIANCE.15: Ray of light of any color springs from caster’s hand, can be up to 5 miles long.
BRILLIANCE.16: As Darkness I, except radius is 1000'.
BRILLIANCE.17: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Lightning Bolt attack table, as a Miniscule attack.
BRILLIANCE.18: Nullifies all magically created darkness in a 100'R, and lights that area as full daylight.
BRILLIANCE.19: Darkens a 100'R area, no light (except Utterlight) can exist within this radius.
BRILLIANCE.20: Focuses sunlight as a lens, must be focused initially on a fixed point. The lens can be moved at a rate of 1'/round, after the first round. It will burn through a 1' diameter at a rate of: 1' wood/round, 4" stone/round, or 1" metal/ round. This spell cannot be used effectively in combat (as foes can easily move out of the way). However, if used on an immobile foe, see Hand of Fire for damage resolution.
BRILLIANCE.25: As Sunfires, except does not require sunlight.
BRILLIANCE.30: Focuses sunlight (requires sunlight) as a lens, initial focus is 6" from open palm of caster (caster’s arm is immune). The lens can be moved at a rate of 10'/round, after the first round. It will burn through a 1' diameter at a rate of: 1' wood/round, 4" stone/round, or 1" metal/ round. If used in melee, it strikes on the Fire Bolt table (with concussion hits doubled) using the caster’s Directed Spell: Elemental Bolts skill; concentration is not required when focus is fixed 6" from palm. If the attack is fumbled (01-02 UM), the caster takes an automatic C Heat Critical.
BRILLIANCE.35: As Beacon, except that the beam will rotate through a full circle, repeatedly, and it has the listed duration and stays centered at the initial location, rather than requiring the caster to stay and concentrate.
BRILLIANCE.40: A bolt of lightning is shot from the caster’s palm; resolve attack on the Lightning Bolt Attack Table as a Medium-sized attack.
BRILLIANCE.50: Focuses sunlight (does not require sunlight) as a lens, initial focus is 6" from open palm of caster (caster’s arm is immune). The lens can be moved at a rate of 10'/round, after the first round. It will burn through a 1' diameter at a rate of: 1' wood/round, 4" stone/round, or 1" metal/ round. If used in melee, it strikes on the Fire Bolt table (with concussion hits doubled) using the caster’s Directed Spell: Elemental Bolts skill; concentration is not required when focus is fixed 6" from palm. If the attack is fumbled (01-02 UM), the caster takes an automatic C Heat Critical.

CLOAKING.1: Causes caster to appear blurred to attackers, granting a +10 to the caster’s DB.
CLOAKING.2: Caster and objects on the caster’s person appear to be in shadow and thus are almost invisible in dark areas (in many situations this could be handled with a Stalking bonus of between +25 and +75).
CLOAKING.3: The next Cloaking spell cast by the caster of this spell, within a minute of completing this spell, will make any noises produced by the caster inaudible to the target(s). This means that the caster can then speak or otherwise make a sound without allowing additional RRs.
CLOAKING.4: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in the caster being invisible to the target; others see the caster normally. If the caster makes an obvious action (e.g., talking, moving an object, etc.), the target may make another RR (the GM may deem it appropriate to apply modifiers to this RR based upon the action the caster takes). If the caster attacks the target, the target may make another RR with a +50 modifier. If the caster begins to concentrate, he can extend the duration of this spell indefinitely (as long as he can concentrate).
CLOAKING.5: Caster has a limited illusion on himself that allows him to look like any humanoid race within 20% of his own size. The illusion moves as the caster moves.
CLOAKING.6: [RR Mod = -50] As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 3 targets.
CLOAKING.7: [RR Mod = -50] As Cloaking I, except every target in the area of effect must make an RR. New targets entering the sphere while the spell is still in effect will need to make an RR or be affected as well. Once a target makes a successful RR, he need not make another RR against the spell; however, once affected, leaving the sphere does not cancel the effect.
CLOAKING.8: [RR Mod = -50] As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 5 targets.
CLOAKING.9: [RR Mod = -50] As Cloaking Sphere I, except for the area of effect.
CLOAKING.10: Creates a duplicate of the caster; if the caster concentrates, it will move as willed; otherwise, it does exactly as the caster does. The duplicate must be created within line of sight of the caster and the caster can only control it within line of sight. If the caster concentrates, he can “merge” the duplicate with himself and then split back apart again (making it difficult to discern which one is the “real” caster).
CLOAKING.11: As Facade I, except illusion may include altering the caster’s voice and any other sounds generated.
CLOAKING.12: [RR Mod = -50] As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 10 targets.
CLOAKING.13: [RR Mod = -50] As Cloaking Sphere I, except for the area of effect.
CLOAKING.14: Caster’s apparent location is offset from the actual location; all attacks have no effect 10% of the time. Each time a foe misses due to this effect, the chance of that foe missing again goes down 5%.
CLOAKING.15: Caster and objects on his person take on the visual texture, color, and form of the surrounding area. Caster is nearly invisible when motionless (+200 to Stalking maneuvers) and gives a +50 bonus to Stalking attempts even when moving (requires concentration). This spell is not cumulative with Shadow.
CLOAKING.16: [RR Mod = -50] As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 20 targets.
CLOAKING.17: [RR Mod = -50] As Cloaking III, except for duration.
CLOAKING.18: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 20%.
CLOAKING.19: [RR Mod = -50] As Cloaking Sphere I, except for the area of effect.
CLOAKING.20: As Shadow Mentalist I, except there are two duplicates.
CLOAKING.25: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 30%.
CLOAKING.30: As Camouflage, except does not require concentration while moving and the Stalking bonus when moving is +75.
CLOAKING.35: [RR Mod = -50] As Extended Cloak III, except the caster can affect 8 targets.
CLOAKING.40: [RR Mod = -50] As Cloaking I, except for duration and that the caster can make any number of associates (up to a maximum of the caster’s level) invisible to the target. Additional RRs due to actions of one of these “invisible” persons are resolved as for Cloaking spells, but if one of them is revealed to the target, this does not expose the others. (Only one RR is made initially to determine if the target resists having the entire group be invisible to him.)
CLOAKING.50: [RR Mod = -50] As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect as many targets as he has levels and the range is only limited to the caster’s field of vision.

DAMAGE RESISTANCE.1: Caster is protected from natural heat up to 176°F (80°C) (treat as if caster were in 68°F [20°C] temperature). For temperatures above 176°F, subtract 108°F (60°C) to determine the effective temperature for the target. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs vs. heat spells/attacks and a +20 to DB vs. elemental fire/ heat attacks.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.2: Caster is protected from natural cold down to 14°F (-10°C) (treat as if caster were in 68°F [20°C] temperature). For temperatures below 14°F, add 54°F (30°C) to determine the effective temperature for the target. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs vs. cold spells/attacks and a +20 to DB vs. elemental cold/ice attacks.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.3: Caster is protected from natural light and light changes (instantly adjusting vision to changing light intensity to never be blinded by glare, sudden light, or sudden darkness). Caster also receives +20 to all RRs vs. light or electricity spells/ attacks and a +20 to DB vs. elemental light/electricity attacks.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.4: Caster is protected from falls of up to 50'. For falls longer than 50', subtract 50' to determine the effective length of the fall. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs vs. spells that do Impact criticals and +20 DB vs elemental attacks doing Impact criticals.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.5: Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits (round off fractional hits) before passing out; hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.6: Caster is relieved of 1 round’s worth of accumulated stun effects.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.7: Delays the effect of a poison on the caster. If the poison is not eliminated before the spell expires, the poison will affect the caster at that time.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.8: As Heat Resistance, except for duration, spell is not instantaneous, and bonus against magical attacks is only +10.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.9: As Cold Resistance, except for duration, spell is not instantaneous, and bonus against magical attacks is only +10.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.10: As Unpain I, except 50% additional hits may be sustained.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.11: Caster is relieved of 3 rounds of accumulated stun effects.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.12: Any poison inside the caster must make an RR with a -20 modifier or be neutralized. In any case, it delays the effects of the poison for the duration of the spell.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.13: Caster takes half hits damage from all physical (non-magical) attacks.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.14: This spell will awaken the caster from sleep the round following casting (caster can preset conditions under which the spell will activate).
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.15: As Unpain I, except 75% additional hits may be sustained.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.16: Caster is relieved of 5 rounds’ worth of accumulated stun effects.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.17: As Heat Resistance, except caster is immune to natural heat and is treated as one Size larger when taking damage from heat spells.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.18: As Cold Resistance, except caster is immune to natural cold and is treated as one Size larger when taking damage from cold spells.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.19: As Light Resistance, except caster is immune to natural light/electricity and is treated as one Size larger when taking damage from electrical spells.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.20: As Unpain I, except 100% additional hits may be sustained.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.25: As Neutralize Poison, except poison has a -70 modifier to its RR.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.30: As Awake, except there is no delay and it can be triggered by any normally perceivable previously declared condition within 50' (e.g., anyone entering the area, a stranger entering the area, or a drawn weapon in the area).
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.35: As Heat Resistance True, Cold Resistance True, and Light Resistance True.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.40: Caster is relieved of all accumulated stun effects.
DAMAGE RESISTANCE.50: Caster ignores all pain; he ignores the penalties for lost hits and will never become unconscious due to hits taken, nor will he die from hit loss while this spell is in effect.

DELVING.1: Caster receives basic idea of item’s purpose, if any.
DELVING.2: Detects magical power in an item, but not the realm or how much. A different item can be examined each round by concentrating.
DELVING.3: Gives a general idea of the place of origin of an item.
DELVING.4: Once the caster has detected magical power in an object, this spell will reveal what realm of magic is involved.
DELVING.5: The caster learns if there is a curse on the item.
DELVING.6: Caster learns the origins of an item’s power.
DELVING.7: Caster gets details of where, when, and how the examined stone was worked.
DELVING.8: Caster gets a vision of a significant event in the item’s past.
DELVING.9: Caster gets a vision of a significant event in the person’s past.
DELVING.10: Caster learns the significant details about an item’s construction and purpose (not specific powers).
DELVING.11: Caster gets a vision up to 1 hour/level into the past; desired time can be set within ±30 min. Vision must be associated with an item or place. Vision can last up to 1 min/level, if the caster concentrates and remains inactive. Once the caster breaks concentration, the spell ends.
DELVING.12: Gives details of where, when, how, and by whom the examined text was written. This does not provide the ability to read the text, but if the caster can read the text, this spell assists in comprehending it (+50 to any relevant maneuvers).
DELVING.13: Gives major abilities and powers of an item.
DELVING.14: Gives a vision of the caster and circumstances of the casting of an active spell. Caster must touch a physical manifestation of the spell or a person or object under the influence of the spell.
DELVING.15: Gives a vision of how someone died and an image of the killer, if any. This spell must be cast within 24 hours of the death and must be cast at the place of death or in the presence of the body. Vision occurs in real time and covers the dying process.
DELVING.16: Gives a complete rundown on an item’s non-magical construction, powers, and purpose. This spell will not reveal anything relating to magical powers the item may possess.
DELVING.17: When cast just before a Past Vision spell, it allows caster to lock onto a specific event in an item’s past, and then examine that event with the Past Vision.
DELVING.18: As Death’s Memory, except that it may be cast within one week of the death.
DELVING.19: The caster gains complete information on the item’s construction, purpose, magical abilities, and any non-magical bonuses.
DELVING.20: As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 day/level (error: ±1 hour) and vision can last up to 10 min/ level.
DELVING.25: As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 month/level (error: ±1 day) and vision can last up to 1 hour/level.
DELVING.30: As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 year/level (error: ±1 week) and vision can last up to 5 hours/level.
DELVING.35: Caster may revisit any past experience. The memory is accurately enhanced, allowing the caster to note details that were missed at the time and recall vividly details that had been forgotten or misremembered.
DELVING.40: As Item Analysis, except allows analysis of 1 item per round.
DELVING.50: As Past Vision I, except time range is 10 year/level (error: ±1 month) and vision can last up to 10 hour/level (each hour only takes 10 minutes of real time).

DETECTIONS.1: Detects any active spell or active magical item from the Mentalism realm; caster can concentrate on a different 5'R area each round.
DETECTIONS.2: As Detect Mentalism, except realm is Essence.
DETECTIONS.3: As Detect Mentalism, except realm is Channeling.
DETECTIONS.4: Caster can detect any extreme emotion (e.g., hatred, love, sadness, fear, etc.). In addition, the caster learns which emotion(s) the target is feeling. If there are no extremes of emotion (i.e., only normal feelings), nothing is detected. Caster may change the spell’s target each round.
DETECTIONS.5: As Detect Mentalism, except detects invisible things; all attacks against something so detected are at -50.
DETECTIONS.6: As Detect Mentalism, except detects any evil being or any item created by evil or long used by a very evil person.
DETECTIONS.7: As Detect Mentalism, except it gives a 75% chance of detecting a trap (modified by half the bonus or penalty difficulty of finding the trap through a Perception maneuver). See Section 10.14. If a trap is missed, the spell will not find it no matter how many times the caster scans the same area.
DETECTIONS.8: Caster learns the power (level) of every person or item or spell within the area examined. Caster can focus on a different 5'R area each round.
DETECTIONS.9: As Detect Mentalism, except it detects any one substance (e.g., gold, silver, black pepper, goat’s milk, human blood, water) chosen by the caster at the time of casting.
DETECTIONS.10: Detects any active magic on a target person or item. It also analyzes general spell type (in item or cast) and what profession cast or created it; in case of a person, it gives an exact profession.
DETECTIONS.11: As Determine Power I, except range is 100' and area is a circle with a 10' radius.
DETECTIONS.12: As Detect Mentalism, except detects anything deliberately concealed by non-magical means, including secret doors and compartments, as well as hiding individuals. To be detected, a thing must have either been hidden within 1 day/ level of the caster, or there must be someone currently within range who is aware of the concealment.
DETECTIONS.13: As Detect Invisible, except caster can see invisible things anywhere the caster can normally see; the caster’s attacks on invisible targets get no penalty (as they are not invisible to him).
DETECTIONS.14: Caster learns if any external influences or probes are in the caster’s own mind. The involved spell or effect is learned, but this spell does not reveal the identity of the “intruder”.
DETECTIONS.15: Detects any spell that has been cast in the area examined any time as far back as 1 day per caster level. For each spell, the caster learns the spell type and the list it was cast from. A different area may be probed each round.
DETECTIONS.16: As Determine Power I, except range is 500' and area is a circle with a 50' radius.
DETECTIONS.17: Each round, the caster can detect any poison, venom, disease, curse, parasitic infection, or mental illness afflicting one living target, gaining a general knowledge of the type(s) of each present (e.g., a Channeling curse and two mild nerve poisons).
DETECTIONS.18: Detects and exactly identifies every spell cast or active in the target area. It will also identify any magic item or spellcaster within the radius as if it were a target of Power Typing.
DETECTIONS.19: As See Invisible, except caster need not concentrate in order to see invisible things.
DETECTIONS.20: As Determine Power I, except range is 1 mile and area is a circle with a 300' radius.
DETECTIONS.25: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail. The caster must have the dimensions of the object exact within 10% of actual size and know at least two other attributes that make the item unique (e.g., color, texture, weight, etc.) within range of the spell. Note that sometimes the caster must know more than two other attributes to make the item unique.
DETECTIONS.30: Detects as any one of the lower level Detect spells. Thing detected and area of effect can both be changed each round.
DETECTIONS.35: As Location V, except for range.
DETECTIONS.40: As Spell Probe, except detects spells as far back as one year per caster level.
DETECTIONS.50: Caster may use any of the lower level spells on this list up to level 30 each round. Also, the caster may combine “detections”, allowing the detection of multiple things in the same targeted area during a single round (once the appropriate spells are active).

SEEMINGS.1: The caster can alter the visual appearance of an item, being, or place as perceived in the mind of one target for the duration of this spell. The other characteristics of the item, being, or place do not change. The nature of the item, place, or being does not change (e.g., a book will remain a book, a bridge will remain a bridge, etc.). The caster can set up to one conditional action per level of the caster in the Overlay spell (this action requires no concentration from the caster). The action is triggered on a given action by the target. By concentrating, the caster can exercise dynamic control over what is perceived in the target’s mind with regard to the affected item, being, or place (though the target must still be within range of the caster).
SEEMINGS.2: The caster can create a visual (static or dynamic) image (e.g., of an item, being, or place) which is perceived in the mind of one target for the duration of this spell. The caster can set up to one conditional action per level of the caster in the Seeming spell (this action requires no concentration from the caster). This action is triggered on a given action by the target. By concentrating, the caster can exercise dynamic control over what is perceived in the target’s mind with regard to the affected item, being, or place (though the target must still be within range of the caster).
SEEMINGS.3: As Overlay I, but the caster may choose one of the following options: a) an extra sense can be added to the Overlay, b) an additional target may be affected, c) the duration can be doubled, d) the range can be doubled, or e) an additional item, being, or place may be altered.
SEEMINGS.4: As Seeming I, but the caster may choose one of the following options: a) an extra sense can be added to the Seeming, b) an additional target may be affected, c) the duration can be doubled, d) the range can be doubled, or e) an additional image (of an item, being, or place) can be created.
SEEMINGS.5: As Overlay II, except the caster may choose two of the options.
SEEMINGS.6: As Seeming II, except the caster may choose two of the options.
SEEMINGS.7: This spell will allow the next Overlay or Seeming spell the caster casts to be able to affect animal targets (though the spell must be cast within one minute of completing this spell).
SEEMINGS.8: As Overlay II, except it can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following as a trigger for the spell: a) time period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, f) specified taste, or g) other specified sensation perceived by the target.
SEEMINGS.9: As Seeming II, except it can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following as a trigger for the spell: a) time period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, f) specified taste, or g) other specified sensation perceived by the target.
SEEMINGS.10: As Overlay II, except the caster may choose four of the options.
SEEMINGS.11: As Seeming II, except the caster may choose four of the options.
SEEMINGS.12: As Waiting Overlay II, except two options may be chosen.
SEEMINGS.13: As Waiting Seeming II, except two options may be chosen.
SEEMINGS.14: As Overlay II, except the caster may choose nine of the options.
SEEMINGS.15: As Seeming II, except the caster may choose nine of the options.
SEEMINGS.16: As Waiting Overlay II, except four options may be chosen.
SEEMINGS.17: As Waiting Seeming II, except four options may be chosen.
SEEMINGS.18: As Overlay II, except the caster may choose fourteen of the options.
SEEMINGS.19: As Seeming II, except the caster may choose fourteen of the options.
SEEMINGS.20: As Waiting Overlay II, except nine options may be chosen.
SEEMINGS.25: As Waiting Seeming II, except nine options may be chosen.
SEEMINGS.30: As Overlay II, except the caster may choose nineteen of the options.
SEEMINGS.35: As Seeming II, except the caster may choose nineteen of the options.
SEEMINGS.40: As Waiting Overlay II, except the caster may choose nineteen of the options.
SEEMINGS.50: As Waiting Seeming II, except the caster may choose nineteen of the options.

SELF HEALING.1: Caster is healed of 5 concussion hits damage.
SELF HEALING.2: Allows caster to stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding at rate of 1 hit/round. For one hour, the caster can engage in no activity more vigorous than walking or bleeding will resume at the prior rate.
SELF HEALING.3: Removes up to -30 in penalties from fatigue.
SELF HEALING.4: Allows caster to stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding at rate of up to 3 hits/round. For one hour, the caster can engage in no activity more vigorous than walking or bleeding will resume at the prior rate.
SELF HEALING.5: Caster is relieved of 1 round’s worth of accumulated stun effects.
SELF HEALING.6: An injury incurring a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, and the caster receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll. Cuts (wounds that involve both bleeding and injury penalties) must have the bleeding stopped (e.g., with Clotting) before the injury penalty may be treated (e.g., by this spell).
SELF HEALING.7: Instantly stops bleeding from 1 wound that bleeds at rate of 1 hit/round or permanently reduces bleeding from a more severe cut by 1 hit/round. This spell may be used repeatedly on the same wound and the effects are cumulative.
SELF HEALING.8: Reduces damage by 2 hits every round as long as caster concentrates; if caster is unconscious, this spell will operate without concentration.
SELF HEALING.9: As Light Wound Relief, except an injury incurring a penalty up to 40.
SELF HEALING.10: Caster is relieved of 3 rounds of accumulated stun effects.
SELF HEALING.11: This spell will awaken the caster from sleep the round following casting (caster can preset conditions under which the spell will activate).
SELF HEALING.12: As Light Wound Relief, except an injury incurring any penalty.
SELF HEALING.13: Caster comes out of a coma or unconsciousness caused by injury, disease, poison, spell, or spell failure.
SELF HEALING.14: As Clotting I, except caster can heal bleeding in multiple wounds up to a total hits/round of bleeding equal to his level.
SELF HEALING.15: Upon receiving a death blow, the caster goes into a state of suspended animation, until cured or killed by brain destruction.
SELF HEALING.16: This spell allows the caster to spend ten minutes in renewing his body’s blood. This allows him to gain a new RR with a +10 bonus to any blood-borne disease or poison which might be in his system. It will also stop any form of conversion process that entered through a wound (e.g., lycanthropy, vampirism). Caster remains automatically Concentrating throughout this process.
SELF HEALING.17: Caster can reattach 1 severed limb. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
SELF HEALING.18: As Regeneration I, except 6 hits are healed every round.
SELF HEALING.19: Caster’s heart will start beating after having stopped. This does not repair any heart disease or damage that caused the initial stoppage.
SELF HEALING.20: Caster is relieved of 5 rounds’ worth of accumulated stun effects.
SELF HEALING.25: An injury incurring a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll, and the recovery period is reduced to hours rather than days.
SELF HEALING.30: As Light Wound Healing, except an injury incurring a penalty up to -40.
SELF HEALING.35: As Light Wound Healing, except an injury incurring any penalty.
SELF HEALING.40: The caster instantly heals all concussion hit damage, hits/round damage, accumulated stun effects, and fatigue.
SELF HEALING.50: Caster can cast one lower level spell on this list each round, so long as he concentrates. He can also entirely regenerate body parts: a muscle, tendon, or bone takes two rounds of concentration, while an organ other than the brain requires ten rounds of concentration, and a limb would take 1-10 hours, depending on how much is missing (10 hours for a full arm or leg). This does not allow regeneration of brain damage or nerve damage, except to grow new nerves in a regenerated limb. Concentration on this healing is not tiring and is maintained automatically.

SPELL RESISTANCE.1: Caster gains a bonus of +5 to RRs against spells and a bonus of +5 to DB against elemental attacks.
SPELL RESISTANCE.2: When the caster is a target of a spell from the Realm of Mentalism, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR before the caster makes an RR. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster of this spell normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target. Being a “willing target” does not eliminate this effect, but the caster’s own spells do not need to make an RR. Note that the caster is considered to be a target of any spell which includes him in its area of effect or would “detect” him.
SPELL RESISTANCE.3: Gives the caster a +10 RR bonus against spells with the “mental” subtype.
SPELL RESISTANCE.4: As Cancel Mentalism, except affects spells from the realm of Essence.
SPELL RESISTANCE.5: As Protection I, except bonuses are +10.
SPELL RESISTANCE.6: As Cancel Mentalism, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
SPELL RESISTANCE.7: As Cancel Mentalism, except affects spells from two realms of the caster’s choice.
SPELL RESISTANCE.8: Creates a shimmering shield in front of the caster: it provides a bonus to the caster’s RR or DB of 10 against all frontal Mentalism spell attacks on the caster (force and elemental). If the caster takes an instantaneous action to do so, he can “deflect” one spell attack. This results in adding the caster’s ranks in this list to his RR or, for spells that use an attack table, to his DB (in addition to the basic bonus of 10 for having the Shield). Multiple deflections can be done in a single round, but each is a separate instantaneous action (costing 1 AP for every instantaneous action after the first).
SPELL RESISTANCE.9: As Cancel Mentalism, except affects spells from any realm.
SPELL RESISTANCE.10: As Mentalism Shield, except is effective only against Essence spells.
SPELL RESISTANCE.11: As Protection I, except bonuses are +15.
SPELL RESISTANCE.12: As Cancel Mentalism, except this spell only attempts to cancel the next Mentalism spell (not cast by the caster) to target the caster. Only one Waiting Cancel can be in place at a time, but it will last indefinitely until triggered.
SPELL RESISTANCE.13: As Mentalism Shield, except is effective only against Channeling spells.
SPELL RESISTANCE.14: As Waiting Mentalism Cancel, except affects spells from the realm of Essence.
SPELL RESISTANCE.15: As Mentalism Shield, except it is effective against any two of the three realms.
SPELL RESISTANCE.16: As Waiting Mentalism Cancel, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
SPELL RESISTANCE.17: As Protection I, except bonuses are +25.
SPELL RESISTANCE.18: As Waiting Mentalism Cancel, except affects spells from any realm.
SPELL RESISTANCE.19: As Mentalism Shield, except it is effective against all spells.
SPELL RESISTANCE.20: Gives a +50 to all RRs against Mentalism spells.
SPELL RESISTANCE.25: Gives a +50 to all RRs against Essence spells.
SPELL RESISTANCE.30: Gives a +50 to all RRs against Channeling spells.
SPELL RESISTANCE.35: Caster may make a second RR against any spell, if the first RR fails.
SPELL RESISTANCE.40: As Spell Shield True, except if the caster makes a successful RR against the incoming spell while “deflecting”, he can send the spell back at the caster.
SPELL RESISTANCE.50: Gives a +50 to all RRs against all spells.

TELEKINESIS.1: Caster can move one object at a distance, weighing up to 1 pound, up to 1'/second with no acceleration. If the caster stops concentration before the duration is up, the object remains stationary as if it had Staying I (with a 1 pound limit) thrown on it.
TELEKINESIS.2: Exerts 25 pounds of counterforce on a person or object. Object cannot be moved by Staying alone, which can only be used to counter another force, such as gravity, and it can only exert force in one direction.
TELEKINESIS.3: As Telekinesis I, except weight limit is 5 lbs.
TELEKINESIS.4: As Staying II, except force limit is 125 pounds.
TELEKINESIS.5: As Staying II, except 2 objects may be affected with 25 pounds total force or Staying II can be used to 200'.
TELEKINESIS.6: As Telekinesis I, except 2 objects of 5 lbs. total weight may be moved or Telekinesis I can be used at 200'.
TELEKINESIS.7: As Telekinesis I, except weight limit is 25 lbs.
TELEKINESIS.8: As Staying II, except force limit is 250 pounds.
TELEKINESIS.9: As Telekinesis I, except weight limit is 50 lbs.
TELEKINESIS.10: Caster may “hurl” one object (that starts within 10' of the caster) of 1 pound. or less with sufficient force to deliver an attack on the Sling Attack Table with the ranges of a Short Bow. Base the caster’s OB on his Directed Spell: Hurling skill. If a weapon is “hurled”, a medium Spell Mastery maneuver will allow use of the weapon’s normal attack table, retaining the Short Bow range penalties. If this is done, the weapon gets any normal OB bonuses (e.g., from superior materials).
TELEKINESIS.11: As Staying II, except force limit is 500 pounds.
TELEKINESIS.12: As Telekinesis I, except weight limit is 100 lbs.
TELEKINESIS.13: Caster may “hurl” one object (that starts within 10' of the caster) of 5 pounds or less with sufficient force to deliver an attack on the Sling Attack Table with the ranges of a Short Bow and it delivers 3x normal hits. Base the caster’s OB on his Directed Spell: Hurling skill. If a weapon is “hurled”, a medium Spell Mastery maneuver will allow use of the weapon’s normal attack table, retaining the Short Bow range penalties. If this is done, the weapon gets any normal OB bonuses (e.g., from superior materials). Hit multiplication does not apply if hurling a weapon using its own attack table.
TELEKINESIS.14: As Staying II, except force limit is 600 lbs.
TELEKINESIS.15: As Staying II, except 3 objects may be affected with 25 pounds total force or Staying II can be used to 300'.
TELEKINESIS.16: As Telekinesis I, except 3 objects of 25 lbs total weight may be moved or Telekinesis I can be used to 300'.
TELEKINESIS.17: As Telekinesis I, except weight limit is 200 lbs.
TELEKINESIS.18: Caster may “hurl” one object (that starts within 10' of the caster) of 25 pounds or less with sufficient force to deliver an attack on the Sling Attack Table with the ranges of a Short Bow and it delivers 5x normal hits. Base the caster’s OB on his Directed Spell: Hurling skill. If a weapon is “hurled”, a medium Spell Mastery maneuver will allow use of the weapon’s normal attack table, retaining the Short Bow range penalties. If this is done, the weapon gets any normal OB bonuses (e.g., from superior materials). Hit multiplication does not apply if hurling a weapon using its own attack table.
TELEKINESIS.19: As Staying II, except force limit is 50 pounds per level.
TELEKINESIS.20: As Telekinesis I, except weight limit is 20 pounds per level.
TELEKINESIS.25:
Caster may “hurl” one object (that starts within 300' away or the caster may hurl 3 objects that start up to 100' away (at the same target). Each hurled object must be 1lb or less with sufficient force to deliver an attack on the Sling Attack Table with the ranges of a Short Bow.

Base the caster’s OB on his Directed Spell: Hurling skill. If a weapon is “hurled”, a medium Spell Mastery maneuver will allow use of the weapon’s normal attack table, retaining the Short Bow range penalties. If this is done, the weapon gets any normal OB bonuses (e.g., from superior materials).

Directed Spells skill must be divided between multiple objects. Range penalties are based on distance from object starting point to the target.
TELEKINESIS.30: Caster may “hurl” one object (that starts within 10' of the caster) of 50 pounds or less with sufficient force to deliver an attack on the Sling Attack Table with the ranges of a Short Bow and it delivers 5x normal hits and the OB has an additional +50 bonus. Base the caster’s OB on his Directed Spell: Hurling skill. If a weapon is “hurled”, a medium Spell Mastery maneuver will allow use of the weapon’s normal attack table, retaining the Short Bow range penalties. If this is done, the weapon gets any normal OB bonuses (e.g., from superior materials). Hit multiplication does not apply if hurling a weapon using its own attack table.
TELEKINESIS.35:
Caster may “hurl” one object (that starts within 300' away or the caster may hurl 3 objects that start up to 100' away (at the same target). Each hurled object must be 25lb or less with sufficient force to deliver an attack on the Sling Attack Table with the ranges of a Short Bow.

Base the caster’s OB on his Directed Spell: Hurling skill. If a weapon is “hurled”, a medium Spell Mastery maneuver will allow use of the weapon’s normal attack table, retaining the Short Bow range penalties. If this is done, the weapon gets any normal OB bonuses (e.g., from superior materials).

Directed Spells skill must be divided between multiple objects. Range penalties are based on distance from object starting point to the target.
TELEKINESIS.40: Caster channels telekinetic force in conjunction with the caster’s armed or unarmed melee attacks, resulting in all such attacks doing an additional Impact critical of the same severity as the normal critical.
TELEKINESIS.50: As Telekinesis True, except for duration and caster can manipulate a new object (up to a combined total of 100 pounds per level) each round and a Staying applies to each object while it is not being concentrated on.

ATTACK AVOIDANCE.1: Caster adds +20 to his DB versus one missile fired at the caster. The caster must be able to see the attack.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.2: Caster adds +20 to his DB versus one melee attack on the caster. The caster must be able to see the attack.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.3: Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster; it subtracts 25 from up to 3 attacks per round from the caster’s front. This does not occupy a hand, but is not usable with a physical shield (nor does it benefit from the Shield skill).
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.4: Caster adds +20 to his DB versus one directed spell attack on the caster. The caster must be able to see the attack.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.5: Deflects one missile fired at the caster; that missile has 50 subtracted from its attack (missile must be in caster’s field of vision).
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.6: As Deflect I, except its effect is against one melee attack.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.7: As Shield, except force shield encircles caster, protecting against any number of attacks from all directions. It can be combined with actual armor, but not with either a physical shield or the Shield spell.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.8: As Deflect I, except missile automatically misses.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.9: As Shield, but the defensive bonus is 40 against up to 4 attacks per round.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.10: Creates a pocket of still air 1”/level on all sides of the caster, that no outside gas can come into (duration is the time for the oxygen to be exhausted by one person).
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.11: As Deflect I, except affects 2 missiles.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.12: Allows caster to get full Quickness- based DB against all attacks, including those of which the caster is unaware.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.13: Deflects one directed elemental spell against caster; attack roll has -50 added to it (must be in field of vision).
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.14: Sets up vibrations in any weapon used to attack the caster in melee. This causes the fumble number of such weapons to be increased by 5.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.15: As Bladeturn I, except affects 2 melee attacks.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.16: Caster’s parry is doubled in value (i.e., if the caster used 15 OB to parry with, the caster would gain 30 DB).
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.17: The caster moves to avoid the area of effect of an elemental area effect spell or innate power (typically a ball attack or breath weapon). This results in a -50 to the attack roll as applied to the caster (and caster cannot be subjected to the attack bonus for being at the center of the attack).
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.18: As Deflect I, except affects 3 missiles.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.19: As Aiming Untrue I, except affects 2 missiles.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.20: As Spell Deflect I, except affects 2 directed elemental attack spells.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.25: As Bladeturn I, except affects 3 melee attacks.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.30: As Spell Deflect I, except affects 3 directed elemental attack spells.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.35: As Spell Deflect I, except penalty to attacking spell is -100.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.40: As Enhanced Parry, except defensive value is tripled.
ATTACK AVOIDANCE.50: As Deflect I, Bladeturn I, and Spell Deflect I; except any 3 attacks can be deflected.

GAS MANIPULATION.1: Condenses 1 cubic foot of water from the surrounding air. Condensation can be channeled into any suitable receptacle, including caster’s cupped hands.
GAS MANIPULATION.2: Warms 1 cubic foot per level of air (any inanimate gas) up to 100°F (56°C) above ambient temperature.
GAS MANIPULATION.3: Creates very dense fog in a 10' radius; normal visibility is 1'.
GAS MANIPULATION.4: Creates a wall of dense churning air up to 10'x10'x3'. This wall requires 1 AP to cross, the pace of anyone moving through it at more than a Walk comes out with his pace reduced by one (e.g, a Run going in would be a Jog coming out), and attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty. See Section 10.20 for additional details on Wall spells.
GAS MANIPULATION.5: Stops all generalized air movement up to winds of 30 mph and cuts higher winds by 30 mph in a 10' radius.
GAS MANIPULATION.6: Creates a near vacuum with a five foot radius; all within this radius take an A Impact critical, as air leaves and rushes back in.
GAS MANIPULATION.7: Creates very dense fog in a 50' radius; normal visibility is 1'.
GAS MANIPULATION.8: Disperses fog within the area of effect. If not all of a fog is dispersed (i.e., the fog covers a greater area than the area of effect for this spell), the fog will refill the area of effect, reducing the cleared radius by 10' every 1-5 minutes (varying depending on the heaviness of the fog and ambient humidity).
GAS MANIPULATION.9: As Airwall, except wall is 10'x20'x3' and can be curved up to a semicircle.
GAS MANIPULATION.10: As Airwall, except has a set duration of 1 min/level and does not require concentration.
GAS MANIPULATION.11: Creates very dense fog in a 100' radius; normal visibility is 1'.
GAS MANIPULATION.12: As Air Stop I, except radius is 50'.
GAS MANIPULATION.13: As Unfog V, except radius is 100'.
GAS MANIPULATION.14: As Soft Vacuum I, except radius is 10'.
GAS MANIPULATION.15: All gas within 10' of caster is converted to breathable air.
GAS MANIPULATION.16: As Soft Vacuum I, except it does a C Impact critical.
GAS MANIPULATION.17: Creates a whirlwind about caster; it moves with the caster and has a 10'R. No missile attacks can penetrate it and any movement (except for caster’s) into the whirlwind costs 2 AP and slows movement to a Walk pace, melee or elemental attacks on the caster through the whirlwind suffer a -50 penalty to OB.
GAS MANIPULATION.18: As Soft Vacuum I, except radius is 20'.
GAS MANIPULATION.19: Controls the wind within the radius of effect, from completely still air to up to 1 mph/level of wind in a constant direction.
GAS MANIPULATION.20: Enriches a 50' radius of air with extra oxygen; within this radius all animal life receives a +20 bonus to their OBs and fire attacks deliver double the normal number of hits.
GAS MANIPULATION.25: As Thick Fog I, except duration is 1 hour/level and the radius is 100'/level.
GAS MANIPULATION.30: As Unfog V, except radius is 100'/level.
GAS MANIPULATION.35: As Soft Vacuum I, except radius is 30'.
GAS MANIPULATION.40: As Hard Vacuum I, except radius is 20'.
GAS MANIPULATION.50: Caster has complete control of clouds within area of effect (includes fog); storm clouds can be gathered and made to rain (or snow or hail in suitable conditions), but they cannot be created.

LIQUID MANIPULATION.1: The caster may increase the temperature of any inanimate body of liquid of up to 1 cubic foot per level by 50°F (28°C) per round of concentration. Once the liquid begins to boil, it will not continue to heat up, but will begin to cool naturally if the caster stops concentrating. Caster is immune to the heat thus generated.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.2: The caster may decrease the temperature of any inanimate body of liquid of up to 1 cubic foot per level by 50°F [28°C] per round of concentration. Once the liquid freezes, it will not continue to grow colder, but will begin to warm naturally if the caster stops concentrating. Caster is immune to the cold thus generated.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.3: Clears target liquid of all sediment.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.4: Gives nature and origin of natural liquid, and when and how a worked liquid was obtained and worked.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.5: Removes all dissolved substances from the target liquid.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.6: Creates a wall of water up to 10’x10’x1’. This wall requires 2 AP to cross, the pace of anyone moving through it at more than a Walk comes out with his pace reduced by two (e.g, a Sprint going in would be a Jog pace coming out) to a minimum of a Walk, and attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty. See Section 10.20 for additional details on Wall spells.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.7: As Boil Liquid, except all the liquid is evaporated (i.e., boiled away and turned into heated gas) at a rate of one cubic foot of liquid per round of concentration. Liquid and vapor are subject to natural cooling once caster ceases concentration.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.8: Creates a corridor through liquid up to 100’ long, 3’ wide, and 10’ deep (must be open at the top).
LIQUID MANIPULATION.9: A bolt of water is shot from a water source within 20’ of the caster; results are determined on the Water Bolt Table. Range modifier is based on the distance from the water source to the bolt’s target.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.10: As Waterwall, except wall is 10’x20’x1’ and can be curved up to a semicircle.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.11: All water within a 100’R is calmed; waves are cut by 20’ in the center and less towards the perimeter. This will negate the effects of currents in the area of effect.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.12: Transforms up to one cubic foot of acid per level to plain water.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.13: As Waterwall, but has a set duration of 1 minute/level and does not require concentration.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.14: Caster can be exposed to liquid, even complete submersion, and come out completely dry, protecting his person and (probably more importantly) his possessions. While this does not prevent drowning, any penalties for heavy clothing should be significantly reduced, as they will not become water- logged and thus retain air and a certain degree of bouyancy.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.15: As Liquid Corridor I, except limit is 300’x4’x50’ deep.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.16: A bolt of water is shot from a water source within 20’ of the caster; results are determined on the Water Bolt Table. Range modifier is based on the distance from the water source to the bolt’s target.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.17: Creates a whirlpool with a 20 foot radius in any liquid body that will draw in any objects in the liquid up to 200’ away. Objects capable of moving under their own power may make a Very Hard maneuver to resist the pull of the whirlpool.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.18: Creates a wave moving away from the caster; wave is 1’ high/level in the center and 10’/level wide.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.19: Creates a bubble of air (10’R) around the caster and others, which will carry them in up to 100’ depth of water (air is replenished). Caster can direct the motion of the bubble at a rate of 30’/round (may be adjusted by the presence of (un) favorable water currents). If/when the caster stops concentrating, the bubble will rise to the surface at the same rate (30’/round). If the caster resumes concentrating before the bubble surfaces, the bubble may be controlled again. All objects inside the bubble will rise with it. After reaching the surface, the bubble will burst.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.20: As Calm Water, except radius is 100’/ lvl and waves are cut by 50’ in the center and caster need not concentrate.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.25: As Liquid Corridor, except limit is 100’/lvl x 6’x100’ deep.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.30: As Water Bubble, except radius is 20’ and there is no depth limit.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.35: Caster creates a waterspout over a body of water (minimally 1’ water depth), causing it to arise anywhere within range.
