The waterspout moves as the caster wills within the range of the spell (only a 10’ radius may be effectively attacked each round, and a Spell Mastery roll may be required to attack an actively evasive target). Anything caught within the waterspout is subjected to a battering vortex of water (use the Water Bolt table with a +50 OB, but treat the attack size as Large). Waterspout takes one round to form.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.40: The area of effect for this spell is the water immediately surrounding the boat that the caster is on (where “boat” should be interpreted loosely; a log is a “boat” for purposes of this spell if the caster is riding it on water). For the duration of this spell, the speed of the boat will be modified by 25’ per round (approximately 3 miles per hour) in a given direction (which may be “upstream” or “downstream” if following a river). One round of concentration will allow the caster to change the direction of this magical current.
LIQUID MANIPULATION.50: Caster can use one of the lower spells on this list each round, but with lesser ranges extended to 100’.

MIND'S DOOR.1: Opens a door. Any bars/bolts that the caster can see will be displaced to allow opening, while locks (magical or mundane) have but a 10% chance of being unlocked. See Section 10.14 for guidelines on handling locks.
MIND'S DOOR.2: Caster “teleports” a single inanimate object to a point up to 100' away from its current location. There can be no intervening barriers in a direct line between the target and the point (for these purposes, a barrier is anything the object could not physically go through). The object has a maximum weight limit of 1 pound per level of the caster.
MIND'S DOOR.3: Caster “teleports” to a point up to 50' away, but there can be no intervening barriers in a direct line between the target and the point (for these purposes a barrier is anything the caster could not physically go through; a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).
MIND'S DOOR.4: As Leave Item I, except the object can pass through barriers by specifying exact direction and distance. If the arrival point coincides with solid material, the object does not move (though the caster still loses the PP).
MIND'S DOOR.5: As Minor Leaving , except caster can move 100'.
MIND'S DOOR.6: [RR Mod.: -50] Caster may mentally speak with any one thinking being. Caster must be able to see the target or the caster must know the exact location of the target. In all cases, the target must also be within range.
MIND'S DOOR.7: As Long Door Item I, except object can be moved up to 200'.
MIND'S DOOR.8: As Leaving I, except caster can move 300'.
MIND'S DOOR.9: As Leave Item I, except object can be moved up to 500'.
MIND'S DOOR.10: As Minor Leaving, except caster can pass through barriers by specifying exact direction and distance. If the arrival point coincides with solid material, the caster does not move, instead being stunned (-50) 1-10 rounds, and the PP for this spell are still expended.
MIND'S DOOR.11: As Leaving I, except caster can move 500'.
MIND'S DOOR.12: As Minor Long Door, except caster can move 100'.
MIND'S DOOR.13: As Long Door Item I, except object can be moved up to 500'.
MIND'S DOOR.14: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mind Tongue I, except range is 1,000'.
MIND'S DOOR.15: As Leaving I, except caster can move 100'/level up to 2000'.
MIND'S DOOR.16: As Long Door I, except caster can move 300'.
MIND'S DOOR.17: As Long Door Item I, except object may weigh up to 10 pounds/level and may be moved up to 300'.
MIND'S DOOR.18: As Long Door I, except caster can move 500'.
MIND'S DOOR.19: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mind Tongue I, except range is 1 mile.
MIND'S DOOR.20: If caster has established mental contact with a target (an intelligent being) that will cooperate, the caster can teleport to the target’s location or the target can teleport to the caster’s location. There is no chance of error and the movement limit is 1 mile.
MIND'S DOOR.25: As Leaving I, except movement is limited only by the barrier restriction (on a flat plain this would be the horizon).
MIND'S DOOR.30: As Mind’s Door I, except limit is 10 miles/level.
MIND'S DOOR.35: As Long Door I, except caster can move 2000'.
MIND'S DOOR.40: As Mind’s Door I, except that there is no distance limit and instead of being able to change their own locations, the caster may hand an item up to 1 pound/ level to the target, or the target may hand such an item to the caster.
MIND'S DOOR.50: As Mind’s Door I, except that there is no distance limit.

MIND MASTERY.1: Caster may cast this spell with another spell in order to store that second spell. The spell to be stored must be cast within one minute after the Spell Store spell is cast. The stored spell may then be cast later as an instantaneous spell. The Spell Store spell costs the same number of PP as the spell that is stored. No other spell may be cast while a spell is stored.
MIND MASTERY.2: Caster is aware of the presence of all sentient/ thinking beings within 20'.
MIND MASTERY.3: Caster gets +5 bonus to RRs versus mind attacks.
MIND MASTERY.4: Caster’s next sleep period will require 25% less time to complete, with the caster awaking as fully refreshed as if the complete normal time had been spent (e.g., if the caster normally required eight hours of sleep in a night, this spell would allow the caster to sleep only six hours instead).
MIND MASTERY.5: Caster’s recall of relevant past experience and education are enhanced to assist in the current situation; this increases the caster’s Memory stat bonus by +25 for the duration of one maneuver involving Memory (e.g., the use of a “lore” skill).
MIND MASTERY.6: For the purposes of mental or magical detections, caster appears to be of any race with which the caster is familiar.
MIND MASTERY.7: Caster gains insight or facts by observing a person or thing with intense concentration (e.g., room, item); increases caster’s Perception skill bonus by +50 for one “observation”.
MIND MASTERY.8: Caster gets +10 bonus to RRs versus mind attacks.
MIND MASTERY.9: As Misfeel Kind, except caster’s profession may be misrepresented.
MIND MASTERY.10: Caster is able to correlate known facts to obtain conclusions; increases the caster’s Reasoning stat bonus by +25 for the duration of one maneuver involving Reasoning (e.g., the use of a “lore” skill, picking a lock, one “navigation” attempt, etc.).
MIND MASTERY.11: As Misfeel Kind, except caster’s level may be misrepresented (to an upper limit of twice the caster’s actual level).
MIND MASTERY.12: This spell enables the caster to have unusually intense focus and self-control for one situation or maneuver; increasing the caster’s Self Discipline stat bonus by +25 for the duration of one maneuver involving Self Discipline (e.g., stalking a foe, a Perception maneuver, one “silent kill” attempt, etc.).
MIND MASTERY.13: Caster gets +15 bonus to RRs versus mind attacks.
MIND MASTERY.14: This spell assigns a compartmentalized portion of the caster’s mind to maintain a spell with a duration of “C”. Effectively, it allows that part of the caster’s mind to concentrate on the spell, freeing the rest of the caster’s mind to do other things (i.e., the caster does not take the normal penalty for Concentration). The caster can have only one Pseudoconcentration active at one time.
MIND MASTERY.15: Target becomes undetectable by Presence spells or related abilities.
MIND MASTERY.16: Caster gets +25 bonus to RRs versus mind attacks.
MIND MASTERY.17: As Recall, except recall is nearly automatic and in effect gives the caster an eidetic memory; Memory bonus is +50.
MIND MASTERY.18: Allows caster to use all of the Misfeel spells at once.
MIND MASTERY.19: Caster gets +50 bonus to RRs versus mind attacks.
MIND MASTERY.20: As Observation, except virtually every detail in even a large situation is noticed; Perception bonus is +100.
MIND MASTERY.25: As Correlation, except obtaining conclusions is nearly automatic; the Reasoning bonus is +50.
MIND MASTERY.30: As Resolve, except focus/control is nearly total; the Self Discipline bonus is +50.
MIND MASTERY.35: As Inner Wall True, except protects not only the caster, but anyone with whom the caster is in telepathic contact.
MIND MASTERY.40: As Misfeel, except it has a ten minute/level duration and does not require concentration.
MIND MASTERY.50: Caster reflects all mind attacks back on the attacker who must then make an RR against his own spell.

MOVEMENT.1: Allows caster to make one leap up to 50' laterally or 20' vertically (as a separate 1 AP action, with no Pace penalty for the leaping movement) in the round that the spell was cast.
MOVEMENT.2: This spell may be cast when the caster begins to fall, taking effect immediately, allowing the caster to land safely in a fall up to 20' per level of the caster and to take that distance off the severity of any longer fall.
MOVEMENT.3: Allows caster to move up and down vertically 10' per round. This spell does not confer any ability to control horizontal movement, which must be accomplished by other means.
MOVEMENT.4: Caster becomes nearly weightless (lighter than air), but has no magical movement control; weight gradually returns at the end of the duration.
MOVEMENT.5: Caster can take action underwater as if on land.
MOVEMENT.6: Caster can fly at a rate of 8'/round (approximately 1 mph). ). This spell allows free movement in all three dimensions and allows hovering.
MOVEMENT.7: As Levitation I, except rate is 50'/round.
MOVEMENT.8: Caster can safely dive through the air up to 50' per level so long as there is deep enough water present at the end of the dive (at least 1' of water per 25' of dive).
MOVEMENT.9: As both Leaping and Landing, once each round.
MOVEMENT.10: Caster can merge into any solid, inanimate material. While merged, caster cannot move, perceive, or cast spells. When the caster emerges from the material, it is possible to emerge from any side or face of the material, although this is limited to moving “through” no more than the caster’s own body size plus two feet worth of material. The caster can exit at any time up to the end of spell duration (at which time the caster automatically emerges at the entrance point).
MOVEMENT.11: As Slow Fly, except rate is 35'/round (approximately 5 mph).
MOVEMENT.12: As Landing, except caster can land safely from any fall 99% of the time, and still takes the normal 20'/level off any fall for the 1% of the time that safety is not complete.
MOVEMENT.13: As Levitation I, except rate is 200'/ round.
MOVEMENT.14: Caster may pass through any inanimate material up to 1 foot/level. It takes 1 round to pass through 2 feet of material.
MOVEMENT.15: As Fly I, except rate is 75'/round (approximately 10 mph).
MOVEMENT.16: As Fly I, except duration is 10 minutes/level.
MOVEMENT.17: As Merging, except caster can turn within the material and can perceive the outside world if within 6" of the surface.
MOVEMENT.18: As Levitation I, except rate is 100'/ round and caster may remain levitated for an entire day.
MOVEMENT.19: When the caster casts another spell from this list (within one minute of completing this spell), the caster will be able to move three times the normal weight with that spell.
MOVEMENT.20: As Great Merge, except caster can cast spells on himself while merged.
MOVEMENT.25: As Fly I, except rate is 150'/round (approximately 20 mph).
MOVEMENT.30: As Passing, except caster can pass through as much material as the duration allows at a rate of 10'/rnd.
MOVEMENT.35: As Fly I, except rate is 225'/round (approximately 30 mph).
MOVEMENT.40: As Fly True, except duration is 10 minutes/level.
MOVEMENT.50: Caster may cast any of the spells up to 30th level on this list each round.

SENSE MASTERY.1: Caster gains an extremely acute sense of hearing. This results in +50 to Perception rolls involving only hearing, +25 to Perception involving hearing and other senses.
SENSE MASTERY.2: Caster can see up to 100' as if it were daylight, so long as there is some light.
SENSE MASTERY.3: Caster has a 300° field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the caster is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus is lowered to +15.
SENSE MASTERY.4: Caster can check one object or place (up to a 5'R) and tell if it is an illusion or has an illusion on it.
SENSE MASTERY.5: Caster can see 100' in any water (including murky water) as if through air in daylight.
SENSE MASTERY.6: Caster gains an extremely acute sense of smell (e.g., +50 to Perception involving only smell, +25 to Perception involving smell and other senses).
SENSE MASTERY.7: As Nightvision, plus caster sees 100' in any precipitation (including thick fog) as if the air were clear.
SENSE MASTERY.8: Caster gains extreme tactile sensitivity. This provides a bonus to any action requiring a sense of touch. For example, caster might receive +25 to picking locks, disarming traps, opening secret doors, etc. and +50 to Perception involving only touch, +25 to Perception involving touch and other senses).
SENSE MASTERY.9: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. No light at all is needed for this spell to work.
SENSE MASTERY.10: Caster can pick a point up to 100'/ level away and hear as if at that point (there can be intervening objects such as walls); the caster must have visited the point before or have the location in sight. Note that this means that the caster does not have hearing at his own location.
SENSE MASTERY.11: As Mentalist Ear, except caster can see instead of listening.
SENSE MASTERY.12: While this spell is in effect, one illusion within the caster’s range ceases to exist for the caster only. The caster must specify the illusion to be negated (unless caster knows something is an illusion, this spell would be gambling PP).
SENSE MASTERY.13: As Detect Illusion, except caster can concentrate on one object or place per round.
SENSE MASTERY.14: As all lower level Vision spells functioning at the same time.
SENSE MASTERY.15: As Nightvision, except range is the normal daylight vision range.
SENSE MASTERY.16: As Mentalist Ear, except caster can use all senses at the remote point.
SENSE MASTERY.17: As Disillusion, except all illusions within range cease to exist for the caster.
SENSE MASTERY.18: As Watervision, except range is the normal daylight vision range.
SENSE MASTERY.19: As Fogvision, except range is the normal daylight vision range.
SENSE MASTERY.20: As all lower level Vision spells functioning at the same time.
SENSE MASTERY.25: As Mentalist Ear, except range is 1 mile/level.
SENSE MASTERY.30: As Mentalist Eye, except range is 1 mile/level.
SENSE MASTERY.35: As Mentalist Senses, except range is 1 mile/level.
SENSE MASTERY.40: Caster can view objects within 2' at up to 40x magnification.
SENSE MASTERY.50: Caster can “merge” senses with those of a subject whose location is known by spells or by prior arrangement. Both caster and target will have a full awareness of both locations; the spell provides for this not being terribly confusing. If target is not at the specified location, the PP for this spell are wasted.

SHIFTING.1: Adds +50 to any rolls for any moving maneuvers performed at a walking pace or less (e.g., walking a 3” beam).
SHIFTING.2: Allows caster to disjoint limbs, contract muscles, etc.; in order to escape manacles and ropes and slip through small places (+50 to +100 to escape maneuvers).
SHIFTING.3: Alters the caster’s face to resemble someone else, but not so closely as to be confused on a close inspection.
SHIFTING.4: Allows caster to analyze the form of another being for future use with True Change. The caster can only have as many forms analyzed as he has ranks in this list. Caster may choose to forget a form at any time to make room for replacements.
SHIFTING.5: Caster can breathe water but not air.
SHIFTING.6: Alters the caster’s flesh and bones to a more elastic form, reducing by one the severity of all “Krush” and “Impact” criticals taken.
SHIFTING.7: Alters the caster’s entire body to the form of another humanoid race. The form cannot be that of a particular individual form. For example, a human caster could take the form of a Dwarf, but not the Dwarven High Chancellor. Only the physical form is gained (e.g., a target who becomes a Dwarf would not receive the Dwarves’ ability to see in the dark). This spell does not allow the caster to change his Size category, but size may be changed as desired within that limit. This does not change anything the caster carries or wears, only his own body, except that prosthetics added by the Lay Healer Base list Prosthetics will change with the caster.
SHIFTING.8: Caster can breathe any gas as normal air.
SHIFTING.9: Caster’s body is able to adapt to extremely high or low pressure or sudden changes in pressure, without suffering any harm. This does not apply to crushing by solids, only pressures from environmental gasses or liquids.
SHIFTING.10: As Face Shifting, except duration is 1 hour/level.
SHIFTING.11: Caster can breathe water, air, and any gas at will.
SHIFTING.12: Alters the caster’s Size by one category. This does not change anything the caster carries or wears, only his own body, except that prosthetics added by the Lay Healer Base list Prosthetics will change with the caster.
SHIFTING.13: As Changing to Kind, except alteration can be to any organic form within the caster’s own Size category; caster does not obtain any special abilities.
SHIFTING.14: As Waterlungs, except duration is one hour/level.
SHIFTING.15: Caster becomes as if made of very dense stone (cannot move or cast spells).
SHIFTING.16: Caster does not need to breathe at all.
SHIFTING.17: As Change, except altered form can be that of a specific being analyzed by Change Lore.
SHIFTING.18: As True Change, except caster may assume a different form anytime during the spell; each change of shape takes one round of concentration.
SHIFTING.19: As Waterlungs plus Depth Mastery, except duration is one hour/level.
SHIFTING.20: Caster takes the form of a liquid mass, able to seep through cracks as well as water. In this form, the caster can move through water at 10 mph, but is unable to cast spells.
SHIFTING.25: Caster takes the form of a mist, able to fly 20 mph (modified by ambient winds, of course), seep through cracks, extend self to become virtually invisible, etc. (may not cast spells in this form).
SHIFTING.30: As Waterform and Mistform, except the two forms are interchangeable at will (concentrate for 1 round to change).
SHIFTING.35: As Waterform, but caster can cast spells with a -10 penalty.
SHIFTING.40: As Mistform, but caster can cast spells with a -10 penalty.
SHIFTING.50: As Changing and Form Master, except all forms are interchangeable at will (concentrate for 1 round to change). The caster’s Size may be changed by one category.

SOLID MANIPULATION.1: Warms 1 cubic foot of stone per level up to 100°F (38°C) at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round of concentration (without concentration, the material will remain at its current temperature for the remainder of the duration).
SOLID MANIPULATION.2: As Warm Stone, except 6 cubic inches of metal/level can be warmed at a rate of 6 cubic inches per round of concentration.
SOLID MANIPULATION.3: As Warm Stone, except can affect any solid, inanimate, non-metal material.
SOLID MANIPULATION.4: As Warm Stone except temperature limit is 500°F (260°C) and it takes 1 round per 100°F (56°C). Caster need only touch the target when the spell is cast. The caster is immune to this heat. The caster must concentrate to increase the temperature (without concentration, the material will retain its current temperature for the duration of the spell).
SOLID MANIPULATION.5: As Heat Stone, except 6 cubic inches of metal/level can be heated.
SOLID MANIPULATION.6: As Heat Stone, except affects any solid, inanimate, non-metal material.
SOLID MANIPULATION.7: Any solid, inanimate, non-metal material can be cooled to -20°F (-29°C), at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round (cooling spreads evenly from initial point of cooling unless caster concentrates to direct spread).
SOLID MANIPULATION.8: As Cool Solid, except 6 cubic inches of metal/level can be cooled.
SOLID MANIPULATION.9: Any solid, inanimate, non-metal material can be cooled to -200°F (-129°C), at a rate of (1 cu' and -100°F[-56°C])/round. The caster must concentrate to decrease the temperature (without concentration, the material will retain its current temperature for the duration of the spell).
SOLID MANIPULATION.10: Any previous cracks or flaws in material up to a 10'x10'x10' section will extend to their limit.
SOLID MANIPULATION.11: As Heat Other Solid, except the only limit to the temperature is the melting point of the solid (i.e., until the solid melts) or sublimation point if the solid converts directly to a gas when heated. Will affect 6 cu"/level of metal or 1 cu'/level of any other material.
SOLID MANIPULATION.12: As Chill Solid, except affects metal to a limit of six cubic inches per level and a like rate of chilling.
SOLID MANIPULATION.13: As Cracks Call, except material with cracks will crumble to dust.
SOLID MANIPULATION.14: Will break a piece of wood up to one foot in diameter (6" radius).
SOLID MANIPULATION.16: As Stone Door, except doorway can be through metal.
SOLID MANIPULATION.17: As Bowbreak, except a piece of metal can be broken, up to 3" in diameter.
SOLID MANIPULATION.18: Causes a lock to break; it can be broken in a locked or unlocked state.
SOLID MANIPULATION.19: As Stone Door, except doorway can be in any inanimate, solid material and it can be 3'x6' with a depth of 1'/level for stone and 3"/level for all other materials.
SOLID MANIPULATION.20: Caster’s hands can mold up to one cubic foot of stone as if it were putty or clay. Stone hardens to normal consistency when the caster is finished. Quality of results depends on caster’s skill and time invested.
SOLID MANIPULATION.25: As Mold Stone, except caster may mold metal.
SOLID MANIPULATION.30: As Mold Stone, except caster may mold any inanimate, solid material.
SOLID MANIPULATION.35: Caster can repair any flaws in a piece of stone, whether cracks, blemishes, or other imperfections, including the flaws that reduce the value of precious stones. The stone affected cannot be larger than one cubic foot per level.
SOLID MANIPULATION.40: As Mold Solid, but working on a larger scale, suitable for monuments, architectural components, etc.
SOLID MANIPULATION.50: Transmutes up to 1 ounce of any solid material into another non-magical solid material that the caster has a sample of. This transmutation requires eight hours of uninterrupted work.

SPEED.1: Caster can change stance instantaneously at any time during the spell duration. Stance is standing, sitting, crouching, prone, etc.
SPEED.2: Caster mounts or dismounts a riding beast “instantly” (i.e., the action is considered part of this instantaneous spell action for 0 or 1 AP).
SPEED.3: Caster makes a Perception maneuver at no penalty to assess the current situation instantly (i.e., the Perception maneuver is considered part of this instantaneous spell action for 0 or 1 AP).
SPEED.4: Caster gains a +5 bonus to initiative rolls.
SPEED.5: Caster gains an additional 1 AP to use each round this spell is in effect (i.e., caster gets 5 AP to use during the round), and he may maintain the spell so long as he wishes. However, caster incurs a -2 fatigue penalty at the end of each round (adding to any existing penalty including from previous rounds). It is not possible to rest while this spell remains in effect.
SPEED.6: Caster has a 10% increase in his base movement rate (BMR), rounding up to the nearest foot/ round. For a BMR of 20'/round, this results in a 2'/round increase.
SPEED.7: Caster gains an additional 1 AP to use each round this spell is in effect (i.e., caster gets 5 AP to use during the round).
SPEED.8: Caster gains a +10 bonus to initiative rolls.
SPEED.9: When he would otherwise be surprised, the caster’s subconscious casts this spell and this negates surprise effects.
SPEED.10: Caster gains a +15 bonus to initiative rolls.
SPEED.11: As Rush I, except caster gains an additional 2 AP.
SPEED.12: As Long Stride I, except increase is 30%.
SPEED.13: Caster gains a +20 bonus to initiative rolls.
SPEED.14: Caster’s mind works at incredible speed, allowing time to carefully consider the situation as if the world paused while he makes up his mind. No physical action may be taken in this moment, nor may any spells be cast, but much mental activity may be done. In addition to being able to take time to consider when otherwise faced with a need for an instant decision, the character’s Lore and Science skills (and the knowledge aspects of other skills) may be used to make maneuvers (although no skill may be consulted more than three times). If the caster is in mental contact with someone, he may send a message of any length, though the recipient will need the normal time to process it. Anything mental sensed may be examined as carefully as might be done in a full round.
SPEED.15: As Haste I, except caster gains an additional 2 AP.
SPEED.16: While this spell is active, the caster casts all spells as instantaneous spells.
SPEED.17: As Rush I, except caster gains an additional 3 AP.
SPEED.18: Caster’s Quickness bonus is increased by +5.
SPEED.19: Allows caster to complete an entire sleep cycle in one hour (allows quick PP and hit recovery).
SPEED.20: As Long Stride I, except increase is 50%.
SPEED.25: As Haste I, except caster gains an additional 3 AP.
SPEED.30: As Rush I, except caster gains an additional 4 AP.
SPEED.35: As Rush I, except caster gains an additional 5 AP.
SPEED.40: Caster’s Quickness bonus is increased by +15.
SPEED.50: As Haste I, except caster gains an additional 4 AP.

BLOOD MASTERY.1: Reduces target’s blood loss by up to 3 hits per round. Until the injury is actually treated by some means (e.g., Medicine maneuver or a Flesh Relief spell), the target cannot move or be moved without the bleeding resuming. Multiple Flowstop spells may not be cast upon the same wound.
BLOOD MASTERY.2: Instantly stops bleeding from a wound that bleeds at a rate of 1 hit/round.
BLOOD MASTERY.3: One poison or disease afflicting the target is reduced by one level of severity (e.g. from Extreme to Severe, or from Mild to cured), and, in the case of disease, anyone subsequently infected by the target gains a bonus of +20 on their RR. This spell may not be used multiple times on the same target to treat the same disease.
BLOOD MASTERY.4: Stops bleeding on a wound bleeding up to 3 hits/round. For one hour, the target can engage in activity no more vigorous than walking or bleeding will resume.
BLOOD MASTERY.5: Instantly stops bleeding on a wound that bleeds at a rate up to 3 hits/round.
BLOOD MASTERY.6: A flesh wound or skin/tissue injury or any severity is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, and the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll. Note that this treats wounds that incur injury penalties, but does not treat bleeding.
BLOOD MASTERY.7: Target receives an additional RR vs either poison or disease, as specified by the caster at the time of casting.
BLOOD MASTERY.8: A flesh wound or skin/tissue injury that incurs a penalty up to -40 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll, and the recovery period is reduced to hours rather than days.
BLOOD MASTERY.9: Caster may reattach one severed limb. The Joining spells from the Bone, Muscle, and Nerve and Organ Mastery spell lists must be cast for the limb to be functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
BLOOD MASTERY.10: As Flowstop III, except the caster may stop all blood loss in the target.
BLOOD MASTERY.11: Target is kept in a state of suspended animation and prevented from dying for the duration of the spell (i.e., the body is “preserved” and the “soul” will not leave the body). Also requires the use of the other Suspend Life I spell (on the Nerve and Organ list).
BLOOD MASTERY.12: As Clotting III, except a wound bleeding at any rate.
BLOOD MASTERY.13: Instantly stops bleeding on a wound that bleeds at a rate up to 5 hits/round.
BLOOD MASTERY.14: Removes any one disease from the target.
BLOOD MASTERY.15: Instantly stops bleeding on a wound that bleeds at any rate.
BLOOD MASTERY.16: As Medium Flesh Healing, except a wound incurring any penalty.
BLOOD MASTERY.17: As Suspend Life I, except for duration and the requirement of Suspend Life II from Nerve & Organ Mastery.
BLOOD MASTERY.18: Removes any one poison from the target.
BLOOD MASTERY.19: As Clotting III, except stops total bleeding of up to 1 hit/round per level of the caster in any number of targets within range.
BLOOD MASTERY.20: As Joining, except recovery is instantaneous.
BLOOD MASTERY.25: Caster can instantly stop bleeding from multiple wounds (in a single target) up to a total hits/round of bleeding equal to his level.
BLOOD MASTERY.30: A flesh wound or skin/tissue injury that incurs a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll, and the recovery period is reduced to rounds rather than days.
BLOOD MASTERY.35: As Light Flesh Healing True, except an injury incurring a penalty up to 40.
BLOOD MASTERY.40: As Light Flesh Healing True, except an injury with any penalty.
BLOOD MASTERY.50: Caster can regrow 1 severed limb; it requires the use of the Regrow Limb spells from Bone, Muscle, and Nerve and Organ Mastery for the limb to become fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.

BONE MASTERY.1: An injury to cartilage incurring a penalty up to -40 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, and the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll.
BONE MASTERY.2: Target’s bones become flexible, granting +50 to escape maneuvers.
BONE MASTERY.3: As Medium Cartilage Relief, except an injury to bones incurring a penalty up to -40.
BONE MASTERY.4: As Medium Cartilage Relief, except an injury incurring any penalty.
BONE MASTERY.5: Allows caster to prevent deterioration of one limb (even while severed); requires use of the Muscle Mastery Limb Preservation spell as well.
BONE MASTERY.6: An injury to cartilage incurring a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll and the recovery period is reduced to hours rather than days.
BONE MASTERY.7: As Medium Cartilage Relief, except a bone injury incurring any penalty.
BONE MASTERY.8: Target’s bones are strengthened, and the injury penalty incurred by any bone injury sustained within the duration is halved. Injuries suffered before the spell was cast are not affected.
BONE MASTERY.9: Caster may reattach one severed limb. The Joining spells from the Blood, Muscle, and Nerve and Organ Mastery spell lists must be cast for the limb to be functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
BONE MASTERY.10: As Light Cartilage Healing, except an injury incurring a penalty up to -40.
BONE MASTERY.11: As Medium Cartilage Healing, except for a bone injury.
BONE MASTERY.12: A bone injury is temporarily braced and immobilized such that the injury penalty from that injury is halved for the duration.
BONE MASTERY.13: As Light Cartilage Healing, except an injury incurring any penalty.
BONE MASTERY.14: As Severe Cartilage Healing, except for a bone injury.
BONE MASTERY.15: As Strong Bones I, except the duration is 10 minutes per level.
BONE MASTERY.16: Target regenerates any one bone. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
BONE MASTERY.17: As Medium Bone Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
BONE MASTERY.18: As Severe Cartilage Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
BONE MASTERY.19: Target’s bones are greatly strengthened, granting a physical RR to prevent any new bone injuries.
BONE MASTERY.20: As Joining, except recovery is instantaneous.
BONE MASTERY.25: As Severe Bone Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
BONE MASTERY.30: Target’s bones become unbreakable, and any new bone injury which would incur an injury penalty is prevented.
BONE MASTERY.35: As Severe Bone Healing, except for both cartilage and bone injuries, up to a number of injuries equal to the caster’s level (on one target).
BONE MASTERY.40: Target regenerates all of the lost bone and/or cartilage in his body; recovery time is 2-20 days.
BONE MASTERY.50: Caster can regrow 1 severed limb; it requires the use of the Regrow Limb spells from Blood, Muscle, and Nerve and Organ Mastery for the limb to become fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.

CONCUSSION MASTERY.1: Removes up to -30 in penalties from fatigue.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.3: Target is relieved of 1 round’s worth of accumulated stun effects.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.4: Reduces target’s concussion hit damage by 2 hits every round as long as caster concentrates; if caster is unconscious, this spell will operate on the caster without concentration.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.6: An injury from burns, chemical burns, scalding, or frostbite incurring a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll and the recovery period is reduced to hours rather than days.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.8: Target is relieved of 3 rounds’ worth of accumulated stun effects.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.9: As Light Burn/ Frostbite Healing, except an injury incurring a penalty up to -40.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.10: As Regeneration I, except 4 hits per round.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.12: As Light Burn/ Frostbite Healing, except an injury incurring any penalty.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.13: Target is relieved of 5 rounds’ worth of accumulated stun effects.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.14: As Stun Relief I, except the range is 200'.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.15: As Regeneration I, except 6 hits per round.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.16: As Light Burn/ Frostbite Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.18: As Light Burn/Frostbite Healing True, except an injury incurring a penalty up to -40.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.19: Target is relieved of 10 rounds’ worth of accumulated stun effects.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.20: As Light Burn/Frostbite Healing True, except an injury incurring any penalty.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.25: Target is healed of all concussion hit damage.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.30: As Severe Burn/ Frostbite Healing, except all such injuries on the target.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.35: As Severe Burn/Frostbite Healing True, except all such injuries on the target.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.40: Target is relieved of all accumulated stun effects.
CONCUSSION MASTERY.50: Caster can use one of the lower level spells on this list each round.

MUSCLE MASTERY.1: Target receives a +10 bonus to all Jumping and Climbing maneuvers.
MUSCLE MASTERY.2: An injury to muscle or tendons incurring a penalty up to -40 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, and the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll.
MUSCLE MASTERY.3: As Medium Muscle Relief, except injuries incurring any penalty.
MUSCLE MASTERY.4: Target gains a +5 Strength bonus, granting +5 to most skills involving strength (+10 melee OB).
MUSCLE MASTERY.5: Allows caster to prevent deterioration of one limb (even while severed); requires use of the Bone Mastery Limb Preservation spell as well.
MUSCLE MASTERY.6: Target is not fatigued by moving on the ground or in water at a walk or run pace.
MUSCLE MASTERY.7: An injury to muscle or tendons incurring a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll and the recovery period is reduced to hours rather than days.
MUSCLE MASTERY.8: Target drops anything currently held and takes a -20 to any maneuver attempted this round.
MUSCLE MASTERY.9: Caster may reattach one severed limb. The Joining spells from the Bone, Blood, and Nerve and Organ Mastery spell lists must be cast for the limb to be functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
MUSCLE MASTERY.10: As Light Muscle Healing, except an injury incurring a penalty up to -40.
MUSCLE MASTERY.11: A random limb is in intense pain and the joint locks, rendering the limb unusable. A moving target afflicted with a leg lock will fall down; a target with an arm lock will drop anything in that hand.
MUSCLE MASTERY.12: As Light Muscle Healing, except an injury incurring any penalty.
MUSCLE MASTERY.13: As Strength I, except the bonus is +10 (resulting in +20 for melee OB).
MUSCLE MASTERY.14: As Light Muscle Healing, except the recovery period is reduced to rounds.
MUSCLE MASTERY.15: Target will not accumulate any additional fatigue penalties for the duration.
MUSCLE MASTERY.16: As Light Muscle Healing True, except injuries incurring penalties up to -40.
MUSCLE MASTERY.17: Target regenerates any one tendon or muscle (other than the heart). The recovery time is 1-10 hours.
MUSCLE MASTERY.18: As Strength I, except the bonus is +15 (resulting in +30 for melee OB).
MUSCLE MASTERY.19: As Light Muscle Healing True, except an injury incurring any penalty.
MUSCLE MASTERY.20: As Joining, except recovery is instantaneous.
MUSCLE MASTERY.25: As Strength I, except the bonus is +20 (resulting in +40 for melee OB).
MUSCLE MASTERY.30: As Severe Muscle Healing, except all of the muscle and tendon injuries sustained by the target.
MUSCLE MASTERY.35: Target regenerates all tendons and muscles (other than the heart). The recovery time is 1-10 hours.
MUSCLE MASTERY.40: All injuries to muscle or tendons are cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll and the recovery period is reduced to rounds rather than days.
MUSCLE MASTERY.50: Caster can regrow 1 severed limb; it requires the use of the Regrow Limb spells from Bone, Blood, and Nerve and Organ Mastery for the limb to become fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.

NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.1: Diagnoses target’s wounds, injuries, and diseases allowing a +20 bonus to all Medicine maneuvers made by the caster to treat the target’s diagnosed condition(s). Caster can take a round to advise someone else on treating the target, providing a +10 bonus to treat the target.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.2: An injury to an organ (e.g. eye, ear, liver but not the brain or nerves) incurring a penalty up to 20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, and the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.3: As Light Organ Relief, but an injury incurring a penalty up to -40. This can be used to cure most causes of infertility (if the requisite organs are still present).
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.4: Prevents deteriorization of any specific organ, even if it is outside of its body.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.5: Target’s heart will start beating after having stopped. This does not repair any heart disease or damage that caused the initial stoppage.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.6: One of target’s natural senses (e.g. vision, hearing, touch) is honed and perfected for the duration. Perception maneuvers based exclusively on that sense gain a +20 bonus, while Perception that involves that sense and others gain a +10 bonus.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.7: As Light Organ Relief, but an injury incurring any penalty.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.8: Target comes out of a coma or unconsciousness caused by injury, disease, poison, spell, or spell failure. Process takes 1-10 hours and target is at -50 to Endurance rolls for 1-10 days.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.9: Caster may reattach one severed limb. The Joining spells from the Bone, Blood, and Muscle Mastery spell lists must be cast for the limb to be functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.10: Target experiences all sense impressions as distorted and confused. Target is at -25 for most actions, suffers double penalties if attempting to move faster than a walk, and has a -40 to Perception rolls.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.11: Target is kept in a state of suspended animation and prevented from dying for the duration of the spell (i.e., the body is “preserved” and the “soul” will not leave the body). Also requires the use of the other Suspend Life I spell (on the Blood Mastery list).
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.12: An injury to an organ, brain, or nerves incurring a penalty up to -40 is treated as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives +50 bonus on their recovery roll, and recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.13: Allows caster to transplant a healthy organ (not including brain or nervous system) into the target. Requires a one-hour operation. Recovery time is 1-10 days. Chance of rejection is 1% if organ comes from a relative of the target, 10% if it comes from a member of the same species, 30% if it comes from a similar species (e.g., one humanoid to another), and 60% if it comes from a vaguely similar species (e.g., ape to humanoid).
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.14: As Severe Organ Relief, except the recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.15: Target’s senses are impaired. All Perception maneuvers are at -40 and target cannot sense anything further than 20' away.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.16: Caster can cure any paralysis problem. The recovery time is 1-10 days. Treat as a -100 injury for progress of recovery.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.17: As Suspend Life I, except for duration and the requirement of Suspend Life II from Blood Mastery.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.18: As Organ Transplant, except recovery time is only 1-10 hours.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.19: An injury to the brain or nerves incurring any penalty is treated as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll, and the recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.20: As Joining, except recovery is instantaneous.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.25: Target will regenerate any one organ (external or internal) or the brain or nerves. The recovery time is 1-10 hours for most organs or 1-10 days for the brain, during which the target is unconscious. This spell will restore memories and knowledge which might otherwise have been lost due to brain damage.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.30: As Severe Nerve Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.35: As Organ Transplant, except a brain may be transplanted and the chance of rejection becomes a chance of the brain going insane because it cannot adapt to its new body.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.40: Caster can regrow one severed limb; it requires the use of the Regrow Limb spells for Bone, Blood, and Muscle Mastery for the limb to become fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
NERVE AND ORGAN MASTERY.50: As Nerve/Organ Regeneration, except the recovery time for brain regeneration is 1-10 hours.

PROSTHETICS.1: Caster learns the proper dimension needed to make a false limb or other prosthetic for the target.
PROSTHETICS.2: Allows the caster to create a perfectly formed artificial limb (or other body part) out of non-magical wood. This takes 8 hours. Suitability for use is guaranteed by this spell. Any special features or enhanced appearance depends on the appropriate Crafting skill(s) of the caster. Requires that Measurements has been cast to determine necessary form of the prosthetic.
PROSTHETICS.3: Allows caster to attach an artifical wooden limb or other prosthetic to a body. Process takes 1 hour. This spell must be cast before an Animation spell can be cast.
PROSTHETICS.4: Allows target to operate any artificial limbs (and other prosthetics) at will for 8 hours.
PROSTHETICS.5: As Fashion Wood, except the material worked is non-magical glass, and it requires two castings (16 hours of work) to finish the prosthetic.
PROSTHETICS.6: As Fit Wood; except allows caster to attach a glass prosthetic.
PROSTHETICS.7: Allows target to operate any artificial limbs (and other prosthetics) at will for 24 hours.
PROSTHETICS.8: As Fashion Wood, except the material worked is metal, and it requires three castings (24 hours of work) to finish the prosthetic.
PROSTHETICS.9: As Fit Wood; allows caster to attach a metal prosthetic.
PROSTHETICS.10: This spell enables the caster to convert clay into artificial flesh which can be used to cover an artificial limb (which must be done at the time of casting). The flesh is only semi-realistic (similar to plastic). Time required to cover a full limb is 4 hours if the limb is for a Small recipient, 8 hours for a Medium limb, and 16 hours for a Big limb. If the prosthetic is not a full limb (e.g., a hand or foot), the GM should decrease the time.
PROSTHETICS.11: Allows target to operate any artificial limbs (and other prosthetics) at will for 1 week.
PROSTHETICS.12: As Fashion Wood, except the material worked may be of any type, including magical materials, and it requires four castings (32 hours of work) to finish the prosthetic.
PROSTHETICS.13: As Fit Wood; allows caster to attach a “special” (of enchanted or exotic material) prosthetic.
PROSTHETICS.14: Allows incorporation of simple mechanisms into a prosthetic (e.g., a small retractable knife blade hidden in a finger), which can then be operated by the will of the wearer when an Animation spell is active on the prosthetic. The mechanism must be constructed normally.
PROSTHETICS.15: Allows target to operate any artificial limbs (and other prosthetics) at will for 1 month.
PROSTHETICS.16: Repairs all damage to a single prosthetic.
PROSTHETICS.17: Allows an artificial organ (created with one of the Mold spells on this list and/or through normal crafting) to be incorporated into a living target. Typically, this will be a glass eye that can provide sight when an Animation spell is cast on it, but theoretically any organ could be replaced with a suitable artificial organ. If an internal organ is replaced, surgery will be required for the insertion of the artificial organ.
PROSTHETICS.18: As Mechanical Contrivance, except that a complex mechanism (e.g., a dart gun) can be included in a prosthetic.
PROSTHETICS.19: Allows target to operate any artificial limbs (and other prosthetics) at will for 3 months.
PROSTHETICS.20: As Artificial Flesh, except perfectly realistic synthetic flesh can be made and worked. The process will require days instead of hours, with the same numbers as in Artificial Flesh.
PROSTHETICS.25: Allows target to operate any artificial limbs (and other prosthetics) at will for 1 year.
PROSTHETICS.30: Allows target to operate any artificial limbs (and other prosthetics) at will for 1 decade.
PROSTHETICS.35: Caster can emplace one spell of any level into a prosthetic. Within one minute of casting this spell, the spell to be emplaced must also be cast (within 10'). Once the spell is implanted, it will remain waiting in the prosthetic until used. When the prosthetic is attached and an Animation spell is in effect, the prosthetic wearer may trigger the spell at any time (treat as an innate power).
PROSTHETICS.40: This spell allows the caster to attach an artificial part that is not a replacement. The recipient of the part could be given wings (two spells and two prosthetics required to actually fly), an extra arm, or the like. An Animation spell is required for the added part to actually function.
PROSTHETICS.50: Allows target to operate any artificial limbs (and other prosthetics) at will permanently.

ASSASSINATION MASTERY.1: Target object (no larger than a dagger) is camouflaged to appear as part of the caster’s clothing or skin. This is an illusion to all senses (including feel), and can be detected as an illusion. The object will remain concealed until taken from the location, or the duration expires.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.2: [RR Mod: -50] When this spell is cast on a person, it remains active for 24 hours. After 24 hours has passed (but before another 24 hours has passed), the caster must cast this spell again on the same person. During the time the spell is active, it is recording information concerning the activities of the target. When the spell is cast the second time, the information about those activities is revealed to the caster. This information is used for spells later on this list and spells on other lists (see the Misdirections and Disguise Mastery lists). The caster can only have one “patsy” studied at a time.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.3: The next attack made by the caster (within one minute of casting this spell) receives a bonus of +25.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.4: If the caster’s next attack (made within one minute of casting this spell), gets a “flank” or “rear” bonus, he may use his Ambush skill even if the target is aware of the caster. However, the maximum change to the critical roll from Ambush is ±2.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.5: The caster is able to make use of whatever weapons are available, including non-standard weapons such as a candlestick. Whatever penalties are applied due to the use of “similar skill”, limitations of the item when employed as a weapon, or unsuitability for use due a mismatch between the caster and the user for which a weapon is designed (as from Size) are reduced by 20.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.6: Caster may cast this spell to create one piece of physical evidence that implicates the currently studied patsy (see Study Patsy). This could include a fingerprint, a footprint, etc., but must be something that cannot normally be moved from the crime scene. The evidence should be treated as circumstantial (i.e., a good alibi should still get the patsy off the hook).
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.7: As Concealed Object I, except will affect an object up to the size of a one-handed sword.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.8: As Well-Aimed Attack I, except bonus is +50.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.9: As Open Ambush I, except the limit on critical roll modification is ±4.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.10: As Improvised Attack I, except penalties are reduced by 40.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.11: Caster gains a +20 to his initiative roll this round. This must be the caster’s first action and the +20 applies to the casting of this spell.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.12: As Create Evidence I, except two pieces of evidence are created; one piece of evidence is incriminating (i.e., patsy will need more than a good alibi).
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.13: As Well-Aimed Attack I, except bonus is +75.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.14: As Open Ambush I, except the limit on critical roll modification is ±6.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.15: As Improvised Attack I, except penalties are reduced by 60.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.16: As Concealed Object I, except object may be of any size, so long as the largest dimension of the object is less than the caster’s height.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.17: As Study Patsy, except the information it gathers is required for use with the Slaying Attack spells later on this list.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.18: As Create Evidence I, except three pieces of evidence are created; two pieces of evidence are incriminating.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.19: As Well-Aimed Attack I, except bonus is +100.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.20: The caster’s next attack (within one minute of casting this spell) against the currently studied victim (see Study Victim) will be resolved as a Slaying IV attack (+20 to the critical roll).
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.25: As Open Ambush I, except the limit on critical roll modification is ±10.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.30: As Improvised Attack I, except penalties are reduced by 90.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.35: As Open Ambush I, except the limit on critical roll modification is ±14, the caster has 10 minutes in which to make the attack, and he does not have to have a positional bonus.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.40: As Improvised Attack I, except penalties are reduced by 120.
ASSASSINATION MASTERY.50: As Slaying Attack, except all of the caster’s attacks made against the victim are resolved as Slaying IV attacks, and the duration is 1 minute per level.

DISGUISE MASTERY.1: Caster studies a person for use with disguise spells later on this list. The caster can only have as many disguises studied as he has ranks in this list. He may forget a studied disguise at any time to make room for replacements.
DISGUISE MASTERY.2: One object (up to 10 pounds per level) has its visual appearance altered for the duration of the spell. Note that no other aspect of the object changes. This spell cannot make an object cast light (although it may alter the appearance of light given off, whether naturally or from another spell).
DISGUISE MASTERY.3: Caster has a limited illusion on himself that allows him to look like any humanoid race within 20% of his own size. The illusion moves as the caster moves.
DISGUISE MASTERY.4: All deeds performed while this spell is active are “shadowed” to divination spells. All related visions gained through divination effect are shrouded in shadows. For example, a Death’s Mastery cast on the scene of a murder might reveal a shadowy figure performing the deeds (but no details about the identity of the figure).
DISGUISE MASTERY.5: For the purposes of mental or magical detections, caster appears to be of any race with which the caster is familiar.
DISGUISE MASTERY.6: As Facade I, except one extra sense is added.
DISGUISE MASTERY.7: Caster physically changes to take on the form and visual appearance of any one studied person (using the Study Disguise spell). This is strictly a physical change.
DISGUISE MASTERY.8: As Shadow Assassin, except absolutely no information about the caster will be revealed. For example, a Death’s Memory cast on the scene of a murder might show the victim collapsing with a knife in his chest (but no sign of the assassin).
DISGUISE MASTERY.9: As Facade I, except two extra senses are added.
DISGUISE MASTERY.10: As Disguise I, except caster also takes on the vocal characteristics of the person mimicked.
DISGUISE MASTERY.11: As Misfeel Kind, except caster’s profession may be misrepresented.
DISGUISE MASTERY.12: Caster may mentally speak with one target; to the target it will seem as if they are communicating normally (i.e., orally).
DISGUISE MASTERY.13: As Disguise II, except caster also takes on the obvious mannerisms of the person mimicked (e.g., left-handedness, limp).
DISGUISE MASTERY.14: As Facade I, except all five basic human senses (sight, hearing, smell, taste, touch) are included.
DISGUISE MASTERY.15: As Misfeel Kind, except caster’s level may be misrepresented (to an upper limit of twice the caster’s actual level).
DISGUISE MASTERY.16: As Disguise III, except caster also takes on the subtle mannerisms of the person mimicked. This makes him virtually undetectable to all but the closest of associates.
DISGUISE MASTERY.17: Target becomes undetectable by Presence spells or related abilities.
DISGUISE MASTERY.18: As Shadow Assassin, except all deeds performed while this spell is active will appear as if the currently studied patsy is performing the caster’s actions (see Study Patsy on Assassination Mastery list).
DISGUISE MASTERY.19: As Disguise IV, except even very subtle mannerisms are gained.
DISGUISE MASTERY.20: Allows caster to use all of the “Misfeel” spells at once.
DISGUISE MASTERY.25: Caster and items on his person cannot be detected by any Detect... spell.
DISGUISE MASTERY.30: As Misfeel, except it has a ten minute/level duration and does not require concentration.
DISGUISE MASTERY.35: As Facade III, except duration is only ten minutes per level and it may be used on another person.
DISGUISE MASTERY.40: As Facade V, except with one round of concentration, the caster can change the facade to another.
DISGUISE MASTERY.50: Caster may use any lower level spell on this list, once per round.

ESCAPES.1: Gives the caster +20 bonus for picking the lock analyzed. If the caster takes a round to explain the lock to someone else, that person gets a +10 bonus to pick the lock.
ESCAPES.2: Any minor covering on the head of the caster made of organic material is loosened. This includes any gags or blindfolds.
ESCAPES.3: This spell allows the caster to perform one maneuver using a Craft or Technical skill as if the caster had a complete set of the appropriate tools with a bonus of +10.
ESCAPES.4: Caster quietly “teleports” a single inanimate object to a point up to 100' away from its current location. There can be no intervening barriers in a direct line between the target and the point (for these purposes, a barrier is anything the object could not physically go through). The object has a maximum weight limit of 1 pound per level of the caster.
ESCAPES.5: Any ropes (or similar bindings) that are binding the caster are untied.
ESCAPES.6: As Phantom Tools I, except bonus for tools is +20.
ESCAPES.7: Caster quietly “teleports” to a point up to 100' away, but there can be no intervening barriers in a direct line between the target and the point (for these purposes a barrier is anything the caster could not physically go through; a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).
ESCAPES.8: As Silenced Leave Item I, except the object can pass through barriers by specifying exact direction and distance. If the arrival point coincides with solid material, the object does not move (though the caster still loses the PP).
ESCAPES.9: Each lock or shackle binding the caster has a 75% chance of opening (modified by the sophistication of the lock, see Section 10.14).
ESCAPES.10: As Silenced Leave Item I, except target can be moved 500'.
ESCAPES.11: Caster may pass through any inanimate material up to 1 foot/level. It takes 1 round to pass through 2 feet of material.
ESCAPES.12: As Silenced Leaving I, except caster can pass through barriers by specifying exact distances. If the arrival point coincides with solid material, the caster does not move, instead being stunned (-50) 1-10 rounds, and the PP for this spell are expended.
ESCAPES.13: As Phantom Tools I, except bonus for tools is +30.
ESCAPES.14: As Silenced Long Door Item I, except object can be moved up to 500'.
ESCAPES.15: As Unbind, except will also work on fixed shackles (i.e., those that have been rivetted shut).
ESCAPES.16: As Silenced Leaving I, except caster can move 300'.
ESCAPES.17: As Phantom Tools I, except bonus for tools is +30.
ESCAPES.18: Caster is flattened until becoming virtually two-dimensional. This allows the caster to slide through cracks and makes the caster effectively invisible when viewed from the side.
ESCAPES.19: As Silenced Long Door I, except caster can move 300'.
ESCAPES.20: As Passing, except caster can pass through as much material as the duration allows at a rate of 10'/rnd.
ESCAPES.25: Opens a portal 3'x6'x3' in any solid surface, through which anyone can pass. At the end of the duration, the surface is returned to its previous state. Anyone in the area of effect when the spell ends will be forced back out to the point of entry.
ESCAPES.30: As Phantom Tools I, except bonus for tools is +50.
ESCAPES.35: As Silenced Long Door I, except caster can move 1000'.
ESCAPES.40: Caster leaves no physical trace of having passed: no footprints, no broken twigs, no scent. Non-magical tracking is impossible. No protection against magical tracking is provided, nor does the caster gain any unusual abilities (the caster will still sink in snow normally, it just will be left unmarked after the caster passes). Deliberate actions will still leave traces (e.g., the caster will not snap a twig off a tree in passing, but if the caster reaches out and breaks a twig, it will stay broken),
ESCAPES.50: As Silenced Long Door I, except movement range is 10 miles per level. Making a precise appearance is difficult, especially if unfamiliar with the destination. The following chances for error exist: Never seen place (only described) = 50%; been briefly (1 hr) = 25%; Studied (24 hr) = 10%; Studied carefully (1 week) =1%; Lived in (1 yr) = .01 %. In case of failure: first determine direction of error (randomly), then determine amount of error (make an open-ended d100 roll for the number of feet).

GATHERING SECRETS.1: This spell copies a document that the caster is examining. The caster merely concentrates and touches the document with one hand and a blank sheet with his other hand. The copy is not exact (i.e., not a forgery). Note that the caster does not have to be able to read the document. Alternatively, this spell can transcribe (in monochromatic black ink) one scene that he is viewing onto a page, creating the equivalent of a well-drawn, detailed realistic drawing. The process occurs at the rate of 1 minute per page or scene.
GATHERING SECRETS.2: Caster can pick a point up to 10'/level away and will hear as if physically at that point (there can be intervening objects such as walls). Note that this means that he cannot hear where his ears are.
GATHERING SECRETS.3: This spell makes a hardened clay copy of a small, 3-dimensional object (up to 6"x6"x6"). This spell requires that the caster have enough clay to make the copy (at a one to one scale). The clay must start off soft (the spell will harden it). This process requires one minute of concentration.
GATHERING SECRETS.4: One location is “marked” so that the caster can find it again later with a Far Sense spell. The marker is automatically located when the caster casts a Far Sense spell if the marker is within range of the Far Sense spell. A marker can be placed on any inanimate object. The caster can only have as many markers as he has ranks in this list; a Sensory Marker spell can be cancelled even if the caster is no longer within range of the marker.
GATHERING SECRETS.5: As Copy I, except copies 1 page/scene every four rounds.
GATHERING SECRETS.6: Caster may designate any one of his senses to be used at a “marked” location within range (see Sensory Marker). The caster can use any perception abilities he has at the time (e.g., if he is currently under the effects of Nightvision, he will have Nightvision at the marked location). The remote sensory point may be rotated to face any direction. While he is sensing at the marked location, the caster must remain immobile and concentrate (and does not have that sense available at his own location).
GATHERING SECRETS.7: After casting this spell, the caster will know what (if any) evidence exists within the range which would implicate the currently studied patsy if found at the scene of the crime (see Study Patsy on the Assassination Mastery list). The evidence (if any exists) will be circumstantial, but will imply that the patsy was at the scene when a crime occurred. This spell provides only the direction, distance, and description of the piece of evidence. It does not provide any details as to why the patsy will be implicated by the evidence.
GATHERING SECRETS.8: As Listen, except caster sees from the fixed point (it can rotate).
GATHERING SECRETS.9: As Duplicate I, except will work on an object up to 3' x 3' x 3' in dimensions.
GATHERING SECRETS.10: As Copy I, except copies 1 page/scene per 2 rounds.
GATHERING SECRETS.11: As Far Sense I, except caster may designate up to two senses for use at the marked location.
GATHERING SECRETS.12: Caster can see through wood (up to a maximum thickness of 1"/level).
GATHERING SECRETS.13: As Locate Evidence I, except two pieces of evidence are located (providing such exist) and the evidence will be incriminating (not just circumstantial).
GATHERING SECRETS.14: As Duplicate I, except will work on an object up to 6' x 6' x 6' in dimensions.
GATHERING SECRETS.15: As Copy I, except copies 1 page/scene per round.
GATHERING SECRETS.16: As Far Sense I, except caster can move while the spell is active (though he must maintain concentration).
GATHERING SECRETS.17: Caster can see through stone (up to a maximum thickness of 1"/level).
GATHERING SECRETS.18: As Locate Evidence I, except three pieces of evidence are located and the evidence will “prove” that the patsy is guilty.
GATHERING SECRETS.19: As Far Sense II, except caster can move while the spell is active (though he must maintain concentration).
GATHERING SECRETS.20: Caster can see through iron or steel (up to a maximum thickness of 1"/level).
GATHERING SECRETS.25: As Far Sense I, except the range is 500 feet/level.
GATHERING SECRETS.30: As Copy I, except copies 2 pages/scenes per round.
GATHERING SECRETS.35: Caster touches two similar writing surfaces (e.g., two parchments, two bound volumes of like dimensions, or two clay tablets) and so long as the spell remains in effect, anything written on one of these documents will also appear written on the other.
GATHERING SECRETS.40: As Far Sense II, except the range is 500 feet/level.
GATHERING SECRETS.50: As Copy I, except will copy any bound volume onto an equal number of pages (not necessarily bound). Also, the caster need not examine the material or maintain touch contact after the spell begins (he simply casts the spell and then he can leave the spell running). The spell will copy pages at the rate of 5 pages per round (and will even copy color images).

MISDIRECTIONS.1: [RR Mod = -20] Target will think that the caster has the proper credentials for the current situation (this could include passwords or documents).
MISDIRECTIONS.2: A single object is made invisible (1 garment, 1 naked body, etc.); until 24 hrs pass or the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc.) or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack) or casts a spell of type E or F.
MISDIRECTIONS.3: [RR Mod = -20] Up to three targets will incorrectly identify the caster as someone else (all three will describe the caster in the same fashion).
MISDIRECTIONS.4: [RR Mod = -50] Affects up to three targets. Each target makes an RR. Failure results in the caster being invisible to the target; others see the caster normally. If the caster makes an obvious action (e.g., talking, moving an object, etc.), any target that would normally sense that action may make another RR (the GM may deem it appropriate to apply modifiers to this RR based upon the action the caster takes). If the caster attacks a target, that target may make another RR with a +50 modifier. If the caster begins to concentrate, he can extend the duration of this spell indefinitely (as long as he can concentrate).
MISDIRECTIONS.5: Target’s perception is skewed. All Awareness maneuvers are modified by -10.
MISDIRECTIONS.6: As Unseen I, except affects two objects.
MISDIRECTIONS.7: [RR Mod = -50] As Quick Cloaking III, except affects up to five targets.
MISDIRECTIONS.8: As Eyewitness III, except affects five targets.
MISDIRECTIONS.9: [RR Mod = -50] As Quick Cloaking III, except every target in the area of effect must make an RR. New targets entering the sphere while the spell is still in effect will need to make an RR or be affected as well. Once a target makes a successful RR, he need not make another RR against the spell, however once affected, leaving the sphere does not cancel the effect.
MISDIRECTIONS.10: As Misleading I, except penalties are -30.
MISDIRECTIONS.11: [RR Mod = -50] As Quick Cloaking III, except affects up to ten targets.
MISDIRECTIONS.12: Caster’s apparent location is offset from the actual location; all attacks have no effect 10% of the time. Each time a foe misses due to this effect, the chance of that foe missing again goes down 5%.
MISDIRECTIONS.13: As Eyewitness III, except affects ten targets.
MISDIRECTIONS.14: [RR Mod = -50] As Quick Cloaking Sphere I, except area of effect is a twenty foot radius.
MISDIRECTIONS.15: As Misleading I, except penalties are -50.
MISDIRECTIONS.16: As Quick Cloaking III, except affects up to twenty targets.
MISDIRECTIONS.17: Creates a false trail with the same physical markings (typically footprints) and scent(s) as the actual trail left by the caster, but Routine (+30) to follow (without appearing to be so). The trail can be laid out as the caster wishes, within the range of the spell. This can be especially effective when combined with some form of teleportation to break the real trail.
MISDIRECTIONS.18: As Eyewitness III, except affects one target per level of the caster.
MISDIRECTIONS.19: [RR Mod = -50] As Quick Cloaking Sphere I, except area of effect is a thirty foot radius.
MISDIRECTIONS.20: As Misleading I, except penalties are -100.
MISDIRECTIONS.25: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 30%.
MISDIRECTIONS.30: [RR Mod = -50] As Quick Cloaking III, except the caster can affect as many targets as he has levels and the range is only limited to the caster’s field of vision.
MISDIRECTIONS.35: [RR Mod = -50] As Quick Cloaking Sphere I, except area of effect is a hundred foot radius.
MISDIRECTIONS.40: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 40%.
MISDIRECTIONS.50: [RR Mod.: -50] As Eyewitness III, except affects everyone who sees the caster.

POISON MASTERY.1: The caster knows what type of poison(s) are needed to achieve a particular effect. The GM may deem it appropriate to give the caster a bonus of +25 to any maneuver directly involving poison(s).
POISON MASTERY.2: The caster receives an additional RR versus poisons (i.e., if the caster is poisoned, the caster has two chances to roll a successful RR).
POISON MASTERY.3: This spell causes one dose of a poison to adhere to an inanimate, solid surface. The poison will wear off normally.
POISON MASTERY.4: This spell magically prepares a poison (up to 5th level in potency). This spell normally requires d100 minutes before it is completed. Note that the caster must have the poison in its raw form before casting this spell (i.e., the spell does not create the poison; it merely prepares it).
POISON MASTERY.5: Caster may analyze a poison to determine the exact effects and what antidotes are necessary. Poison may be on an item or in a being.
POISON MASTERY.6: For the duration of this spell, all effects from a single poison are suspended. Note that the poison will still be in the caster and takes effect normally after the duration (though the spell may be recast to continue delaying the effects, and some poisons may leave the caster’s system before the spell expires).
POISON MASTERY.7: Caster can transfer a single dose of a poison from one target to the caster (who can then use the self-only poison negation spells on this list to deal with it).
POISON MASTERY.8: As Apply Poison I, except affects two doses (which can be applied to different surfaces).
POISON MASTERY.9: Any poison inside the caster must make an RR with a -20 modifier or be neutralized. In any case, it delays the effects of the poison for the duration of the spell.
POISON MASTERY.10: As Work Poison V, except affects poisons up to a potency of 10th level.
POISON MASTERY.11: The caster can convert any poison that he is touching into a venom. The poison will now be effective when introduced into the victim’s blood stream (regardless of its normal method of affecting a target).
POISON MASTERY.12: As Apply Poison II, except affects three doses.
POISON MASTERY.13: As Neutralize Poison, except poison has a -70 modifier to its RR.
POISON MASTERY.14: Caster can transfer a single dose of a poison from one target to a second target. Caster must be touching both targets simultaneously.
POISON MASTERY.15: Caster can coat the target’s hands with a poison. The target is unaffected by the poison.
POISON MASTERY.16: As Work Poison V, except affects any poison.
POISON MASTERY.17: As Apply Poison II, except affects four doses.
POISON MASTERY.18: As Venom, except converts the poison into a contact poison (a poison that affects its victim upon contact with the victim’s skin) regardless of its normal method of affecting a target.
POISON MASTERY.19: As Transfer Poison II, except caster need only touch the target from which the poison is transferred; the target to receive the poison need merely be within the spell’s range.
POISON MASTERY.20: The caster can ingest a single dose of a poison. For the duration of this spell, he will be unaffected by the poison. Anytime before the duration expires, the caster can attempt to transfer the poison to a single target. The target must be no further away than 5' and the caster’s mouth must be capable of delivering the poison (either through a kiss, a whisper, spitting, etc.). The target gets an RR to avoid the effects of this spell (in addition to the RR to resist the poison).
POISON MASTERY.25: As Venom’s Breath, except the caster can transfer the poison to any single target within the range. The caster must be able to cast an obvious, evil glare at the target.
POISON MASTERY.30: The caster can disperse a poison (which becomes an inhaled poison) into a misty cloud. The size of the mist is one foot in radius per dose of the poison used. The poison will linger in the area normally until the duration of the spell expires (i.e., the mist will be subject to the wind, etc.). When the duration expires, the poison disperses.
POISON MASTERY.35: As Transfer Poison III, except caster need not touch the target from which the poison is transferred, both targets need merely be within the spell’s range.
POISON MASTERY.40: Improves the potency of a poison such that any victim of the poison must make two RRs and take the worse of the two results. If in or on an object (e.g., goblet of a poisoned drink, poison on a blade, but not a person), then the poison will linger for 24 hours, even if normally effective washing procedures are done. This residual poison will continue to affect anyone who would normally be affected by the poison there, but it is diluted from the original potency and will allow a normal single RR, with a +10 bonus.
POISON MASTERY.50: As Venom’s Glare, except for the range.

MIND ATTACK.2: Target hesitates in any non-defensive action, suffering a -20 to initiative, and must parry with at least half OB.
MIND ATTACK.3: Target takes 25% of current concussion hits (i.e., those not already taken).
MIND ATTACK.4: Target takes an A Electricity critical strike.
MIND ATTACK.6: Target drops anything currently held and takes a -20 to any maneuver attempted this round.
MIND ATTACK.7: Target is paralyzed, unable to move or take any action.
MIND ATTACK.8: Target takes a B Electricity critical strike.
MIND ATTACK.9: Target loses 50% of remaining concussion hits.
MIND ATTACK.10: Everyone except the caster within the radius is a target, all failing to resist are stunned (-50) for 1 Rd for every 10 RR failed.
MIND ATTACK.12: Target is in a stunned (-75) condition.
MIND ATTACK.13: Target takes a C Electricity critical strike.
MIND ATTACK.14: As Paralyze I, except duration is 3 rounds/10 failure.
MIND ATTACK.15: As Mind Shout I, except the area of effect is a circle with a radius of 50'.
MIND ATTACK.16: Target takes a D Electricity critical strike.
MIND ATTACK.17: As Paralyze I, except duration is 5 rounds/10 failure.
MIND ATTACK.19: As Mind Shout I, except the area of effect is a circle with a radius of 100'.
MIND ATTACK.20: Target takes an E Electricity critical strike.
MIND ATTACK.25: As Mind Shout I, except area of effect is a circle with a radius of 50' and any target failing by more than 50 is unconscious for eight hours.
MIND ATTACK.30: As Mind Shout I, except the area of effect is circle with a radius of 300'.
MIND ATTACK.35: Target takes an F (E+A) Electricity critical strike.
MIND ATTACK.40: As Jolts I, except affects 1 target/level and duration varies by degree of RR failure.
MIND ATTACK.50: Targets failing by 1-50 are unconscious, and targets failing by more than 50 are dead; RRs for spell casters of Mentalism are modified by -20. Affects everyone else within 50' of the caster.

MIND CONTROL.1: Target must answer a single-concept question truthfully (assuming target can understand the question).
MIND CONTROL.2: Target falls into natural sleep. The first round of sleep is magical (the target cannot be awakened through normal means). Falling asleep is rapid, but not so instantaneous that the victim cannot slump gently to the ground (no injuries under normal circumstances from falling to the ground).
MIND CONTROL.3: Humanoid target believes caster is a good friend.
MIND CONTROL.4: Target will take no offensive action and will fight only in self-defense.
MIND CONTROL.5: Target is incapable of making decisions or initiating action; he may continue to fight current foes or in self-defense. The target may also follow orders from the target’s leader (if any), but will only be able to follow them so long as no ambiguities arise.
MIND CONTROL.6: Target fears caster and attempts to flee. (This does not involve a Fear RR or the usual fear mechanics. Use a normal Mentalism RR and the result is flight for the specified duration.)
MIND CONTROL.7: Target will perform a single suggested act that is not self-destructive or diametrically opposed to the target’s personality (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, no suggestions that a priest pray to an enemy god, etc.).
MIND CONTROL.8: Humanoid target has its Action Points per round reduced by 3 (i.e., normally, the target will have 1 AP each round).
MIND CONTROL.10: Humanoid target must obey the caster as specified in Suggestion.
MIND CONTROL.11: [RR Mod: +20] Target falls into a coma.
MIND CONTROL.12: As Charm Kind, except works on any sentient creature.
MIND CONTROL.13: Upon being told a story (or related series of statements) the target will completely believe it to be true for the duration of the spell, defending it as truth.
MIND CONTROL.14: As Hold Kind, except works on any sentient creature.
MIND CONTROL.15: Target is given one task by the caster. Until the task is completed, the target has a -10 penalty to all actions not related to completing the task, so long as the target is making an effort to accomplish the task. If the target stops pursuing the task, all actions are at a -25 penalty.
MIND CONTROL.16: [RR Mod: -20] Humanoid target is paralyzed and can do nothing.
MIND CONTROL.17: As Master of Kind, except works on any sentient creature.
MIND CONTROL.18: Target is a blathering idiot. The target may be led around, but can take no action.
MIND CONTROL.19: [RR Mod: -20] As Hold Kind True, except works on any sentient creature.
MIND CONTROL.20: [RR Mod: -20] Target is unconscious and cannot be woken except by magic; even awakening the victim with a spell requires that the waking spell make a successful RR against this spell.
MIND CONTROL.25: As Geas, except the target suffers a -20 penalty for actions not related to completing the task or a -50 penalty to all actions if the task is ignored. Maneuvers (not attack rolls or SCRs) directly related to the task receive a +10 bonus.
MIND CONTROL.30: Caster has total control of target’s mind (when concentrating). After the initial casting, the range for control is 1 mile/level.
MIND CONTROL.35: As Fear, except target will always flee when confronted by the caster.
MIND CONTROL.40: Target is completely enthralled with the caster. The caster cannot control the target directly, but the target will treat the caster as his best friend, believe him to be of the utmost character and will believe anything the caster tells him unless confronted with definitive proof of its falsity.
MIND CONTROL.50: As Mind Control True, except duration is permanent (until dispelled); caster need only concentrate to give commands. Only one target can be so controlled at a time.

MIND MERGE.1: Caster learns target’s basic feelings; caster can concentrate on a new target each round.
