MIND MERGE.2: Caster learns target’s emotions in detail; caster can concentrate on a new target each round.
MIND MERGE.3: Allows two Mentalism spell users to communicate mentally and exchange Power Points.
MIND MERGE.4: When cast within one minute before a Mind Merge or Ready Merge or Hivemind spell, this spell allows the caster to focus on a specific person as the target. This target must be Mind Stored (see the Presence spell list).
MIND MERGE.5: Caster receives surface thoughts from target.
MIND MERGE.6: Allows caster and target to interchange thoughts; if both are Mentalism spell users, they can interchange Power Points. They must be able to see each other or the caster must know the exact location of the target or the caster must use Focus Merge to locate the target. In all cases, the target must also be within range.
MIND MERGE.7: The caster prepares himself to be the target of a Mind Merge or Ready Merge spell, thus, increasing the range of the “incoming” spell. The increased range is equal to the original range times twenty.
MIND MERGE.8: As Mind Merge I, except range is 100'.
MIND MERGE.9: Some minds may be sufficiently different from the caster’s own as to be almost incomprehensible, whereas others may be so alien as to create terror and psychic pain. When cast, this spell acts as a filter and interpreter which allows a caster to understand and tolerate these mental differences. This can be as mundane as catching cultural implications in someone’s Inner Thoughts or as exotic as understanding interdimensional fish monsters which directly sense forces of gravitation, magnetism, essence, and luck.
MIND MERGE.10: As Thoughts, except caster also learns reasoning and thought patterns behind surface thoughts.
MIND MERGE.11: As in Mind Merge II, except for range and instantaneous nature of spell. Caster and target must have Merged before.
MIND MERGE.13: Target and caster switch minds and spell-casting abilities; target (in caster’s body) is in a coma if not also a Mentalist. An unwilling target may make a new RR every hour.
MIND MERGE.14: Breaks any contacts made with the caster’s mind through various spells or other effects, regardless of how they were made. Connections may make an RR, but at a -50 penalty. Also expels any mental intruders in residence, such as through demonic possesion. Intruders only have a -25 penalty.
MIND MERGE.15: As in Inner Thoughts, except affects a single target and caster can also scan target’s conscious memories; at a rate of 1 scene/ round.
MIND MERGE.16: As Inner Thoughts, except for range.
MIND MERGE.17: Spell creates a mental bond between the caster and one target which allows each to use one skill possessed by the other. This gives the borrower the skill ranks of the other so long as the spell lasts; in all respects, it is as if the borrower actually had developed those ranks himself. The following are not allowed as shared skills: Body Development, Power Point Development, Spell Lists. The skill ranks are not lost to the individual who originally had them. If the caster and target are ever more than 100' apart, the spell terminates immediately.
MIND MERGE.18: As Mind Merge I, except range is 50'/ level.
MIND MERGE.19: As Mind Scan, except for range.
MIND MERGE.20: As Mind Scan, except caster can probe target’s subconscious memories (i.e., all experiences).
MIND MERGE.25: As in Mind Switch, except lasts as long as the caster likes (or until an unwilling target makes an RR).
MIND MERGE.30: Caster can remove one thought or memory from the target’s mind each round.
MIND MERGE.35: As Mind Merge I, except range is 50'/level, and multiple minds may be merged. The location of the various minds must be known to the caster as in Mind Merge and the caster must have Merged with each of them before and there is a limit of one mind for every five caster levels. Any of the merged minds may interchange Power Points if they share a realm.
MIND MERGE.40: Two targets switch minds and spell casting abilities; both parties must be willing to experience the transfer.
MIND MERGE.50: As in Ready Merge, except range is unlimited.

MIND SPEECH.1: [RR Mod.: -50] Caster may mentally speak with another spell caster of the Mentalism realm.
MIND SPEECH.2: Caster enters a trance-like state to mentally prepare to be the recipient for a Mind Tongue spell. While he is under the effects of this spell, any “incoming” Mind Tongue spell has its range increased to 10 times normal.
MIND SPEECH.3: [RR Mod.: -50] Caster may mentally speak with any one thinking being. Caster must be able to see the target or the caster must know the exact location of the target or the caster must use Focus Mind to locate the target. In all cases, the target must also be within range.
MIND SPEECH.4: When this spell is cast, the next Mind Tongue spell will be able to focus in on a particular person as its target. The person must be Mind Stored (see Presence spell list).
MIND SPEECH.5: As Prepare Mind I, except range is increased to 20x normal.
MIND SPEECH.6: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mind Tongue I, except range is 500'.
MIND SPEECH.7: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mentalist Tongue, except range extends as far as the caster can see.
MIND SPEECH.8: As Prepare Mind I, except range is increased to 50x normal.
MIND SPEECH.9: [RR Mod.: -50] Caster can broadcast thoughts to minds of all within range. This is a one-way broadcast.
MIND SPEECH.10: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mind Tongue I, except range is 1,000'.
MIND SPEECH.11: As Prepare Mind I, except range is increased to 100x normal.
MIND SPEECH.12: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mind Speech I, except area of effect is a radius of 100'.
MIND SPEECH.13: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mind Speech I, except caster can limit broadcast to desired beings.
MIND SPEECH.14: As Prepare Mind I, except range is increased to 500x normal.
MIND SPEECH.15: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mind Speech I, except area of effect is a radius of 300'.
MIND SPEECH.16: [RR Mod.: -50] A 25-word mental message can be delayed and then later triggered by the passage of a fixed time period of up to 24 hours or by certain movements, certain sounds, touch, reading, etc. within the 10' radius of effect or by a specific Mind Stored person entering the area.
MIND SPEECH.17: As Prepare Mind I, except range is increased to 1000x normal.
MIND SPEECH.18: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mind Tongue I, except range is 1 mile.
MIND SPEECH.19: [RR Mod.: -50] As Friend Speech I, except range is limited to any desired minds within a radius of 100'.
MIND SPEECH.20: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mind Speech I, except range is all minds within a radius of 2,000'.
MIND SPEECH.25: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mind Tongue I, except range is 1 mile/level.
MIND SPEECH.30: [RR Mod.: -50] As Waiting Tongue, except it is broadcast to all within a 300'R.
MIND SPEECH.35: [RR Mod.: -50] As Friend Speech I, except range is limited to any desired minds within a radius of 2,000'.
MIND SPEECH.40: [RR Mod.: -50] As Waiting Tongue, except it is broadcast to all within a radius of up to 1000' as determined by the caster and message may be up to 100 words long (or substitute one visual image for 25 words) and it may wait as long as one year.
MIND SPEECH.50: [RR Mod.: -50] As Mind Speech I, except radius can be up to 1 mile/level from caster.

PRESENCE.1: Caster is aware of the presence of all sentient/ thinking beings within range.
PRESENCE.2: Caster gets general idea of the race and level of one being. This being must first be located by Presence, Presence True, or Awareness.
PRESENCE.3: As Feel I, except caster stores mental pattern of target for later use with other spells (on this list and others).
PRESENCE.4: The caster can transfer a copy of any one Mind Stored person to another caster from the Mentalism realm (i.e., both casters now have the person stored). The target of this spell must also know the Mind Store spell.
PRESENCE.5: As Feel I, except three targets are analyzed at once.
PRESENCE.6: As Feel I, except caster learns race, profession, sex, age, and level of target.
PRESENCE.7: Caster gets direction and distance to any unshielded mind for which caster has a Mind Stored reference pattern.
PRESENCE.8: As Mind Finding I, but with an extended range and caster learns direction only.
PRESENCE.9: Can detect presences in area with a 50' radius; caster can concentrate on one such area each round.
PRESENCE.10: As Presence, plus a general knowledge of the actions of each being (e.g., being is casting a spell, but not what spell is being cast).
PRESENCE.11: As Direction I, except range is 1 mile/ level.
PRESENCE.12: As Feel I, except that range is 100'/level.
PRESENCE.13: As Feel I, except five targets are analyzed at once.
PRESENCE.14: As Feel I, except caster may “feel” one being per round.
PRESENCE.15: As Mind Typing, except range is 100'/level.
PRESENCE.16: As Mind Typing, except caster also learns what spell lists and skills the target has learned, the target’s general place/culture of origin, and any current mental contacts with the target mind (including those target may be unaware of; nature of these contacts is revealed, but not identity on other end).
PRESENCE.17: Caster is aware anytime that a spell with a mental subtype targets the caster. If the targeting spell fails an RR against the caster’s level, then the caster of this spell learns what spell it was.
PRESENCE.18: As Mind Finding I, except range is 1 mile/level.
PRESENCE.19: As Feel I, except ten targets are analyzed at once.
PRESENCE.20: As Awareness, except that very detailed knowledge of actions is given.
PRESENCE.25: As Mind Finding I, except range is 5 miles/level.
PRESENCE.30: As Direction I, except with no range limitations.
PRESENCE.35: As Feel I, except up to the caster’s level number of targets are analyzed at once.
PRESENCE.40: As Mind Typing, except simultaneously “types” a number of targets up the caster’s level.
PRESENCE.50: As Mind Finding I, except range is unlimited.

SENSE CONTROL.1: Target is at -30 for all actions.
SENSE CONTROL.2: Random limb of target is numb and useless.
SENSE CONTROL.3: Target has a -100 OB modification for missile attacks and a -50 penalty for all other actions involving sight.
SENSE CONTROL.4: Causes minor false sensations in any one of smell, taste, or touch (e.g., an itch, a stinky smell, or a salty taste).
SENSE CONTROL.6: Causes target to hear any sound(s) caster desires.
SENSE CONTROL.7: Target experiences all sense impressions as distorted and confused. Target is at -25 for most actions, suffers double penalties if attempting to move faster than a walk, and has a -40 to Perception rolls.
SENSE CONTROL.8: Causes target to see whatever the caster desires.
SENSE CONTROL.9: The sensation of bright light blinds target.
SENSE CONTROL.10: Target is totally numbed; target is at -75 for all actions.
SENSE CONTROL.11: Target sees a nonexistent foe and must fight this foe until it is “defeated” (i.e., takes damage that would drop the target). Foe has same capabilities as target but does no damage (i.e., always misses).
SENSE CONTROL.12: As Hallucination, except foe will never attack. Instead, the foe will taunt the target, using full parry against any attacks by the target.
SENSE CONTROL.13: Causes false sensations in the target’s sight and hearing.
SENSE CONTROL.14: Target is troubled by sense of being watched by an unseen, sinister presence and seems to hear mysterious and disturbing whispers. These feelings distract the target, causing a -50 to all actions.
SENSE CONTROL.15: This spell overloads the target’s senses. RR failure by 50 or less results in stunning (-50) for the duration; failure by more than 50 results in unconsciousness.
SENSE CONTROL.16: Same as Sense Control II, except affects any three senses.
SENSE CONTROL.17: As Hallucination, except foe actually seems to the target to attack and do damage normally. The only actual effects are stun results and general penalties, due to the pain and disorientation that the target actually feels. However, no physical harm is done. The target does not lose hits, does not bleed or suffer broken bones, though the target will experience these things as being so while the spell lasts. The pain and confusion causing the penalties and/or stun vanish when the spell ends (target defeats the hallucination or caster stops concentrating).
SENSE CONTROL.18: Same as Sense Control II, except affects any four senses.
SENSE CONTROL.19: Causes total sensory deprivation, i.e., no sensory input. Every day of deprivation gives a 5% chance (cumulative) of a temporary insanity.
SENSE CONTROL.20: As Sense Control II, except affects five senses.
SENSE CONTROL.25: As Sense Control V, except initial range is 300' and then once the spell is in effect, the caster can control the target’s sensations at up to 1 mile/level.
SENSE CONTROL.30: As Far Control, except caster can “program” sensory input (i.e., sense X will experience sensation Y under condition Z) and concentration is only required to “program” sensory input or change current sensations and the duration is 10 min/level and all senses are controlled.
SENSE CONTROL.35: As Sense Control V, except for duration. False sense impressions fade away if the caster stops concentrating, but the caster can renew (or change them) at any time by concentrating, so long as the spell lasts and the target is within range.
SENSE CONTROL.40: As Far Control, except duration is as Long Control.
SENSE CONTROL.50: Target lives in own fantasy world, which may be totally controlled by caster when caster concentrates. While in the fantasy, the target receives no sensory input from the real world.

BODY REINS.1: Adds +50 to any rolls for any moving maneuvers performed at a walking pace or less (e.g., walking a 3" beam).
BODY REINS.2: Allows the caster’s muscles, limbs, and torso to be slightly altered; this facilitates escaping from bonds and small places. Gives a +25 to +50 bonus to maneuvers to perform such escapes.
BODY REINS.3: Adds +20 to any one maneuver (not combat), no other action can be performed the round of this maneuver (except for casting this spell).
BODY REINS.4: Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits (round off fractional hits) before passing out; hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.
BODY REINS.5: Alters the caster’s face to resemble someone else, but not so closely as to be confused on a close inspection.
BODY REINS.6: Caster can breathe water, but not air.
BODY REINS.7: As Concentration I, except bonus is +30.
BODY REINS.8: This spell increases the caster’s effective strength. In melee, the caster does double normal concussion hit damage and gains a +10 bonus to OB.
BODY REINS.9: As Unpain I, except 50% additional hits may be sustained.
BODY REINS.10: Alters the caster’s body slightly to the general shape and size of the desired humanoid race (must be within 25% of the caster’s normal mass and same Size category).
BODY REINS.11: As Concentration I, except bonus is +40.
BODY REINS.12: As Monk’s Strength II, except caster delivers triple concussion hit damage and has a +15 OB bonus.
BODY REINS.13: This spell will awaken the caster from sleep the round following casting (caster can preset conditions under which the spell will activate).
BODY REINS.14: Caster can breathe any gas as normal air.
BODY REINS.15: As Unpain I, except 75% additional hits may be sustained.
BODY REINS.16: As Concentration I, except bonus is +50.
BODY REINS.17: This spell halves the normal amount of time needed for rest. For example, after a normal day, instead of needing eight hours of sleep, the caster will need only four hours of sleep. This spell will remain in effect for the duration of one sleep session.
BODY REINS.18: As Unpain I, except 100% additional hits may be sustained.
BODY REINS.19: During a normal sleep, the caster may make Perception rolls (that are not based on sight) at no penalty. Duration is one sleep session.
BODY REINS.20: Upon receiving a death blow, the caster goes into a state of suspended animation, until cured or killed by brain destruction.
BODY REINS.25: As Monk’s Sleep and Meditative Sleep operating at the same time.
BODY REINS.30: As Monk’s Strength II, except caster’s effective strength is increased dramatically. In melee, the caster delivers four times normal concussion damage and gains an OB bonus of +20.
BODY REINS.35: As Concentration I, except bonus is +70.
BODY REINS.40: As Monk’s Strength II, except caster’s effective strength is increased dramatically. In melee, the caster delivers five times normal concussion damage and gains an OB bonus of +25.
BODY REINS.50: Caster ignores all pain; he ignores the penalties for lost hits and will never become unconscious due to hits taken, nor will he die from hit loss while this spell is in effect.

COMBAT MASTERY.1: The caster analyzes the fighting style of one opponent he is in melee combat with. After he has both attacked and been attacked by the foe, the target is considered ‘studied’ for the purposes of using Strike spells on this list. Target then remains ‘studied’ until spell duration ends.
COMBAT MASTERY.2: After being hit by a studied opponent the caster may cast this spell to get a +10 to his OB on his next attack.
COMBAT MASTERY.3: The caster’s next attack against a studied opponent causes an additional Unbalancing critical of 2 severities less.
COMBAT MASTERY.4: The caster receives +25 to his Combat Expertise: Reverse Strike skill.
COMBAT MASTERY.5: The caster’s next attack receives +50 to his Combat Expertise: Disarm or Subdual skill.
COMBAT MASTERY.6: The caster receives +25 to his Combat Expertise: Multiple Attacks skill.
COMBAT MASTERY.7: Allows caster to ignore the penalties for making a called shot attack on his next attack.
COMBAT MASTERY.8: Any combatants making attacks directed at the caster have their fumble numbers increased by 3 (after any reduction for their number of ranks in the Combat Training specialization).
COMBAT MASTERY.9: The caster’s next attack is treated as 1 Size larger than normal.
COMBAT MASTERY.10: The caster’s next attack is treated as a Slaying I attack.
COMBAT MASTERY.11: As Unbalancing Strike I, except critical is 1 severity less.
COMBAT MASTERY.12: As All-around Attacks I, except bonus is +50.
COMBAT MASTERY.13: As Adept Strike I, except bonus is +75.
COMBAT MASTERY.14: As Multiple Attacks I, except bonus is +50.
COMBAT MASTERY.15: As Foiling Attacks I, except fumble numbers are increased by 6.
COMBAT MASTERY.16: Caster’s next attack ignores any DB due to parry.
COMBAT MASTERY.17: As Mighty Strike I, except attack is treated as 2 Sizes larger than normal.
COMBAT MASTERY.18: As Vitals Strike I, except attack is treated as a Slaying II attack.
COMBAT MASTERY.19: As Unbalancing Strike I, except critical is of equal severity.
COMBAT MASTERY.20: As All-around Attacks I, except bonus is +75.
COMBAT MASTERY.25: As Adept Strike I, except bonus is +100
COMBAT MASTERY.30: As Multiple Attacks I, except bonus is +75.
COMBAT MASTERY.35: As Foiling Attacks I, except fumble numbers are increased by 9.
COMBAT MASTERY.40: As All-around Attacks I and Multiple Attacks I, except bonus is +100 to both skills.
COMBAT MASTERY.50: Caster’s attack is treated as a Confusing Strike, Mighty Strike II, Vitals Strike II, and Unbalancing Strike III.

EVASIONS.1: Allows caster to leap up to 10' vertically or laterally, grasp and swing from a fixed object, and land perfectly (up to 20' away from the object). The object could be a tree, branch, rafter, rope, chandelier, etc. This swing is included as part of this instantaneous spell action (i.e., takes no additional AP).
EVASIONS.2: Caster is immune to stagger effects (includes “prone” or “knocked back” results) for the duration of this spell.
EVASIONS.3: If the caster performs a Full Dodge for a round, he gains +20 to his DB. If he uses a Partial Dodge, he gets half that bonus.
EVASIONS.4: As Swing I, except 3 swings may be executed in rapid succession.
EVASIONS.5: Allows caster to “flip” in any direction, landing up to 10' away (facing in any direction). This flip is included as part of this instantaneous spell action (i.e., takes no additional AP).
EVASIONS.6: Caster can tread very quietly, providing a +25 bonus to Stalking maneuvers when moving.
EVASIONS.7: As Dodging I, but bonus is +40.
EVASIONS.8: Caster may move at up to a Running pace and Dodge without suffering a penalty due to pace.
EVASIONS.9: As Swing I, except 5 swings may be executed in rapid succession.
EVASIONS.10: As Flip I, except 3 flips may be executed in rapid succession.
EVASIONS.11: Caster can tread extremely quietly, providing a +50 bonus to Stalking maneuvers when moving.
EVASIONS.12: As Dodging I, but bonus is +60.
EVASIONS.13: Caster can use his shield against two extra attacks per round (e.g., a full shield may be used against 5 attacks per round).
EVASIONS.14: Caster may move at any pace and Dodge without suffering a penalty due to pace.
EVASIONS.15: Caster can perform a Partial Dodge each round without Concentration.
EVASIONS.16: Caster reacts to an attack to take some control of the placement of an unavoidable blow. This allows him to change the result rolled on a critical taken by himself by up to ±5. This only applies to criticals that result from attacks using a Combat Training skill (e.g., it could be used against a sword attack or a crossbow bolt, but not a Fire Bolt or a Wall of Fire). This effect applies to the first applicable critical taken within the spell’s duration, after which the spell is cancelled.
EVASIONS.17: Caster is all but weightless when standing or treading on a surface of some kind (but falling is normal). This allows the caster to be supported easily by tiny twigs at the ends of tree branches, unsafe roofs, and other surfaces that would normally give under the pressure of his weight. The spell also greatly reduces the impact of the caster’s passing, giving a -75 penalty to attempts to track him by looking for signs (but not by scent or by magic).
EVASIONS.18: As Dodging I, but bonus is +80.
EVASIONS.19: Caster is able to immediately slip free of any Grapple and this spell will also negate any Hold spell or power to which the caster was subject.
EVASIONS.20: As Shield Hand, except allows the use of a shield against any number of attacks per round.
EVASIONS.25: As Dodging I, but bonus is +100.
EVASIONS.30: As Elusive Step, except duration is 1 round per level.
EVASIONS.35: As Defensive Contortion I, except adjustment is by up to ±10.
EVASIONS.40: As Defensive Contortion I, except adjustment is by up to ±15.
EVASIONS.50: Caster can use any one of the lower level spells on this list each round.

MIND OVER MATTER.1: Caster gets a +5 bonus to all Unarmed attacks.
MIND OVER MATTER.2: Caster gets a +20 bonus to his next Body Discipline maneuver within 1 minute per level.
MIND OVER MATTER.3: Caster gets a +20 bonus to his next Mental Discipline maneuver within 1 minute per level.
MIND OVER MATTER.4: For the duration of this spell, the caster’s natural AT is increased by one (e.g., most humanoids would go from AT 1 to AT 2, but if the caster’s normal skin was AT 3 it would become AT 4).
MIND OVER MATTER.5: Caster can strike an inanimate object and deliver damage to it (taking no damage himself). Caster makes a normal Unarmed attack against the object. In addition, the object must make a normal Breakage Check.
MIND OVER MATTER.6: Caster gets a +30 bonus to his next Body Discipline maneuver within 1 minute per level.
MIND OVER MATTER.7: Caster gets a +10 bonus to all Unarmed attacks.
MIND OVER MATTER.8: Caster gets a +30 bonus to his next Mental Discipline maneuver within 1 minute per level.
MIND OVER MATTER.9: As Body Armor I, but caster’s natural AT is increased by two.
MIND OVER MATTER.10: The caster may ignore the effects of the first critical strike made against him. At the end of this spell’s duration, all effects apply normally. Only one wound at a time can be ignored in this fashion (i.e., the caster cannot have more than one Lion’s Heart spell active at any given time).
MIND OVER MATTER.11: Caster gets a +40 bonus to his next Body Discipline maneuver within 1 minute per level.
MIND OVER MATTER.12: Caster gets a +40 bonus to his next Mental Discipline maneuver within 1 minute per level.
MIND OVER MATTER.13: Caster gets a +15 bonus to all Unarmed attacks.
MIND OVER MATTER.14: As Shattering Blow I, except object receives a -30 penalty to its Breakage Check.
MIND OVER MATTER.15: Caster gets a +50 bonus to his next Body Discipline maneuver within 1 minute per level.
MIND OVER MATTER.16: Caster gets a +50 bonus to his next Mental Discipline maneuver within 1 minute per level.
MIND OVER MATTER.17: As Body Armor I, but caster’s natural AT is increased by three.
MIND OVER MATTER.18: As Shattering Blow I, except object receives a -60 penalty to its Breakage Check.
MIND OVER MATTER.19: Caster gets a +20 bonus to all Unarmed attacks.
MIND OVER MATTER.20: Caster gets a +60 bonus to his next Body Discipline or Mental Discipline maneuver within 1 minute per level.
MIND OVER MATTER.25: Caster gets a +30 bonus to all Unarmed attacks.
MIND OVER MATTER.30: As Shattering Blow I, except object receives a -100 penalty to its Breakage Check.
MIND OVER MATTER.35: Caster gets a +40 bonus to all Unarmed attacks.
MIND OVER MATTER.40: Caster gets a +80 bonus to his next Body Discipline or Mental Discipline maneuver within 1 minute per level.
MIND OVER MATTER.50: Caster may use any one of the lower level spells on this list, once per round.

MONK'S BRIDGE.1: Allows caster to make one leap up to 50' laterally or 20' vertically (as a separate 1 AP action, with no Pace penalty for the leaping movement) in the round that the spell was cast.
MONK'S BRIDGE.2: This spell may be cast when the caster begins to fall, taking effect immediately, allowing the caster to land safely in a fall up to 20' per level of the caster and to take that distance off the severity of any longer fall.
MONK'S BRIDGE.3: Caster can walk or run on even, unstable surfaces (sand, ice, etc.) as if on a hard, stable surface.
MONK'S BRIDGE.4: Caster can walk or run on even, narrow (at least 2" wide) surfaces as if on normal ground.
MONK'S BRIDGE.5: As Leaping I, except the caster can execute 3 “leaps” in succession. Each leap must be within 90° of the last leap’s direction. Each leap is a 1 AP action.
MONK'S BRIDGE.6: Allows caster to execute a turn up to 180° with no deceleration or unbalancing (can be used with any “running” spells).
MONK'S BRIDGE.7: Allows caster to move up and down vertically 10' per round. This spell does not confer any ability to control horizontal movement, which must be accomplished by other means.
MONK'S BRIDGE.8: As Landing, except caster can land safely from any fall 99% of the time, and still takes the normal 20'/level off any fall for the 1% of the time that safety is not complete.
MONK'S BRIDGE.9: Caster can walk on solid surfaces up to 90° as if on normal ground.
MONK'S BRIDGE.10: As Leaping I, except limit is 10'/level laterally and 5'/level vertically.
MONK'S BRIDGE.11: As Cornering I, except caster may execute 3 such turns in one round.
MONK'S BRIDGE.12: The caster can leap up to a wall (no more than 10' away), bounce off and land up to 50' (horizontally and/or vertically) from the wall (facing any direction).
MONK'S BRIDGE.13: As Wallwalking, except caster may run.
MONK'S BRIDGE.14: Caster “teleports” to a point up to 100' away, but there can be no intervening barriers in a direct line between the target and the point (for these purposes a barrier is anything the caster could not physically go through; a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).
MONK'S BRIDGE.15: Caster can walk or run on air if there is a wind blowing. However, running directly into the wind is not possible, and when running in any other direction, the wind’s speed will modify the caster’s movement rate (i.e., like the effects of wind on a sail boat).
MONK'S BRIDGE.16: Caster can walk on any liquid surface as if on level ground.
MONK'S BRIDGE.17: As Leaping I, except caster may make one leap per round for the duration of the spell.
MONK'S BRIDGE.18: As Leaving I, except range is 300'.
MONK'S BRIDGE.19: As Windrunning, except the caster may run against the wind with a movement rate unaffected by the wind speed.
MONK'S BRIDGE.20: Caster can walk on any solid surface as if on normal ground (includes ceilings).
MONK'S BRIDGE.25: As Ceilingwalking, except caster may run.
MONK'S BRIDGE.30: As Edgerunning, Windrunning True, Liquidrunning, and Ceilingrunning all at once.
MONK'S BRIDGE.35: As Leaving I, except range is 1000'.
MONK'S BRIDGE.40: As Run True, except that the caster may move at any movement pace.
MONK'S BRIDGE.50: Caster can use any one of the lower level spells on this list each round.

MONK'S SENSE.1: Caster gains an extremely acute sense of hearing. This results in +50 to Perception rolls involving only hearing, +25 to Perception involving hearing and other senses.
MONK'S SENSE.2: Caster can see up to 100' as if it were daylight, so long as there is some light.
MONK'S SENSE.3: Caster has a 300° field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the caster is lowered to +5, and the rear bonus is lowered to +15.
MONK'S SENSE.4: Caster gains extremely acute sense of smell (e.g., +50 to Perception involving only smell, +25 to Perception involving smell and other senses).
MONK'S SENSE.5: Caster can see 100' in any water (including murky water) as if through air in daylight.
MONK'S SENSE.6: As Nightvision, plus caster sees 100' in any precipitation (including thick fog) as if the air were clear.
MONK'S SENSE.7: Caster gains extreme tactile sensitivity. This provides a bonus to any action requiring a sense of touch. For example, caster might receive +25 to picking locks, disarming traps, opening secret doors, etc. and +50 to Perception involving only touch, +25 to Perception involving touch and other senses).
MONK'S SENSE.8: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. No light at all is needed for this spell to work.
MONK'S SENSE.9: Detects any invisible objects or beings; one 5'R area can be checked each round. All attacks against detected targets are modified by -50.
MONK'S SENSE.10: Caster can check one object or place (up to a 5'R) and tell if it is an illusion or has an illusion on it.
MONK'S SENSE.11: As Scent, except caster can detect extremely faint scents (e.g., up to 48 hours old, after rainstorms, through snow, etc.).
MONK'S SENSE.12: While this spell is in effect, one illusion within the caster’s range ceases to exist for the caster only. The caster must specify the illusion to be negated (unless caster knows something is an illusion, this spell would be gambling PP).
MONK'S SENSE.13: As Touch, except bonus is +50, or +75 for pure touch Perception.
MONK'S SENSE.14: Caster can see through wood (up to 1" per level).
MONK'S SENSE.15: Caster can see all invisible things anywhere that would normally be visible to the caster. In addition, the caster suffers no penalties against invisible targets (as they are not invisible to the caster).
MONK'S SENSE.16: Caster can see through any woven organic substance (up to 1" per level).
MONK'S SENSE.17: As any of the lower level Vision spells on this list but without a range limit (i.e., it will function out to normal limits of sight).
MONK'S SENSE.18: Caster cannot see any visual illusions. This does not affect any of the other senses.
MONK'S SENSE.19: Caster can see through stone (up to 1" per level).
MONK'S SENSE.20: As all lower level Vision spells functioning at the same time.
MONK'S SENSE.25: Caster can see through iron or steel (up to 1" per level).
MONK'S SENSE.30: Caster can see through any metal (up to 1" per level).
MONK'S SENSE.35: Caster gains a +100 bonus to any Perception roll to detect danger.
MONK'S SENSE.40: Caster can see through any one chosen substance (up to 1" per level).
MONK'S SENSE.50: Caster can use any one of the lower level spells (on this list) each round.

MIND DEATH.1: The target’s memory of a 20 minute period is temporarily eliminated. After a period of up to one hour (specified by the caster at the time of casting), the target will remember all that transpired during the period.
MIND DEATH.2: Target forgets 10 contiguous minutes totally. The caster determines which ten minute period is forgotten.
MIND DEATH.3: Target’s mind is temporarily blank and he can do nothing. The target will remember nothing that occurs during the period. His body stops (all voluntary actions cease).
MIND DEATH.4: Any time the target attempts to use (roll a maneuver using) a skill with a strong mental component (e.g. one for which Memory or Reasoning stat bonus is used), there is a 20% chance that the victim will not be able to recollect the skill at all and cannot use it again until having slept.
MIND DEATH.5: As Forget I, except 100 minutes can be erased.
MIND DEATH.6: As Mental Block I, except up to 1 hour of memories can be delayed for up to 24 hours.
MIND DEATH.7: As Mind Blank I, except duration is 3 rounds.
MIND DEATH.8: As Skill Amnesia I, except duration is 1 week per 10 failure.
MIND DEATH.9: As Forget I, except 200 minutes can be erased.
MIND DEATH.10: Target mind blanks out for a period of 10 minutes each day at random. Target is incapable of activity or thought during this period (as in Mind Blank).
MIND DEATH.11: Target loses 5% of his collected experience (i.e., experience points).
MIND DEATH.12: As Mental Block I, except memories of up to one hour/level can be delayed for up to one day per level.
MIND DEATH.13: As Mind Blank I, except duration is 5 rounds.
MIND DEATH.14: As Forget I, except 1 hour per level of the caster can be erased.
MIND DEATH.15: As Mind Death I, except the target blanks out twice per day.
MIND DEATH.16: As Skill Amnesia I, except duration is 1 month per 10 failure.
MIND DEATH.17: As Mind Death I, except the target blanks out three times per day.
MIND DEATH.18: As Mind Blank I, except duration is 10 rounds.
MIND DEATH.19: As Lost Experience I, except percentage of experience lost is 10%.
MIND DEATH.20: As Mind Death I, except the target blanks out five times per day.
MIND DEATH.25: As Lost Experience I, except percentage of experience lost is 15%.
MIND DEATH.30: As Mind Death I, except the target blanks out ten times per day.
MIND DEATH.35: As Lost Experience I, except percentage of experience lost is 20%.
MIND DEATH.40: As Mind Blank I, except duration is 20 rounds.
MIND DEATH.50: As Mind Blank I, except the target has a 5% chance of blanking out each round.

MIND DISEASE.1: Target has trouble sleeping. Treat any sleep time as half as effective (e.g., count eight hours “sleep” as four hours). This hinders hit and PP recovery. See RMCL Section 5.5 for effects of inadequate sleep on fatigue. Drugs/herbs or spells may allow for temporary relief by forcing sleep.
MIND DISEASE.2: Target has an extreme dislike for any specific thing the caster chooses. Target has a 50% chance (modified by three times Self Discipline stat bonus) of overcoming the neurosis when given a choice (e.g., neurosis concerning horses would mean that every time the target tried to get on or near a horse the target would need to make a roll in order to do so).
MIND DISEASE.3: Target experiences chronic guilt over some action in his past. The GM should choose some significant event in the target’s past. The target will not perform the same or similar actions again and must take steps to alleviate the guilt (acting to rectify the past wrong or, if that is impossible, similar wrongs).
MIND DISEASE.4: Target believes everyone other than his close associates is out to get him.
MIND DISEASE.5: Target must make an RR against Fear (use the highest level foe, or GM’s judgment for other perils, as level of Fear) at -10 in any personally dangerous situation.
MIND DISEASE.6: Target has a fear of a specific type of thing the caster chooses. The target has a 25+(three times his SD stat bonus)% chance of maintaining control around the feared thing. If the target fails to control himself, he has a 25% chance of fleeing from the object of fear (moving at maximum pace to get away from it), otherwise (75% of the time) he will avoid the object of fear at all costs.
MIND DISEASE.7: Target develops a tendency to hallucinate and see things as they are not. For each major event in a day, the target has a 10% chance of hallucinating and seeing major threats as nothing major and minor things as major threats (similar to the syndrome that Don Quixote suffered from).
MIND DISEASE.8: Target develops a second personality with different values. There is a 10% chance per day that the second personality will become active (at a random time during the day). The GM should select d10 character traits that must be extremely different from the target’s.
MIND DISEASE.9: Target has a psychosis about a specific type of thing of the caster’s choosing. The target has a 50% chance (modified by three times Self Discipline stat bonus) of maintaining control around the object of his psychosis. If the target fails to control himself, he will blindly attack the object (attempting to destroy it at all costs) 20% of the time, avoiding it the rest of the time. If avoidance is not possible, the reaction will be violent.
MIND DISEASE.10: Target drifts in and out of a catatonic state. Every hour there is a 25% chance he will become catatonic for one hour.
MIND DISEASE.11: As Insomnia, except target can only sleep if he uses drugs or spells to induce sleep. He adds +100 to his RRs against all sleep spells. If he gets no sleep, he will slowly go mad (GM’s discretion on the specifics).
MIND DISEASE.12: As Neurosis, except that the base chance of overcoming the neurosis is 25%.
MIND DISEASE.13: As Guilt, except every day that he fails an RR (against the original level of this spell), the target must take actions to atone for his guilt (or sink into a deep depression).
MIND DISEASE.14: Target becomes tempted to steal things at every opportunity. It does not matter if the target even actually wants the things. The target has a chance of maintaining control equal to 25+(three times his SD stat bonus)%. If the target does not maintain control, he will steal something every time there is an opportunity. (Check no more often than once per hour.)
MIND DISEASE.15: Target will trust no one absolutely. When in a life threatening/ dangerous situation, there is a 50% chance (modified by three times Self Discipline stat bonus) that the target will not trust the protection of others and will act unilaterally for self-preservation.
MIND DISEASE.16: Target becomes tempted to set fires at every opportunity. He will also take great pleasure in watching things burn, so this may tip off his companions. The target has a chance of maintaining control equal to 25+(three times his SD stat bonus)%. If the target does not maintain control, he will set something on fire. Check once per day; additional checks may be necessary if exceptional fire-setting opportunities arise.
MIND DISEASE.17: As Paranoia, except target will not associate with anyone for longer than one hour per day.
MIND DISEASE.19: As Psychosis, except that the base chance of overcoming the psychosis is 10%.
MIND DISEASE.20: As Split Personality, except the second personality is active 50% of the time.
MIND DISEASE.25: As Split Personality, except target develops d10+1 extra personalities (Multiple Personality Disorder). There is a 10% chance per day that a non-active personality will become active.
MIND DISEASE.30: As Catatonia, except every hour there is a 95% chance target will be catatonic.
MIND DISEASE.40: Target suffers from one of the lower level spells on this list, but which one changes each day. This makes any attempt to treat the target through non-magical means suffer a -50 penalty.
MIND DISEASE.50: Target may be given any mental disease that the caster chooses.

MIND DOMINATION.1: Target is distracted by an imaginary object. For the duration of this spell, the target wastes 1 AP on this distraction each round.
MIND DOMINATION.2: Caster and target are locked in mental contact until: the caster cancels the spell or the spell is dispelled or either the caster or the target has an RR failure of 30 or greater (both the caster and the target must make RRs against each other every round). The one failing by 30 becomes unconscious. While this spell is active, neither the caster nor the target can take any action.
MIND DOMINATION.3: As Mind Lock, except while target cannot take any action during the mental struggle, the caster may act as normal, within the restrictions of maintaining concentration.
MIND DOMINATION.4: The next Type “Fm” spell cast by the caster of this spell (cast within one minute of completing this spell) will have a special RR penalty of -10.
MIND DOMINATION.5: Target is controlled by a Type I Demon. The target may make an additional RR once per day (attack level equals Demon level) to regain control. The Demon is random, maniacal, and homicidal.
MIND DOMINATION.6: Target’s “soul” and the caster’s “soul” are interchanged; the caster can operate at half of his normal activity (double all AP costs as with concentration) while in the body of the target. The target (in the caster’s body) is inactive. The caster can cancel the spell at any time (takes one round). The target can cancel the spell if he makes a successful RR (he gets one every 10 minutes). If either body is killed, both “souls” are destroyed.
MIND DOMINATION.7: As Mind Invasion, except for range and the caster gains a +10 to his RRs.
MIND DOMINATION.8: Target must obey the caster. If the caster gives an order to do something completely alien to the target, he may make another RR with a +25 modification.
MIND DOMINATION.9: An intelligent magic item becomes submissive to the caster’s will and will obey the caster completely. If the item successfully resists, another attempt to dominate the item cannot be made until the caster gains a rank in this spell list.
MIND DOMINATION.10: As Demonic Possession I, except Demon is Type II.
MIND DOMINATION.11: As Domination, except target is a zombie until he succeeds in his once per day RR. On any round that the caster concentrates, the target must obey him.
MIND DOMINATION.12: The next Type “Fm” spell cast by the caster of this spell (cast within one minute of completing this spell) will have a special RR penalty of -25.
MIND DOMINATION.13: As Mind Slave, except target’s “mind/ essence/soul” is in agony and any round that the caster does not concentrate, the target will obey anyone’s verbal commands. Conflicting commands mean the target does nothing.
MIND DOMINATION.14: As Lesser Object Domination, except for duration.
MIND DOMINATION.15: As Demonic Possession I, except Demon is Type III.
MIND DOMINATION.16: As Domination, except the target must perform a single, straightforward task. The task may take the target out of range of the caster and the target must still attempt to complete the task.
MIND DOMINATION.17: As Lesser Object Domination, except for duration.
MIND DOMINATION.18: As Mind Slave, except the target only gets an RR once per week.
MIND DOMINATION.19: As Demonic Possession I, except Demon is Type IV.
MIND DOMINATION.20: As Mind Slave, except caster need not concentrate to command the target.
MIND DOMINATION.25: As Demonic Possession I, except Demon is Type V.
MIND DOMINATION.30: As Transferral, except target only gets his additional RRs once per month and every time he fails his chance to successfully resist decreases by 1 and the caster may operate normally in the target’s body.
MIND DOMINATION.35: The next Type “Fm” spell cast by the caster of this spell (cast within one minute of completing this spell) will have a special RR penalty of -50.
MIND DOMINATION.40: As Demonic Possession I, except Demon is Type VI.
MIND DOMINATION.50: As Oppression, except target only gets his RRs once per month and every time he fails his chance to successfully resist decreases by 1.

MIND EROSION.1: Target suffers a -1 penalty to one of his mental stats. The penalty applies to the stat bonus, not the stat itself. The mental stats are: Presence, Empathy, Intuition, Memory, Reasoning, and Self Discipline. The stat that suffers the penalty is determined randomly.
MIND EROSION.2: Target is mentally bewildered. Each round, he has only a 50% chance of making a decision. He will always defend himself from direct attack.
MIND EROSION.3: Target immediately loses 10% of his remaining Power Points (PP). They may be recovered normally.
MIND EROSION.4: As Dull Mind I, except penalty is -2.
MIND EROSION.5: As Dull Mind I, except stat influenced is determined by the caster.
MIND EROSION.6: As Power Leak I, except 20% of remaining PP are lost.
MIND EROSION.7: As Dull Mind I, except penalty is -3.
MIND EROSION.8: As Power Leak I, except 30% of remaining PP are lost.
MIND EROSION.9: As Dull Mind I, except penalty is -4.
MIND EROSION.10: As Mind Erosion I, except penalty is -2.
MIND EROSION.11: As Power Leak I, except 40% of remaining PP are lost.
MIND EROSION.12: As Dull Mind I, except penalty is -5.
MIND EROSION.13: As Power Leak I, except 50% of remaining PP are lost.
MIND EROSION.14: As Dull Mind I, except penalty is -6.
MIND EROSION.15: As Mind Erosion I, except penalty is -3.
MIND EROSION.16: As Power Leak I, except 60% of remaining PP are lost.
MIND EROSION.17: As Dull Mind I, except penalty is -7.
MIND EROSION.18: As Mind Erosion I, except penalty is -4.
MIND EROSION.19: As Power Leak I, except 70% of remaining PP are lost.
MIND EROSION.20: As Dull Mind I, except penalty is -8.
MIND EROSION.25: As Power Leak I, except 90% of remaining PP are lost.
MIND EROSION.30: As Dull Mind I, except penalty is -10.
MIND EROSION.35: As Mind Erosion I, except penalty is -6.
MIND EROSION.40: As Mind Erosion I, except penalty is -8.
MIND EROSION.50: As Mind Erosion I, except penalty is -10.

MIND ILLUSIONS.1: All text that the target attempts to read will appear jumbled (and is indecipherable).
MIND ILLUSIONS.2: The target believes that he is very ill (or sicker than he actually is). The GM should base the severity of the “imaginary” illness upon the amount the target fails his RR by (e.g., if he fails his RR by more than 50, he might think he is terminally ill).
MIND ILLUSIONS.3: Target will perceive something incorrectly through one of his senses. For example, he might see something out of the corner of his eye, or hear something that is not there. The sensory effect cannot last longer than one round.
MIND ILLUSIONS.4: Target’s perception is skewed. All Awareness maneuvers are modified by -10.
MIND ILLUSIONS.5: The target is attacked by a creature of shadow. The creature is actually a hallucination and only the target sees the creature. The creature will immediately attack the target (in melee). The creature has the same DB, OB, and Hits as the target (use the target’s highest melee OB as the creature’s OB), but AT is always 1. If the caster casts spells upon himself, the creature acts as if affected by the same spell. The creature is immune to spell attacks. If the creature is slain (by killing or incapacitating it), the spell is cancelled. Creature uses same attack table as target, but damage is not real. However, if damage would render target dead or unconscious if real, target falls unconscious for the remainder of the spell’s duration.
MIND ILLUSIONS.6: Target will view things as if he were in a dream. His reactions are slowed (he suffers a -10 to all actions). In addition, he will sometimes perceive things differently than they actually are. The GM should roll for each event that occurs with a 10% chance that the event is mistaken. For example, the target might see an approaching horse as a large wild animal; or he might see the charging Orc as a messenger bringing news. Note that the caster has no control over what the target perceives or how he perceives it.
MIND ILLUSIONS.7: Target will believe that the next person he sees is someone else. At the time of casting, the caster chooses what type of person the target sees. For example, he might see a servant entering the palace gate instead of the skulking figure. If the next person attacks the target, the effects of this spell are cancelled.
MIND ILLUSIONS.8: As Misleading I, except penalty is -30.
MIND ILLUSIONS.9: As False Sense I, except affects up to 2 senses and the effect can last for up to 2 rounds.
MIND ILLUSIONS.10: As Lesser Phantom, except the creature has an AT of 3.
MIND ILLUSIONS.11: As Waking Dream I, except actions suffer a -20 penalty, and the chance of perceiving things incorrectly is 20%.
MIND ILLUSIONS.12: As Misleading I, except penalty is -50.
MIND ILLUSIONS.13: As False Sense I, except affects up to 3 senses and the effect can last for up to 3 rounds.
MIND ILLUSIONS.14: As Mistaken Identity I, except target mistakes the next person he sees for a specific person. For example, he might see the Chamberlain entering the throne room, instead of a burglar.
MIND ILLUSIONS.15: As Lesser Phantom, except the creature has an AT of 5.
MIND ILLUSIONS.16: As False Sense I, except affects up to 4 senses and the effect can last for up to 4 rounds.
MIND ILLUSIONS.17: As Misleading I, except penalty is -70.
MIND ILLUSIONS.18: As Waking Dream I, except actions suffer a -30 penalty, and the chance of perceiving things incorrectly is 30%.
MIND ILLUSIONS.19: As False Sense I, except affects up to 5 senses and the effect can last for up to 5 rounds.
MIND ILLUSIONS.20: As Lesser Phantom, except the creature has an AT of 7.
MIND ILLUSIONS.25: As Misleading I, except penalty is -100.
MIND ILLUSIONS.30: As Mistaken Identity I, except the target will permanently confuse the next person he sees with someone else. Each time he sees that person, there is a 50% chance that he will mistake that person for someone else.
MIND ILLUSIONS.35: As False Sense I, except affects as many senses as the target has and the effect can last for up to 20 rounds.
MIND ILLUSIONS.40: As Lesser Phantom, except the creature has an AT of 10.
MIND ILLUSIONS.50: As Waking Dream I, except actions suffer a -40 penalty, the chance of perceiving things incorrectly is 40%, and the effects are permanent.

MIND SUBVERSION.1: Target suspects the actions of his associates (GM may give descriptions that arouse the player’s own suspicions).
MIND SUBVERSION.2: One of the target’s personality traits is perverted (that trait is taken to an extreme). If the target already has a tendency in one direction, it will be taken to an extreme: if spending habits were affected, a thrifty fellow would become a miser, while a generous spender would become a spendthrift. However, someone may still have a middle of the road trait affected, in which case it might go to either extreme (e.g., someone not particularly brave or cautious could become cowardly or reckless).
MIND SUBVERSION.3: Target has a 20% chance of lying anytime he makes a statement.
MIND SUBVERSION.4: As Trait Subversion I, except 2 traits may be perverted.
MIND SUBVERSION.5: Target will attempt to cheat on all matters (e.g., splitting loot, card games, etc.).
MIND SUBVERSION.6: Target has urges to commit minor property damage. When such an opportunity arives, there is a 60% chance the target must attempt to commit such damage.
MIND SUBVERSION.7: Target becomes a sneak thief and has a 10% chance of attempting to steal anything that catches his fancy (if it does not involve violence).
MIND SUBVERSION.8: As Trait Subversion I, except 3 traits may be perverted.
MIND SUBVERSION.9: Target becomes fascinated with subtle damage that endangers others. Every time he is alone with someone else’s things, he has a 50% chance of cutting ropes partway through, punching small holes in waterskins, loosening saddles, etc.
MIND SUBVERSION.10: As Stealing, except target will use violence to steal.
MIND SUBVERSION.11: As Trait Subversion I, except 5 traits may be perverted.
MIND SUBVERSION.12: As Trait Subversion I, except a different trait will be affected each day (with the previous day’s trait reverting back to its normal state).
MIND SUBVERSION.13: There is a 5% chance the target will assault any given person when he initially encounters him (the target must actually meet the person, not merely pass him on the street).
MIND SUBVERSION.14: Target will become bent on avenging even minor disputes with the setting of fires. There is a 40% chance that he will attempt to set on fire goods or a building belonging to anyone with whom he has even the slightest quarrel.
MIND SUBVERSION.15: As Trait Subversion I, except 7 traits may be perverted.
MIND SUBVERSION.16: As Random Trait Subversion I, except two traits are affected at one time.
MIND SUBVERSION.17: As Assault, except there is a 10% chance that the target will attempt to maim any given person.
MIND SUBVERSION.18: As Trait Subversion I, except 10 traits may be perverted.
MIND SUBVERSION.19: As Random Trait Subversion I, except three traits are affected at one time.
MIND SUBVERSION.20: As Assault, except target attempts to kill.
MIND SUBVERSION.25: As Assault, except target will take note of a person and plan to assassinate him later. This spell will last until the target has made an assassination attempt on a target.
MIND SUBVERSION.30: As Trait Subversion I, except duration is permanent.
MIND SUBVERSION.35: As Assassination, except each assassination attempt will only allow a new RR against this spell. If the RR fails, a new victim will be selected and another assassination attempt will be made, continuing until an RR is successfully made.
MIND SUBVERSION.40: As any spell on this list of up to 25th level, except effects may be delayed until some trigger occurs (a word is spoken in the target’s presence, the target visits some location, the next full moon rises, etc.). The effects may wait years until being triggered; the triggered spell’s duration is based on the RR failure to this spell, where applicable.
MIND SUBVERSION.50: Whenever the target is injured, suffers humiliation, or fails in something, he will attempt suicide in some imaginative way.

BLOOD WAYS.1: Stops bleeding on a wound that is bleeding at rate of up to 2 hits/round. For one hour, the caster can engage in no activity more vigorous than walking or bleeding will resume at the prior rate.
BLOOD WAYS.2: Instantly stops bleeding from 1 wound that bleeds at rate of 1 hit/round.
BLOOD WAYS.3: A flesh wound or skin/tissue injury that incurs a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll, and the recovery period is reduced to hours rather than days. Note that this treats wounds that incur injury penalties, but does not treat bleeding.
BLOOD WAYS.4: As Clotting II, except caster can heal a wound bleeding up to 5 hits/round.
BLOOD WAYS.5: Instantly stops bleeding from 1 wound that bleeds at rate of up to 3 hits/round.
BLOOD WAYS.6: As Light Flesh Healing, except a wound that incurs a penalty up to -40.
BLOOD WAYS.7: Caster can reattach 1 severed limb; it requires the use of the other 3 Healer Joining spells in order to make limb fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
BLOOD WAYS.8: Stops bleeding on a wound that is bleeding at any rate. For one hour, the caster can engage in no activity more vigorous than walking or bleeding will resume at the prior rate.
BLOOD WAYS.9: As Light Flesh Healing, except a wound that incurs any penalty.
BLOOD WAYS.10: Instantly stops bleeding from 1 wound regardless of bleeding rate.
BLOOD WAYS.11: Adjusts caster’s blood contents to prepare for exertions. All Endurance rolls made while this spell is in effect are made with a +50 bonus.
BLOOD WAYS.12: As Clotting II, except caster can heal bleeding in multiple wounds up to a total hits/round of bleeding equal to his level.
BLOOD WAYS.13: As Medium Flesh Healing, except up to one wound per level.
BLOOD WAYS.14: Caster can instantly stop bleeding from multiple wounds up to a total hits/round of bleeding equal to his level.
BLOOD WAYS.15: As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Healer Joining True spells and recovery is instantaneous.
BLOOD WAYS.16: A flesh wound or skin/tissue injury that incurs a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll, and the recovery period is reduced to rounds rather than days.
BLOOD WAYS.17: As Severe Flesh Healing, except up to one wound per level.
BLOOD WAYS.18: As Light Flesh Healing True, except a wound that incurs a penalty up to -40.
BLOOD WAYS.19: Caster must take a full day in a healing trance to use this spell, which will cleanse the body of accumulated toxins and other ills. Caster physically becomes 5 years younger (to a minimum of half the caster’s true age).
BLOOD WAYS.20: Caster can regulate his own blood flow and completely eliminate any blood loss without fear of harm. The duration of this spell is for as long as the caster is immobile. He can cast other spells, although spells not listed as subconscious take the normal penalties for casting a spell without words or gestures.
BLOOD WAYS.25: As Light Flesh Healing True, except a wound that incurs any penalty.
BLOOD WAYS.30: Caster can regrow 1 lost limb; requires use of the other 3 Healer Regrow Limb spells in order to make limb fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
BLOOD WAYS.35: As Severe Flesh Healing True, except up to one wound per level.
BLOOD WAYS.40: Caster must take a full day in a healing trance to use this spell, which will cleanse the body of accumulated toxins and other ills. Caster physically becomes 10 years younger (to a minimum of one third the caster’s true age).
BLOOD WAYS.50: Caster can use any 1 of the lower spells on this list in a given round at will.

BONE WAYS.1: An injury to cartilage incurring a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll and the recovery period is reduced to hours rather than days.
BONE WAYS.2: As Light Cartilage Healing, except an injury to bone other than the skull incurring a penalty up to -20.
BONE WAYS.3: As Light Cartilage Healing, except a cartilage injury incurring a penalty up to -40.
BONE WAYS.4: As Light Cartilage Healing, except an injury to the skull incurring a penalty up to -20.
BONE WAYS.5: As Light Cartilage Healing, except an injury to bone other than the skull incurring a penalty up to -40.
BONE WAYS.6: As Light Cartilage Healing, except a cartilage injury incurring any penalty.
BONE WAYS.7: Caster can reattach 1 severed limb; it requires the use of the other 3 Healer Joining spells in order to make limb fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
BONE WAYS.8: As Light Cartilage Healing, except an injury to the skull incurring a penalty up to -40.
BONE WAYS.9: As Light Cartilage Healing, except an injury to bone other than the skull incurring any penalty.
BONE WAYS.10: As Medium Cartilage Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
BONE WAYS.11: As Light Cartilage Healing, except an injury to the skull incurring any penalty.
BONE WAYS.12: As Medium Osseous Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
BONE WAYS.13: As Light Skull Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
BONE WAYS.14: Caster can regenerate any 1 bone that is not part of the skull. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
BONE WAYS.15: As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Healer Joining True spells and recovery is instantaneous.
BONE WAYS.16: As Medium Skull Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
BONE WAYS.17: As Severe Cartilage Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
BONE WAYS.18: Caster’s skull regenerates. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
BONE WAYS.19: As Severe Osseous Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
BONE WAYS.20: As Severe Skull Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
BONE WAYS.25: Any number of injuries to bone (including the skull) and cartilage up to the caster’s level are cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, and the caster receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll.
BONE WAYS.30: Caster can regrow 1 lost limb; requires use of the other 3 Healer Regrow Limb spells in order to make limb fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
BONE WAYS.35: Caster can regenerate any 1 bone that is not part of the skull. Recovery is instantaneous.
BONE WAYS.40: As Mass Skeletal Relief, and the recovery time is reduced from days to hours.
BONE WAYS.50: Caster can regenerate all of the lost bone and/or cartilage in his body; recovery is instantaneous.

CLEANSING.1: Caster taps into the mind of a target to diagnose the target’s wounds, injuries, and diseases allowing a +25 bonus to all Medicine maneuvers made by the caster to treat the target’s diagnosed condition(s). Caster can take a round to advise someone else on treating the target, providing a +15 bonus to treat the target.
CLEANSING.2: Caster transfers one injury, wound, state of death, soul departure (not soul destruction), disease, or poison from the target to himself. With an Easy Spell Mastery maneuver, the caster may elect to only transfer certain components of an injury to himself, but he cannot break up an individual component of the injury (e.g., if an injury has done 18 hits, a round of Stun (-50), 2 hits/round of bleeding, and inflicted a -30 penalty, the caster might elect to transfer the Stun or bleeding as the most urgent components, and leave the target with 18 hits of damage and a -30 penalty; the caster could not, however, choose to only transfer 12 of the hits or 1 hit/round of bleeding, or -20 worth of penalty). The caster immediately suffers all effects transferred, while the target is immediately and completely cured of all such effects. However, if the caster would be killed by the transferred damage, they go into a coma and death is delayed for one minute (during which time subconscious healing spells may be cast to prevent death from occurring at all).
CLEANSING.3: Caster transfers one mental illness or addiction from the target to himself.
CLEANSING.4: One poison or disease is totally removed from the caster’s system. This does not undo any damage already done by the poison or disease, which must be cured separately.
CLEANSING.6: Caster cleanses his system of one addiction. There is a recovery period of 1-10 weeks during which minor withdrawal symptoms will cause the caster a -10 penalty to all actions.
CLEANSING.7: Caster transfers one curse from the target to himself.
CLEANSING.8: As Transference, except that it this is an instantaneous spell.
CLEANSING.9: [RR Mod.: -10] Caster rids himself of one curse. If the curse makes its RR, the caster cannot try again to remove it until he has gained a rank in this list. (Note that if the caster has a different curse removal spell from a different list, then he does get a second chance with that spell.)
CLEANSING.10: Caster is cured of one mental illness or malady. This will require a 1-10 day recovery period to take effect.
CLEANSING.12: For the caster’s next Transference spell, cast within one round/level of casting this spell, he may instead transfer the affliction to another (willing) target with a range of touch.
CLEANSING.13: Caster may suspend all life functions from his body, effectively entering suspended animation for the duration of the spell or until a fixed specified time has passed or a specified triggering event occurs (e.g., body brought to a specific person). While suspended the caster does not age, require food, water, or air, nor will any herbs work on his body although healing spells may continue to be used, but no further harm will come to him from any injury, toxin, curse, etc. until life resumes. The caster is not protected from further harm by external causes.
CLEANSING.14: As Diagnostics, except each round caster may target any one individual within range of this spell.
CLEANSING.15: Caster may transfer any number of afflictions from 1 target.
CLEANSING.16: Caster cleanses his system of one addiction. There is a recovery period of 1-10 days during which minor withdrawal symptoms will cause the caster a -10 penalty to all actions.
CLEANSING.17: All poisons and diseases are totally removed from the caster’s system. This does not undo any damage already done by a poison or disease, which must be cured separately.
CLEANSING.18: Caster is instantly cured of one mental illness or malady.
CLEANSING.19: As Suspend Life, except for duration.
CLEANSING.20: [RR Mod.: -50] As Curse Cure, except curse’s RR is at a -50 penalty.
CLEANSING.25: Caster cleanses his system of one addiction. There is a recovery period of 1-10 hours during which minor withdrawal symptoms will cause the caster a -10 penalty to all actions.
CLEANSING.30: Caster may transfer up to 1 condition/ level to himself from any number of targets within range. A condition in this context is a wound, injury, disease, poison, curse, mental illness, or addiction.
CLEANSING.35: Caster transfers one possessing demon, spirit, soul, or like entitity from the target to himself.
CLEANSING.40: [RR Mod.: -35] Caster expels one possessing demon, spirit, soul, or like entity from his person. If this fails, the caster cannot cast this spell again for 1-10 days, though he will get whatever normal RRs may be allowed to resist/expel the possessing entity.
CLEANSING.50: Caster may use 1 spell from this list per round.

MUSCLE WAYS.1: An injury to tendons incurring any penalty is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, and the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll.
MUSCLE WAYS.2: As Severe Tendon Relief, except an injury to a muscle.
MUSCLE WAYS.3: An injury to tendons incurring a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll and the recovery period is reduced to hours rather than days.
MUSCLE WAYS.4: As Light Tendon Healing, except an injury to a muscle incurring a penalty up to -20.
MUSCLE WAYS.5: As Light Tendon Healing, except an injury to a tendon incurring a penalty up to -40.
MUSCLE WAYS.6: As Light Tendon Healing, except an injury to a muscle incurring a penalty up to -40.
MUSCLE WAYS.7: Caster can reattach 1 severed limb; it requires the use of the other 3 Healer Joining spells in order to make limb fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
MUSCLE WAYS.8: As Light Tendon Healing, except an injury to a tendon incurring any penalty.
MUSCLE WAYS.9: As Light Tendon Healing, except an injury to a muscle incurring any penalty.
MUSCLE WAYS.10: As Light Tendon Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
MUSCLE WAYS.11: As Light Muscular Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
MUSCLE WAYS.12: Caster can regenerate any 1 tendon. The recovery time is 1-10 hours.
MUSCLE WAYS.13: As Medium Tendon Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
MUSCLE WAYS.14: As Medium Muscular Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
MUSCLE WAYS.15: As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Healer Joining True spells and recovery is instantaneous.
MUSCLE WAYS.16: Caster can regenerate any one muscle (other than the heart). The recovery time is 1-10 hours.
MUSCLE WAYS.17: As Severe Tendon Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
MUSCLE WAYS.18: As Severe Muscular Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
MUSCLE WAYS.19: As Severe Tendon Healing, except it affects all tendon injuries.
MUSCLE WAYS.20: As Severe Muscular Healing, except it affects all muscle injuries.
MUSCLE WAYS.25: Caster can regenerate all of the muscles and/or tendons in his body (other than the heart). The recovery time is 1-10 hours.
MUSCLE WAYS.30: Caster can regrow 1 lost limb; requires use of the other 3 Healer Regrow Limb spells in order to make limb fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
MUSCLE WAYS.35: As Mass Tendon Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
MUSCLE WAYS.40: As Mass Muscular Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
MUSCLE WAYS.50: Caster can repair or regenerate a number of damaged muscles and/or tendons equal to his level. Recovery is instantaneous.

ORGAN WAYS.1: An injury to an organ (e.g. eye, ear, liver, but not the brain or nerves) incurring a penalty up to 20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, and the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll.
ORGAN WAYS.2: As Light Organ Relief, but an injury incurring a penalty up to -40. This can be used to cure most causes of infertility (if the requisite organs are still present).
ORGAN WAYS.3: As Light Organ Relief, but an injury incurring any penalty.
ORGAN WAYS.4: Caster’s heart will start beating after having stopped. This does not repair any heart disease or damage that caused the initial stoppage.
ORGAN WAYS.5: Caster regains function in one sensory organ, so long as that sensory organ has not been completely destroyed (in which case Organ Regeneration is required). The recovery time is 1-10 hours.
ORGAN WAYS.6: As Light Organ Relief, except the recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
ORGAN WAYS.7: Caster can reattach 1 severed limb; it requires the use of the other 3 Healer Joining spells in order to make limb fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
ORGAN WAYS.8: Caster comes out of a coma or unconsciousness caused by injury, disease, poison, spell, or spell failure.
ORGAN WAYS.9: As Medium Organ Relief, except the recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
ORGAN WAYS.10: As Sense Restoration, except recovery is instantaneous.
ORGAN WAYS.11: As Severe Organ Relief, except the recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
ORGAN WAYS.12: Removes any paralysis problem suffered by the caster. The recovery time is 1-10 days. Treat as -100 injury for progress of recovery.
ORGAN WAYS.13: As Light Organ Relief, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds rather than days.
ORGAN WAYS.14: As Light Organ Relief, except an injury to nerves incurring a penalty up to -20, and the recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
ORGAN WAYS.15: As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Healer Joining True spells and recovery is instantaneous.
ORGAN WAYS.16: As Medium Organ Relief, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds rather than days.
ORGAN WAYS.17: As Light Nerve Healing, except an injury to nerves incurring a penalty up to -40.
ORGAN WAYS.18: As Severe Organ Relief, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds rather than days.
ORGAN WAYS.19: As Light Nerve Healing, except an injury to nerves incurring any penalty.
ORGAN WAYS.20: Caster can repair brain damage (such as that caused by a skull fracture, etc. at the discretion of the GM). Recovery time is 1-10 hours. This includes damage from the Mind Death spell list.
ORGAN WAYS.25: Caster can regenerate any 1 organ (external or internal), except the brain. The recovery time is 1-10 hours.
ORGAN WAYS.30: Caster can regrow 1 lost limb; requires use of the other 3 Healer Regrow Limb spells in order to make limb fully functional. The recovery time is 1-10 days.
ORGAN WAYS.35: As Paralysis Cures, except recovery is instantaneous.
ORGAN WAYS.40: As Brain Repair, except instantly provides complete recovery, taking data stored in caster’s or original victim’s aura to reconstruct the brain exactly.
ORGAN WAYS.50: Caster may reunite his soul with his body, provided the latter is functional. To restore a dead target to life, a Healer would first have to heal all of the latter’s wounds (without “killing” himself) and then restore the target’s soul by giving up his own (for the target this process operates like the 19th level Lifegiving II spell on the Cleric Base list, Life Mastery). While technically alive, but without his soul, the Healer would be affected as if he had been “absolved” (see Cleric Base list, Channels); thus, he could take no conscious actions and he would be at -75 for all subconscious actions. The caster may regain his own soul through the use of this spell (which does not suffer the -75 penalty) or through someone else casting an appropriate spell.

SURFACE WAYS.1: Caster is healed of 10 concussion hits.
SURFACE WAYS.2: Removes up to -30 in penalties from fatigue.
SURFACE WAYS.3: Caster is relieved of 1 round’s worth of accumulated stun effects.
SURFACE WAYS.4: Reduces damage by 2 hits every round as long as caster concentrates; if caster is unconscious, this spell will operate without concentration.
SURFACE WAYS.5: An injury from burns, chemical burns, scalding, or frostbite incurring a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll and the recovery period is reduced to hours rather than days.
SURFACE WAYS.7: Caster is healed of 25 concussion hits.
SURFACE WAYS.8: As Light Burn/ Frostbite Healing, except an injury incurring a penalty up to 40.
SURFACE WAYS.9: Caster is relieved of 3 rounds’ worth of accumulated stun effects.
SURFACE WAYS.10: As Regeneration I, except 4 hits are healed every round.
SURFACE WAYS.11: As Light Burn/Frostbite Healing, except an injury incurring any penalty.
SURFACE WAYS.12: Caster is healed of 50 concussion hits.
SURFACE WAYS.13: Caster is relieved of 5 rounds’ worth of accumulated stun effects.
SURFACE WAYS.14: An injury from burns, chemical burns, scalding, or frostbite incurring a penalty up to -20 is cleaned, protected, and bound as effectively as if a successful Medicine maneuver was performed, the target receives a +50 bonus on their recovery roll and the recovery period is reduced to rounds rather than days.
SURFACE WAYS.15: As Regeneration I, except 6 hits are healed every round.
SURFACE WAYS.16: As Medium Burn/Frostbite Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
SURFACE WAYS.17: Caster is healed of 75 concussion hits.
SURFACE WAYS.18: As Severe Burn/ Frostbite Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to hours rather than days.
SURFACE WAYS.19: Caster is relieved of 10 rounds’ worth of accumulated stun effects.
SURFACE WAYS.20: Caster is healed of 100 concussion hits.
SURFACE WAYS.25: Caster is healed of all concussion hit damage.
SURFACE WAYS.30: As Severe Burn/Frostbite Healing, except affecting all such injuries.
SURFACE WAYS.35: As Mass Burn/ Frostbite Healing, except the recovery time is reduced to rounds.
SURFACE WAYS.40: Caster is relieved of all accumulated stun effects.
SURFACE WAYS.50: Caster is instantly relieved of all accumulated stun effects, concussion hit damage, fatigue penalties, and wounds due to burn, chemical burn, scalding, or frostbite.

CONFUSING WAYS.1: Target is at -30 for all actions.
CONFUSING WAYS.2: Target is incapable of making decisions or initiating action, but may continue to fight current foes or in self-defense. The target may also follow orders from the target’s leader (if any), but will only be able to follow them so long as no ambiguities arise.
CONFUSING WAYS.3: Target has a -100 OB modification for missile attacks and a -50 penalty for all other actions involving sight.
CONFUSING WAYS.4: Target fears caster and attempts to flee. (This does not involve a Fear RR or the usual fear mechanics. Use a normal Essence or Mentalism RR and the result is flight for the specified duration.)
CONFUSING WAYS.5: Target becomes unbalanced. If the target is moving, the target trips and falls (prone and stunned (-50) for 1-5 rounds); any maneuver that the target was performing when affected by this spell automatically fails.
CONFUSING WAYS.6: As Stumble, except target also fumbles any weapon or item currently held; roll on the appropriate RMCL Chapter 11 Fumble Table.
CONFUSING WAYS.7: Target sees a nonexistent foe and must fight this foe until it is “defeated” (i.e., takes damage that would drop the target). Foe has same capabilities as target but does no damage (i.e., always misses).
CONFUSING WAYS.8: Target is spun about a few times, ending up facing 180° away from his original facing, then spends the rest of the round recovering from the disorientation.
CONFUSING WAYS.9: Target perceives the target’s weapon(s) as changed into some other similar weapon(s), which lacks the right balance even if familiar to the target. Target will only have half normal OB with the weapon(s) so long as this delusion remains in effect.
CONFUSING WAYS.10: Target sees all moving things clearly, but the caster can control the fixed scene that the target “sees”.
CONFUSING WAYS.12: Target sees moving things shifted between 6" and 18" from where they really are; any attack the target makes against a moving foe has a 50% chance of having no effect.
CONFUSING WAYS.13: A number of targets equal to the caster’s level can be distracted as in Distraction; they must all be in the caster’s field of vision.
CONFUSING WAYS.14: As Fear, except the spell is instantaneous and the duration is 1 minute per 5 failure.
CONFUSING WAYS.15: Target has amnesia, but loses no skills or abilities. This is a loss of personal memories and knowledge of own identity and background.
CONFUSING WAYS.16: As Confusion, except the spell is instantaneous and all beings (other than the caster) within an area encompassed by a radius of 50' are targets.
CONFUSING WAYS.17: As any single spell from this list of no more than 10th level, except the range is increased to 300'.
CONFUSING WAYS.18: As Fear, except the spell is instantaneous and the duration is 1 minute per 5 failure and all beings (other than the caster) within a fifty foot radius are targets.
CONFUSING WAYS.19: As Weapon Alteration, except target must also make an RR each round or fumble his weapon. If the target is using two weapons, he must make a separate RR for each weapon and may fumble twice in a round due to the spell. He may still fumble normally if he gets to make an attack.
CONFUSING WAYS.20: As any single spell from this list of no more than 10th level, except affects up to 20 targets.
CONFUSING WAYS.25: As Amnesia, except duration is permanent (unless dispelled).
CONFUSING WAYS.30: Target sees and hears a world in which everything real has an image, but the image is changed or distorted (e.g., a Dwarf might seem to be an Elf, a house might seem to be a cave, etc.).
CONFUSING WAYS.35: As Amnesia, except the spell is instantaneous and all beings (other than the caster) within an area encompassed by a radius of 50' are targets.
CONFUSING WAYS.40: As any single spell from this list of no more than 10th level, except the range is increased to 300' and it affects up to one target per level of the caster.
CONFUSING WAYS.50: As any single spell from this list of no more than 20th level, except affects up to one target per level of the caster and the range is 300'.

GAS ALTERATION.1: Condenses 1 cubic foot of water from the surrounding air. Condensation can be channeled into any suitable receptacle, including caster’s cupped hands.
GAS ALTERATION.2: Creates a wall of dense churning air up to 10'x10'x3'. This wall requires 1 AP to cross, the pace of anyone moving through it at more than a Walk comes out with his pace reduced by one (e.g, a Run going in would be a Jog coming out), and attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty. See Section 10.20 for additional details on Wall spells.
GAS ALTERATION.3: Creates very dense fog in a 20' radius; normal visibility is 1'.
