In either case, the caster gains a +30 bonus to his relevant Crafting maneuver(s). Use of this spell eliminates the risk of poisoning oneself while working with the poison.
FLUID SKILLS.5: Allows caster to work with non-magical, non-toxic gasses to create an enchanted item (normally a gaseous potion). All required tools and material must be present. Alternatively, this spell can be used to work on a non-magical gas without enchanting it, in which case the caster can do the work in half the normal time. In either case, the caster gains a +30 bonus to his relevant Crafting maneuver(s).
FLUID SKILLS.6: Allows caster to create a potion into which an herb is dissolved at the beginning of the enchanting process. The potion will provide the effects of the herb upon consumption and with no delay. If this is to be the only quality of the potion, the only other spell needed is a Work spell for the potion’s base liquid (or gas).
FLUID SKILLS.7: Allows caster to create a potion which will cause the imbiber to instantly recover 20% of their maximum PP (but not more than they have expended), if the imbiber uses the Realm of Essence only. (Make Potion is not required, since no spell will be embedded.)
FLUID SKILLS.8: By casting this spell in conjunction with a Make Potion spell, the caster creates a powder that can later be reconstituted as a regular potion by mixing with a small amount of liquid. The amount of powder is quite small, about what you would get by pulverizing two aspirin.
FLUID SKILLS.9: As Make Potion III, except 6 levels of spells.
FLUID SKILLS.10: As Work Poison I, except that the poison may be of up to 10th level potency.
FLUID SKILLS.11: Allows caster to work with non-toxic magical liquids to create an enchanted item (normally a potion). All required tools and material must be present. Alternatively, this spell can be used to work on a magical liquid without enchanting it, in which case the caster can do the work in half the normal time. In either case, the caster gains a +30 bonus to his relevant Crafting maneuver(s).
FLUID SKILLS.12: By casting this spell in conjunction with a Make Potion spell, the caster creates a cream, gel, or similar substance that can be rubbed onto the desired target of the embedded spell. Applying this lotion is a 4 AP action. It can also be used with other enchantments (without a Make Potion spell) to provide a temporary enchantment (e.g, an “armor polish” that provides the effect of Armor II). Such a temporary enchantment will last for 24 hours. The application of such a temporary enchantment must be specified to the level of skill specialization where applicable. Weapon I in a lotion must apply to a specified weapon type. General I would apply to a specified type of tool (e.g., carpentry tools or lock picks). Work Liquid is required to prepare the liquid base for the lotion.
FLUID SKILLS.13: By casting this spell in conjunction with a Make Potion spell, the caster creates a gaseous potion (also requiring Work Gas). The area of effect of the gas is 1' radius per level of spell in the potion. Everyone in the area of effect around the point where the gas is released will be affected. Gas delivers the spell by contact (holding your breath offers no protection). The GM may rule that some spells are not suitable for this type of use. One casting will cover an entire batch if batch production is used.
FLUID SKILLS.14: As Distill Essence, except with no restriction on imbiber’s realm.
FLUID SKILLS.15: As Make Potion III, except 10 levels of spells.
FLUID SKILLS.16: As Work Poison I, except that the poison may be of up to 15th level potency.
FLUID SKILLS.17: By casting this spell in conjunction with a Work Liquid spell, the caster can convert a normal acid into an acidic gas (which may be kept in a breakable container for later use as a missile). The acid will then form a cloud 1' radius per level of the potion when released, doing the equivalent of a splash with the acid to everyone caught within the cloud.
FLUID SKILLS.18: Allows caster to work with non-toxic magical gasses to create an enchanted item (normally a gaseous potion). All required tools and material must be present. Alternatively, this spell can be used to work on a magical gas without enchanting it, in which case the caster can do the work in half the normal time. In either case, the caster gains a +30 bonus to his relevant Crafting maneuver(s).
FLUID SKILLS.19: By casting this spell in conjunction with a Work Poison spell, the caster can convert a normal poison into a poisonous gas (which may be kept in a breakable container for later use as a missile). Poison will then work by inhalation (unlike a gaseous potion, breath holding will protect you). Radius of effect from point of release is 2' per potency level of the chosen poison.
FLUID SKILLS.20: As Make Potion III, except 20 levels of spells.
FLUID SKILLS.25: As Work Poison I, except that the poison may be of any potency.
FLUID SKILLS.30: As Make Potion III, except 50 levels of spells or one spell of any level.
FLUID SKILLS.35: As Poison Gas, except the radius is 5' per level of the poison.
FLUID SKILLS.40: As Poison Gas Cloud, except that the gas remains effective for one round per level of the enchanted gas (not the level of the poison itself). The cloud can be moved as any other gas can.
FLUID SKILLS.50: By casting this spell in conjunction with a Make Potion spell, the caster creates a concentrated potion which requires only a single drop to have effect. The resulting potion will have one drop (dose) per every full 5 levels of the caster.
FLUID SKILLS.60: As Acidic Gas, except that the gas forms a 2' per level radius cloud and remains effective for one round per level. The cloud can be moved as any other gas can. If someone is inhaling the cloud (holding one’s breath will postpone this), every round after the first, treat as if that individual had ingested the acid.
FLUID SKILLS.75: Allows caster to create one dose of a potion that will heal all wounds, illness, or poisoning in the imbiber, as long as death has not occurred. Recovery takes but a single round.
FLUID SKILLS.90: Allows caster to create one dose of a potion that will stop aging in the imbiber.

SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.1: Caster learns the origin and characteristics of one pair of footwear, including the materials and processes used in their creation (including spells), a general idea of who made them, and their size.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.2: Allows caster to work with non-magical organic materials to create an enchanted pair of footwear. All required tools and material must be present. Alternatively, this spell can be used to work on non-magical organic materials to create footwear without enchanting it, in which case the caster can do the work in half the normal time. In either case, the caster gains a +30 bonus to his relevant Crafting maneuver(s).
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.3: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that will fit any humanoid foot of a correctly Sized individual comfortably. This also prevents foot odor and provides a +50 RR bonus against any fungal or other parasitic attack on the feet. If worn during recovery from a foot or ankle injury, the time needed for recovery is halved.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.4: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that provides a +5 bonus to one appropriate skill: Jumping, Running, Skating (if a pair of skates), Stalking, or other skills that the GM deems suitably foot-related.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.5: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that provides a permanent effect identical to one Walking spell (e.g., Waterwalking).
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.6: As Work Mundane Organic Material, except caster may work with non-magical, inorganic materials to create an enchanted pair of footwear.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.7: As Bonus I, except bonus is +10.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.8: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that will adapt to fit any humanoid feet, regardless of Size.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.9: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that provides a permanent effect identical to one “Running” spell (e.g., Waterrunning).
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.10: As Work Mundane Organic Material, except caster may work with any materials to create an enchanted pair of footwear.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.11: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that gives the wearer the abilities of a Leaping and Landing spell (each once per round).
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.12: As Bonus I, except bonus is +15.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.13: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that provide a +15 OB bonus when used for Unarmed: Strikes.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.14: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that prevents the wearer from suffering fatigue from ground-based movement.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.15: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that allow the wearer to fly at his normal movement rate, subject to the normal rules regarding flight. Most such items do have little wings, but this is not actually required.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.16: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that negates 25% of leg criticals.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.17: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that allow the wearer to move on any surface without penalty and negate 50% of all criticals suffered due to the failure of a Movement maneuver. The shoes will also be able to slip freely out of any material, so the wearer will not be caught in mud, glue, etc., unless he falls in deeper than his footwear.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.18: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that allows the wearer to make melee attacks while moving on foot up to a Jog pace with no penalties to OB due to movement. If moving faster, treat this as a +50 bonus to Footwork skill.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.19: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that doubles the base movement rate of the wearer.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.20: As Bonus I, except bonus is +20.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.25: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that allows the wearer to take a single step and travel up to seven leagues (21 miles) in a single round. Any attempt to do this more than once per day requires an Absurd Fatigue Check. This is not a teleport effect, but a magically swift leap; it will not allow passage through barriers that the wearer could not normally go through, but it does automatically avoid collisions with birds and such. This effect requires Attunement to use.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.30: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that negates 50% of leg criticals.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.35: As Bonus I, except bonus is +25.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.40: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that provide a +7 DB bonus and allows the wearer unusual luck, defined in game terms as the ability to reroll any roll made by the character or force a reroll of any roll affecting only the wearer (this could not apply to a Fire Ball attack that included others, but could apply to the critical taken by the wearer) up to seven times each day.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.50: As Bonus I, except bonus is +30.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.60: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that negates 75% of leg criticals.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.75: As Bonus I, except bonus is +35.
SHOE ENCHANTMENTS.90: Allows caster to create an enchanted pair of footwear that allows the wearer to “step through the walls of the world” and travel to other planes of existence. Note that this does not provide protection from the conditions to be found on these other planes (e.g., the wearer will gain no resistance to fire by using these to reach the elemental plane of fire). Use of this ability requires Attunement and control of one’s destination may be based on an appropriate Lore (or Science) skill, at the GM’s option.

POWER IMPRESSIONS.1: Allows caster to create a link between himself and another individual so that the other may be used as a template in enchanting items. The spell need only be cast once at the beginning of the process, but the template must be within 100' of the caster during item creation and the link is broken at the end of the creation of the item. To use that template again, this spell must be recast. However, any number of abilities from the template may be impressed into the item based on this link. The caster may link to multiple templates in order to access all desired abilities. If access to a template is lost (the template goes away, dies, etc.), the process of impression fails, although any enchantments that do not involve the template may still be completed.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.2: Allows caster to enchant an item with a 1st level spell emplaced in it. This spell must be known by the template or the caster. The spell to be emplaced must also be cast into the item, or an additional casting of this spell may be used in its place (e.g., if the caster does not know the spell).
POWER IMPRESSIONS.3: Allows caster to enchant an item so that an additional person can be attuned to the item at a given time (i.e., if this capability is added twice, three individuals could be attuned to the item at one time).
POWER IMPRESSIONS.4: Allows caster to enchant an item so that it contains 1 PP for every two ranks which the template has in Power Development. PP may be used to power spells emplaced in the item or an attuned user may use the PP himself, so long as the user and the template have a Realm in common (or the item has Omnipower). The item’s PP will regenerate at the same time as an attuned user within 10' of the item recovers his PP (and at the same rate).
POWER IMPRESSIONS.5: As Emplace Spell I, except a spell up to 3rd level.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.6: Allows caster to enchant an item that grants its user a Talent possessed by the template with a value of no more than 5 DP. This excludes any innate casting abilities, which must be handled as other spells.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.7: Allows caster to enchant an item that can use PP from any realm to power any emplaced spells.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.8: Allows caster to enchant an item with the spells in a single list (to the level known by the template or the caster), up to 3rd level, to be emplaced in the item. Either all of the included spells must be cast into the item, or the time and PP requirements for this spell are tripled.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.9: As Emplace Spell I, except a spell up to 5th level.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.10: As Talent Embedding I, except limit is 10 DP.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.11: As Implant Power I, except that the item will have 1 PP per template rank in Power Development.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.12: As Emplace Spell I, except a spell up to 8th level.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.13: As Emplace List III, except up to 5th level.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.14: As Talent Embedding I, except limit is 15 DP.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.15: As Emplace Spell I, except a spell up to 10th level.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.16: Allows caster to enchant an item such that implanted PP may be used to cast spells from any realm.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.17: As Implant Power I, except that the item will have 3 PP per every two template ranks in Power Development.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.18: As Emplace List III, except up to 7th level.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.19: As Talent Embedding I, except limit is 20 DP.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.20: As Emplace Spell I, except a spell up to 15th level.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.25: As Emplace List III, except up to 10th level..
POWER IMPRESSIONS.30: As Emplace Spell I, except a spell up to 20th level.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.35: As Talent Embedding I, except limit is 30 DP.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.40: As Implant Power I, except that the item will have 2 PP per template rank in Power Development.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.50: As Emplace List III, except up to 20th level.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.60: As Emplace Spell I, except a spell of any level.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.75: As Talent Embedding I, except limit is DP equal to the caster’s level.
POWER IMPRESSIONS.90: As Emplace List III, except up to 50th level.

ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.1: Caster learns the race, level, and profession of the individual(s) attuned to the target item.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.2: Allows caster to enchant an item which provides the bearer a +5 bonus to all Spell-Casting Rolls.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.3: Allows caster to enchant an item so that an additional person can be attuned to the item at a given time (i.e., if this enchantment is added twice, three individuals could be attuned to the item at one time).
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.4: Allows caster to enchant an item which provides the bearer a +5 bonus to all Ball and Cone OBs.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.5: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +1 Spell Adder.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.6: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a x1.25 PP Multiplier.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.7: Allows caster to enchant an item which provides the bearer a +10 bonus to all Spell-Casting Rolls.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.8: Allows caster to enchant an item which provides the bearer a +10 bonus to all Ball and Cone OBs.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.9: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +2 Spell Adder.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.10: Allows caster to enchant an item that acts to improve the bearer’s ability to concentrate on spells. This results in doubling the base duration of concentration (12 rounds in a stressful environment, 2 minutes in a calm environment, 10 minutes in a meditative trance) and even after that time, Endurance rolls need only be made at twice the normal interval.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.11: Allows caster to enchant an item which provides the bearer a +15 bonus to all Spell-Casting Rolls.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.12: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a x1.5 PP Multiplier.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.13: Allows caster to enchant an item which provides the bearer a +15 bonus to all Ball and Cone OBs.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.14: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +3 Spell Adder.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.15: Allows caster to enchant an item which provides the bearer a +20 bonus to all Spell-Casting Rolls.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.16: Allows caster to enchant an item which provides the bearer with the ability to cast spells with a higher casting level than normal. The casting levels of all spells cast by the bearer are increased by 5 levels. Multiple castings of Increase Power each day of enchantment are cumulative, increasing the bearer's spells' casting levels by 5 per Increase Power cast daily. The days required may be reduced by limiting the application of the effect. If it applies only to a single Spell Type (e.g., Utility spells), these are halved. If it applies only to a single spell list (e.g., Spirit Mastery), time requirements are one-eighth normal.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.17: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a x1.75 PP Multiplier.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.18: Allows caster to enchant an item which provides the bearer a +20 bonus to all Ball and Cone OBs.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.19: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +4 Spell Adder.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.20: Allows caster to enchant an item which provides the bearer a +25 bonus to all Spell-Casting Rolls.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.25: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a x2 PP Multiplier.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.30: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +5 Spell Adder.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.35: Allows caster to enchant an item which provides the bearer a +35 bonus to all Spell-Casting Rolls.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.40: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +7 Spell Adder. This spell may also be used to create a +6 Spell Adder, requiring 36 PP and enchantment days rather than 40.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.50: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a x2.5 PP Multiplier.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.60: Allows caster to enchant an item such that it will negate 50% of spell failure effects (negation means that the wielder need not roll on the spell failure table, but the spell will still fail quietly and PP expended will be lost).
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.75: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a x3 PP Multiplier.
ENCHANTMENT MASTERY.90: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +10 Spell Adder. This spell may also be used to create a +8 Spell Adder (requiring 50 PP and enchantment days) or a +9 Spell Adder (requiring 70 PP and enchantment days).

BLADERUNES.1: Allows caster to detect and identify all bladerunes on a single item.
BLADERUNES.2: Creates a bladerune that increases the item’s OB by 10. The bladerune fades when the additional +10 OB changes the result of an attack (i.e., the +10 causes an attack to cause damage when it would have otherwise caused none, when it increases the severity value of a critical given in combat, etc.). This OB is in addition to the item’s normal OB, magical or non-magical.
BLADERUNES.3: Creates a bladerune which “keys” the runed item to a particular individual, who must be touching the item when this spell is cast. The individual to which the item is keyed gains a +30 bonus to his Runes maneuvers to activate bladerunes on this item, while all others suffer a -30 penalty. This bladerune does not fade unless dispelled or, in the case of a magical item, if the item on which it is placed becomes attuned to someone other than the individual to which the Runekey is linked.
BLADERUNES.4: Creates a bladerune that increases the item wielder’s DB by 10. The bladerune fades when the additional +10 changes the result of an attack (i.e., the +10 permits blocking an attack which otherwise would not have been blocked, causes an attack to fail to do damage or inflict a lesser critical, etc.). This DB is in addition to any normally granted by the item, magical or non-magical.
BLADERUNES.5: As Weapon Rune I, except the OB increase is +20.
BLADERUNES.6: Allows caster to create an item which accepts Bladerunes easily. This is treated as the item having the -50 RR penalty for a “willing target” when a Bladerune spell is cast on it.
BLADERUNES.7: Creates a bladerune that provides the item’s wielder with a +10 bonus to RRs. The bladerune fades when the +10 bonus changes the result of an RR (i.e., it allows the wielder to avoid an effect or reduces the effect suffered as a result of a failed RR).
BLADERUNES.8: As Shield Rune I, except the increase is +20.
BLADERUNES.9: Creates a bladerune that increases the range of the weapon on which it is placed. In the case of a weapon (including a shield), which cannot normally be thrown, it allows it to be thrown with a range increment of 10 feet. On a thrown weapon, it increases the range increment by 10 feet. On a missile, it increases the range increment by 25 feet. The bladerune fades when a ranged attack is made.
BLADERUNES.10: Creates a bladerune that will cause the weapon to return to its wielder when the weapon is thrown or fired. The weapon returns via Long Door (i.e., it teleports) and the bladerune fades after returning the weapon.
BLADERUNES.11: As Resistance Rune I, except the RR increase is +20.
BLADERUNES.12: Creates a bladerune that adds +5 to a critical roll made for an attack using the weapon on which it is placed. The bladerune fades after a critical is rolled. This effect is cumulative with other Slaying effects, up to the maximum Slaying bonus of +25. E.g., a Slaying Rune I on a weapon that does Slaying II against bears could gain a +15 bonus to a critical roll against a bear.
BLADERUNES.13: As Weapon Rune I, except the OB increase is +30.
BLADERUNES.14: Creates a bladerune which is linked to another bladerune on the same item. When this other bladerune would normally fade, the Anchoring Rune attempts to preserve it, drawing some energy from the wielder to assist. The item wielder must make an Endurance roll, subtracting twice the level of the “anchored” rune as a penalty. If he succeeds, the Anchoring Rune and the anchored bladerune both remain on the item. If he fails, he suffers as normal for a failed Endurance roll, while both the Anchoring Rune and the anchored bladerune fade. The anchored bladerune must be activated between uses; after resisting fading, it still becomes inactive and will not function again until again activated by the wielder.
BLADERUNES.15: As Shield Rune I, except the increase is +30.
BLADERUNES.16: As Resistance Rune I, except the RR increase is +30.
BLADERUNES.17: Creates a bladerune that adds an additional critical when a critical is scored using the weapon on which it is placed. The additional critical is one level of severity less than the original critical, and the type of this critical must be selected when the bladerune is cast. The bladerune fades after inflicting one critical.
BLADERUNES.18: As Weapon Rune I, except the OB increase is +40.
BLADERUNES.19: As Slaying Rune I, except the critical roll is modified by +10.
BLADERUNES.20: As Shield Rune I, except the increase is +40.
BLADERUNES.25: Creates a bladerune that adds an additional critical when a critical is scored using the weapon on which it is placed. The additional critical is of the same severity as the original critical, and the type of this critical may be selected when the bladerune is activated. The bladerune fades after inflicting one critical.
BLADERUNES.30: As Weapon Rune I, except the OB increase is +50.
BLADERUNES.35: As Slaying Rune I, except the critical roll is modified by +15.
BLADERUNES.40: As Shield Rune I, except the increase is +50.
BLADERUNES.50: As Slaying Rune I, except the critical roll is modified by +20.
BLADERUNES.60: As Resistance Rune I, except the RR increase is +50.
BLADERUNES.75: Creates a bladerune that will negate the next critical taken by the item’s wielder. The rune fades after negating one critical.
BLADERUNES.90: Creates a bladerune that requires the first individual (after activation of the bladerune) to suffer a critical scored using the weapon on which it is placed to make an RR (versus a 50th level Essence spell) or instantly die. The bladerune fades after one use, even if the target makes the RR.

SKIN ENCHANTMENT.1: Allows caster to work with living skin to create an enchanted tattoo. All required tools and material must be present. Alternatively, this spell can be used to create a normal tattoo without enchanting it, in which case the caster can do the work in half the normal time. In either case, the caster gains a +30 bonus to his relevant Crafting maneuver(s).
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.2: As Work Skin, except allows caster to work with living organic exterior surfaces such as scales or fur to create an enchanted tattoo. This does allow the caster to permanently mark creatures whose surfaces would not normally take a permanent marking.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.3: Allows caster to use Embed Spell to create a tattoo that will allow the tattooed being to cast an embedded 1st level spell, using the tattooed being’s own PP, but allowing the spell to be cast instantaneously. Normal casting penalties for lack of free hands, silence, etc. do not apply, but there is a -10 SCR penalty if the tattoo is partially covered, -30 if it is completely covered. The spell may be used as often as desired, limited only by PP.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.4: Allows caster to embed a single spell into a tattoo. Requires 10% of tattooable surface area. The spell to be embedded must also be cast every day during the enchantment process and counts towards the total number of required working days. The spell will only be usable a single time and then erased, unless a suitable Make Tattoo spell is also used.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.5: Allows caster to create a tattoo that can move in place (e.g., dancing girl actually dances) or even move around the skin, provided that the areas moved through have no other tattoos (e.g., the “Mom” tattoo on the arm travels down to the leg). Such movement can be programmed by the caster, or the tattooed individual can control it by Concentration.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.6: As Make Tattoo I, except allows embedding a 2nd level spell or, by using Embed List, a list of spells up to second level.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.7: Allows caster to create a tattoo that will, once per day, completely negate one fumble or spell failure by the tattooed individual or one critical suffered by him. This covers 15% of tattooable surface area.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.8: Allows caster to completely and painlessly remove non-magical tattoos in a one hour process. Caster may also remove magical tattoos, but this requires one hour per level of the tattoo. Tattoo gets an RR at the higher of its own level or the tattooed individual’s level. If the RR is made, caster must gain another rank in this list before trying again.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.9: As Make Tattoo II, except spells may be up to 3rd level.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.10: Allows caster to embed a series of spells from the same list into a tattoo. Requires 20% of tattooable surface area. Each of the usable spells must also be cast every day during the enchantment (and count towards the total number of working days required).
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.11: Allows caster to create a tattoo in which the tattooed may store a spell of up to 5th level, to be later released as an instantaneous spell. Requires 10% of tattooable surface area.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.12: As Make Tattoo II, except spells may be up to 4th level.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.13: Allows caster to enchant a tattoo depicting an animal. This tattoo will grant a +10 to all maneuvers when interacting with the depicted animal type, grant a +10 OB when fighting that animal type, and allow speech with that animal type by Concentrating.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.14: Modifies a tattoo made with Embed Spell or Embed List so that only half the normal PP (round up) are required to cast the spell(s) embedded.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.15: As Make Tattoo II, except spells may be up to 5th level.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.16: As Protective Tattoo I, except the tattoo can function twice a day.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.17: Allows caster to create a tattoo in which the tattooed may store a spell of up to 10th level, to be later released as an instantaneous spell. Requires 10% of tattooable surface area.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.18: As Make Tattoo II, except spells may be up to 6th level.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.19: Allows caster to create a tattoo into which the bearer can confine any demon, elemental, or similar supernatural creature. The bearer of the tattoo or an ally must first control the entity to be imprisoned in order to command it into the tattoo. Thereafter, the bearer of the tattoo may release the confined being at any time. When this happens, the confined being must make an RR at -50 or be under the command of the tattoo-bearer for the duration of one combat or simple task. Rarely will an entity risk reconfinement by turning on the tattoo-bearer after finishing the task, preferring to flee home. This tattoo requires 20% of tattooable surface area.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.20: As Make Tattoo II, except spells may be up to 8th level.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.25: As Make Tattoo II, except spells may be up to 10th level.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.30: As Protective Tattoo I, except the tattoo can function three times a day.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.35: As Make Tattoo II, except spells may be up to 15th level.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.40: Allows caster to create a tattoo in which the tattooed may store a spell of up to 20th level, to be later released as an instantaneous spell. Requires 10% of tattooable surface area.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.50: As Make Tattoo II, except spells may be up to 20th level.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.60: Allows caster to create a tattoo which provides AT 6 to the bearer (to the whole body, not just the part covered by the tattoo). This tattoo requires 20% of tattooable surface area.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.75: As Make Tattoo II, except spells may of any level.
SKIN ENCHANTMENT.90: Allows caster to create the fabled Dragon Tattoo. This grants the bearer an extra 100 Power Points, increases the Size of his elemental attacks by one, allows the bearer to make Unarmed attacks that are considered magical and have a Slaying III power against one creature Variety determined at the time of tattooing, and with Concentration, allows the bearer to speak any language, gaining a +20 bonus to Influence skills in the process. This tattoo takes 25% of tattooable surface area.

ELEMENTAL BINDING.1: Each round, the caster may learn one of the following about a single elemental: level, element (usually obvious), one talent, one flaw, one spell list, one skill bonus. Skill bonuses are learned from largest on down to (eventually) smallest, talents and flaws from most DP involved to least (ignoring negative nature of flaw “cost”), and otherwise in random order within the chosen category.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.2: Allows caster to bring out the elemental nature of an item into which an elemental has been embedded. This will have cosmetic effects, transforming the appearance of the item to reflect the nature of the embedded elemental. It will also give the attuned bearer of the item a bonus equal to that of the level of the embedded elemental (not the level of the item) to Creature Lore: Elemental maneuvers and SCRs casting spells dealing with elementals.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.3: Cast once per day, this spell allows the caster to give an intelligent item the power of touch telepathy or the power of speech. Cast twice per day (double time and PP requirement), it can provide the power of ranged telepathy (with a range equal to its level in feet).
ELEMENTAL BINDING.4: Allows caster to provide access to one of an embedded elemental’s talents up to a limit of 6 DP value.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.5: Allows caster to embed a Grade I elemental into an object as described in Section 5.3.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.6: Allows caster to provide access to one of an embedded elemental’s Open spell lists. These spells may be cast using the wielder's PP or the item's PP (e.g., from Manifest Power).
ELEMENTAL BINDING.7: Allows caster to provide access to three of an embedded elemental’s skills for purposes of the item’s own use or the direct use of the item.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.8: Allows caster to enchant an item with an embedded elemental such that the item provides a +5 bonus to RRs and DB against all of the physical elements (Earth, Fire, Ice, Light, Water, Wind), a +10 bonus to all maneuvers and SCRs dealing directly with the element of the embedded elemental (including relevant magical rituals). The wielder of the item may cast up to 10 PP worth of spells from the Magician base list corresponding to the embedded elemental’s element (as if the spells were embedded). If the item is a weapon it does an additional critical of the appropriate type (use Krush for Earth, Unbalancing for Wind, Impact for Water) of two severities less than the normal critical. Requires a Grade II or higher embedded elemental.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.9: Allows caster to provide access to an embedded elemental’s normal PP total, for use in casting spells from its lists.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.10: Allows caster to embed a Grade II or lesser elemental into an object as described in Section 5.3.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.11: Allows caster to provide access to one of an embedded elemental’s Closed spell lists. These spells may be cast using the wielder's PP or the item's PP (e.g., from Manifest Power).
ELEMENTAL BINDING.12: As Manifest Talent I, but limit is 20 DP.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.13: Allows caster to enchant an item with an embedded elemental such that the item provides a +10 bonus to RRs and DB against all of the physical elements, a +15 bonus to all maneuvers and SCRs dealing directly with the element of the embedded elemental (including relevant magical rituals). The wielder of the item may cast up to 15 PP worth of spells from the Magician base list corresponding to the embedded elemental’s element (as if the spells were embedded). If the item is a weapon it does an additional critical of the appropriate type of one severity less than the normal critical. Requires a Grade III or higher embedded elemental.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.14: Allows caster to make one of an embedded elemental’s stat bonuses available to the wielder or to make one of the embedded elemental’s physical stat bonuses (Ag, Co, Qu, St) available for the item’s use.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.15: Allows caster to embed a Grade III or lesser elemental into an object as described in Section 5.3.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.16: Allows caster to provide access to three of an embedded elemental’s skills for all purposes.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.17: Allows caster to provide access to one of an embedded elemental’s spell lists which is neither an Open nor a Closed list. These spells may be cast using the wielder's PP or the item's PP (e.g., from Manifest Power).
ELEMENTAL BINDING.18: As Manifest Talent I, but limit is 40 DP.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.19: Allows caster to enchant an item with an embedded elemental such that the item provides a +15 bonus to RRs and DB against all of the physical elements, a +20 bonus to all maneuvers and SCRs dealing directly with the element of the embedded elemental (including relevant magical rituals). The wielder of the item may cast up to 20 PP worth of spells from the Magician base list corresponding to the embedded elemental’s element (as if the spells were embedded). If the item is a weapon it does an additional critical of the appropriate type of equal severity to the normal critical. Requires a Grade IV or higher embedded elemental.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.20: Allows caster to embed a Grade IV or lesser elemental into an object as described in Section 5.3.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.25: Allows caster to provide access to general traits of an embedded demon, such as its level for purposes of the bearer’s RRs, a full set of senses (without talents) in item form, etc.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.30: As Manifest Talent I, but limit is 75 DP.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.35: Allows caster to embed a Grade V or lesser elemental into an object as described in Section 5.3.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.40: Allows caster to enchant an item with an embedded elemental such that the item provides a +20 bonus to RRs and DB against all of the physical elements, a +25 bonus to all maneuvers and SCRs dealing directly with the element of the embedded elemental (including relevant magical rituals). The wielder of the item may cast up to 30 PP worth of spells from the Magician base list corresponding to the embedded elemental’s element (as if the spells were embedded). If the item is a weapon it does an additional critical of the appropriate type of one greater severity to the normal critical. Requires a Grade V or higher embedded elemental.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.50: Allows caster to embed a Grade VI or lesser elemental into an object as described in Section 5.3.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.60: As Manifest Talent I, but there is no limit on the talent’s DP cost.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.75: Allows caster to enchant an item with an embedded elemental such that the item provides a +25 bonus to RRs and DB against all of the physical elements, a +30 bonus to all maneuvers and SCRs dealing directly with the element of the embedded elemental (including relevant magical rituals). The wielder of the item may cast up to 50 PP worth of spells from the Magician base list corresponding to the embedded elemental’s element (as if the spells were embedded). If the item is a weapon it does an additional critical of the appropriate type of two greater severities than the normal critical. Requires a Grade VI or higher embedded elemental.
ELEMENTAL BINDING.90: Allows caster to embed any elemental into an object as described in Section 5.3.

SACRED RUNES.1: By casting this spell within a minute after the creation of a magical rune, the caster attunes it to his own religious faith. Anyone not of the caster’s religion will suffer a -100 to any Runes maneuver attempted on the affected rune.
SACRED RUNES.2: This spell inscribes another spell on a specially prepared piece of paper (i.e., rune paper) as a rune. The rune can then be used to cast the inscribed spell once (leaving the paper blank but reusable). The spell to be inscribed must be cast within one minute after the Rune spell is cast. Rune I can only inscribe 1st level spells. The rune can be set to affect the reader. The spell to be inscribed in the rune must be cast with that intent, but the caster of the Rune spell need not be the caster of the spell to be inscribed. The caster of the Rune spell and the caster of the inscribed spell must both touch the Rune Paper, that is to hold the rune.
SACRED RUNES.3: Allows caster to work with non-magical paper or parchment (vellum, etc.) or bound books or other writing formats (e.g., clay tablets) appropriate to his religion to create an enchanted item. All required tools and material must be present. Alternatively, this spell can be used to work on non-magical material as listed above without enchanting it, in which case the caster can do the work in half the normal time. In either case, the caster gains a +30 bonus to his relevant Crafting maneuver(s).
SACRED RUNES.4: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-2nd level spells.
SACRED RUNES.5: Allows caster to make a sheet of paper or parchment (vellum, etc.) which will hold a rune as described in the Open Essence spell list Rune Mastery and as appear on this list as well.
SACRED RUNES.6: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-3rd level spells.
SACRED RUNES.7: Allows caster to enchant a text so that the writing is visible only when specific circumstances are met (e.g., when viewed in the light of a full moon). This writing may be mundane or magical in nature. If this is the only magical feature of the text, this spell is sufficient for the enchantment (i.e., no Work spell is needed).
SACRED RUNES.8: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-4th level spells.
SACRED RUNES.9: Allows caster to combine two spells into a single rune, which are then cast together as a single spell. This spell is cast and then the necessary Rune spells may be cast (each spell to be included in the rune requires its own Rune spell), followed by the spells to be combined in the rune. There can be no more than one minute between each spell cast in this process, but the overall time taken does not matter if that condition is met. When casting the rune, treat as if the spell were equal to the highest level spell plus two levels for each additional spell for SCR purposes. Casting level for all spells is equal to the highest spell level included.
SACRED RUNES.10: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-5th level spells.
SACRED RUNES.11: When cast before a Rune spell, allows caster to cast a Magical Ritual as the spell to be placed in a rune. So long as the ritual is begun within one minute of the casting of the Rune spell and the Rune spell is cast within a minute of the casting of this spell, the process can continue as long as caster cares to take on the ritual. This allows placing enhanced versions of a spell in a rune. The rune is then treated as if the spell were normal for purposes of casting and Runes maneuvers.
SACRED RUNES.12: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-6th level spells.
SACRED RUNES.13: As Complex Rune I, except up to three spells may be combined into a single rune.
SACRED RUNES.14: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-7th level spells.
SACRED RUNES.15: Allows caster to enchant a copy of sacred texts such that it may be used in a magic ritual and count as a 1000 gp tool relevant to any ritual where all participants are of the caster’s religion. The bonus from this text may be enhanced for appropriateness as usual (e.g., if the caster worships a storm god, it would be broadly appropriate for weather magic and specifically appropriate to raising a storm).
SACRED RUNES.16: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-8th level spells.
SACRED RUNES.17: As Secret Script, except material concealed can include illustrations (drawings, paintings, etc.) and maps, in addition to text.
SACRED RUNES.18: As Rune I, except caster may inscribe 1st-9th level spells.
SACRED RUNES.19: As Complex Rune I, except up to four spells may be combined into a single rune.
SACRED RUNES.20: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-10th level spells.
SACRED RUNES.25: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe 1st-20th level spells.
SACRED RUNES.30: As Scriptures I, but text is treated as having a 100,000 gp value.
SACRED RUNES.35: As Rune I, except caster can inscribe a spell of any level.
SACRED RUNES.40: As Complex Rune I, except up to five spells may be combined into a single rune.
SACRED RUNES.50: As Scriptures I, but text is treated as having a 10,000,000 gp value.
SACRED RUNES.60: As Complex Rune I, except up to six spells may be combined into a single rune.
SACRED RUNES.75: As Scriptures III, but only the primary caster of the ritual need be of the caster’s religion.
SACRED RUNES.90: As Complex Rune I, except multiple spells may be combined into a single rune, up to a maximum of one spell per every ten levels of the caster.

SKILL IMPRESSIONS.1: Allows caster to enchant an item implanted with a skill bonus for a Practical Skill equal to one-fifth that of the template, to a maximum of +20. Practical Skills are skills from the Animal, Crafting, Environmental, or Vocation skill categories.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.2: Allows caster to enchant an item implanted with a skill bonus for a Subtle Skill equal to one-fifth that of the template, to a maximum of +20. Subtle Skills are skills from the Awareness, Performance Art, Social, Subterfuge, or Technical skill categories.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.3: Allows caster to enchant an item implanted with a skill bonus for an Internal Skill equal to one-fifth that of the template, to a maximum of +20. Internal Skills are skills from the Body Discipline, Composition, Lore, Medical, Mental Discipline, and Science skill categories.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.4: Allows caster to enchant an item implanted with a skill bonus for a Mystical Skill equal to one-fifth that of the template, to a maximum of +20. Mystical Skills are skills from the Delving, Magical Expertise, and Power Manipulation skill categories.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.5: Allows caster to enchant an item implanted with a skill bonus for a Physical Skill equal to one-fifth that of the template, to a maximum of +20. Physical Skills are skills from the Battle Expertise, Brawn, Combat Expertise, Combat Training, Gymnastic, and Movement skill categories.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.6: Allows caster to enchant an item which allows the item’s bearer to benefit from a single Professional Bonus. This has no effect if the bearer already has a Professional Bonus for the skill in question. The caster must have a template that possesses the desired Professional Bonus.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.7: As Practical Skill I, but equal to 40% that of the template, to a maximum of +40.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.8: As Subtle Skill I, but equal to 40% that of the template, to a maximum of +40.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.9: As Internal Skill I, but equal to 40% that of the template, to a maximum of +40.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.10: As Mystical Skill I, but equal to 40% that of the template, to a maximum of +40.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.11: As Physical Skill I, but equal to 40% that of the template, to a maximum of +40.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.12: Allows caster to enchant an item which allows the item’s bearer to benefit from a Knack. This may replace the bearer’s own Knack for the skill in question, if the item bestows a higher bonus Knack than is possessed by the bearer, but the two Knacks are not cumulative. The caster must have a template that possesses the desired Knack.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.13: As Practical Skill I, but equal to 60% that of the template, to a maximum of +60.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.14: As Subtle Skill I, but equal to 60% that of the template, to a maximum of +60.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.15: As Internal Skill I, but equal to 60% that of the template, to a maximum of +60.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.16: As Mystical Skill I, but equal to 60% that of the template, to a maximum of +60.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.17: As Physical Skill I, but equal to 60% that of the template, to a maximum of +60.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.18: Allows caster to enchant an item implanted with a bonus for number of skill ranks equal to that of the template for a single skill (specialized for skills with specializations). This does not change the skill bonus of the bearer, but is useful for skills where the skill rank is applied for certain purposes, such as the Shield skill, Ambush skill, and the use of Spell List ranks in the SCR.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.19: As Practical Skill I, but equal to 80% that of the template, to a maximum of +80.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.20: As Subtle Skill I, but equal to 80% that of the template, to a maximum of +80.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.25: As Internal Skill I, but equal to 80% that of the template, to a maximum of +80.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.30: As Mystical Skill I, but equal to 80% that of the template, to a maximum of +80.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.35: As Physical Skill I, but equal to 80% that of the template, to a maximum of +80.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.40: As Practical Skill I, but equal to that of the template, to a maximum of +100.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.50: As Subtle Skill I, but equal to that of the template, to a maximum of +100.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.60: As Internal Skill I, but equal to that of the template, to a maximum of +100.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.75: As Mystical Skill I, but equal to that of the template, to a maximum of +100.
SKILL IMPRESSIONS.90: As Physical Skill I, but equal to that of the template, to a maximum of +100.

CHARM CREATION.1: Allows caster to create a charm such that whenever the bearer of this charm fails an RR against Fear, he may make a second RR and use the better result. The charm loses its power when the bearer fails the second RR, but he may still benefit from a reduced result if he fails by less than his first RR roll.
CHARM CREATION.2: As Charm of Bravery, except that it applies to RRs against a specific disease.
CHARM CREATION.3: As Charm of Bravery, except that it applies to RRs against a specific spell (different version numbers, “Lord”, “Mass”, and “True” versions are all affected so long as the name is otherwise the same).
CHARM CREATION.4: As Charm of Bravery, except that it applies to RRs against a specific poison or venom.
CHARM CREATION.5: Allows caster to create a charm to protect against a specific individual. When that foe inflicts a critical upon the bearer, the bearer may have that critical rerolled and suffer the preferred result. A token of the individual to be protected from must be included in the charm. The periapt loses its power when the reroll is the same number as the original roll.
CHARM CREATION.6: Allows caster to create a charm such that when the bearer makes a maneuver to perceive danger, the bearer gains a bonus equal to the ranks that the caster has in this list, reduced by one for each time that the talisman has changed the result of a maneuver. When the bonus becomes zero, the enchantment ends.
CHARM CREATION.7: As Charm of Bravery, except that it applies to RRs against anything caused by a particular individual. Some token of this individual must be included in the charm.
CHARM CREATION.8: As Charm of Bravery, except that it applies to RRs against all spells from a given spell list.
CHARM CREATION.9: As Warning Talisman, except that the bonus applies to maneuvers made involving physical risks (e.g., jumping across a chasm or juggling swords).
CHARM CREATION.10: As Charm of Bravery, except that it applies to RRs against all diseases.
CHARM CREATION.11: As Particular Periapt, except protection applies to criticals due to attacks from a given species or Variety of creature (e.g., alligator, corvox), and a token from such a creature must be included in the charm.
CHARM CREATION.12: As Charm of Bravery, except that it applies to RRs against all venoms and poisons.
CHARM CREATION.13: As Warning Talisman, except that the bonus applies to RRs against diseases or against poison or against one Realm of magic.
CHARM CREATION.14: As Particular Periapt, except protection applies to all criticals of a given type (e.g., Cold or Slash) and no special token is required (bearer’s token is still needed if this is a single-user charm).
CHARM CREATION.15: As Charm of Bravery, except that it applies to RRs against all spells from a given Realm.
CHARM CREATION.16: Allows caster to create a charm such that when the bearer fumbles an attack roll, the fumble result may be rerolled and the bearer suffers the preferred result of the two rolls. The periapt loses its power when the reroll is the same number as the original roll.
CHARM CREATION.17: As Charm of Bravery, except that it applies to any breakage checks by equipment on the bearer’s person instead of to RRs.
CHARM CREATION.18: As Warning Talisman, except that the bonus applies to SCRs.
CHARM CREATION.19: As Particular Periapt, except protection applies to criticals from a general creature type (e.g., Dragons or Golems) and a token from a creature of that type must be included in the charm.
CHARM CREATION.20: As Charm of Bravery, except that it applies to RRs against all spells.
CHARM CREATION.25: Allows caster to create a charm such that when the bearer suffers an injury, he may reroll the recovery roll and use the better of the two rolls. The periapt loses its power when the reroll is the same number as the original roll.
CHARM CREATION.30: Allows caster to create a charm such that when the bearer suffers spell failure, he may reroll the spell failure result and take the preferred of the two rolls. The periapt loses its power when the reroll is the same number as the original roll.
CHARM CREATION.35: As Warning Talisman, except that the bonus applies to attack rolls against a given target. A token of the target must be part of the charm.
CHARM CREATION.40: As Warning Talisman, except that the bonus may be applied to any maneuver (no attack rolls or SCRs).
CHARM CREATION.50: As Particular Periapt, except protection applies to all criticals and no special token is required (bearer’s token is still needed if this is a single- user charm).
CHARM CREATION.60: As Warning Talisman, except that the bonus applies to attack rolls against a given species or Variety of creature. A token from such a creature must be part of the charm.
CHARM CREATION.75: As Warning Talisman, except that the bonus applies to DB (each attack that has the result changed reduces the bonus).
CHARM CREATION.90: Allows caster to create a special charm called a “Soulkeeper”. If the bearer of the Soulkeeper dies, the soul of the bearer is kept within the Soulkeeper. With this in hand, the bearer can be restored by Lifegiving even in the absence of the body, in which case the body will be regenerated by the Soulkeeper to rehouse the soul. If the body is still present, then normal Lifegiving may take place, and the stat penalties due to resurrection will be only -5 each. The kept soul might also be embedded in an item using the Spirit Embedding list. This charm will only function once. The soul will also flee into the Soulkeeper in case of Absolution, allowing the soul to return to the body after 24 hours (or a week in the case of Absolution Pure). If the bearer is subjected to Dark Absolution, the soul receives a second RR, with success allowing the soul to escape destruction by sheltering in the Soulkeeper, resulting in an Absolution Pure result. Protecting against Absolution effects does not drain the Soulkeeper’s power.

SACRED PURPOSE.1: Caster learns if one target item is associated with a religion and, if so, which one and whether the item actively serves the religion (as an intelligent/willed item) or is simply dedicated to that religion through enchantment or manufacture.
SACRED PURPOSE.2: Allows caster to enchant an item so that it is suitable for further enchantments from this list or Divine Touch or Golem Making. If only spells from these lists are used, this spell is the only enchantment needed for the base item (i.e., no Work spell is required). The item must meet all applicable standards of the caster’s religion.
SACRED PURPOSE.3: Allows caster to enchant an item such that a given spell ability (e.g., from Sacred Spell) can only be used by those who are members of a certain Race (or set of Races) or of a certain Profession (or set of Professions).
SACRED PURPOSE.4: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +1 Spell Adder which can only be used to cast a kind of spell which is appropriate for the caster’s deity (e.g., fire spells).
SACRED PURPOSE.5: Allows caster to enchant an item such that it gains an additional +5 OB when it attacks any creature of darkness (See SL Section 10.8 for definition).
SACRED PURPOSE.6: Allows caster to enchant an item such that the item’s wielder is immune to curses, magical diseases, magical mind diseases, etc. (i.e., any magical effect that requires a specialized spell to remove, rather than a normal Dispel) and to Black Channels. The wielder gains a +50 to RRs against all forms of Absolution.
SACRED PURPOSE.7: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +2 Spell Adder which can only be used to cast a kind of spell which is appropriate for the caster’s deity (e.g., fire spells).
SACRED PURPOSE.8: Allows caster to enchant an item possessed of an artificial intelligence to cast spells. This spell may be cast multiple times per day to increase the effect of this enchantment. One spell provides the item with access to the Open lists of a single Realm of magic. Doubling up the spell (requiring 16 days and PP) will add access to the Closed lists of the same Realm. Tripling up the spell (24) will add access to all other lists available to a caster of that Realm (Base, Evil). Adding another casting of this spell each day (and adding another 8 days and PP) can be done to give access to an additional Realm, to create an item with Hybrid spellcasting abilities. This spell also provides the item with both the Power Development skill and the Sanctifier's choice of spell lists up to the item's capacity to learn them (the Sanctifier or an assistant must know the spell lists up to the level to be imparted to the item).
SACRED PURPOSE.9: Allows caster to enchant an item such that it possesses Medium Intelligence.
SACRED PURPOSE.10: Allows caster to enchant an item such that it gains an additional +10 OB when it attacks any creature of darkness (See SL Section 10.8 for definition).
SACRED PURPOSE.11: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +3 Spell Adder which can only be used to cast a kind of spell which is appropriate for the caster’s deity (e.g., fire spells).
SACRED PURPOSE.12: Allows caster to enchant an item with artificial intelligence so that it can learn additional skills, as described in Section 5.3.
SACRED PURPOSE.13: Allows caster to enchant an item such that it will deliver a B critical to any unauthorized person touching it. At the time of enchanting, the item may be set to permit contact by Channeling users of the caster’s religion, any member of the caster’s religion, or those who are not Evil (or are Evil).
SACRED PURPOSE.14: Allows caster to enchant an item such that it possesses High Intelligence.
SACRED PURPOSE.15: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +4 Spell Adder which can only be used to cast a kind of spell which is appropriate for the caster’s deity (e.g., fire spells).
SACRED PURPOSE.16: Allows caster to enchant an item such that it gains an additional +15 OB when it attacks any creature of darkness (See SL Section 10.8 for definition).
SACRED PURPOSE.17: As Taboo I, except that a D critical is delivered.
SACRED PURPOSE.18: Allows caster to create a weapon which will strike as if one Size larger when used against Evil entities (demons, undead, anyone with an Evil spell list, etc.). If such an Evil creature directly touches the weapon, that creature will take an A Holy critical (no adjustment for Size). If intelligent, it gains a +10 bonus to Will.
SACRED PURPOSE.19: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +5 Spell Adder which can only be used to cast a kind of spell which is appropriate for the caster’s deity (e.g., fire spells).
SACRED PURPOSE.20: Allows caster to enchant an item such that it possesses Superior Intelligence.
SACRED PURPOSE.25: Allows caster to create a weapon which will strike as if one Size larger when used against Evil entities (demons, undead, anyone with an Evil spell list, etc.) and do an additional Holy critical two severities less than the regular critical. If such an Evil creature directly touches the weapon, that creature will take an B Holy critical (no adjustment for Size). Against demons or undead of a larger Size than the weapon’s wielder, it is Slaying I. If intelligent, it gains a +15 bonus to Will.
SACRED PURPOSE.30: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +7 Spell Adder which can only be used to cast a kind of spell which is appropriate for the caster’s deity (e.g., fire spells). This spell may also be used to create a +6 Spell Adder, treating this as a 25th level spell (but the 30th level version must be known).
SACRED PURPOSE.35: Allows caster to enchant an item such that it possesses Genius Intelligence.
SACRED PURPOSE.40: Allows caster to create an item that will gradually convert its wielder (and his close associates) to the item’s religion, ethics, and purposes. Each use of the item or week spent in its proximity requires an RR against Channeling magic of the item’s level. Each failure is 1% influence. Anything short of 100% can be reversed, reducing the influence by 1% per week spent on opposing sacred ground. When ethical conflicts arise, the % of influence is the chance that an RR must be made for the influenced individual to act according to his old code. Failure indicates that he will do things the item’s way. Modifiers may be applied to the RR for extreme cases. At 100% influence, conversion is complete, and the character has a new outlook and allegiance.
SACRED PURPOSE.50: Allows caster to create a weapon which will strike as if two Sizes larger when used against Evil entities (demons, undead, anyone with an Evil spell list, etc.) and do an additional Holy critical one severity less than the regular critical. If such an Evil creature directly touches the weapon, that creature will take an C Holy critical (no adjustment for Size). Against demons or undead, it is Slaying I. If intelligent, it gains a +20 bonus to Will.
SACRED PURPOSE.60: Allows caster to enchant an item which is a +10 Spell Adder which can only be used to cast a kind of spell which is appropriate for the caster’s deity (e.g., fire spells). This spell may also be used to create a +9 Spell Adder, treating this as a 50th level spell, or a +8 Spell Adder, treating it as 40th level (but the 60th level version must be known in either case).
SACRED PURPOSE.75: Allows caster to enchant an item such that it possesses Transcendent Intelligence.
SACRED PURPOSE.90: Allows caster to enchant an individual such that the individual becomes the alternative form of an item. The item will resemble the individual it becomes in some way, usually as a direct representation. An attuned user (or one employing the proper trigger set at creation) can cause the item to transform into the individual (takes one round). Likewise, an attuned individual can order the individual back into item form. Unless the purpose of the individual is to provide some on-going magical effect, it will have a time limit of one hour before returning to item form. If the individual is killed, it will revert to item form. The individual is immortal so long as the item survives. After returning to item form, the individual cannot be called forth again for 24 hours, during which time all damage short of death is healed. Death will require 1 day per level of the individual to recover from, at which time the item becomes normally usable again. The individual will perform as instructed by the person who summoned them forth, or can be assigned a set function during enchantment.

ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.1: Caster learns the materials of which a shield or armor suit/piece is made, what bonuses it has to DB and breakage rolls, the approximate time and place of manufacture, and whether the armor has any additional magical properties (but not what they are).
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.2: Refits an organic armor (full suit or individual piece) to correctly fit any individual in the same Size category as the armor. The adjustment takes one minute.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.3: Refits an inorganic armor (full suit or individual piece) to correctly fit any individual in the same Size category as the armor. The adjustment takes one minute.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.4: Allows caster to create an armor piece which is considered one step heavier for protective purposes only (e.g., caster can create Light greaves that protect as if they were Medium).
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.5: Allows caster to create torso armor with a +5 DB bonus or torso armor, limb armor, or helmet with a penalty (maneuvers, missiles, or perception) reduced by 5, or a shield with a +5 bonus to Shield skill. Multiple Armor spells may be used to reduce different penalties or to both increase DB and reduce a penalty.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.6: Allows caster to enchant an organic armor (full suit or individual piece) so that it will always change its size to correctly fit any individual in the same Size category as the armor. It will alter to fit as it is being put on, so there is no delay for adjustment.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.7: Allows caster to enchant an armor piece so that it has a 5% chance of negating any critical hit to the area of the body (chest & groin, head, leg, or arm) protected by the armor piece. On a shield, it will negate crits to the shield arm plus a reduced chance (2% per 5% of normal chance) to negate any crit by an attacker against whom the shield is defending.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.8: Allows caster to enchant an inorganic armor (full suit or individual piece) so that it will always change its size to correctly fit any individual in the same Size category as the armor. It will alter to fit as it is being put on, so there is no delay for adjustment.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.9: As Armor I, except a bonus or penalty reduction of 10.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.10: As Crit Negation I, except chance is 10%.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.11: Allows caster to enchant a shield such that it can protect against one additional attack each round. This ability can be added multiple times.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.12: Allows caster to enchant an item to fit itself to an additional Size category (e.g., the caster could make an item that will resize itself for either a Small or Medium user). For an armor, this will also require Automatic Sizing. For non-armors, which have less demanding fit requirements, this spell will function on its own. Multiple castings per day will allow an additional Size for each casting. In any case, Sizes must be contiguous; an Armor cannot fit Small and Big users, skipping over Medium.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.13: As Crit Negation I, except chance is 15%.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.14: As Armor I, except a bonus or penalty reduction of 15.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.15: Allows caster to enchant an item so that once per day, the item may reroll any failed breakage roll. If this spell is cast multiple times per day while enchanting an item, one reroll may be made each day per casting of this spell.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.16: Allows caster to enchant a shield that allows the bearer to perform a full Block by Concentrating (normally requires 4 AP) or a body armor that allows the wearer to do a full Dodge at the cost of Concentrating (rather than 4 AP).
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.17: As Crit Negation I, except chance is 20%.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.18: Allows caster to enchant body armor so that the wearer is treated as being one Size larger when determining the effects of attacks on the wearer (e.g., a Medium wearer would be treated as Big for defensive purposes).
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.19: Allows caster to enchant an armor piece (or set of pieces) so that any weapon which inflicts a critical to the area protected by that armor must make a breakage roll. A shield may also be enchanted with this spell. In that case, the breakage roll is made when the shield prevents a hit (i.e., when the attack misses, but it would have hit if not for the DB from the shield) or when the shield is deliberately struck.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.20: As Crit Negation I, except chance is 25%.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.25: As Armor I, except a bonus or penalty reduction of 20.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.30: As Crit Negation I, except chance is 30%.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.35: Allows caster to enchant body armor so that the wearer is treated as being two Sizes larger when determining the effects of attacks on the wearer (e.g., a Small wearer would be treated as Big for defensive purposes).
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.40: As Crit Negation I, except chance is 40%.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.50: As Armor I, except a bonus or penalty reduction of 25.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.60: As Crit Negation I, except chance is 50%.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.75: As Armor I, except a bonus or penalty reduction of 30.
ARMOR ENCHANTMENT.90: As Crit Negation I, except chance is 75%.
